verses.textZh: 耶和华呼叫摩西，从会幕里对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华呼叫摩西，从会幕里对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华从会幕中呼叫摩西，对他说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting. He said,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord called Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord called to Moses, and spoke to him from the tabernacle of meeting, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord called to Moses from the Tabernacle and said to him,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting. He said,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人说：如果你们中间有人把供物献给耶和华，就要从牛群羊群中献家畜为供物。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人说：如果你们中间有人把供物献给耶和华，就要从牛群羊群中献家畜为供物。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们中间若有人献供物给耶和华，要从牛群羊群中献牲畜为供物。
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When anyone among you brings an offering to the Lord , bring as your offering an animal from either the herd or the flock.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, When any one of you brings an offering to the Lord , you shall bring your offering of livestock from the herd or from the flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When any one of you brings an offering to the Lord, you shall bring your offering of the livestock—of the herd and of the flock.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. When you present an animal as an offering to the Lord , you may take it from your herd of cattle or your flock of sheep and goats.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When anyone of you brings an offering to the Lord, you shall bring your offering of livestock from the herd or the flock.
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When anyone among you brings an offering to the Lord , bring as your offering an animal from either the herd or the flock.

verses.textZh: 他的供物若是献牛作燔祭，就要把一头没有残疾的公牛，牵到会幕门口，就可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的供物若是献牛作燔祭，就要把一头没有残疾的公牛，牵到会幕门口，就可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他的供物若以牛为燔祭，就要在会幕门口献一只没有残疾的公牛，可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, you are to offer a male without defect. You must present it at the entrance to the tent of meeting so that it will be acceptable to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without blemish. He shall bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting, that he may be accepted before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If his offering is a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish; he shall offer it of his own free will at the door of the tabernacle of meeting before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "If the animal you present as a burnt offering is from the herd, it must be a male with no defects. Bring it to the entrance of the Tabernacle so you may be accepted by the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect; he shall offer it at the doorway of the tent of meeting, so that he may be accepted before the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, you are to offer a male without defect. You must present it at the entrance to the tent of meeting so that it will be acceptable to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他要按手在燔祭牲的头上，燔祭就蒙悦纳，可以为他赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要按手在燔祭牲的头上，燔祭就蒙悦纳，可以为他赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要按手在燔祭牲的头上，燔祭便蒙悦纳，为他赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to lay your hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on your behalf to make atonement for you.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall put his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.
verses.textEnNlt: Lay your hand on the animal’s head, and the Lord will accept its death in your place to purify you, making you right with him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, so that it may be accepted for him to make atonement on his behalf.
verses.textEn: You are to lay your hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on your behalf to make atonement for you.

verses.textZh: 他要在耶和华面前宰杀那公牛，亚伦子孙作祭司的，要奉上血，泼在会幕门口祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要在耶和华面前宰杀那公牛，亚伦子孙作祭司的，要奉上血，泼在会幕门口祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要在耶和华面前宰公牛；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要奉上血，把血洒在会幕门口、坛的周围。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to slaughter the young bull before the Lord , and then Aaron’s sons the priests shall bring the blood and splash it against the sides of the altar at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he shall kill the bull before the Lord , and Aaron’s sons the priests shall bring the blood and throw the blood against the sides of the altar that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall kill the bull before the Lord; and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood and sprinkle the blood all around on the altar that isby the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Then slaughter the young bull in the Lord ’s presence, and Aaron’s sons, the priests, will present the animal’s blood by splattering it against all sides of the altar that stands at the entrance to the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall slaughter the bull before the Lord; and Aaron’s sons the priests shall offer up the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: You are to slaughter the young bull before the Lord , and then Aaron’s sons the priests shall bring the blood and splash it against the sides of the altar at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 那人要剥去燔祭牲的皮，把燔祭牲切成块子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人要剥去燔祭牲的皮，把燔祭牲切成块子。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人要剥去燔祭牲的皮，把燔祭牲切成块子。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he shall flay the burnt offering and cut it into pieces,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into its pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: Then skin the animal and cut it into pieces.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall then skin the burnt offering and cut it into its pieces.
verses.textEn: You are to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

verses.textZh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把炭火放在祭坛上，把柴排列在火上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把炭火放在祭坛上，把柴排列在火上；
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司亚伦的子孙要把火放在坛上，把柴摆在火上。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Aaron the priest are to put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: and the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay the wood in order on the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Aaron the priest will build a wood fire on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
verses.textEn: The sons of Aaron the priest are to put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

verses.textZh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把肉块和头，以及脂肪，排列在祭坛炭火上的木柴上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把肉块和头，以及脂肪，排列在祭坛炭火上的木柴上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把肉块和头并脂油摆在坛上火的柴上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron’s sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, the head, and the fat, on the wood that is on the fire on the altar;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire upon the altar;
verses.textEnNlt: They will arrange the pieces of the offering, including the head and fat, on the wood burning on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, with the head and the suet, on the wood which is on the fire that is on the altar.
verses.textEn: Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.

verses.textZh: 那人又要用水洗净内脏和腿；祭司就把这一切全献在祭坛上焚烧，作为燔祭，就是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人又要用水洗净内脏和腿；祭司就把这一切全献在祭坛上焚烧，作为燔祭，就是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 但燔祭的脏腑与腿要用水洗。祭司就要把一切全烧在坛上，当作燔祭，献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to wash the internal organs and the legs with water, and the priest is to burn all of it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: but its entrails and its legs he shall wash with water. And the priest shall burn all of it on the altar, as a burnt offering, a food offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: but he shall wash its entrails and its legs with water. And the priest shall burn all on the altar as a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But the internal organs and the legs must first be washed with water. Then the priest will burn the entire sacrifice on the altar as a burnt offering. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Its entrails, however, and its legs he shall wash with water. And the priest shall offer all of it up in smoke on the altar as a burnt offering, an offering by fire as a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: You are to wash the internal organs and the legs with water, and the priest is to burn all of it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "人的供物若是献羊作燔祭，不论是绵羊或是山羊，总要献一只没有残疾的公羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人的供物若是献羊作燔祭，不论是绵羊或是山羊，总要献一只没有残疾的公羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人的供物若以绵羊或山羊为燔祭，就要献上没有残疾的公羊。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If the offering is a burnt offering from the flock, from either the sheep or the goats, you are to offer a male without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: "If his gift for a burnt offering is from the flock, from the sheep or goats, he shall bring a male without blemish,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If his offering is of the flocks—of the sheep or of the goats—as a burnt sacrifice, he shall bring a male without blemish.
verses.textEnNlt: "If the animal you present as a burnt offering is from the flock, it may be either a sheep or a goat, but it must be a male with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But if his offering is from the flock, either from the sheep or from the goats, as a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.
verses.textEn: " ‘If the offering is a burnt offering from the flock, from either the sheep or the goats, you are to offer a male without defect.

verses.textZh: 他要在耶和华面前，在祭坛的北面，把羊宰杀；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把羊血泼在祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要在耶和华面前，在祭坛的北面，把羊宰杀；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把羊血泼在祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把羊宰于坛的北边，在耶和华面前；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把羊血洒在坛的周围。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to slaughter it at the north side of the altar before the Lord , and Aaron’s sons the priests shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: and he shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the Lord , and Aaron’s sons the priests shall throw its blood against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the Lord; and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Slaughter the animal on the north side of the altar in the Lord ’s presence, and Aaron’s sons, the priests, will splatter its blood against all sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall slaughter it on the side of the altar northward before the Lord, and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
verses.textEn: You are to slaughter it at the north side of the altar before the Lord , and Aaron’s sons the priests shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.textZh: 那人要把燔祭牲切成块子；祭司就把肉块、头和脂肪，排列在祭坛炭火上的木柴上面；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人要把燔祭牲切成块子；祭司就把肉块、头和脂肪，排列在祭坛炭火上的木柴上面；
verses.textZhCuv: 要把燔祭牲切成块子，连头和脂油，祭司就要摆在坛上火的柴上；
verses.textEnNiv: You are to cut it into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall cut it into pieces, with its head and its fat, and the priest shall arrange them on the wood that is on the fire on the altar,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat; and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire upon the altar;
verses.textEnNlt: Then cut the animal in pieces, and the priests will arrange the pieces of the offering, including the head and fat, on the wood burning on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall then cut it into its pieces with its head and its suet, and the priest shall arrange them on the wood which is on the fire that is on the altar.
verses.textEn: You are to cut it into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.

verses.textZh: 那人又要用水洗净内脏和腿，祭司就把这一切全献在祭坛上焚烧，作为燔祭，就是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人又要用水洗净内脏和腿，祭司就把这一切全献在祭坛上焚烧，作为燔祭，就是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 但脏腑与腿要用水洗，祭司就要全然奉献，烧在坛上。这是燔祭，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to wash the internal organs and the legs with water, and the priest is to bring all of them and burn them on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: but the entrails and the legs he shall wash with water. And the priest shall offer all of it and burn it on the altar; it is a burnt offering, a food offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: but he shall wash the entrails and the legs with water. Then the priest shall bring it all and burn it on the altar; it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But the internal organs and the legs must first be washed with water. Then the priest will burn the entire sacrifice on the altar as a burnt offering. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The entrails, however, and the legs he shall wash with water. And the priest shall offer all of it, and offer it up in smoke on the altar; it is a burnt offering, an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: You are to wash the internal organs and the legs with water, and the priest is to bring all of them and burn them on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "人若是献鸟类为燔祭作耶和华的供物，就要献斑鸠或雏鸽。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人若是献鸟类为燔祭作耶和华的供物，就要献斑鸠或雏鸽。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人奉给耶和华的供物，若以鸟为燔祭，就要献斑鸠或是雏鸽为供物。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If the offering to the Lord is a burnt offering of birds, you are to offer a dove or a young pigeon.
verses.textEnEsv: "If his offering to the Lord is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves or pigeons.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if the burnt sacrifice of his offering to the Lordis of birds, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves or young pigeons.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you present a bird as a burnt offering to the Lord , choose either a turtledove or a young pigeon.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But if his offering to the Lord is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall bring his offering from the turtledoves or from young doves.
verses.textEn: " ‘If the offering to the Lord is a burnt offering of birds, you are to offer a dove or a young pigeon.

verses.textZh: 祭司要把鸟带到祭坛那里，扭下牠的头来，焚烧在祭坛上；又把鸟血挤出来，流在祭坛的壁上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要把鸟带到祭坛那里，扭下牠的头来，焚烧在祭坛上；又把鸟血挤出来，流在祭坛的壁上；
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要把鸟拿到坛前，揪下头来，把鸟烧在坛上；鸟的血要流在坛的旁边；
verses.textEnNiv: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off the head and burn it on the altar; its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall bring it to the altar and wring off its head and burn it on the altar. Its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; its blood shall be drained out at the side of the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will take the bird to the altar, wring off its head, and burn it on the altar. But first he must drain its blood against the side of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and pinch off its head, and offer it up in smoke on the altar; and its blood is to be drained out on the side of the altar.
verses.textEn: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off the head and burn it on the altar; its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar.

verses.textZh: 又要除掉鸟的嗉囊和脏物，丢在祭坛东边，倒灰的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要除掉鸟的嗉囊和脏物，丢在祭坛东边，倒灰的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把鸟的嗉子和脏物 除掉，丢在坛的东边倒灰的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: He is to remove the crop and the feathers and throw them down east of the altar where the ashes are.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall remove its crop with its contents and cast it beside the altar on the east side, in the place for ashes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall remove its crop with its feathers and cast it beside the altar on the east side, into the place for ashes.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest must also remove the crop and the feathers and throw them in the ashes on the east side of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall also remove its craw with its feathers and throw it beside the altar eastward, to the place of the fatty ashes.
verses.textEn: He is to remove the crop and the feathers and throw them down east of the altar where the ashes are.

verses.textZh: 然后要拿着两个翅膀把鸟撕裂，只是不可撕断。祭司要把牠放在祭坛，在炭火上的木柴上面焚烧，作为燔祭，就是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后要拿着两个翅膀把鸟撕裂，只是不可撕断。祭司要把牠放在祭坛，在炭火上的木柴上面焚烧，作为燔祭，就是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要拿着鸟的两个翅膀，把鸟撕开，只是不可撕断；祭司要在坛上、在火的柴上焚烧。这是燔祭，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。」
verses.textEnNiv: He shall tear it open by the wings, not dividing it completely, and then the priest shall burn it on the wood that is burning on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He shall tear it open by its wings, but shall not sever it completely. And the priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, a food offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall split it at its wings, but shall not divide it completely; and the priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, grasping the bird by its wings, the priest will tear the bird open, but without tearing it apart. Then he will burn it as a burnt offering on the wood burning on the altar. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall tear it by its wings, but shall not sever it. And the priest shall offer it up in smoke on the altar, on the wood which is on the fire; it is a burnt offering, an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: He shall tear it open by the wings, not dividing it completely, and then the priest shall burn it on the wood that is burning on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "如果有人献素祭为供物给耶和华，他的供物要用细面；他要浇上油，加上乳香，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人献素祭为供物给耶和华，他的供物要用细面；他要浇上油，加上乳香，
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有人献素祭为供物给耶和华，要用细面浇上油，加上乳香，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When anyone brings a grain offering to the Lord , their offering is to be of the finest flour. They are to pour olive oil on it, put incense on it
verses.textEnEsv: "When anyone brings a grain offering as an offering to the Lord , his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘When anyone offers a grain offering to the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour. And he shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you present grain as an offering to the Lord , the offering must consist of choice flour. You are to pour olive oil on it, sprinkle it with frankincense,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now when anyone presents a grain offering as an offering to the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour, and he shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.
verses.textEn: " ‘When anyone brings a grain offering to the Lord , their offering is to be of the finest flour. They are to pour olive oil on it, put incense on it

verses.textZh: 带到亚伦子孙作祭司的那里，祭司就从其中取出一把浇了油的细面，连同所有的乳香，作供物的象征，焚烧在祭坛上，这是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 带到亚伦子孙作祭司的那里，祭司就从其中取出一把浇了油的细面，连同所有的乳香，作供物的象征，焚烧在祭坛上，这是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 带到亚伦子孙作祭司的那里；祭司就要从细面中取出一把来，并取些油和所有的乳香，然后要把所取的这些作为纪念，烧在坛上，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: and take it to Aaron’s sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests. And he shall take from it a handful of the fine flour and oil, with all of its frankincense, and the priest shall burn this as its memorial portion on the altar, a food offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests, one of whom shall take from it his handful of fine flour and oil with all the frankincense. And the priest shall burn itas a memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: and bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. The priest will scoop out a handful of the flour moistened with oil, together with all the frankincense, and burn this representative portion on the altar. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He shall then bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests; and he shall take from it his handful of its fine flour and of its oil, with all of its frankincense. And the priest shall offer it up in smoke as its memorial portion on the altar, an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: and take it to Aaron’s sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 祭余剩的，要归给亚伦和他的子孙；这是献给耶和华的火祭中至圣之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭余剩的，要归给亚伦和他的子孙；这是献给耶和华的火祭中至圣之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 素祭所剩的要归给亚伦和他的子孙；这是献与耶和华的火祭中为至圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the food offerings presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But the rest of the grain offering shall be for Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the Lord ’s food offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rest of the grain offering shallbe Aaron’s and his sons’. Itis most holy of the offerings to the Lord made by fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the grain offering will then be given to Aaron and his sons. This offering will be considered a most holy part of the special gifts presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The remainder of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons: a most holy part of the offerings to the Lord by fire.
verses.textEn: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the food offerings presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "如果你献炉里烤的物作素祭的供物，就要用细面调油所做的无酵饼，或是抹上油的无酵薄饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你献炉里烤的物作素祭的供物，就要用细面调油所做的无酵饼，或是抹上油的无酵薄饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若用炉中烤的物为素祭，就要用调油的无酵细面饼，或是抹油的无酵薄饼。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If you bring a grain offering baked in an oven, it is to consist of the finest flour: either thick loaves made without yeast and with olive oil mixed in or thin loaves made without yeast and brushed with olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you bring a grain offering baked in the oven as an offering, it shall be unleavened loaves of fine flour mixed with oil or unleavened wafers smeared with oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if you bring as an offering a grain offering baked in the oven, itshallbe unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.textEnNlt: "If your offering is a grain offering baked in an oven, it must be made of choice flour, but without any yeast. It may be presented in the form of thin cakes mixed with olive oil or wafers spread with olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now when you bring an offering of a grain offering baked in an oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers spread with oil.
verses.textEn: " ‘If you bring a grain offering baked in an oven, it is to consist of the finest flour: either thick loaves made without yeast and with olive oil mixed in or thin loaves made without yeast and brushed with olive oil.

verses.textZh: 你的供物若是用煎盘上做的物作素祭，就要用调油的无酵细面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的供物若是用煎盘上做的物作素祭，就要用调油的无酵细面。
verses.textZhCuv: 若用铁鏊上做的物为素祭，就要用调油的无酵细面，
verses.textEnNiv: If your grain offering is prepared on a griddle, it is to be made of the finest flour mixed with oil, and without yeast.
verses.textEnEsv: And if your offering is a grain offering baked on a griddle, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mixed with oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if your offering is a grain offering baked in a pan, itshallbeof fine flour, unleavened, mixed with oil.
verses.textEnNlt: If your grain offering is cooked on a griddle, it must be made of choice flour mixed with olive oil but without any yeast.
verses.textEnNasb: And if your offering is a grain offering made on the griddle, it shall be of fine flour, unleavened, mixed with oil;
verses.textEn: If your grain offering is prepared on a griddle, it is to be made of the finest flour mixed with oil, and without yeast.

verses.textZh: 你要把它擘成碎块，浇上油；这是素祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把它擘成碎块，浇上油；这是素祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 分成块子，浇上油；这是素祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall break it in pieces and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall break it in pieces and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Break it in pieces and pour olive oil on it; it is a grain offering.
verses.textEnNasb: you shall break it into bits and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.
verses.textEn: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

verses.textZh: 你若是用浅锅中煎的物作素祭的供物，就要用细面调油做成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若是用浅锅中煎的物作素祭的供物，就要用细面调油做成。
verses.textZhCuv: 若用煎盘做的物为素祭，就要用油与细面做成。
verses.textEnNiv: If your grain offering is cooked in a pan, it is to be made of the finest flour and some olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: And if your offering is a grain offering cooked in a pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If your offering is a grain offering baked in a covered pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.textEnNlt: If your grain offering is prepared in a pan, it must be made of choice flour and olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if your offering is a grain offering made in a pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.textEn: If your grain offering is cooked in a pan, it is to be made of the finest flour and some olive oil.

verses.textZh: 你要把这些东西做好，作献给耶和华的素祭，奉给祭司，让他带到祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这些东西做好，作献给耶和华的素祭，奉给祭司，让他带到祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把这些东西做的素祭带到耶和华面前，并奉给祭司，带到坛前。
verses.textEnNiv: Bring the grain offering made of these things to the Lord ; present it to the priest, who shall take it to the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall bring the grain offering that is made of these things to the Lord , and when it is presented to the priest, he shall bring it to the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall bring the grain offering that is made of these things to the Lord. And when it is presented to the priest, he shall bring it to the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: "No matter how a grain offering for the Lord has been prepared, bring it to the priest, who will present it at the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: When you bring in the grain offering which is made of these things to the Lord, it shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.
verses.textEn: Bring the grain offering made of these things to the Lord ; present it to the priest, who shall take it to the altar.

verses.textZh: 祭司要从素祭中举起象征的部分，焚烧在祭坛上，作献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要从素祭中举起象征的部分，焚烧在祭坛上，作献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要从素祭中取出作为纪念的，烧在坛上，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: He shall take out the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall take from the grain offering its memorial portion and burn this on the altar, a food offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall take from the grain offering a memorial portion, and burn it on the altar. Itis an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will take a representative portion of the grain offering and burn it on the altar. It is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The priest then shall take up from the grain offering its memorial portion, and shall offer it up in smoke on the altar as an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: He shall take out the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 素祭余剩的，要归给亚伦和他的子孙；这是献给耶和华的火祭中至圣之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 素祭余剩的，要归给亚伦和他的子孙；这是献给耶和华的火祭中至圣之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 素祭所剩的要归给亚伦和他的子孙。这是献与耶和华的火祭中为至圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the food offerings presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But the rest of the grain offering shall be for Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the Lord ’s food offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: And what is left of the grain offering shallbe Aaron’s and his sons’. Itis most holy of the offerings to the Lord made by fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the grain offering will then be given to Aaron and his sons as their food. This offering will be considered a most holy part of the special gifts presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The remainder of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons: a most holy part of the offerings to the Lord by fire.
verses.textEn: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the food offerings presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们献给耶和华的一切素祭，都不可发酵，因为任何酵与蜜，你们都不可焚烧作献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们献给耶和华的一切素祭，都不可发酵，因为任何酵与蜜，你们都不可焚烧作献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡献给耶和华的素祭都不可有酵；因为你们不可烧一点酵、一点蜜当作火祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Every grain offering you bring to the Lord must be made without yeast, for you are not to burn any yeast or honey in a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "No grain offering that you bring to the Lord shall be made with leaven, for you shall burn no leaven nor any honey as a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘No grain offering which you bring to the Lord shall be made with leaven, for you shall burn no leaven nor any honey in any offering to the Lord made by fire.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not use yeast in preparing any of the grain offerings you present to the Lord , because no yeast or honey may be burned as a special gift presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘No grain offering, which you bring to the Lord, shall be made with leaven, for you shall not offer up in smoke any leaven or any honey as an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Every grain offering you bring to the Lord must be made without yeast, for you are not to burn any yeast or honey in a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们可以把它们献给耶和华作初熟的供物；只是不可烧在祭坛上，作馨香的祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们可以把它们献给耶和华作初熟的供物；只是不可烧在祭坛上，作馨香的祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些物要献给耶和华作为初熟的供物，只是不可在坛上献为馨香的祭。
verses.textEnNiv: You may bring them to the Lord as an offering of the firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.
verses.textEnEsv: As an offering of firstfruits you may bring them to the Lord , but they shall not be offered on the altar for a pleasing aroma.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the offering of the firstfruits, you shall offer them to the Lord, but they shall not be burned on the altar for a sweet aroma.
verses.textEnNlt: You may add yeast and honey to an offering of the first crops of your harvest, but these must never be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: As an offering of first fruits you shall bring them to the Lord, but they shall not ascend as a soothing aroma on the altar.
verses.textEn: You may bring them to the Lord as an offering of the firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.

verses.textZh: 你献作素祭的一切供物，都要用盐调和；在你的素祭上，不可缺少你神立约的盐；你的一切供物，都要用盐调和献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你献作素祭的一切供物，都要用盐调和；在你的素祭上，不可缺少你神立约的盐；你的一切供物，都要用盐调和献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡献为素祭的供物都要用盐调和，在素祭上不可缺了你神立约的盐。一切的供物都要配盐而献。
verses.textEnNiv: Season all your grain offerings with salt. Do not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offerings; add salt to all your offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall season all your grain offerings with salt. You shall not let the salt of the covenant with your God be missing from your grain offering; with all your offerings you shall offer salt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And every offering of your grain offering you shall season with salt; you shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your grain offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.
verses.textEnNlt: Season all your grain offerings with salt to remind you of God’s eternal covenant. Never forget to add salt to your grain offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: Every grain offering of yours, moreover, you shall season with salt, so that the salt of the covenant of your God will not be lacking from your grain offering; with all your offerings you shall offer salt.
verses.textEn: Season all your grain offerings with salt. Do not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offerings; add salt to all your offerings.

verses.textZh: "如果你把初熟之物作素祭献给耶和华，就要献上烘过的新麦穗，就是碾过的新谷粒，作素祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你把初熟之物作素祭献给耶和华，就要献上烘过的新麦穗，就是碾过的新谷粒，作素祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 若向耶和华献初熟之物为素祭，要献上烘了的禾穗子，就是轧了的新穗子，当作初熟之物的素祭。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the Lord , offer crushed heads of new grain roasted in the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: "If you offer a grain offering of firstfruits to the Lord , you shall offer for the grain offering of your firstfruits fresh ears, roasted with fire, crushed new grain.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If you offer a grain offering of your firstfruits to the Lord, you shall offer for the grain offering of your firstfruits green heads of grain roasted on the fire, grain beaten from full heads.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you present a grain offering to the Lord from the first portion of your harvest, bring fresh grain that is coarsely ground and roasted on a fire.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Also if you bring a grain offering of early ripened things to the Lord, you shall bring fresh heads of grain roasted in the fire, crushed grain of new growth, for the grain offering of your early ripened produce.
verses.textEn: " ‘If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the Lord , offer crushed heads of new grain roasted in the fire.

verses.textZh: 你要浇上油，加上乳香，这是素祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要浇上油，加上乳香，这是素祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 并要抹上油，加上乳香；这是素祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Put oil and incense on it; it is a grain offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall put oil on it, and lay frankincense on it. It is a grain offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Put olive oil on this grain offering, and sprinkle it with frankincense.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall then put oil on it and place incense on it; it is a grain offering.
verses.textEn: Put oil and incense on it; it is a grain offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司要把供物的象征部分，就是一部分碾过的麦粒和油，连同所有的乳香，一起焚烧，作献给耶和华的火祭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要把供物的象征部分，就是一部分碾过的麦粒和油，连同所有的乳香，一起焚烧，作献给耶和华的火祭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要把其中作为纪念的，就是一些轧了的禾穗子和一些油，并所有的乳香，都焚烧，是向耶和华献的火祭。」
verses.textEnNiv: The priest shall burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all the incense, as a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall burn as its memorial portion some of the crushed grain and some of the oil with all of its frankincense; it is a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall burn the memorial portion: part of its beaten grain and part of its oil, with all the frankincense, as an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will take a representative portion of the grain moistened with oil, together with all the frankincense, and burn it as a special gift presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest shall offer up in smoke its memorial portion, part of its crushed grain and its oil with all its incense as an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The priest shall burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all the incense, as a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "人的供物若是作平安祭，如果献的是牛，必须在耶和华面前献一头没有残疾的公牛或母牛；
verses.textZhCnvs: "人的供物若是作平安祭，如果献的是牛，必须在耶和华面前献一头没有残疾的公牛或母牛；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人献供物为平安祭 ，若是从牛群中献，无论是公的是母的，必用没有残疾的献在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If your offering is a fellowship offering, and you offer an animal from the herd, whether male or female, you are to present before the Lord an animal without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: "If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offers an animal from the herd, male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘When his offering is a sacrifice of a peace offering, if he offers it of the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you present an animal from the herd as a peace offering to the Lord , it may be a male or a female, but it must have no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he is going to offer from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘If your offering is a fellowship offering, and you offer an animal from the herd, whether male or female, you are to present before the Lord an animal without defect.

verses.textZh: 他要按手在他的供物的头上，在会幕门口宰杀牠；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把血泼在祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要按手在他的供物的头上，在会幕门口宰杀牠；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把血泼在祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要按手在供物的头上，宰于会幕门口。亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把血洒在坛的周围。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to lay your hand on the head of your offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall splash the blood against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and kill it at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and Aaron’s sons the priests shall throw the blood against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of meeting; and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood all around on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Lay your hand on the animal’s head, and slaughter it at the entrance of the Tabernacle. Then Aaron’s sons, the priests, will splatter its blood against all sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the doorway of the tent of meeting, and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
verses.textEn: You are to lay your hand on the head of your offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall splash the blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.textZh: 他要从平安祭中奉上献给耶和华的火祭，就是把遮盖内脏的脂肪，和内脏上的一切脂肪，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要从平安祭中奉上献给耶和华的火祭，就是把遮盖内脏的脂肪，和内脏上的一切脂肪，
verses.textZhCuv: 从平安祭中，将火祭献给耶和华，也要把盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，
verses.textEnNiv: From the fellowship offering you are to bring a food offering to the Lord : the internal organs and all the fat that is connected to them,
verses.textEnEsv: And from the sacrifice of the peace offering, as a food offering to the Lord , he shall offer the fat covering the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人说：如果有人在耶和华吩咐不可行的事上无意犯了罪，他必须遵行以下条例中的一样：
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人说：如果有人在耶和华吩咐不可行的事上无意犯了罪，他必须遵行以下条例中的一样：
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：若有人在耶和华所吩咐不可行的什么事上误犯了一件，
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘When anyone sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands—
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, saying, If anyone sins unintentionally in any of the Lord ’s commandments about things not to be done, and does any one of them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘If a person sins unintentionally against any of the commandments of the Lord in anything which ought not to be done, and does any of them,
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. This is how you are to deal with those who sin unintentionally by doing anything that violates one of the Lord ’s commands.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘If a person sins unintentionally in any of the things which the Lord has commanded not to be done, and commits any of them,
verses.textEn: "Say to the Israelites: ‘When anyone sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands—

verses.textEnNiv: He is to dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the Lord , in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle part of the blood seven times before the Lord in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the Lord, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the Lord in front of the inner curtain of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the Lord, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: He is to dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the Lord , in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 然后祭司要用血抹会幕里耶和华面前的香坛的四角；至于其余的牛血，都要倒在会幕门口的燔祭坛脚那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后祭司要用血抹会幕里耶和华面前的香坛的四角；至于其余的牛血，都要倒在会幕门口的燔祭坛脚那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把些血抹在会幕内、耶和华面前香坛的四角上，再把公牛所有的血倒在会幕门口、燔祭坛的脚那里。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest shall then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the Lord in the tent of meeting. The rest of the bull’s blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense before the Lord that is in the tent of meeting, and all the rest of the blood of the bull he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of meeting; and he shall pour the remaining blood of the bull at the base of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar for fragrant incense that stands in the Lord ’s presence inside the Tabernacle. He will pour out the rest of the bull’s blood at the base of the altar for burnt offerings at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall also put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense which is before the Lord in the tent of meeting; and all the rest of the blood of the bull he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: The priest shall then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the Lord in the tent of meeting. The rest of the bull’s blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 他要取出赎罪祭的公牛所有的脂肪，就是遮盖内脏的脂肪和内脏上的一切脂肪，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要取出赎罪祭的公牛所有的脂肪，就是遮盖内脏的脂肪和内脏上的一切脂肪，

verses.textEnNiv: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—all the fat that is connected to the internal organs,
verses.textEnEsv: And all the fat of the bull of the sin offering he shall remove from it, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall take from it all the fat of the bull as the sin offering. The fat that covers the entrails and all the fat which is on the entrails,

verses.textEnNasb: And he shall remove from it all the fat of the bull of the sin offering: the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat which is on the entrails,
verses.textEn: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—all the fat that is connected to the internal organs,

verses.textEnNiv: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys—
verses.textEnEsv: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins and the long lobe of the liver that he shall remove with the kidneys
verses.textEnNkjv: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove,
verses.textEnNlt: the two kidneys and the fat around them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver. He must remove these along with the kidneys,
verses.textEnNasb: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys
verses.textEn: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys—

verses.textZh: 正如从平安祭的公牛取出来的一样。祭司要把这些焚烧在燔祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如从平安祭的公牛取出来的一样。祭司要把这些焚烧在燔祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 与平安祭公牛上所取的一样；祭司要把这些烧在燔祭的坛上。
verses.textEnNiv: just as the fat is removed from the ox sacrificed as a fellowship offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: (just as these are taken from the ox of the sacrifice of the peace offerings); and the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: as it was taken from the bull of the sacrifice of the peace offering; and the priest shall burn them on the altar of the burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: just as he does with cattle offered as a peace offering, and burn them on the altar of burnt offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: (just as it is removed from the ox of the sacrifice of peace offerings); and the priest is to offer them up in smoke on the altar of burnt offering.
verses.textEn: just as the fat is removed from the ox sacrificed as a fellowship offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 至于公牛的皮和所有的肉，连头带腿，以及内脏和粪，
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于公牛的皮和所有的肉，连头带腿，以及内脏和粪，
verses.textZhCuv: 公牛的皮和所有的肉，并头、腿、脏、腑、粪，
verses.textEnNiv: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, as well as the head and legs, the internal organs and the intestines—
verses.textEnEsv: But the skin of the bull and all its flesh, with its head, its legs, its entrails, and its dung—
verses.textEnNkjv: But the bull’s hide and all its flesh, with its head and legs, its entrails and offal—
verses.textEnNlt: But he must take whatever is left of the bull—its hide, meat, head, legs, internal organs, and dung—
verses.textEnNasb: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, along with its head, its legs, its entrails, and its refuse,
verses.textEn: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, as well as the head and legs, the internal organs and the intestines—

verses.textZh: 就是整头公牛，要搬到营外洁净的地方，倒坛灰的地方，放在柴上用火焚烧，就在倒坛灰的地方焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是整头公牛，要搬到营外洁净的地方，倒坛灰的地方，放在柴上用火焚烧，就在倒坛灰的地方焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是全公牛，要搬到营外洁净之地、倒灰之所，用火烧在柴上。
verses.textEnNiv: that is, all the rest of the bull—he must take outside the camp to a place ceremonially clean, where the ashes are thrown, and burn it there in a wood fire on the ash heap.
verses.textEnEsv: all the rest of the bull—he shall carry outside the camp to a clean place, to the ash heap, and shall burn it up on a fire of wood. On the ash heap it shall be burned up.
verses.textEnNkjv: the whole bull he shall carry outside the camp to a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire; where the ashes are poured out it shall be burned.
verses.textEnNlt: and carry it away to a place outside the camp that is ceremonially clean, the place where the ashes are dumped. There, on the ash heap, he will burn it on a wood fire.
verses.textEnNasb: that is, all the rest of the bull, he is to bring out to a clean place outside the camp where the fatty ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire; where the fatty ashes are poured out it shall be burned.
verses.textEn: that is, all the rest of the bull—he must take outside the camp to a place ceremonially clean, where the ashes are thrown, and burn it there in a wood fire on the ash heap.

verses.textZh: "如果以色列全体会众无意犯罪，是隐而未现、会众看不出来的，但他们行了一件耶和华吩咐不可行的事，他们就有罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果以色列全体会众无意犯罪，是隐而未现、会众看不出来的，但他们行了一件耶和华吩咐不可行的事，他们就有罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列全会众若行了耶和华所吩咐不可行的什么事，误犯了罪，是隐而未现、会众看不出来的，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If the whole Israelite community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, even though the community is unaware of the matter, when they realize their guilt
verses.textEnEsv: "If the whole congregation of Israel sins unintentionally and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they do any one of the things that by the Lord ’s commandments ought not to be done, and they realize their guilt,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Now if the whole congregation of Israel sins unintentionally, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done something against any of the commandments of the Lord in anything which should not be done, and are guilty;
verses.textEnNlt: "If the entire Israelite community sins by violating one of the Lord ’s commands, but the people don’t realize it, they are still guilty.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if the entire congregation of Israel does wrong unintentionally and the matter escapes the notice of the assembly, and they commit any of the things which the Lord has commanded not to be done, and they become guilty;
verses.textEn: " ‘If the whole Israelite community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, even though the community is unaware of the matter, when they realize their guilt

verses.textEnNkjv: when the sin which they have committed becomes known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for the sin, and bring it before the tabernacle of meeting.

verses.textEnNasb: when the sin which they have committed becomes known, then the assembly shall offer a bull of the herd as a sin offering and bring it in front of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: and the sin they committed becomes known, the assembly must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the tent of meeting.

verses.textEnNkjv: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the Lord. Then the bull shall be killed before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The elders of the community must then lay their hands on the bull’s head and slaughter it before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the Lord, and the bull shall be slaughtered before the Lord.
verses.textEn: The elders of the community are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the Lord , and the bull shall be slaughtered before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 处理这公牛与处理大祭司的赎罪祭公牛一样，要按同一条例执行。祭司为他们赎了罪，他们就蒙赦免。

verses.textZhCuv: 收拾这牛，与那赎罪祭的牛一样。祭司要为他们赎罪，他们必蒙赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: and do with this bull just as he did with the bull for the sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the community, and they will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus shall he do with the bull. As he did with the bull of the sin offering, so shall he do with this. And the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall do with the bull as he did with the bull as a sin offering; thus he shall do with it. So the priest shall make atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
verses.textEnNlt: just as he does with the bull offered as a sin offering for the high priest. Through this process, the priest will purify the people, making them right with the Lord , and they will be forgiven.

verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is a sin offering for the assembly.

verses.textEnNasb: Then he is to bring the bull out to a place outside the camp and burn it just as he burned the first bull; it is the sin offering for the assembly.

verses.textEnNiv: He is to lay his hand on the goat’s head and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the Lord . It is a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: and shall lay his hand on the head of the goat and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the Lord ; it is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it at the place where they kill the burnt offering before the Lord. It is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: He must lay his hand on the goat’s head and slaughter it at the place where burnt offerings are slaughtered before the Lord . This is an offering for his sin.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the male goat and slaughter it in the place where they slaughter the burnt offering before the Lord; it is a sin offering.
verses.textEn: He is to lay his hand on the goat’s head and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the Lord . It is a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司要用指头取赎罪祭牲的一些血，抹燔祭坛的四角，其余的血要倒在燔祭坛脚那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要用指头取赎罪祭牲的一些血，抹燔祭坛的四角，其余的血要倒在燔祭坛脚那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要用指头蘸些赎罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭坛的四角上，把血倒在燔祭坛的脚那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the priest will dip his finger in the blood of the sin offering and put it on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings. He will pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.textEn: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

verses.textZh: 公羊所有的脂肪，都要焚烧在祭坛上，好象平安祭的脂肪一样；祭司为他赎了罪，他就蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公羊所有的脂肪，都要焚烧在祭坛上，好象平安祭的脂肪一样；祭司为他赎了罪，他就蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 所有的脂油，祭司都要烧在坛上，正如平安祭的脂油一样。至于他的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: He shall burn all the fat on the altar as he burned the fat of the fellowship offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the leader’s sin, and he will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: And all its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings. So the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall burn all its fat on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of the peace offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he must burn all the goat’s fat on the altar, just as he does with the peace offering. Through this process, the priest will purify the leader from his sin, making him right with the Lord , and he will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall offer all its fat up in smoke on the altar as in the case of the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings. So the priest shall make atonement for him regarding his sin, and he will be forgiven.
verses.textEn: He shall burn all the fat on the altar as he burned the fat of the fellowship offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the leader’s sin, and he will be forgiven.

verses.textZh: "如果那地的居民中有人无意犯了罪，行了一件耶和华吩咐不可行的事，他就有罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果那地的居民中有人无意犯了罪，行了一件耶和华吩咐不可行的事，他就有罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 「民中若有人行了耶和华所吩咐不可行的什么事，误犯了罪，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If any member of the community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, when they realize their guilt
verses.textEnEsv: "If anyone of the common people sins unintentionally in doing any one of the things that by the Lord ’s commandments ought not to be done, and realizes his guilt,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If anyone of the common people sins unintentionally by doing something against any of the commandments of the Lord in anything which ought not to be done, and is guilty,
verses.textEnNlt: "If any of the common people sin by violating one of the Lord ’s commands, but they don’t realize it, they are still guilty.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if anyone of the common people sins unintentionally by doing any of the things which the Lord has commanded not to be done, and becomes guilty,
verses.textEn: " ‘If any member of the community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, when they realize their guilt

verses.textZh: 他一发觉犯了罪，就要为自己所犯的罪，牵一只没有残疾的母山羊作供物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一发觉犯了罪，就要为自己所犯的罪，牵一只没有残疾的母山羊作供物。
verses.textZhCuv: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要为所犯的罪牵一只没有残疾的母山羊为供物，
verses.textEnNiv: and the sin they have committed becomes known, they must bring as their offering for the sin they committed a female goat without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: or the sin which he has committed is made known to him, he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without blemish, for his sin which he has committed.
verses.textEnNkjv: or if his sin which he has committed comes to his knowledge, then he shall bring as his offering a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he has committed.
verses.textEnNlt: When they become aware of their sin, they must bring as an offering for their sin a female goat with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: if his sin which he has committed is made known to him, then he shall bring as his offering a goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has committed.
verses.textEn: and the sin they have committed becomes known, they must bring as their offering for the sin they committed a female goat without defect.

verses.textZh: 他要按手在赎罪祭牲的头上，然后在宰燔祭牲的地方，宰杀赎罪祭牲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要按手在赎罪祭牲的头上，然后在宰燔祭牲的地方，宰杀赎罪祭牲。
verses.textZhCuv: 按手在赎罪祭牲的头上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to lay their hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering at the place of the burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: They must lay a hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place where burnt offerings are slaughtered.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter the sin offering at the place of the burnt offering.
verses.textEn: They are to lay their hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司要用指头取一些羊血，抹燔祭坛的四角，其余的血都要倒在祭坛脚那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要用指头取一些羊血，抹燔祭坛的四角，其余的血都要倒在祭坛脚那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要用指头蘸些羊的血，抹在燔祭坛的四角上，所有的血都要倒在坛的脚那里，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the priest will dip his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar for burnt offerings. He will pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall then take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.
verses.textEn: Then the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

verses.textZh: 母山羊所有的脂肪都要取出来，好象取出平安祭牲的脂肪一样；然后祭司要把这些焚烧在祭坛上，献给耶和华作馨香的祭。祭司为他赎了罪，他就蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 母山羊所有的脂肪都要取出来，好象取出平安祭牲的脂肪一样；然后祭司要把这些焚烧在祭坛上，献给耶和华作馨香的祭。祭司为他赎了罪，他就蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把羊所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭牲的脂油一样。祭司要在坛上焚烧，在耶和华面前作为馨香的祭，为他赎罪，他必蒙赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: They shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord . In this way the priest will make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: And all its fat he shall remove, as the fat is removed from the peace offerings, and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasing aroma to the Lord . And the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall remove all its fat, as fat is removed from the sacrifice of the peace offering; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a sweet aroma to the Lord. So the priest shall make atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he must remove all the goat’s fat, just as he does with the fat of the peace offering. He will burn the fat on the altar, and it will be a pleasing aroma to the Lord . Through this process, the priest will purify the people, making them right with the Lord , and they will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall remove all its fat, just as the fat was removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall offer it up in smoke on the altar as a soothing aroma to the Lord. So the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.
verses.textEn: They shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord . In this way the priest will make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.

verses.textZh: "如果人献一只绵羊羔作赎罪祭的供物，就要牵一只没有残疾的母羊；
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人献一只绵羊羔作赎罪祭的供物，就要牵一只没有残疾的母羊；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若牵一只绵羊羔为赎罪祭的供物，必要牵一只没有残疾的母羊，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If someone brings a lamb as their sin offering, they are to bring a female without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: "If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without blemish
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If he brings a lamb as his sin offering, he shall bring a female without blemish.
verses.textEnNlt: "If the people bring a sheep as their sin offering, it must be a female with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But if he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.
verses.textEn: " ‘If someone brings a lamb as their sin offering, they are to bring a female without defect.

verses.textZhCnvs: 他要按手在赎罪祭牲的头上，然后在宰燔祭牲的地方宰杀牠，作为赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 按手在赎罪祭牲的头上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了作赎罪祭。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to lay their hand on its head and slaughter it for a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.
verses.textEnEsv: and lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it as a sin offering at the place where they kill the burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: They must lay a hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place where burnt offerings are slaughtered.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering in the place where they slaughter the burnt offering.
verses.textEn: They are to lay their hand on its head and slaughter it for a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要用指头取一些赎罪祭牲的血，抹燔祭坛的四角，其余的羊血，都要倒在祭坛脚那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要用指头蘸些赎罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭坛的四角上，所有的血都要倒在坛的脚那里，

verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.
