verses.textZh: 羊所有的脂肪都要取出来，好象取出平安祭绵羊羔的脂肪一样；祭司要把这些放在祭坛耶和华的火祭上面焚烧，祭司为他所犯的罪行赎罪，他就蒙赦免。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊所有的脂肪都要取出来，好象取出平安祭绵羊羔的脂肪一样；祭司要把这些放在祭坛耶和华的火祭上面焚烧，祭司为他所犯的罪行赎罪，他就蒙赦免。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭羊羔的脂油一样。祭司要按献给耶和华火祭的条例，烧在坛上。至于所犯的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。」
verses.textEnNiv: They shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the lamb of the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar on top of the food offerings presented to the Lord . In this way the priest will make atonement for them for the sin they have committed, and they will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: And all its fat he shall remove as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings, and the priest shall burn it on the altar, on top of the Lord ’s food offerings. And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which he has committed, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall remove all its fat, as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of the peace offering. Then the priest shall burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire to the Lord. So the priest shall make atonement for his sin that he has committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he must remove all the sheep’s fat, just as he does with the fat of a sheep presented as a peace offering. He will burn the fat on the altar on top of the special gifts presented to the Lord . Through this process, the priest will purify the people from their sin, making them right with the Lord , and they will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall remove all its fat, just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of the peace offerings, and the priest shall offer it up in smoke on the altar, on the offerings by fire to the Lord. So the priest shall make atonement for him regarding his sin which he has committed, and he will be forgiven.
verses.textEn: They shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the lamb of the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar on top of the food offerings presented to the Lord . In this way the priest will make atonement for them for the sin they have committed, and they will be forgiven.

verses.textZh: "如果有人犯罪：他听见发誓的声音 ；他本是证人，却不肯把看见或知道的说出来，他就要担当自己的罪责。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人犯罪：他听见发誓的声音 ；他本是证人，却不肯把看见或知道的说出来，他就要担当自己的罪责。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有人听见发誓的声音 ，他本是见证，却不把所看见的、所知道的说出来，这就是罪；他要担当他的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If anyone sins because they do not speak up when they hear a public charge to testify regarding something they have seen or learned about, they will be held responsible.
verses.textEnEsv: "If anyone sins in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, and though he is a witness, whether he has seen or come to know the matter, yet does not speak, he shall bear his iniquity;
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If a person sins in hearing the utterance of an oath, and is a witness, whether he has seen or known of the matter—if he does not tell it, he bears guilt.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you are called to testify about something you have seen or that you know about, it is sinful to refuse to testify, and you will be punished for your sin.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if a person sins after he hears a public order to testify when he is a witness, whether he has seen or otherwise known, if he does not tell it, then he will bear his punishment.
verses.textEn: " ‘If anyone sins because they do not speak up when they hear a public charge to testify regarding something they have seen or learned about, they will be held responsible.

verses.textZh: 或人摸了甚么不洁净的东西，无论是不洁净野兽的尸体，或是不洁净牲畜的尸体，或是不洁净昆虫的尸体，当时并不留意，他因为成了不洁净，就有罪了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 或人摸了甚么不洁净的东西，无论是不洁净野兽的尸体，或是不洁净牲畜的尸体，或是不洁净昆虫的尸体，当时并不留意，他因为成了不洁净，就有罪了；
verses.textZhCuv: 或是有人摸了不洁的物，无论是不洁的死兽，是不洁的死畜，是不洁的死虫，他却不知道，因此成了不洁，就有了罪。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If anyone becomes aware that they are guilty—if they unwittingly touch anything ceremonially unclean (whether the carcass of an unclean animal, wild or domestic, or of any unclean creature that moves along the ground) and they are unaware that they have become unclean, but then they come to realize their guilt;
verses.textEnEsv: or if anyone touches an unclean thing, whether a carcass of an unclean wild animal or a carcass of unclean livestock or a carcass of unclean swarming things, and it is hidden from him and he has become unclean, and he realizes his guilt;
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Or if a person touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean beast, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and he is unaware of it, he also shall be unclean and guilty.
verses.textEnNlt: "Or suppose you unknowingly touch something that is ceremonially unclean, such as the carcass of an unclean animal. When you realize what you have done, you must admit your defilement and your guilt. This is true whether it is a wild animal, a domestic animal, or an animal that scurries along the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Or if a person touches any unclean thing, whether a carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean cattle, or a carcass of unclean swarming things, though it is hidden from him and he is unclean, then he will be guilty.
verses.textEn: " ‘If anyone becomes aware that they are guilty—if they unwittingly touch anything ceremonially unclean (whether the carcass of an unclean animal, wild or domestic, or of any unclean creature that moves along the ground) and they are unaware that they have become unclean, but then they come to realize their guilt;

verses.textZh: 或有人摸了人的污秽，他没有留意沾染了甚么污秽；他一知道，就有罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 或有人摸了人的污秽，他没有留意沾染了甚么污秽；他一知道，就有罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 或是他摸了别人的污秽，无论是染了什么污秽，他却不知道，一知道了就有了罪。
verses.textEnNiv: or if they touch human uncleanness (anything that would make them unclean) even though they are unaware of it, but then they learn of it and realize their guilt;
verses.textEnEsv: or if he touches human uncleanness, of whatever sort the uncleanness may be with which one becomes unclean, and it is hidden from him, when he comes to know it, and realizes his guilt;
verses.textEnNkjv: Or if he touches human uncleanness—whatever uncleanness with which a man may be defiled, and he is unaware of it—when he realizes it, then he shall be guilty.
verses.textEnNlt: "Or suppose you unknowingly touch something that makes a person unclean. When you realize what you have done, you must admit your guilt.
verses.textEnNasb: Or if he touches human uncleanness, of whatever sort his uncleanness may be with which he becomes unclean, and it is hidden from him, and then he comes to know it, he will be guilty.
verses.textEn: or if they touch human uncleanness (anything that would make them unclean) even though they are unaware of it, but then they learn of it and realize their guilt;

verses.textZh: 或有人嘴唇轻率发誓，无论是出于恶意或是出于好意，他没有留意起了甚么誓；他一知道，就有罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 或有人嘴唇轻率发誓，无论是出于恶意或是出于好意，他没有留意起了甚么誓；他一知道，就有罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 或是有人嘴里冒失发誓，要行恶，要行善，无论人在什么事上冒失发誓，他却不知道，一知道了就要在这其中的一件上有了罪。
verses.textEnNiv: or if anyone thoughtlessly takes an oath to do anything, whether good or evil (in any matter one might carelessly swear about) even though they are unaware of it, but then they learn of it and realize their guilt—
verses.textEnEsv: or if anyone utters with his lips a rash oath to do evil or to do good, any sort of rash oath that people swear, and it is hidden from him, when he comes to know it, and he realizes his guilt in any of these;
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Or if a person swears, speaking thoughtlessly with his lips to do evil or to do good, whatever it is that a man may pronounce by an oath, and he is unaware of it—when he realizes it, then he shall be guilty in any of these matters.
verses.textEnNlt: "Or suppose you make a foolish vow of any kind, whether its purpose is for good or for bad. When you realize its foolishness, you must admit your guilt.
verses.textEnNasb: Or if a person swears thoughtlessly with his lips to do evil or to do good, in whatever matter people speak thoughtlessly with an oath, and it is hidden from him, and then he comes to know it, he will be guilty of one of these things.
verses.textEn: or if anyone thoughtlessly takes an oath to do anything, whether good or evil (in any matter one might carelessly swear about) even though they are unaware of it, but then they learn of it and realize their guilt—

verses.textZh: 如果他在任何一件事上犯了罪，就要承认自己所犯的罪；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他在任何一件事上犯了罪，就要承认自己所犯的罪；
verses.textZhCuv: 他有了罪的时候，就要承认所犯的罪，
verses.textEnNiv: when anyone becomes aware that they are guilty in any of these matters, they must confess in what way they have sinned.
verses.textEnEsv: when he realizes his guilt in any of these and confesses the sin he has committed,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And it shall be, when he is guilty in any of these matters, that he shall confess that he has sinned in that thing;
verses.textEnNlt: "When you become aware of your guilt in any of these ways, you must confess your sin.
verses.textEnNasb: So it shall be when he becomes guilty of one of these things, that he shall confess that in which he has sinned.
verses.textEn: when anyone becomes aware that they are guilty in any of these matters, they must confess in what way they have sinned.

verses.textZh: 他要为所犯的罪，把赎愆祭带到耶和华面前当作赎罪祭，就是羊群中的母羊，或绵羊羔或山羊；祭司就为他的罪行赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要为所犯的罪，把赎愆祭带到耶和华面前当作赎罪祭，就是羊群中的母羊，或绵羊羔或山羊；祭司就为他的罪行赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 并要因所犯的罪，把他的赎愆祭牲－就是羊群中的母羊，或是一只羊羔，或是一只山羊－牵到耶和华面前为赎罪祭。至于他的罪，祭司要为他赎了。
verses.textEnNiv: As a penalty for the sin they have committed, they must bring to the Lord a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering ; and the priest shall make atonement for them for their sin.
verses.textEnEsv: he shall bring to the Lord as his compensation for the sin that he has committed, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering. And the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he shall bring his trespass offering to the Lord for his sin which he has committed, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats as a sin offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you must bring to the Lord as the penalty for your sin a female from the flock, either a sheep or a goat. This is a sin offering with which the priest will purify you from your sin, making you right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He shall also bring his guilt offering to the Lord for his sin which he has committed, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat as a sin offering. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf for his sin.
verses.textEn: As a penalty for the sin they have committed, they must bring to the Lord a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering ; and the priest shall make atonement for them for their sin.

verses.textZh: "他的经济能力若是不够献一只羊，他就要为所犯的罪，带两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽到耶和华面前作赎愆祭，一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他的经济能力若是不够献一只羊，他就要为所犯的罪，带两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽到耶和华面前作赎愆祭，一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他的力量若不够献一只羊羔，就要因所犯的罪，把两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽带到耶和华面前为赎愆祭：一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Anyone who cannot afford a lamb is to bring two doves or two young pigeons to the Lord as a penalty for their sin—one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: "But if he cannot afford a lamb, then he shall bring to the Lord as his compensation for the sin that he has committed two turtledoves or two pigeons, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If he is not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring to the Lord, for his trespass which he has committed, two turtledoves or two young pigeons: one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: "But if you cannot afford to bring a sheep, you may bring to the Lord two turtledoves or two young pigeons as the penalty for your sin. One of the birds will be for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But if he cannot afford a lamb, then he shall bring to the Lord his guilt offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves or two young doves, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering.
verses.textEn: " ‘Anyone who cannot afford a lamb is to bring two doves or two young pigeons to the Lord as a penalty for their sin—one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 他要把牠们带到祭司那里，祭司就要先献上作为赎罪祭的一只，把鸟的头从颈项上扭断，只是不可撕断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要把牠们带到祭司那里，祭司就要先献上作为赎罪祭的一只，把鸟的头从颈项上扭断，只是不可撕断。
verses.textZhCuv: 把这些带到祭司那里，祭司就要先把那赎罪祭献上，从鸟的颈项上揪下头来，只是不可把鸟撕断，
verses.textEnNiv: They are to bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one for the sin offering. He is to wring its head from its neck, not dividing it completely,
verses.textEnEsv: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall offer first the one for the sin offering. He shall wring its head from its neck but shall not sever it completely,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall bring them to the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off its head from its neck, but shall not divide it completely.
verses.textEnNlt: You must bring them to the priest, who will present the first bird as the sin offering. He will wring its neck but without severing its head from the body.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer that which is for the sin offering, and shall pinch off its head at the front of its neck, but he shall not sever it.
verses.textEn: They are to bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one for the sin offering. He is to wring its head from its neck, not dividing it completely,

verses.textZh: 然后他要把赎罪祭牲的一些血，弹在祭坛旁边，其余的血要在祭坛脚那里挤出来；这是赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后他要把赎罪祭牲的一些血，弹在祭坛旁边，其余的血要在祭坛脚那里挤出来；这是赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 也把些赎罪祭牲的血弹在坛的旁边，剩下的血要流在坛的脚那里；这是赎罪祭。
verses.textEnNiv: and is to splash some of the blood of the sin offering against the side of the altar; the rest of the blood must be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: and he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, while the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar; it is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he will sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering against the sides of the altar, and the rest of the blood will be drained out at the base of the altar. This is an offering for sin.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall also sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, while the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar: it is a sin offering.
verses.textEn: and is to splash some of the blood of the sin offering against the side of the altar; the rest of the blood must be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 第二只作为燔祭的鸟，要按照燔祭的规则献上，祭司为他的罪行赎罪，他就蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二只作为燔祭的鸟，要按照燔祭的规则献上，祭司为他的罪行赎罪，他就蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要照例献第二只为燔祭。至于他所犯的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest shall then offer the other as a burnt offering in the prescribed way and make atonement for them for the sin they have committed, and they will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he shall offer the second for a burnt offering according to the rule. And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin that he has committed, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall offer the second as a burnt offering according to the prescribed manner. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf for his sin which he has committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will then prepare the second bird as a burnt offering, following all the procedures that have been prescribed. Through this process the priest will purify you from your sin, making you right with the Lord , and you will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: The second he shall then prepare as a burnt offering according to the ordinance. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf for his sin which he has committed, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.textEn: The priest shall then offer the other as a burnt offering in the prescribed way and make atonement for them for the sin they have committed, and they will be forgiven.

verses.textZh: "他的经济能力若是不够献两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽，就要为所犯的罪，带来一公斤的细面作赎罪祭的供物；供物不可浇上油，也不可加上乳香，因为这是赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他的经济能力若是不够献两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽，就要为所犯的罪，带来一公斤的细面作赎罪祭的供物；供物不可浇上油，也不可加上乳香，因为这是赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他的力量若不够献两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，就要因所犯的罪带供物来，就是细面伊法十分之一为赎罪祭；不可加上油，也不可加上乳香，因为是赎罪祭。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If, however, they cannot afford two doves or two young pigeons, they are to bring as an offering for their sin a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour for a sin offering. They must not put olive oil or incense on it, because it is a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: "But if he cannot afford two turtledoves or two pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for the sin that he has committed a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it and shall put no frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But if he is not able to bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he who sinned shall bring for his offering one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, nor shall he put frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you cannot afford to bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons, you may bring two quarts of choice flour for your sin offering. Since it is an offering for sin, you must not moisten it with olive oil or put any frankincense on it.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But if his means are insufficient for two turtledoves or two young doves, then for his offering for that which he has sinned, he shall bring the tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering; he shall not put oil on it or place incense on it, for it is a sin offering.
verses.textEn: " ‘If, however, they cannot afford two doves or two young pigeons, they are to bring as an offering for their sin a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour for a sin offering. They must not put olive oil or incense on it, because it is a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 他要把供物带到祭司那里，祭司从其中取出一把，作为象征，放在祭坛耶和华的火祭上面焚烧；这是赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要把供物带到祭司那里，祭司从其中取出一把，作为象征，放在祭坛耶和华的火祭上面焚烧；这是赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要把供物带到祭司那里，祭司要取出自己的一把来作为纪念，按献给耶和华火祭的条例烧在坛上；这是赎罪祭。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to bring it to the priest, who shall take a handful of it as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar on top of the food offerings presented to the Lord . It is a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take a handful of it as its memorial portion and burn this on the altar, on the Lord ’s food offerings; it is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as a memorial portion, and burn it on the altar according to the offerings made by fire to the Lord. It is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Take the flour to the priest, who will scoop out a handful as a representative portion. He will burn it on the altar on top of the special gifts presented to the Lord . It is an offering for sin.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as its memorial portion and offer it up in smoke on the altar, with the offerings of the Lord by fire: it is a sin offering.
verses.textEn: They are to bring it to the priest, who shall take a handful of it as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar on top of the food offerings presented to the Lord . It is a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司为他所犯的任何一样罪赎罪，他就蒙赦免。其余的祭物 要归给祭司，好象素祭一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司为他所犯的任何一样罪赎罪，他就蒙赦免。其余的祭物 要归给祭司，好象素祭一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于他在这几件事中所犯的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。剩下的面都归与祭司，和素祭一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: In this way the priest will make atonement for them for any of these sins they have committed, and they will be forgiven. The rest of the offering will belong to the priest, as in the case of the grain offering.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which he has committed in any one of these things, and he shall be forgiven. And the remainder shall be for the priest, as in the grain offering."
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall make atonement for him, for his sin that he has committed in any of these matters; and it shall be forgiven him. The rest shall be the priest’s as a grain offering.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Through this process, the priest will purify those who are guilty of any of these sins, making them right with the Lord , and they will be forgiven. The rest of the flour will belong to the priest, just as with the grain offering."
verses.textEnNasb: So the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has committed from one of these, and it will be forgiven him; then the rest shall become the priest’s, like the grain offering.’ "
verses.textEn: In this way the priest will make atonement for them for any of these sins they have committed, and they will be forgiven. The rest of the offering will belong to the priest, as in the case of the grain offering.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses:
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses:

verses.textZh: "如果有人在耶和华的圣物上不忠实，无意犯了罪，他就要依照你按着圣所衡量银子标准所估的银价，把他的赎愆祭牲，就是羊群中一只没有残疾的公绵羊，牵到耶和华面前作赎愆祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人在耶和华的圣物上不忠实，无意犯了罪，他就要依照你按着圣所衡量银子标准所估的银价，把他的赎愆祭牲，就是羊群中一只没有残疾的公绵羊，牵到耶和华面前作赎愆祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若在耶和华的圣物上误犯了罪，有了过犯，就要照你所估的，按圣所的舍客勒拿银子，将赎愆祭牲－就是羊群中一只没有残疾的公绵羊－牵到耶和华面前为赎愆祭；
verses.textEnNiv: "When anyone is unfaithful to the Lord by sinning unintentionally in regard to any of the Lord ’s holy things, they are to bring to the Lord as a penalty a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value in silver, according to the sanctuary shekel. It is a guilt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: "If anyone commits a breach of faith and sins unintentionally in any of the holy things of the Lord , he shall bring to the Lord as his compensation, a ram without blemish out of the flock, valued in silver shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a guilt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a person commits a trespass, and sins unintentionally in regard to the holy things of the Lord, then he shall bring to the Lord as his trespass offering a ram without blemish from the flocks, with your valuation in shekels of silver according to the shekel of the sanctuary, as a trespass offering.
verses.textEnNlt: "If one of you commits a sin by unintentionally defiling the Lord ’s sacred property, you must bring a guilt offering to the Lord . The offering must be your own ram with no defects, or you may buy one of equal value with silver, as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel.
verses.textEnNasb: "If a person acts unfaithfully and sins unintentionally against the Lord’s holy things, then he shall bring his guilt offering to the Lord: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your assessment in silver by shekels, in terms of the shekel of the sanctuary, as a guilt offering.
verses.textEn: "When anyone is unfaithful to the Lord by sinning unintentionally in regard to any of the Lord ’s holy things, they are to bring to the Lord as a penalty a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value in silver, according to the sanctuary shekel. It is a guilt offering.

verses.textZh: 他要补偿他在圣物上所亏欠的，另加五分之一，交给祭司；祭司要用赎愆祭的公绵羊为他赎罪，他就蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要补偿他在圣物上所亏欠的，另加五分之一，交给祭司；祭司要用赎愆祭的公绵羊为他赎罪，他就蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且他因在圣物上的差错要偿还，另外加五分之一，都给祭司。祭司要用赎愆祭的公绵羊为他赎罪，他必蒙赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: They must make restitution for what they have failed to do in regard to the holy things, pay an additional penalty of a fifth of its value and give it all to the priest. The priest will make atonement for them with the ram as a guilt offering, and they will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall also make restitution for what he has done amiss in the holy thing and shall add a fifth to it and give it to the priest. And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall make restitution for the harm that he has done in regard to the holy thing, and shall add one-fifth to it and give it to the priest. So the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textEnNlt: You must make restitution for the sacred property you have harmed by paying for the loss, plus an additional 20 percent. When you give the payment to the priest, he will purify you with the ram sacrificed as a guilt offering, making you right with the Lord , and you will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall make restitution for that which he has sinned against the holy thing, and shall add to it a fifth part of it and give it to the priest. The priest shall then make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.textEn: They must make restitution for what they have failed to do in regard to the holy things, pay an additional penalty of a fifth of its value and give it all to the priest. The priest will make atonement for them with the ram as a guilt offering, and they will be forgiven.

verses.textZh: "如果有人犯了罪，行了一件耶和华吩咐不可行的事；他虽然不清楚，仍是有罪，他就要担当自己的罪责。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人犯了罪，行了一件耶和华吩咐不可行的事；他虽然不清楚，仍是有罪，他就要担当自己的罪责。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有人犯罪，行了耶和华所吩咐不可行的什么事，他虽然不知道，还是有了罪，就要担当他的罪孽；
verses.textEnNiv: "If anyone sins and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, even though they do not know it, they are guilty and will be held responsible.
verses.textEnEsv: "If anyone sins, doing any of the things that by the Lord ’s commandments ought not to be done, though he did not know it, then realizes his guilt, he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a person sins, and commits any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the Lord, though he does not know it, yet he is guilty and shall bear his iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose you sin by violating one of the Lord ’s commands. Even if you are unaware of what you have done, you are guilty and will be punished for your sin.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now if a person sins and does any of the things which the Lord has commanded not to be done, though he was unaware, he is still guilty and shall bear his punishment.
verses.textEn: "If anyone sins and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, even though they do not know it, they are guilty and will be held responsible.

verses.textZh: 他要依照你的估价，从羊群中把一只没有残疾的公绵羊牵来，给祭司作赎愆祭。祭司为他赎罪，那不清楚的无心之失，就蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要依照你的估价，从羊群中把一只没有残疾的公绵羊牵来，给祭司作赎愆祭。祭司为他赎罪，那不清楚的无心之失，就蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要照你所估定的价，从羊群中牵一只没有残疾的公绵羊来，给祭司作赎愆祭。至于他误行的那错事，祭司要为他赎罪，他必蒙赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to bring to the priest as a guilt offering a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value. In this way the priest will make atonement for them for the wrong they have committed unintentionally, and they will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall bring to the priest a ram without blemish out of the flock, or its equivalent, for a guilt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for him for the mistake that he made unintentionally, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall bring to the priest a ram without blemish from the flock, with your valuation, as a trespass offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him regarding his ignorance in which he erred and did not know it, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textEnNlt: For a guilt offering, you must bring to the priest your own ram with no defects, or you may buy one of equal value. Through this process the priest will purify you from your unintentional sin, making you right with the Lord , and you will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: He is then to bring to the priest a ram without defect from the flock, according to your assessment, as a guilt offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he committed unintentionally and did not know it, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.textEn: They are to bring to the priest as a guilt offering a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value. In this way the priest will make atonement for them for the wrong they have committed unintentionally, and they will be forgiven.

verses.textZh: 这是赎愆祭，他在耶和华面前实在有罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是赎愆祭，他在耶和华面前实在有罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这是赎愆祭，因他在耶和华面前实在有了罪。」
verses.textEnNiv: It is a guilt offering; they have been guilty of wrongdoing against the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: It is a guilt offering; he has indeed incurred guilt before the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: It is a trespass offering; he has certainly trespassed against the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: This is a guilt offering, for you have been guilty of an offense against the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: It is a guilt offering; he was certainly guilty before the Lord."
verses.textEn: It is a guilt offering; they have been guilty of wrongdoing against the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses:
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses:

verses.textZh: "如果有人犯罪，对耶和华不忠实，在人寄存给他的物上或抵押品上欺骗自己的同伴，或是抢夺，或是欺压自己的同胞，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人犯罪，对耶和华不忠实，在人寄存给他的物上或抵押品上欺骗自己的同伴，或是抢夺，或是欺压自己的同胞，
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有人犯罪，干犯耶和华，在邻舍交付他的物上，或是在交易上行了诡诈，或是抢夺人的财物，或是欺压邻舍，
verses.textEnNiv: "If anyone sins and is unfaithful to the Lord by deceiving a neighbor about something entrusted to them or left in their care or about something stolen, or if they cheat their neighbor,
verses.textEnEsv: "If anyone sins and commits a breach of faith against the Lord by deceiving his neighbor in a matter of deposit or security, or through robbery, or if he has oppressed his neighbor
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a person sins and commits a trespass against the Lord by lying to his neighbor about what was delivered to him for safekeeping, or about a pledge, or about a robbery, or if he has extorted from his neighbor,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose one of you sins against your associate and is unfaithful to the Lord . Suppose you cheat in a deal involving a security deposit, or you steal or commit fraud,
verses.textEnNasb: "When a person sins and acts unfaithfully against the Lord, and disavows the rightful claim of his neighbor regarding a deposit or a security entrusted to him, or regarding robbery, or he has extorted from his neighbor,
verses.textEn: "If anyone sins and is unfaithful to the Lord by deceiving a neighbor about something entrusted to them or left in their care or about something stolen, or if they cheat their neighbor,

verses.textZh: 或是拾去人遗失的东西，却欺骗人，起假誓，行了任何一件人常犯的罪，
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是拾去人遗失的东西，却欺骗人，起假誓，行了任何一件人常犯的罪，
verses.textZhCuv: 或是在捡了遗失的物上行了诡诈，说谎起誓，在这一切的事上犯了什么罪；
verses.textEnNiv: or if they find lost property and lie about it, or if they swear falsely about any such sin that people may commit—
verses.textEnEsv: or has found something lost and lied about it, swearing falsely—in any of all the things that people do and sin thereby—
verses.textEnNkjv: or if he has found what was lost and lies concerning it, and swears falsely—in any one of these things that a man may do in which he sins:
verses.textEnNlt: or you find lost property and lie about it, or you lie while swearing to tell the truth, or you commit any other such sin.
verses.textEnNasb: or has found what was lost and lied about it and sworn falsely, so that he sins regarding any of the things that people do;
verses.textEn: or if they find lost property and lie about it, or if they swear falsely about any such sin that people may commit—

verses.textZh: 他犯了罪，有了罪，就应归还他所抢夺的，或是欺压得来的，或是别人寄存在他那里的，或是他拾去的失物，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他犯了罪，有了罪，就应归还他所抢夺的，或是欺压得来的，或是别人寄存在他那里的，或是他拾去的失物，
verses.textZhCuv: 他既犯了罪，有了过犯，就要归还他所抢夺的，或是因欺压所得的，或是人交付他的，或是人遗失他所捡的物，
verses.textEnNiv: when they sin in any of these ways and realize their guilt, they must return what they have stolen or taken by extortion, or what was entrusted to them, or the lost property they found,
verses.textEnEsv: if he has sinned and has realized his guilt and will restore what he took by robbery or what he got by oppression or the deposit that was committed to him or the lost thing that he found
verses.textEnNkjv: then it shall be, because he has sinned and is guilty, that he shall restore what he has stolen, or the thing which he has extorted, or what was delivered to him for safekeeping, or the lost thing which he found,
verses.textEnNlt: If you have sinned in any of these ways, you are guilty. You must give back whatever you stole, or the money you took by extortion, or the security deposit, or the lost property you found,
verses.textEnNasb: then it shall be, when he sins and becomes guilty, that he shall restore what he took by robbery or acquired by extortion, or the deposit which was entrusted to him, or the lost property which he found,
verses.textEn: when they sin in any of these ways and realize their guilt, they must return what they have stolen or taken by extortion, or what was entrusted to them, or the lost property they found,

verses.textZh: 或是他因起假誓所得的任何东西；在赔过的时候，他除了按原数偿还外，必须另外加上五分之一，交给原主；
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是他因起假誓所得的任何东西；在赔过的时候，他除了按原数偿还外，必须另外加上五分之一，交给原主；
verses.textZhCuv: 或是他因什么物起了假誓，就要如数归还，另外加上五分之一，在查出他有罪的日子要交还本主。
verses.textEnNiv: or whatever it was they swore falsely about. They must make restitution in full, add a fifth of the value to it and give it all to the owner on the day they present their guilt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: or anything about which he has sworn falsely, he shall restore it in full and shall add a fifth to it, and give it to him to whom it belongs on the day he realizes his guilt.
verses.textEnNkjv: or all that about which he has sworn falsely. He shall restore its full value, add one-fifth more to it, and give it to whomever it belongs, on the day of his trespass offering.
verses.textEnNlt: or anything obtained by swearing falsely. You must make restitution by paying the full price plus an additional 20 percent to the person you have harmed. On the same day you must present a guilt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: or anything about which he swore falsely; he shall make restitution for it in full and add to it a fifth more. He shall give it to the one to whom it belongs on the day he presents his guilt offering.
verses.textEn: or whatever it was they swore falsely about. They must make restitution in full, add a fifth of the value to it and give it all to the owner on the day they present their guilt offering.

verses.textZh: 还要照着你的估价，把赎愆祭牲，就是从羊群中取一只没有残疾的公绵羊，牵到耶和华面前，给祭司作赎愆祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还要照着你的估价，把赎愆祭牲，就是从羊群中取一只没有残疾的公绵羊，牵到耶和华面前，给祭司作赎愆祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要照你所估定的价，把赎愆祭牲－就是羊群中一只没有残疾的公绵羊－牵到耶和华面前，给祭司为赎愆祭。
verses.textEnNiv: And as a penalty they must bring to the priest, that is, to the Lord , their guilt offering, a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall bring to the priest as his compensation to the Lord a ram without blemish out of the flock, or its equivalent, for a guilt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering to the Lord, a ram without blemish from the flock, with your valuation, as a trespass offering, to the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: As a guilt offering to the Lord , you must bring to the priest your own ram with no defects, or you may buy one of equal value.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall bring to the priest his guilt offering to the Lord, a ram without defect from the flock, according to your assessment, as a guilt offering,
verses.textEn: And as a penalty they must bring to the priest, that is, to the Lord , their guilt offering, a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value.

verses.textZh: 祭司在耶和华面前，为他所行的任何一件过失赎罪，他就蒙赦免。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司在耶和华面前，为他所行的任何一件过失赎罪，他就蒙赦免。"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪；他无论行了什么事，使他有了罪，都必蒙赦免。」
verses.textEnNiv: In this way the priest will make atonement for them before the Lord , and they will be forgiven for any of the things they did that made them guilty."
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord , and he shall be forgiven for any of the things that one may do and thereby become guilty."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord, and he shall be forgiven for any one of these things that he may have done in which he trespasses."
verses.textEnNlt: Through this process, the priest will purify you before the Lord , making you right with him, and you will be forgiven for any of these sins you have committed."
verses.textEnNasb: and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord, and he will be forgiven for any one of the things which he may have done to incur guilt."
verses.textEn: In this way the priest will make atonement for them before the Lord , and they will be forgiven for any of the things they did that made them guilty."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses:
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses:

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐亚伦和他的子孙说：燔祭的律例是这样：燔祭要放在祭坛的柴上，通宵达旦；祭坛上的火，必须一直烧着。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐亚伦和他的子孙说：燔祭的律例是这样：燔祭要放在祭坛的柴上，通宵达旦；祭坛上的火，必须一直烧着。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要吩咐亚伦和他的子孙说，燔祭的条例乃是这样：燔祭要放在坛的柴上，从晚上到天亮，坛上的火要常常烧着。
verses.textEnNiv: "Give Aaron and his sons this command: ‘These are the regulations for the burnt offering: The burnt offering is to remain on the altar hearth throughout the night, till morning, and the fire must be kept burning on the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: "Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering. The burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: The burnt offering shall be on the hearth upon the altar all night until morning, and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give Aaron and his sons the following instructions regarding the burnt offering. The burnt offering must be left on top of the altar until the next morning, and the fire on the altar must be kept burning all night.
verses.textEnNasb: "Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law for the burnt offering: the burnt offering itself shall remain on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning, and the fire on the altar is to be kept burning on it.
verses.textEn: "Give Aaron and his sons this command: ‘These are the regulations for the burnt offering: The burnt offering is to remain on the altar hearth throughout the night, till morning, and the fire must be kept burning on the altar.

verses.textZh: 祭司要穿上细麻布外袍，又把细麻布裤子穿在身上；他要把祭坛上燔祭烧成的灰收起来，放在祭坛旁边；
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要穿上细麻布外袍，又把细麻布裤子穿在身上；他要把祭坛上燔祭烧成的灰收起来，放在祭坛旁边；
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要穿上细麻布衣服，又要把细麻布裤子穿在身上，把坛上所烧的燔祭灰收起来，倒在坛的旁边；
verses.textEnNiv: The priest shall then put on his linen clothes, with linen undergarments next to his body, and shall remove the ashes of the burnt offering that the fire has consumed on the altar and place them beside the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall put on his linen garment and put his linen undergarment on his body, and he shall take up the ashes to which the fire has reduced the burnt offering on the altar and put them beside the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen trousers he shall put on his body, and take up the ashes of the burnt offering which the fire has consumed on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: In the morning, after the priest on duty has put on his official linen clothing and linen undergarments, he must clean out the ashes of the burnt offering and put them beside the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest is to put on his linen robe, and he shall put on linen undergarments next to his body; and he shall take up the fatty ashes to which the fire reduces the burnt offering on the altar and place them beside the altar.
verses.textEn: The priest shall then put on his linen clothes, with linen undergarments next to his body, and shall remove the ashes of the burnt offering that the fire has consumed on the altar and place them beside the altar.

verses.textZh: 然后脱去这些衣服，穿上别的衣服，把灰拿出营外洁净的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后脱去这些衣服，穿上别的衣服，把灰拿出营外洁净的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后要脱去这衣服，穿上别的衣服，把灰拿到营外洁净之处。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he is to take off these clothes and put on others, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a place that is ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he shall take off his garments and put on other garments and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall take off his garments, put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he must take off these garments, change back into his regular clothes, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a place that is ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall take off his garments and put on other garments, and carry the fatty ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
verses.textEn: Then he is to take off these clothes and put on others, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a place that is ceremonially clean.

verses.textZh: 祭坛上的火，应常常烧着，不可熄灭；每天早晨，祭司要在上面烧柴，把燔祭排列在坛上，又在上面焚烧平安祭的脂肪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭坛上的火，应常常烧着，不可熄灭；每天早晨，祭司要在上面烧柴，把燔祭排列在坛上，又在上面焚烧平安祭的脂肪。
verses.textZhCuv: 坛上的火要在其上常常烧着，不可熄灭。祭司要每日早晨在上面烧柴，并要把燔祭摆在坛上，在其上烧平安祭牲的脂油。
verses.textEnNiv: The fire on the altar must be kept burning; it must not go out. Every morning the priest is to add firewood and arrange the burnt offering on the fire and burn the fat of the fellowship offerings on it.
verses.textEnEsv: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it; it shall not go out. The priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and he shall arrange the burnt offering on it and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it; it shall not be put out. And the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order on it; and he shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the fire on the altar must be kept burning; it must never go out. Each morning the priest will add fresh wood to the fire and arrange the burnt offering on it. He will then burn the fat of the peace offerings on it.
verses.textEnNasb: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it. It shall not go out, but the priest shall burn wood on it every morning; and he shall lay out the burnt offering on it, and offer up in smoke the fat portions of the peace offerings on it.
verses.textEn: The fire on the altar must be kept burning; it must not go out. Every morning the priest is to add firewood and arrange the burnt offering on the fire and burn the fat of the fellowship offerings on it.

verses.textZh: 火必须不断在祭坛上烧着，不可熄灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 火必须不断在祭坛上烧着，不可熄灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 在坛上必有常常烧着的火，不可熄灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continuously; it must not go out.
verses.textEnEsv: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fire shall always be burning on the altar; it shall never go out.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, the fire must be kept burning on the altar at all times. It must never go out.
verses.textEnNasb: Fire shall be kept burning continually on the altar; it is not to go out.
verses.textEn: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continuously; it must not go out.

verses.textZh: "素祭的律例是这样：亚伦的子孙要在耶和华面前的祭坛前献素祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "素祭的律例是这样：亚伦的子孙要在耶和华面前的祭坛前献素祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「素祭的条例乃是这样：亚伦的子孙要在坛前把这祭献在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘These are the regulations for the grain offering: Aaron’s sons are to bring it before the Lord , in front of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: "And this is the law of the grain offering. The sons of Aaron shall offer it before the Lord in front of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘This is the law of the grain offering: The sons of Aaron shall offer it on the altar before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the instructions regarding the grain offering. Aaron’s sons must present this offering to the Lord in front of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now this is the law of the grain offering: the sons of Aaron shall present it before the Lord in front of the altar.
verses.textEn: " ‘These are the regulations for the grain offering: Aaron’s sons are to bring it before the Lord , in front of the altar.

verses.textZh: 从其中取出一把作素祭的细面、油，和在素祭上所有的乳香，焚烧在祭坛上献给耶和华为馨香的祭，作供物的象征。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从其中取出一把作素祭的细面、油，和在素祭上所有的乳香，焚烧在祭坛上献给耶和华为馨香的祭，作供物的象征。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要从其中－就是从素祭的细面中－取出自己的一把，又要取些油和素祭上所有的乳香，烧在坛上，奉给耶和华为馨香素祭的纪念。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to take a handful of the finest flour and some olive oil, together with all the incense on the grain offering, and burn the memorial portion on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And one shall take from it a handful of the fine flour of the grain offering and its oil and all the frankincense that is on the grain offering and burn this as its memorial portion on the altar, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall take from it his handful of the fine flour of the grain offering, with its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the grain offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a sweet aroma, as a memorial to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest on duty will take from the grain offering a handful of the choice flour moistened with olive oil, together with all the frankincense. He will burn this representative portion on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then one of them shall lift up from it a handful of the fine flour of the grain offering, with its oil and all the incense that is on the grain offering, and he shall offer it up in smoke on the altar, a soothing aroma, as its memorial offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The priest is to take a handful of the finest flour and some olive oil, together with all the incense on the grain offering, and burn the memorial portion on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亚伦和他的子孙要吃剩余的祭物，在圣洁的地方作无酵饼吃；他们要在会幕的院子里吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦和他的子孙要吃剩余的祭物，在圣洁的地方作无酵饼吃；他们要在会幕的院子里吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 所剩下的，亚伦和他子孙要吃，必在圣处不带酵而吃，要在会幕的院子里吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron and his sons shall eat the rest of it, but it is to be eaten without yeast in the sanctuary area; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And the rest of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place. In the court of the tent of meeting they shall eat it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the remainder of it Aaron and his sons shall eat; with unleavened bread it shall be eaten in a holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of meeting they shall eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron and his sons may eat the rest of the flour, but it must be baked without yeast and eaten in a sacred place within the courtyard of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: And Aaron and his sons are to eat what is left of it. It shall be eaten as unleavened cakes in a holy place; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: Aaron and his sons shall eat the rest of it, but it is to be eaten without yeast in the sanctuary area; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 烤饼的时候，不可加酵。这是我从献给我的火祭中，赐给他们的分，是至圣的，与赎罪祭和赎愆祭一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 烤饼的时候，不可加酵。这是我从献给我的火祭中，赐给他们的分，是至圣的，与赎罪祭和赎愆祭一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 烤的时候不可搀酵。这是从所献给我的火祭中赐给他们的分，是至圣的，和赎罪祭并赎愆祭一样。
verses.textEnNiv: It must not be baked with yeast; I have given it as their share of the food offerings presented to me. Like the sin offering and the guilt offering, it is most holy.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as their portion of my food offerings. It is a thing most holy, like the sin offering and the guilt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as their portion of My offerings made by fire; it is most holy, like the sin offering and the trespass offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, it must never be prepared with yeast. I have given it to the priests as their share of the special gifts presented to me. Like the sin offering and the guilt offering, it is most holy.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as their share from My offerings by fire; it is most holy, like the sin offering and the guilt offering.
verses.textEn: It must not be baked with yeast; I have given it as their share of the food offerings presented to me. Like the sin offering and the guilt offering, it is most holy.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的子孙中的男丁，都要从献给耶和华的火祭中吃这些祭物；这是你们世世代代永远的律例。人接触过这些祭物，必成为圣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的子孙中的男丁，都要从献给耶和华的火祭中吃这些祭物；这是你们世世代代永远的律例。人接触过这些祭物，必成为圣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡献给耶和华的火祭，亚伦子孙中的男丁都要吃这一分，直到万代，作他们永得的分。摸这些祭物的，都要成为圣。」
verses.textEnNiv: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat it. For all generations to come it is his perpetual share of the food offerings presented to the Lord . Whatever touches them will become holy. ’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Every male among the children of Aaron may eat of it, as decreed forever throughout your generations, from the Lord ’s food offerings. Whatever touches them shall become holy."
verses.textEnNkjv: All the males among the children of Aaron may eat it. It shall be a statute forever in your generations concerning the offerings made by fire to the Lord. Everyone who touches them must be holy.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Any of Aaron’s male descendants may eat from the special gifts presented to the Lord . This is their permanent right from generation to generation. Anyone or anything that touches these offerings will become holy."
verses.textEnNasb: Every male among the sons of Aaron may eat it; it is a permanent ordinance throughout your generations, from the offerings by fire to the Lord. Whoever touches them will become consecrated.’ "
verses.textEn: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat it. For all generations to come it is his perpetual share of the food offerings presented to the Lord . Whatever touches them will become holy. ’ "

verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord also said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "亚伦和他的子孙，在受膏的日子要献给耶和华的供物，就是一公斤的细面，作常献的素祭，早晨献一半，晚上献一半。
verses.textZhCnvs: "亚伦和他的子孙，在受膏的日子要献给耶和华的供物，就是一公斤的细面，作常献的素祭，早晨献一半，晚上献一半。
verses.textZhCuv: 「当亚伦受膏的日子，他和他子孙所要献给耶和华的供物，就是细面伊法十分之一，为常献的素祭：早晨一半，晚上一半。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the offering Aaron and his sons are to bring to the Lord on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.
verses.textEnEsv: "This is the offering that Aaron and his sons shall offer to the Lord on the day when he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the offering of Aaron and his sons, which they shall offer to the Lord, beginning on the day when he is anointed: one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a daily grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it at night.
verses.textEnNlt: "On the day Aaron and his sons are anointed, they must present to the Lord the standard grain offering of two quarts of choice flour, half to be offered in the morning and half to be offered in the evening.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is the offering which Aaron and his sons are to present to the Lord on the day when he is anointed; the tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.
verses.textEn: "This is the offering Aaron and his sons are to bring to the Lord on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

verses.textZh: 你要把这些细面在煎盘上用油调和作饼，烘 好了，你就拿进来；将擘成碎块的素祭献上，献给耶和华为馨香的祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这些细面在煎盘上用油调和作饼，烘 好了，你就拿进来；将擘成碎块的素祭献上，献给耶和华为馨香的祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 要在铁鏊上用油调和做成，调匀了，你就拿进来；烤好了分成块子，献给耶和华为馨香的素祭。
verses.textEnNiv: It must be prepared with oil on a griddle; bring it well-mixed and present the grain offering broken in pieces as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be made with oil on a griddle. You shall bring it well mixed, in baked pieces like a grain offering, and offer it for a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be made in a pan with oil. When it is mixed, you shall bring it in. The baked pieces of the grain offering you shall offer for a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: It must be carefully mixed with olive oil and cooked on a griddle. Then slice this grain offering and present it as a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be prepared with oil on a griddle. When it is well stirred, you shall bring it. You shall present the grain offering in baked pieces as a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: It must be prepared with oil on a griddle; bring it well-mixed and present the grain offering broken in pieces as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亚伦的子孙继承他作受膏立的祭司的，都要献这素祭，把它完全焚烧，献给耶和华，作永远的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的子孙继承他作受膏立的祭司的，都要献这素祭，把它完全焚烧，献给耶和华，作永远的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦的子孙中，接续他为受膏的祭司，要把这素祭献上，要全烧给耶和华。这是永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: The son who is to succeed him as anointed priest shall prepare it. It is the Lord ’s perpetual share and is to be burned completely.
verses.textEnEsv: The priest from among Aaron’s sons, who is anointed to succeed him, shall offer it to the Lord as decreed forever. The whole of it shall be burned.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest from among his sons, who is anointed in his place, shall offer it. It is a statute forever to the Lord. It shall be wholly burned.
verses.textEnNlt: In each generation, the high priest who succeeds Aaron must prepare this same offering. It belongs to the Lord and must be burned up completely. This is a permanent law.
verses.textEnNasb: The anointed priest who will be in his place among his sons shall offer it. By a permanent ordinance it shall be entirely offered up in smoke to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The son who is to succeed him as anointed priest shall prepare it. It is the Lord ’s perpetual share and is to be burned completely.

verses.textZh: 凡是祭司献的素祭都要完全焚烧，不可以吃。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是祭司献的素祭都要完全焚烧，不可以吃。"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司的素祭都要烧了，却不可吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: Every grain offering of a priest shall be burned completely; it must not be eaten."
verses.textEnEsv: Every grain offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten."
verses.textEnNkjv: For every grain offering for the priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten."
verses.textEnNlt: All such grain offerings of a priest must be burned up entirely. None of it may be eaten."
verses.textEnNasb: So every grain offering of the priest shall be burned entirely. It shall not be eaten."
verses.textEn: Every grain offering of a priest shall be burned completely; it must not be eaten."

verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉亚伦和他的儿子：赎罪祭的律例是这样：赎罪祭牲应在宰杀燔祭牲的地方，在耶和华面前宰杀，这是至圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉亚伦和他的儿子：赎罪祭的律例是这样：赎罪祭牲应在宰杀燔祭牲的地方，在耶和华面前宰杀，这是至圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你对亚伦和他的子孙说，赎罪祭的条例乃是这样：要在耶和华面前、宰燔祭牲的地方宰赎罪祭牲；这是至圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to Aaron and his sons: ‘These are the regulations for the sin offering: The sin offering is to be slaughtered before the Lord in the place the burnt offering is slaughtered; it is most holy.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering. In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the Lord ; it is most holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before the Lord. It is most holy.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give Aaron and his sons the following instructions regarding the sin offering. The animal given as an offering for sin is a most holy offering, and it must be slaughtered in the Lord ’s presence at the place where the burnt offerings are slaughtered.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, the sin offering shall be slaughtered before the Lord; it is most holy.
verses.textEn: "Say to Aaron and his sons: ‘These are the regulations for the sin offering: The sin offering is to be slaughtered before the Lord in the place the burnt offering is slaughtered; it is most holy.

verses.textZh: 献这赎罪祭的祭司要吃这祭牲；在会幕院子里的圣洁地方吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 献这赎罪祭的祭司要吃这祭牲；在会幕院子里的圣洁地方吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 为赎罪献这祭的祭司要吃，要在圣处，就是在会幕的院子里吃。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it is to be eaten in the sanctuary area, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. In a holy place it shall be eaten, in the court of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. In a holy place it shall be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest who offers the sacrifice as a sin offering must eat his portion in a sacred place within the courtyard of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it is to be eaten in the sanctuary area, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 接触过这祭肉的，必成为圣。沾了祭牲的血，必须清理；血溅在衣服上，应该在圣洁的地方洗净，
verses.textZhCnvs: 接触过这祭肉的，必成为圣。沾了祭牲的血，必须清理；血溅在衣服上，应该在圣洁的地方洗净，
verses.textZhCuv: 凡摸这祭肉的要成为圣；这祭牲的血若弹在什么衣服上，所弹的那一件要在圣处洗净。
verses.textEnNiv: Whatever touches any of the flesh will become holy, and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment, you must wash it in the sanctuary area.
verses.textEnEsv: Whatever touches its flesh shall be holy, and when any of its blood is splashed on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was splashed in a holy place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone who touches its flesh must be holy. And when its blood is sprinkled on any garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled, in a holy place.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone or anything that touches the sacrificial meat will become holy. If any of the sacrificial blood spatters on a person’s clothing, the soiled garment must be washed in a sacred place.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever touches its flesh will become consecrated; and when any of its blood spatters on a garment, you shall wash what spattered on it in a holy place.
verses.textEn: Whatever touches any of the flesh will become holy, and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment, you must wash it in the sanctuary area.

verses.textZh: 煮祭物的瓦器却要打碎；如果煮祭物的是铜器，只需用水冲洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 煮祭物的瓦器却要打碎；如果煮祭物的是铜器，只需用水冲洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有煮祭物的瓦器要打碎；若是煮在铜器里，这铜器要擦磨，在水中涮净。
verses.textEnNiv: The clay pot the meat is cooked in must be broken; but if it is cooked in a bronze pot, the pot is to be scoured and rinsed with water.
verses.textEnEsv: And the earthenware vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken. But if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, that shall be scoured and rinsed in water.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken. And if it is boiled in a bronze pot, it shall be both scoured and rinsed in water.
verses.textEnNlt: If a clay pot is used to boil the sacrificial meat, it must then be broken. If a bronze pot is used, it must be scoured and thoroughly rinsed with water.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the earthenware vessel in which it was boiled shall be broken; and if it was boiled in a bronze vessel, then it shall be scoured and rinsed in water.
verses.textEn: The clay pot the meat is cooked in must be broken; but if it is cooked in a bronze pot, the pot is to be scoured and rinsed with water.

verses.textZh: 祭司家中的男丁，都可以吃祭肉；这是至圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司家中的男丁，都可以吃祭肉；这是至圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡祭司中的男丁都可以吃；这是至圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: Any male in a priest’s family may eat it; it is most holy.
verses.textEnEsv: Every male among the priests may eat of it; it is most holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the males among the priests may eat it. It is most holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Any male from a priest’s family may eat from this offering; it is most holy.
verses.textEnNasb: Every male among the priests may eat it; it is most holy.
verses.textEn: Any male in a priest’s family may eat it; it is most holy.

verses.textZh: 但是任何赎罪祭，如果它的血带进了会幕在圣所内进行赎罪，祭肉就不可吃；必须用火烧尽。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是任何赎罪祭，如果它的血带进了会幕在圣所内进行赎罪，祭肉就不可吃；必须用火烧尽。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡赎罪祭，若将血带进会幕在圣所赎罪，那肉都不可吃，必用火焚烧。」
verses.textEnNiv: But any sin offering whose blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place must not be eaten; it must be burned up.
verses.textEnEsv: But no sin offering shall be eaten from which any blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place; it shall be burned up with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: But no sin offering from which any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of meeting, to make atonement in the holy place, shall be eaten. It shall be burned in the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: But the offering for sin may not be eaten if its blood was brought into the Tabernacle as an offering for purification in the Holy Place. It must be completely burned with fire.
verses.textEnNasb: But no sin offering of which any of the blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place shall be eaten; it shall be burned with fire.
verses.textEn: But any sin offering whose blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place must not be eaten; it must be burned up.

verses.textZh: "赎愆祭的律例是这样：这祭是至圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "赎愆祭的律例是这样：这祭是至圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「赎愆祭的条例乃是如此：这祭是至圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘These are the regulations for the guilt offering, which is most holy:
verses.textEnEsv: "This is the law of the guilt offering. It is most holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering (it is most holy):
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the instructions for the guilt offering. It is most holy.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now this is the law of the guilt offering; it is most holy.
verses.textEn: " ‘These are the regulations for the guilt offering, which is most holy:

verses.textZh: 人在甚么地方宰杀燔祭牲，就要在那里宰杀赎愆祭牲，牠的血要泼在祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人在甚么地方宰杀燔祭牲，就要在那里宰杀赎愆祭牲，牠的血要泼在祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCuv: 人在那里宰燔祭牲，也要在那里宰赎愆祭牲；其血，祭司要洒在坛的周围。
verses.textEnNiv: The guilt offering is to be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and its blood is to be splashed against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: In the place where they kill the burnt offering they shall kill the guilt offering, and its blood shall be thrown against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the place where they kill the burnt offering they shall kill the trespass offering. And its blood he shall sprinkle all around on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: The animal sacrificed as a guilt offering must be slaughtered at the place where the burnt offerings are slaughtered, and its blood must be splattered against all sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: In the place where they slaughter the burnt offering they are to slaughter the guilt offering, and the priest shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
verses.textEn: The guilt offering is to be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and its blood is to be splashed against the sides of the altar.

verses.textZh: 祭司要把祭牲的一切脂肪都献上，就是肥尾巴和遮盖内脏的脂肪，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要把祭牲的一切脂肪都献上，就是肥尾巴和遮盖内脏的脂肪，
verses.textZhCuv: 又要将肥尾巴和盖脏的脂油，
verses.textEnNiv: All its fat shall be offered: the fat tail and the fat that covers the internal organs,
verses.textEnEsv: And all its fat shall be offered, the fat tail, the fat that covers the entrails,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall offer from it all its fat. The fat tail and the fat that covers the entrails,
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will then offer all its fat on the altar, including the fat of the broad tail, the fat around the internal organs,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall offer from it all its fat: the fat tail and the fat that covers the entrails,
verses.textEn: All its fat shall be offered: the fat tail and the fat that covers the internal organs,

verses.textZh: 以及两个肾、肾上近腰旁的脂肪和肾旁的肝叶，一起取下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及两个肾、肾上近腰旁的脂肪和肾旁的肝叶，一起取下。
verses.textZhCuv: 两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，并肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下。
verses.textEnNiv: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.
verses.textEnEsv: the two kidneys with the fat that is on them at the loins, and the long lobe of the liver that he shall remove with the kidneys.
verses.textEnNkjv: the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;
verses.textEnNlt: the two kidneys and the fat around them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver. These are to be removed with the kidneys,
verses.textEnNasb: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins; and he shall remove the lobe on the liver with the kidneys.
verses.textEn: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

verses.textZh: 然后把这些焚烧在祭坛上，作献给耶和华的火祭，这是赎愆祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后把这些焚烧在祭坛上，作献给耶和华的火祭，这是赎愆祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要在坛上焚烧，为献给耶和华的火祭，是赎愆祭。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord . It is a guilt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering to the Lord ; it is a guilt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the priest shall burn them on the altar as an offering made by fire to the Lord. It is a trespass offering.
verses.textEnNlt: and the priests will burn them on the altar as a special gift presented to the Lord . This is the guilt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall offer them up in smoke on the altar as an offering by fire to the Lord; it is a guilt offering.
verses.textEn: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord . It is a guilt offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司家中的男丁，都可以吃祭牲的肉，要在圣洁的地方吃；这是至圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司家中的男丁，都可以吃祭牲的肉，要在圣洁的地方吃；这是至圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司中的男丁都可以吃这祭物；要在圣处吃，是至圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: Any male in a priest’s family may eat it, but it must be eaten in the sanctuary area; it is most holy.
verses.textEnEsv: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every male among the priests may eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Any male from a priest’s family may eat the meat. It must be eaten in a sacred place, for it is most holy.
verses.textEnNasb: Every male among the priests may eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.
verses.textEn: Any male in a priest’s family may eat it, but it must be eaten in the sanctuary area; it is most holy.

verses.textZh: 赎罪祭怎样，赎愆祭也怎样；两个祭的律例相同；祭物要归主持赎罪的祭司，
verses.textZhCnvs: 赎罪祭怎样，赎愆祭也怎样；两个祭的律例相同；祭物要归主持赎罪的祭司，
verses.textZhCuv: 赎罪祭怎样，赎愆祭也是怎样，两个祭是一个条例。献赎愆祭赎罪的祭司要得这祭物。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The same law applies to both the sin offering and the guilt offering: They belong to the priest who makes atonement with them.
verses.textEnEsv: The guilt offering is just like the sin offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with it shall have it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The trespass offering is like the sin offering; there is one law for them both: the priest who makes atonement with it shall have it.
verses.textEnNlt: "The same instructions apply to both the guilt offering and the sin offering. Both belong to the priest who uses them to purify someone, making that person right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The guilt offering is like the sin offering: there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with it shall have it.
verses.textEn: " ‘The same law applies to both the sin offering and the guilt offering: They belong to the priest who makes atonement with them.

verses.textZh: 祭司替人献燔祭，祭牲的皮要归献燔祭的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司替人献燔祭，祭牲的皮要归献燔祭的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 献燔祭的祭司，无论为谁奉献，要亲自得他所献那燔祭牲的皮。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest who offers a burnt offering for anyone may keep its hide for himself.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering that he has offered.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest who offers anyone’s burnt offering, that priest shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
verses.textEnNlt: In the case of the burnt offering, the priest may keep the hide of the sacrificed animal.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the priest who presents anyone’s burnt offering, that priest shall have for himself the hide of the burnt offering which he has presented.
verses.textEn: The priest who offers a burnt offering for anyone may keep its hide for himself.

verses.textZh: 一切在炉里烤的，或在浅锅里或在煎盘上做的素祭，都要归给那献祭的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切在炉里烤的，或在浅锅里或在煎盘上做的素祭，都要归给那献祭的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在炉中烤的素祭和煎盘中做的，并铁鏊上做的，都要归那献祭的祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: Every grain offering baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who offers it,
verses.textEnEsv: And every grain offering baked in the oven and all that is prepared on a pan or a griddle shall belong to the priest who offers it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also every grain offering that is baked in the oven and all that is prepared in the covered pan, or in a pan, shall be the priest’s who offers it.
verses.textEnNlt: Any grain offering that has been baked in an oven, prepared in a pan, or cooked on a griddle belongs to the priest who presents it.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise, every grain offering that is baked in the oven and everything prepared in a pan or on a griddle shall belong to the priest who presents it.
verses.textEn: Every grain offering baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who offers it,

verses.textZh: 一切用油调和，或是干的素祭，都要归给亚伦所有的子孙，大家均分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切用油调和，或是干的素祭，都要归给亚伦所有的子孙，大家均分。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡素祭，无论是油调和的是干的，都要归亚伦的子孙，大家均分。」
verses.textEnNiv: and every grain offering, whether mixed with olive oil or dry, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: And every grain offering, mixed with oil or dry, shall be shared equally among all the sons of Aaron.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every grain offering, whether mixed with oil or dry, shall belong to all the sons of Aaron, to one as much as the other.
verses.textEnNlt: All other grain offerings, whether made of dry flour or flour moistened with olive oil, are to be shared equally among all the priests, the descendants of Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: Every grain offering, mixed with oil or dry, shall belong to all the sons of Aaron, to all alike.
verses.textEn: and every grain offering, whether mixed with olive oil or dry, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.

verses.textZh: "献给耶和华的平安祭的律例是这样：
verses.textZhCnvs: "献给耶和华的平安祭的律例是这样：
verses.textZhCuv: 「人献与耶和华平安祭的条例乃是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘These are the regulations for the fellowship offering anyone may present to the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: "And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings that one may offer to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings which he shall offer to the Lord:
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the instructions regarding the different kinds of peace offerings that may be presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings which shall be presented to the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘These are the regulations for the fellowship offering anyone may present to the Lord :

verses.textZh: 人若是为感恩献祭，就要用调油的无酵饼和抹了油的无酵薄饼，以及用油调和了细面做的饼，与感恩祭一同献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若是为感恩献祭，就要用调油的无酵饼和抹了油的无酵薄饼，以及用油调和了细面做的饼，与感恩祭一同献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若为感谢献上，就要用调油的无酵饼和抹油的无酵薄饼，并用油调匀细面做的饼，与感谢祭一同献上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If they offer it as an expression of thankfulness, then along with this thank offering they are to offer thick loaves made without yeast and with olive oil mixed in, thin loaves made without yeast and brushed with oil, and thick loaves of the finest flour well-kneaded and with oil mixed in.
verses.textEnEsv: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the thanksgiving sacrifice unleavened loaves mixed with oil, unleavened wafers smeared with oil, and loaves of fine flour well mixed with oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer, with the sacrifice of thanksgiving, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers anointed with oil, or cakes of blended flour mixed with oil.
verses.textEnNlt: If you present your peace offering as an expression of thanksgiving, the usual animal sacrifice must be accompanied by various kinds of bread made without yeast—thin cakes mixed with olive oil, wafers spread with oil, and cakes made of choice flour mixed with olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: If he offers it by way of thanksgiving, then along with the sacrifice of thanksgiving he shall offer unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil, and cakes of well stirred fine flour mixed with oil.
verses.textEn: " ‘If they offer it as an expression of thankfulness, then along with this thank offering they are to offer thick loaves made without yeast and with olive oil mixed in, thin loaves made without yeast and brushed with oil, and thick loaves of the finest flour well-kneaded and with oil mixed in.

verses.textZh: 他要把他的供物，连同有酵的饼，跟那为感恩而献的平安祭，一起献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要把他的供物，连同有酵的饼，跟那为感恩而献的平安祭，一起献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用有酵的饼和为感谢献的平安祭，与供物一同献上。
verses.textEnNiv: Along with their fellowship offering of thanksgiving they are to present an offering with thick loaves of bread made with yeast.
verses.textEnEsv: With the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving he shall bring his offering with loaves of leavened bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: Besides the cakes, as his offering he shall offer leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offering.
verses.textEnNlt: This peace offering of thanksgiving must also be accompanied by loaves of bread made with yeast.
verses.textEnNasb: With the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving, he shall present his offering with cakes of leavened bread.
verses.textEn: Along with their fellowship offering of thanksgiving they are to present an offering with thick loaves of bread made with yeast.

verses.textZh: 他要从各物中，取出一个饼作为举祭，献给耶和华，归给那泼平安祭牲之血的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要从各物中，取出一个饼作为举祭，献给耶和华，归给那泼平安祭牲之血的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 从各样的供物中，他要把一个饼献给耶和华为举祭，是要归给洒平安祭牲血的祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to bring one of each kind as an offering, a contribution to the Lord ; it belongs to the priest who splashes the blood of the fellowship offering against the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And from it he shall offer one loaf from each offering, as a gift to the Lord . It shall belong to the priest who throws the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: And from it he shall offer one cake from each offering as a heave offering to the Lord. It shall belong to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offering.
verses.textEnNlt: One of each kind of bread must be presented as a gift to the Lord . It will then belong to the priest who splatters the blood of the peace offering against the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Of this he shall present one of every offering as a contribution to the Lord; it shall belong to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.textEn: They are to bring one of each kind as an offering, a contribution to the Lord ; it belongs to the priest who splashes the blood of the fellowship offering against the altar.

verses.textZh: "为感恩而献的平安祭的肉，只能在献祭那日吃，一点也不可留到早晨。
verses.textZhCnvs: "为感恩而献的平安祭的肉，只能在献祭那日吃，一点也不可留到早晨。
verses.textZhCuv: 为感谢献平安祭牲的肉，要在献的日子吃，一点不可留到早晨。
verses.textEnNiv: The meat of their fellowship offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day it is offered; they must leave none of it till morning.
verses.textEnEsv: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offering for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day it is offered. He shall not leave any of it until morning.
verses.textEnNlt: The meat of the peace offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the same day it is offered. None of it may be saved for the next morning.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now as for the flesh of the sacrifice of his thanksgiving peace offerings, it shall be eaten on the day of his offering; he shall not leave any of it over until morning.
verses.textEn: The meat of their fellowship offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day it is offered; they must leave none of it till morning.

verses.textZh: 他献的供物若是还愿祭，或是甘心祭，献祭那日可以吃；剩下的，第二天也可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他献的供物若是还愿祭，或是甘心祭，献祭那日可以吃；剩下的，第二天也可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 若所献的是为还愿，或是甘心献的，必在献祭的日子吃，所剩下的第二天也可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If, however, their offering is the result of a vow or is a freewill offering, the sacrifice shall be eaten on the day they offer it, but anything left over may be eaten on the next day.
verses.textEnEsv: But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow offering or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice, and on the next day what remains of it shall be eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offers his sacrifice; but on the next day the remainder of it also may be eaten;
verses.textEnNlt: "If you bring an offering to fulfill a vow or as a voluntary offering, the meat must be eaten on the same day the sacrifice is offered, but whatever is left over may be eaten on the second day.
verses.textEnNasb: But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice, and on the next day what is left of it may be eaten;
