verses.textEn: " ‘If, however, their offering is the result of a vow or is a freewill offering, the sacrifice shall be eaten on the day they offer it, but anything left over may be eaten on the next day.

verses.textZh: 还剩下的祭肉，到了第三天，就要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还剩下的祭肉，到了第三天，就要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚烧；
verses.textEnNiv: Any meat of the sacrifice left over till the third day must be burned up.
verses.textEnEsv: But what remains of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned up with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day must be burned with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Any meat left over until the third day must be completely burned up.
verses.textEnNasb: but what is left over from the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.
verses.textEn: Any meat of the sacrifice left over till the third day must be burned up.

verses.textZh: 如果在第三天吃平安祭的肉，必不蒙悦纳，他献上的也不再算为祭，因为祭肉已经成为不洁；吃这肉的人，必担当自己的罪责。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果在第三天吃平安祭的肉，必不蒙悦纳，他献上的也不再算为祭，因为祭肉已经成为不洁；吃这肉的人，必担当自己的罪责。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三天若吃了平安祭的肉，这祭必不蒙悦纳，人所献的也不算为祭，反为可憎嫌的，吃这祭肉的，就必担当他的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: If any meat of the fellowship offering is eaten on the third day, the one who offered it will not be accepted. It will not be reckoned to their credit, for it has become impure; the person who eats any of it will be held responsible.
verses.textEnEsv: If any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offering is eaten on the third day, he who offers it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be credited to him. It is tainted, and he who eats of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offering is eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, nor shall it be imputed to him; it shall be an abomination to him who offers it, and the person who eats of it shall bear guilt.
verses.textEnNlt: If any of the meat from the peace offering is eaten on the third day, the person who presented it will not be accepted by the Lord . You will receive no credit for offering it. By then the meat will be contaminated; if you eat it, you will be punished for your sin.
verses.textEnNasb: So if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is ever eaten on the third day, he who offers it will not be accepted, and it will not be credited to him. It will be an unclean thing, and the person who eats it shall bear his punishment.
verses.textEn: If any meat of the fellowship offering is eaten on the third day, the one who offered it will not be accepted. It will not be reckoned to their credit, for it has become impure; the person who eats any of it will be held responsible.

verses.textZh: "祭肉若是接触了任何不洁，就不可以吃，要用火烧掉。洁净的人才可以吃祭肉；
verses.textZhCnvs: "祭肉若是接触了任何不洁，就不可以吃，要用火烧掉。洁净的人才可以吃祭肉；
verses.textZhCuv: 「挨了污秽物的肉就不可吃，要用火焚烧。至于平安祭的肉，凡洁净的人都要吃；
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Meat that touches anything ceremonially unclean must not be eaten; it must be burned up. As for other meat, anyone ceremonially clean may eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned up with fire. All who are clean may eat flesh,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘The flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. And as for the clean flesh, all who are clean may eat of it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Meat that touches anything ceremonially unclean may not be eaten; it must be completely burned up. The rest of the meat may be eaten, but only by people who are ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Also the flesh that touches anything unclean shall not be eaten; it shall be burned with fire. As for other flesh, anyone who is clean may eat such flesh.
verses.textEn: " ‘Meat that touches anything ceremonially unclean must not be eaten; it must be burned up. As for other meat, anyone ceremonially clean may eat it.

verses.textZh: 身上不洁净的人吃了献与耶和华的平安祭的祭肉，那人必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 身上不洁净的人吃了献与耶和华的平安祭的祭肉，那人必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是献与耶和华平安祭的肉，人若不洁净而吃了，这人必从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: But if anyone who is unclean eats any meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord , they must be cut off from their people.
verses.textEnEsv: but the person who eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of the Lord ’s peace offerings while an uncleanness is on him, that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the person who eats the flesh of the sacrifice of the peace offering that belongs to the Lord, while he is unclean, that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEnNlt: If you are ceremonially unclean and you eat meat from a peace offering that was presented to the Lord , you will be cut off from the community.
verses.textEnNasb: But the person who eats the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the Lord, when he is unclean, that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEn: But if anyone who is unclean eats any meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord , they must be cut off from their people.

verses.textZh: 人若是摸了任何不洁，或是人的污秽，或是牲畜的污秽，或是任何不洁净的可憎之物，然后吃献给耶和华的平安祭的肉，那人必从自己的族人中被剪除。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若是摸了任何不洁，或是人的污秽，或是牲畜的污秽，或是任何不洁净的可憎之物，然后吃献给耶和华的平安祭的肉，那人必从自己的族人中被剪除。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人摸了什么不洁净的物，或是人的不洁净，或是不洁净的牲畜，或是不洁可憎之物，吃了献与耶和华平安祭的肉，这人必从民中剪除。」
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who touches something unclean—whether human uncleanness or an unclean animal or any unclean creature that moves along the ground —and then eats any of the meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord must be cut off from their people.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And if anyone touches an unclean thing, whether human uncleanness or an unclean beast or any unclean detestable creature, and then eats some flesh from the sacrifice of the Lord ’s peace offerings, that person shall be cut off from his people."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the person who touches any unclean thing, such as human uncleanness, an unclean animal, or any abominable unclean thing, and who eats the flesh of the sacrifice of the peace offering that belongs to the Lord, that person shall be cut off from his people.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: If you touch anything that is unclean (whether it is human defilement or an unclean animal or any other unclean, detestable thing) and then eat meat from a peace offering presented to the Lord , you will be cut off from the community."
verses.textEnNasb: When anyone touches anything unclean, whether human uncleanness, or an unclean animal, or any unclean detestable thing, and eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the Lord, that person shall be cut off from his people.’ "
verses.textEn: Anyone who touches something unclean—whether human uncleanness or an unclean animal or any unclean creature that moves along the ground —and then eats any of the meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord must be cut off from their people.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人说：所有公牛、绵羊或是山羊的脂肪，你们都不可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人说：所有公牛、绵羊或是山羊的脂肪，你们都不可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：牛的脂油、绵羊的脂油、山羊的脂油，你们都不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Do not eat any of the fat of cattle, sheep or goats.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, saying, You shall eat no fat, of ox or sheep or goat.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘You shall not eat any fat, of ox or sheep or goat.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. You must never eat fat, whether from cattle, sheep, or goats.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘You shall not eat any fat from an ox, a sheep, or a goat.
verses.textEn: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Do not eat any of the fat of cattle, sheep or goats.

verses.textZh: 自死的或被野兽撕裂的动物的脂肪，可以作别的用途，只是你们决不可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自死的或被野兽撕裂的动物的脂肪，可以作别的用途，只是你们决不可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 自死的和被野兽撕裂的，那脂油可以做别的使用，只是你们万不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: The fat of an animal found dead or torn by wild animals may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: The fat of an animal that dies of itself and the fat of one that is torn by beasts may be put to any other use, but on no account shall you eat it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the fat of an animal that dies naturally, and the fat of what is torn by wild beasts, may be used in any other way; but you shall by no means eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: The fat of an animal found dead or torn to pieces by wild animals must never be eaten, though it may be used for any other purpose.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the fat of an animal which dies and the fat of an animal torn by animals may be put to any other use, but you certainly are not to eat it.
verses.textEn: The fat of an animal found dead or torn by wild animals may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.

verses.textZh: 因为无论何人吃了献给耶和华为火祭的牲畜的脂肪，那吃的人就必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为无论何人吃了献给耶和华为火祭的牲畜的脂肪，那吃的人就必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论何人吃了献给耶和华当火祭牲畜的脂油，那人必从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who eats the fat of an animal from which a food offering may be presented to the Lord must be cut off from their people.
verses.textEnEsv: For every person who eats of the fat of an animal of which a food offering may be made to the Lord shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever eats the fat of the animal of which men offer an offering made by fire to the Lord, the person who eats it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who eats fat from an animal presented as a special gift to the Lord will be cut off from the community.
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever eats the fat of the animal from which an offering by fire is offered to the Lord, the person who eats it shall also be cut off from his people.
verses.textEn: Anyone who eats the fat of an animal from which a food offering may be presented to the Lord must be cut off from their people.

verses.textZh: 在你们的一切住处，任何血，无论是飞鸟或是牲畜的，你们都不可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你们的一切住处，任何血，无论是飞鸟或是牲畜的，你们都不可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你们一切的住处，无论是雀鸟的血是野兽的血，你们都不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: And wherever you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, you shall eat no blood whatever, whether of fowl or of animal, in any of your dwelling places.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover you shall not eat any blood in any of your dwellings, whether of bird or beast.
verses.textEnNlt: No matter where you live, you must never consume the blood of any bird or animal.
verses.textEnNasb: And you are not to eat any blood, either of bird or animal, in any of your dwellings.
verses.textEn: And wherever you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal.

verses.textZh: 无论谁吃了甚么血，那人必从自己的族人中被剪除。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论谁吃了甚么血，那人必从自己的族人中被剪除。"
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是谁吃血，那人必从民中剪除。」
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who eats blood must be cut off from their people.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever eats any blood, that person shall be cut off from his people."
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever eats any blood, that person shall be cut off from his people.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who consumes blood will be cut off from the community."
verses.textEnNasb: Any person who eats any blood, that person shall also be cut off from his people.’ "
verses.textEn: Anyone who eats blood must be cut off from their people.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人：向耶和华献平安祭的，必须从他的平安祭中取出奉给耶和华的供物。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人：向耶和华献平安祭的，必须从他的平安祭中取出奉给耶和华的供物。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：献平安祭给耶和华的，要从平安祭中取些来奉给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Anyone who brings a fellowship offering to the Lord is to bring part of it as their sacrifice to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, saying, Whoever offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the Lord shall bring his offering to the Lord from the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offering to the Lord shall bring his offering to the Lord from the sacrifice of his peace offering.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. When you present a peace offering to the Lord , bring part of it as a gift to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the Lord shall bring his offering to the Lord from the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.textEn: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Anyone who brings a fellowship offering to the Lord is to bring part of it as their sacrifice to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亲手把献给耶和华的火祭带来，就是把脂肪连胸带来，在耶和华面前摇一摇，作为摇祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲手把献给耶和华的火祭带来，就是把脂肪连胸带来，在耶和华面前摇一摇，作为摇祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他亲手献给耶和华的火祭，就是脂油和胸，要带来，好把胸在耶和华面前作摇祭，摇一摇。
verses.textEnNiv: With their own hands they are to present the food offering to the Lord ; they are to bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast before the Lord as a wave offering.
verses.textEnEsv: His own hands shall bring the Lord ’s food offerings. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved as a wave offering before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: His own hands shall bring the offerings made by fire to the Lord. The fat with the breast he shall bring, that the breast may be waved as a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Present it to the Lord with your own hands as a special gift to the Lord . Bring the fat of the animal, together with the breast, and lift up the breast as a special offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: His own hands are to bring offerings by fire to the Lord. He shall bring the fat with the breast, so that the breast may be presented as a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.textEn: With their own hands they are to present the food offering to the Lord ; they are to bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast before the Lord as a wave offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司要把脂肪焚烧在祭坛上，胸归给亚伦和他的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要把脂肪焚烧在祭坛上，胸归给亚伦和他的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要把脂油在坛上焚烧，但胸要归亚伦和他的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.
verses.textEnEsv: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be for Aaron and his sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the priest will burn the fat on the altar, but the breast will belong to Aaron and his descendants.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest shall offer up the fat in smoke on the altar, but the breast shall belong to Aaron and to his sons.
verses.textEn: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.

verses.textZh: 你们要从平安祭牲中，拿右后腿来作举祭，奉给祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要从平安祭牲中，拿右后腿来作举祭，奉给祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要从平安祭中把右腿作举祭，奉给祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to give the right thigh of your fellowship offerings to the priest as a contribution.
verses.textEnEsv: And the right thigh you shall give to the priest as a contribution from the sacrifice of your peace offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the right thigh you shall give to the priest as a heave offering from the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: Give the right thigh of your peace offering to the priest as a gift.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall give the right thigh to the priest as a contribution from the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.textEn: You are to give the right thigh of your fellowship offerings to the priest as a contribution.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的子孙中，谁献平安祭牲的血和脂肪，右后腿就归给他，是他的分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的子孙中，谁献平安祭牲的血和脂肪，右后腿就归给他，是他的分。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦子孙中，献平安祭牲血和脂油的，要得这右腿为分；
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Aaron who offers the blood and the fat of the fellowship offering shall have the right thigh as his share.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever among the sons of Aaron offers the blood of the peace offerings and the fat shall have the right thigh for a portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: He among the sons of Aaron, who offers the blood of the peace offering and the fat, shall have the right thigh for his part.
verses.textEnNlt: The right thigh must always be given to the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the peace offering.
verses.textEnNasb: The one among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings and the fat, the right thigh shall be his as his portion.
verses.textEn: The son of Aaron who offers the blood and the fat of the fellowship offering shall have the right thigh as his share.

verses.textZh: 因为我从以色列人的平安祭中，取出了这摇祭的胸和举祭的后腿，给亚伦祭司和他的子孙，成为以色列人中永远的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我从以色列人的平安祭中，取出了这摇祭的胸和举祭的后腿，给亚伦祭司和他的子孙，成为以色列人中永远的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我从以色列人的平安祭中，取了这摇的胸和举的腿给祭司亚伦和他子孙，作他们从以色列人中所永得的分。」
verses.textEnNiv: From the fellowship offerings of the Israelites, I have taken the breast that is waved and the thigh that is presented and have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as their perpetual share from the Israelites.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For the breast that is waved and the thigh that is contributed I have taken from the people of Israel, out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons, as a perpetual due from the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering I have taken from the children of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons from the children of Israel by a statute forever.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For I have reserved the breast of the special offering and the right thigh of the sacred offering for the priests. It is the permanent right of Aaron and his descendants to share in the peace offerings brought by the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have taken from the sons of Israel the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their allotted portion forever from the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: From the fellowship offerings of the Israelites, I have taken the breast that is waved and the thigh that is presented and have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as their perpetual share from the Israelites.’ "

verses.textZh: "这是亚伦和他子孙，从奉献他们作耶和华的祭司那日开始，受膏立应得的分。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这是亚伦和他子孙，从奉献他们作耶和华的祭司那日开始，受膏立应得的分。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是从耶和华火祭中，作亚伦受膏的分和他子孙受膏的分，正在摩西 叫他们前来给耶和华供祭司职分的日子，
verses.textEnNiv: This is the portion of the food offerings presented to the Lord that were allotted to Aaron and his sons on the day they were presented to serve the Lord as priests.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the portion of Aaron and of his sons from the Lord ’s food offerings, from the day they were presented to serve as priests of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the consecrated portion for Aaron and his sons, from the offerings made by fire to the Lord, on the day when Moses presented them to minister to the Lord as priests.
verses.textEnNlt: This is their rightful share. The special gifts presented to the Lord have been reserved for Aaron and his descendants from the time they were set apart to serve the Lord as priests.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is the allotment to Aaron and the allotment to his sons from the offerings by fire to the Lord, on that day when he presented them to serve as priests to the Lord.
verses.textEn: This is the portion of the food offerings presented to the Lord that were allotted to Aaron and his sons on the day they were presented to serve the Lord as priests.

verses.textZh: 就是耶和华膏立他们的时候，命令以色列人给他们的。这是世世代代永远的律例。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是耶和华膏立他们的时候，命令以色列人给他们的。这是世世代代永远的律例。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就是在摩西 膏他们的日子，耶和华吩咐以色列人给他们的。这是他们世世代代永得的分。
verses.textEnNiv: On the day they were anointed, the Lord commanded that the Israelites give this to them as their perpetual share for the generations to come.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord commanded this to be given them by the people of Israel, from the day that he anointed them. It is a perpetual due throughout their generations."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord commanded this to be given to them by the children of Israel, on the day that He anointed them, by a statute forever throughout their generations.
verses.textEnNlt: On the day they were anointed, the Lord commanded the Israelites to give these portions to the priests as their permanent share from generation to generation."
verses.textEnNasb: These the Lord had commanded to be given them from the sons of Israel on the day that He anointed them. It is their allotted portion forever throughout their generations.’ "
verses.textEn: On the day they were anointed, the Lord commanded that the Israelites give this to them as their perpetual share for the generations to come.

verses.textZh: 以上关于燔祭、素祭、赎罪祭、赎愆祭、承受圣职祭和平安祭的律例，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上关于燔祭、素祭、赎罪祭、赎愆祭、承受圣职祭和平安祭的律例，
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是燔祭、素祭、赎罪祭、赎愆祭，和平安祭的条例，并承接圣职的礼，
verses.textEnNiv: These, then, are the regulations for the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering and the fellowship offering,
verses.textEnEsv: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the grain offering, of the sin offering, of the guilt offering, of the ordination offering, and of the peace offering,
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the law of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecrations, and the sacrifice of the peace offering,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the instructions for the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering, as well as the ordination offering and the peace offering.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the law of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering and the guilt offering, and the ordination offering and the sacrifice of peace offerings,
verses.textEn: These, then, are the regulations for the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering and the fellowship offering,

verses.textZh: 都是耶和华在西奈山吩咐摩西的，就是他在西奈的旷野吩咐以色列人，把他们的供物献给耶和华的时候所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 都是耶和华在西奈山吩咐摩西的，就是他在西奈的旷野吩咐以色列人，把他们的供物献给耶和华的时候所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 都是耶和华在西奈山所吩咐摩西的，就是他在西奈旷野吩咐以色列人献供物给耶和华之日所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: which the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai in the Desert of Sinai on the day he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: which the Lord commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day that he commanded the people of Israel to bring their offerings to the Lord , in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEnNkjv: which the Lord commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day when He commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the Lord in the Wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave these instructions to Moses on Mount Sinai when he commanded the Israelites to present their offerings to the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEnNasb: which the Lord commanded Moses on Mount Sinai on the day that He commanded the sons of Israel to present their offerings to the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEn: which the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai in the Desert of Sinai on the day he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要把亚伦和他的儿子，连同圣衣、膏油、赎罪祭的一头公牛、两只公绵羊，一篮无酵饼都带来，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要把亚伦和他的儿子，连同圣衣、膏油、赎罪祭的一头公牛、两只公绵羊，一篮无酵饼都带来，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你将亚伦和他儿子一同带来，并将圣衣、膏油，与赎罪祭的一只公牛、两只公绵羊、一筐无酵饼都带来，
verses.textEnNiv: "Bring Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams and the basket containing bread made without yeast,
verses.textEnEsv: "Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments and the anointing oil and the bull of the sin offering and the two rams and the basket of unleavened bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, the anointing oil, a bull as the sin offering, two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
verses.textEnNlt: "Bring Aaron and his sons, along with their sacred garments, the anointing oil, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of bread made without yeast,
verses.textEnNasb: "Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams and the basket of unleavened bread,
verses.textEn: "Bring Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams and the basket containing bread made without yeast,

verses.textZh: 又要召集全体会众到会幕门口那里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要召集全体会众到会幕门口那里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又招聚会众到会幕门口。」
verses.textEnNiv: and gather the entire assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting."
verses.textEnEsv: And assemble all the congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting."
verses.textEnNkjv: and gather all the congregation together at the door of the tabernacle of meeting."
verses.textEnNlt: and call the entire community of Israel together at the entrance of the Tabernacle. "
verses.textEnNasb: and assemble all the congregation at the doorway of the tent of meeting."
verses.textEn: and gather the entire assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting."

verses.textZh: 于是摩西照着耶和华命令他的去行，会众就聚集到会幕门口那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西照着耶和华命令他的去行，会众就聚集到会幕门口那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就照耶和华所吩咐的行了；于是会众聚集在会幕门口。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses did as the Lord commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him, and the congregation was assembled at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses did as the Lord commanded him. And the congregation was gathered together at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses followed the Lord ’s instructions, and the whole community assembled at the Tabernacle entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses did just as the Lord commanded him. When the congregation was assembled at the doorway of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEn: Moses did as the Lord commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 摩西对会众说："这是耶和华吩咐我作的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对会众说："这是耶和华吩咐我作的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西告诉会众说：「这就是耶和华所吩咐当行的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to the assembly, "This is what the Lord has commanded to be done."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to the congregation, "This is the thing that the Lord has commanded to be done."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to the congregation, "This is what the Lord commanded to be done."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses announced to them, "This is what the Lord has commanded us to do!"
verses.textEnNasb: Moses said to the congregation, "This is the thing which the Lord has commanded us to do."
verses.textEn: Moses said to the assembly, "This is what the Lord has commanded to be done."

verses.textZh: 摩西领亚伦和他的儿子来，用水给他们洗身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西领亚伦和他的儿子来，用水给他们洗身。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西带了亚伦和他儿子来，用水洗了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons and washed them with water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons and washed them with water.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he presented Aaron and his sons and washed them with water.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses had Aaron and his sons come near, and he washed them with water.
verses.textEn: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.

verses.textZh: 然后给亚伦穿上内袍，束上腰带，穿上外袍，又加上以弗得，用巧工织成的以弗得带子束上，把以弗得系在他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后给亚伦穿上内袍，束上腰带，穿上外袍，又加上以弗得，用巧工织成的以弗得带子束上，把以弗得系在他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 给亚伦穿上内袍，束上腰带，穿上外袍，又加上以弗得，用其上巧工织的带子把以弗得系在他身上，
verses.textEnNiv: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him. He also fastened the ephod with a decorative waistband, which he tied around him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he put the coat on him and tied the sash around his waist and clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him and tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod around him, binding it to him with the band.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he put the tunic on him, girded him with the sash, clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him; and he girded him with the intricately woven band of the ephod, and with it tied the ephod on him.
verses.textEnNlt: He put the official tunic on Aaron and tied the sash around his waist. He dressed him in the robe, placed the ephod on him, and attached the ephod securely with its decorative sash.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he put the tunic on Aaron and wrapped his waist with the sash, and clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him; and he wrapped his waist with the artistic band of the ephod, with which he fitted it to him.
verses.textEn: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him. He also fastened the ephod with a decorative waistband, which he tied around him.

verses.textZh: 又给他佩上胸牌，把乌陵和土明放在胸牌里面，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又给他佩上胸牌，把乌陵和土明放在胸牌里面，
verses.textZhCuv: 又给他戴上胸牌，把乌陵和土明放在胸牌内，
verses.textEnNiv: He placed the breastpiece on him and put the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.
verses.textEnEsv: And he placed the breastpiece on him, and in the breastpiece he put the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he put the breastplate on him, and he put the Urim and the Thummim in the breastplate.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses placed the chestpiece on Aaron and put the Urim and the Thummim inside it.
verses.textEnNasb: He then placed the breastpiece on him, and in the breastpiece he put the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.textEn: He placed the breastpiece on him and put the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.

verses.textZh: 把礼冠戴在他头上；在礼冠前面安上金牌，就是圣冠，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把礼冠戴在他头上；在礼冠前面安上金牌，就是圣冠，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 把冠冕戴在他头上，在冠冕的前面钉上金牌，就是圣冠，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he placed the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the sacred emblem, on the front of it, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And he set the turban on his head, and on the turban, in front, he set the golden plate, the holy crown, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he put the turban on his head. Also on the turban, on its front, he put the golden plate, the holy crown, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: He placed the turban on Aaron’s head and attached the gold medallion—the badge of holiness—to the front of the turban, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: He also placed the turban on his head, and on the turban, at its front, he placed the golden plate, the holy crown, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Then he placed the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the sacred emblem, on the front of it, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 摩西取膏油，抹了帐幕和其中所有的东西，使它们分别为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西取膏油，抹了帐幕和其中所有的东西，使它们分别为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西用膏油抹帐幕和其中所有的，使它成圣；
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything in it, and so consecrated them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and consecrated them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and consecrated them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the Tabernacle and everything in it, making them holy.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses then took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything that was in it, and consecrated them.
verses.textEn: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything in it, and so consecrated them.

verses.textZh: 又七次弹膏油在祭坛上，膏抹祭坛和祭坛的一切器皿，以及洗濯盆和盆座，使它们分别为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又七次弹膏油在祭坛上，膏抹祭坛和祭坛的一切器皿，以及洗濯盆和盆座，使它们分别为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用膏油在坛上弹了七次，又抹了坛和坛的一切器皿，并洗濯盆和盆座，使它成圣；
verses.textEnNiv: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its utensils and the basin and its stand, to consecrate them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, anointed the altar and all its utensils, and the laver and its base, to consecrate them.
verses.textEnNlt: He sprinkled the oil on the altar seven times, anointing it and all its utensils, as well as the washbasin and its stand, making them holy.
verses.textEnNasb: He also sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times and anointed the altar and all its utensils, and the basin and its stand, to consecrate them.
verses.textEn: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.

verses.textZh: 然后把膏油倒在亚伦的头上，膏立他，使他分别为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后把膏油倒在亚伦的头上，膏立他，使他分别为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 又把膏油倒在亚伦的头上膏他，使他成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him, to consecrate him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, anointing him and making him holy for his work.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him, to consecrate him.
verses.textEn: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.

verses.textZh: 摩西把亚伦的儿子带来，给他们穿上内袍，束上腰带，包上裹头巾，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把亚伦的儿子带来，给他们穿上内袍，束上腰带，包上裹头巾，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西带了亚伦的儿子来，给他们穿上内袍，束上腰带，包上裹头巾，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he brought Aaron’s sons forward, put tunics on them, tied sashes around them and fastened caps on them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons and clothed them with coats and tied sashes around their waists and bound caps on them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses brought Aaron’s sons and put tunics on them, girded them with sashes, and put hats on them, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Moses presented Aaron’s sons. He clothed them in their tunics, tied their sashes around them, and put their special head coverings on them, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: Next Moses had Aaron’s sons come near, and he clothed them with tunics and wrapped their waists with sashes, and bound caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Then he brought Aaron’s sons forward, put tunics on them, tied sashes around them and fastened caps on them, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 他把赎罪祭的公牛牵来；亚伦和他的儿子按手在赎罪祭的公牛的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把赎罪祭的公牛牵来；亚伦和他的儿子按手在赎罪祭的公牛的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他牵了赎罪祭的公牛来，亚伦和他儿子按手在赎罪祭公牛的头上，
verses.textEnNiv: He then presented the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought the bull for the sin offering. Then Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull for the sin offering,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses presented the bull for the sin offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the bull’s head,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.
verses.textEn: He then presented the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

verses.textZh: 摩西就宰杀公牛，取了血，用指头抹祭坛四角的周围，洁净祭坛，其余的血倒在祭坛脚那里，使祭坛成圣，为坛赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就宰杀公牛，取了血，用指头抹祭坛四角的周围，洁净祭坛，其余的血倒在祭坛脚那里，使祭坛成圣，为坛赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 就宰了公牛。摩西用指头蘸血，抹在坛上四角的周围，使坛洁净，把血倒在坛的脚那里，使坛成圣，坛就洁净了；
verses.textEnNiv: Moses slaughtered the bull and took some of the blood, and with his finger he put it on all the horns of the altar to purify the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. So he consecrated it to make atonement for it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he killed it, and Moses took the blood, and with his finger put it on the horns of the altar around it and purified the altar and poured out the blood at the base of the altar and consecrated it to make atonement for it.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Moses killed it. Then he took the blood, and put some on the horns of the altar all around with his finger, and purified the altar. And he poured the blood at the base of the altar, and consecrated it, to make atonement for it.
verses.textEnNlt: and Moses slaughtered it. Moses took some of the blood, and with his finger he put it on the four horns of the altar to purify it. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. Through this process, he made the altar holy by purifying it.
verses.textEnNasb: Next Moses slaughtered it and took the blood and with his finger put some of it around on the horns of the altar, and purified the altar. Then he poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar and consecrated it, to make atonement for it.
verses.textEn: Moses slaughtered the bull and took some of the blood, and with his finger he put it on all the horns of the altar to purify the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. So he consecrated it to make atonement for it.

verses.textZh: 摩西取出内脏上所有的脂肪、肾旁的肝叶、两个肾和肾上的脂肪，焚烧在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西取出内脏上所有的脂肪、肾旁的肝叶、两个肾和肾上的脂肪，焚烧在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又取脏上所有的脂油和肝上的网子，并两个腰子与腰子上的脂油，都烧在坛上；
verses.textEnNiv: Moses also took all the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and both kidneys and their fat, and burned it on the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took all the fat that was on the entrails and the long lobe of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and Moses burned them on the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took all the fat that was on the entrails, the fatty lobe attached to the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat, and Moses burned them on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses took all the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat around them, and he burned it all on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: He also took all the fat that was on the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat; and Moses offered it up in smoke on the altar.
verses.textEn: Moses also took all the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and both kidneys and their fat, and burned it on the altar.

verses.textZh: 至于那公牛，牠的皮、肉和粪，都要在营外用火烧掉，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那公牛，牠的皮、肉和粪，都要在营外用火烧掉，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有公牛，连皮带肉并粪，用火烧在营外，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: But the bull with its hide and its flesh and its intestines he burned up outside the camp, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: But the bull and its skin and its flesh and its dung he burned up with fire outside the camp, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the bull, its hide, its flesh, and its offal, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: He took the rest of the bull, including its hide, meat, and dung, and burned it on a fire outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: But the bull and its hide, its flesh, and its refuse he burned in the fire outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: But the bull with its hide and its flesh and its intestines he burned up outside the camp, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 摩西把燔祭的公绵羊牵来，亚伦和他的儿子按手在公绵羊的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把燔祭的公绵羊牵来，亚伦和他的儿子按手在公绵羊的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他奉上燔祭的公绵羊；亚伦和他儿子按手在羊的头上，
verses.textEnNiv: He then presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he presented the ram of the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought the ram as the burnt offering. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses presented the ram for the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the ram’s head,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he presented the ram of the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.textEn: He then presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

verses.textZh: 摩西就宰杀公绵羊，把血泼在祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就宰杀公绵羊，把血泼在祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCuv: 就宰了公羊。摩西把血洒在坛的周围，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses slaughtered the ram and splashed the blood against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And he killed it, and Moses threw the blood against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Moses killed it. Then he sprinkled the blood all around on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: and Moses slaughtered it. Then Moses took the ram’s blood and splattered it against all sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses slaughtered it and sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
verses.textEn: Then Moses slaughtered the ram and splashed the blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.textZh: 摩西把公绵羊切成块子以后，就把头、肉块和脂肪都焚烧了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把公绵羊切成块子以后，就把头、肉块和脂肪都焚烧了。
verses.textZhCuv: 把羊切成块子，把头和肉块并脂油都烧了。
verses.textEnNiv: He cut the ram into pieces and burned the head, the pieces and the fat.
verses.textEnEsv: He cut the ram into pieces, and Moses burned the head and the pieces and the fat.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burned the head, the pieces, and the fat.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he cut the ram into pieces, and he burned the head, some of its pieces, and the fat on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: When he had cut the ram into its pieces, Moses offered up the head and the pieces and the suet in smoke.
verses.textEn: He cut the ram into pieces and burned the head, the pieces and the fat.

verses.textZh: 又用水洗净了内脏和腿之后，摩西就把整个公绵羊焚烧在祭坛上；这是燔祭，是献给耶和华馨香的火祭，都是耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用水洗净了内脏和腿之后，摩西就把整个公绵羊焚烧在祭坛上；这是燔祭，是献给耶和华馨香的火祭，都是耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 用水洗了脏腑和腿，就把全羊烧在坛上为馨香的燔祭，是献给耶和华的火祭，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: He washed the internal organs and the legs with water and burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord , as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: He washed the entrails and the legs with water, and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering with a pleasing aroma, a food offering for the Lord , as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he washed the entrails and the legs in water. And Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: After washing the internal organs and the legs with water, Moses burned the entire ram on the altar as a burnt offering. It was a pleasing aroma, a special gift presented to the Lord , just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: After he had washed the entrails and the legs with water, Moses offered up the whole ram in smoke on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a soothing aroma; it was an offering by fire to the Lord, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: He washed the internal organs and the legs with water and burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord , as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 他又把第二只公绵羊牵来，就是承受圣职所献的公绵羊；亚伦和他的儿子按手在公绵羊的头上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把第二只公绵羊牵来，就是承受圣职所献的公绵羊；亚伦和他的儿子按手在公绵羊的头上；
verses.textZhCuv: 他又奉上第二只公绵羊，就是承接圣职之礼的羊；亚伦和他儿子按手在羊的头上，
verses.textEnNiv: He then presented the other ram, the ram for the ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he presented the other ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought the second ram, the ram of consecration. Then Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses presented the other ram, which was the ram of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the ram’s head,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he presented the second ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.textEn: He then presented the other ram, the ram for the ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

verses.textZh: 摩西宰杀了羊，取了一些羊血，抹在亚伦的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，以及右脚的大拇趾上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西宰杀了羊，取了一些羊血，抹在亚伦的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，以及右脚的大拇趾上。
verses.textZhCuv: 就宰了羊。摩西把些血抹在亚伦的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses slaughtered the ram and took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron’s right ear, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.textEnEsv: And he killed it, and Moses took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron’s right ear and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Moses killed it. Also he took some of its blood and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.textEnNlt: and Moses slaughtered it. Then Moses took some of its blood and applied it to the lobe of Aaron’s right ear, the thumb of his right hand, and the big toe of his right foot.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses slaughtered it and took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.textEn: Moses slaughtered the ram and took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron’s right ear, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

verses.textZh: 又把亚伦的儿子带来，摩西也把血抹在他们的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，以及右脚的大拇趾上；其余的血则泼在祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把亚伦的儿子带来，摩西也把血抹在他们的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，以及右脚的大拇趾上；其余的血则泼在祭坛的四周。
verses.textZhCuv: 又带了亚伦的儿子来，把些血抹在他们的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，又把血洒在坛的周围。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses also brought Aaron’s sons forward and put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet. Then he splashed blood against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he presented Aaron’s sons, and Moses put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears and on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet. And Moses threw the blood against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought Aaron’s sons. And Moses put some of the blood on the tips of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. And Moses sprinkled the blood all around on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Moses presented Aaron’s sons and applied some of the blood to the lobes of their right ears, the thumbs of their right hands, and the big toes of their right feet. He then splattered the rest of the blood against all sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: He also had Aaron’s sons come near; and Moses put some of the blood on the lobe of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot. Moses then sprinkled the rest of the blood around on the altar.
verses.textEn: Moses also brought Aaron’s sons forward and put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet. Then he splashed blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.textZh: 然后他取出脂肪、肥尾巴、内脏上所有的脂肪、肾旁的肝叶、两个肾、肾上的脂肪和右后腿；
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后他取出脂肪、肥尾巴、内脏上所有的脂肪、肾旁的肝叶、两个肾、肾上的脂肪和右后腿；
verses.textZhCuv: 取脂油和肥尾巴，并脏上一切的脂油与肝上的网子，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，并右腿，
verses.textEnNiv: After that, he took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, both kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he took the fat and the fat tail and all the fat that was on the entrails and the long lobe of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat and the right thigh,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took the fat and the fat tail, all the fat that was on the entrails, the fatty lobe attached to the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;
verses.textEnNlt: Next Moses took the fat, including the fat of the broad tail, the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat around them, along with the right thigh.
verses.textEnNasb: He then took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was on the entrails, and the lobe of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh.
verses.textEn: After that, he took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, both kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.

verses.textZh: 又从在耶和华面前的无酵饼篮子里，取出一个无酵饼、一个油饼和一个薄饼，都放在脂肪和右后腿上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从在耶和华面前的无酵饼篮子里，取出一个无酵饼、一个油饼和一个薄饼，都放在脂肪和右后腿上；
verses.textZhCuv: 再从耶和华面前、盛无酵饼的筐子里取出一个无酵饼，一个油饼，一个薄饼，都放在脂油和右腿上，
verses.textEnNiv: And from the basket of bread made without yeast, which was before the Lord , he took one thick loaf, one thick loaf with olive oil mixed in, and one thin loaf, and he put these on the fat portions and on the right thigh.
verses.textEnEsv: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before the Lord he took one unleavened loaf and one loaf of bread with oil and one wafer and placed them on the pieces of fat and on the right thigh.
verses.textEnNkjv: and from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the Lord he took one unleavened cake, a cake of bread anointed with oil, and one wafer, and put them on the fat and on the right thigh;
verses.textEnNlt: On top of these he placed a thin cake of bread made without yeast, a cake of bread mixed with olive oil, and a wafer spread with olive oil. All these were taken from the basket of bread made without yeast that was placed in the Lord ’s presence.
verses.textEnNasb: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the Lord, he took one unleavened cake and one cake of bread mixed with oil and one wafer, and placed them on the portions of fat and on the right thigh.
verses.textEn: And from the basket of bread made without yeast, which was before the Lord , he took one thick loaf, one thick loaf with olive oil mixed in, and one thin loaf, and he put these on the fat portions and on the right thigh.

verses.textZh: 他把这一切都放在亚伦手上和他儿子手上，在耶和华面前摇一摇作为摇祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把这一切都放在亚伦手上和他儿子手上，在耶和华面前摇一摇作为摇祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 把这一切放在亚伦的手上和他儿子的手上作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
verses.textEnNiv: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons, and they waved them before the Lord as a wave offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And he put all these in the hands of Aaron and in the hands of his sons and waved them as a wave offering before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and he put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them as a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons, and he lifted these gifts as a special offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He then put all these on the hands of Aaron and on the hands of his sons, and presented them as a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.textEn: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons, and they waved them before the Lord as a wave offering.

verses.textZh: 然后，摩西从他们的手上接过来，焚烧在祭坛的燔祭上；这些是承受圣职祭，是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，摩西从他们的手上接过来，焚烧在祭坛的燔祭上；这些是承受圣职祭，是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西从他们的手上拿下来，烧在坛上的燔祭上，都是为承接圣职献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses took them from their hands and burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering as an ordination offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses took them from their hands and burned them on the altar with the burnt offering. This was an ordination offering with a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses took them from their hands and burned them on the altar, on the burnt offering. They were consecration offerings for a sweet aroma. That was an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses then took all the offerings back from them and burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering. This was the ordination offering. It was a pleasing aroma, a special gift presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses took them from their hands and offered them up in smoke on the altar with the burnt offering. They were an ordination offering for a soothing aroma; it was an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then Moses took them from their hands and burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering as an ordination offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 摩西取了祭牲的胸，在耶和华面前把它摇一摇作摇祭；这是承受圣职祭的公绵羊中，归给摩西的分，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西取了祭牲的胸，在耶和华面前把它摇一摇作摇祭；这是承受圣职祭的公绵羊中，归给摩西的分，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西拿羊的胸作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，是承接圣职之礼，归摩西的分，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses also took the breast, which was his share of the ordination ram, and waved it before the Lord as a wave offering, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses took the breast and waved it for a wave offering before the Lord . It was Moses’ portion of the ram of ordination, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses took the breast and waved it as a wave offering before the Lord. It was Moses’ part of the ram of consecration, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses took the breast and lifted it up as a special offering to the Lord . This was Moses’ portion of the ram of ordination, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses also took the breast and presented it as a wave offering before the Lord; it was Moses’ portion of the ram of ordination, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Moses also took the breast, which was his share of the ordination ram, and waved it before the Lord as a wave offering, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 摩西拿了一些膏油和祭坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，以及他儿子和他们的衣服上；这样就使亚伦和他的衣服，他的儿子和他们的衣服都分别为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西拿了一些膏油和祭坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，以及他儿子和他们的衣服上；这样就使亚伦和他的衣服，他的儿子和他们的衣服都分别为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西取点膏油和坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子和他儿子的衣服上，使他和他们的衣服一同成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood from the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments and his sons and their garments.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and of the blood that was on the altar and sprinkled it on Aaron and his garments, and also on his sons and his sons’ garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments, and his sons and his sons’ garments with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him; and he consecrated Aaron, his garments, his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar, and he sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. In this way, he made Aaron and his sons and their garments holy.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him; and he consecrated Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
verses.textEn: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood from the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments and his sons and their garments.

verses.textZh: 摩西对亚伦和他的儿子说："你们要在会幕门口煮祭肉，也在那里吃祭肉和承受圣职祭篮子里的饼，照着我的吩咐，亚伦和他的儿子要吃这些。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对亚伦和他的儿子说："你们要在会幕门口煮祭肉，也在那里吃祭肉和承受圣职祭篮子里的饼，照着我的吩咐，亚伦和他的儿子要吃这些。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对亚伦和他儿子说：「把肉煮在会幕门口，在那里吃，又吃承接圣职筐子里的饼，按我所吩咐的说 ：『这是亚伦和他儿子要吃的。』
verses.textEnNiv: Moses then said to Aaron and his sons, "Cook the meat at the entrance to the tent of meeting and eat it there with the bread from the basket of ordination offerings, as I was commanded: ‘Aaron and his sons are to eat it.’
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, "Boil the flesh at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, "Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and eat it there with the bread that is in the basket of consecration offerings, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons, "Boil the remaining meat of the offerings at the Tabernacle entrance, and eat it there, along with the bread that is in the basket of offerings for the ordination, just as I commanded when I said, ‘Aaron and his sons will eat it.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, "Boil the flesh at the doorway of the tent of meeting, and eat it there together with the bread which is in the basket of the ordination offering, just as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’
verses.textEn: Moses then said to Aaron and his sons, "Cook the meat at the entrance to the tent of meeting and eat it there with the bread from the basket of ordination offerings, as I was commanded: ‘Aaron and his sons are to eat it.’

verses.textZh: 剩下来的肉和饼，你们要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 剩下来的肉和饼，你们要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 剩下的肉和饼，你们要用火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: Then burn up the rest of the meat and the bread.
verses.textEnEsv: And what remains of the flesh and the bread you shall burn up with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: What remains of the flesh and of the bread you shall burn with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Any meat or bread that is left over must then be burned up.
verses.textEnNasb: And the remainder of the flesh and of the bread you shall burn in the fire.
verses.textEn: Then burn up the rest of the meat and the bread.

verses.textZh: 七天之内，你们不可出会幕的门口，直到你们承受圣职礼的日子满了，因为主要用这七天使你们承受圣职 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 七天之内，你们不可出会幕的门口，直到你们承受圣职礼的日子满了，因为主要用这七天使你们承受圣职 。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们七天不可出会幕的门，等到你们承接圣职的日子满了，因为主叫你们七天承接圣职。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not leave the entrance to the tent of meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are completed, for your ordination will last seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not go outside the entrance of the tent of meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are completed, for it will take seven days to ordain you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall not go outside the door of the tabernacle of meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are ended. For seven days he shall consecrate you.
verses.textEnNlt: You must not leave the Tabernacle entrance for seven days, for that is when the ordination ceremony will be completed.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall not go outside the doorway of the tent of meeting for seven days, until the day that the period of your ordination is fulfilled; for he will ordain you through seven days.
verses.textEn: Do not leave the entrance to the tent of meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are completed, for your ordination will last seven days.

verses.textZh: 今天所行的，是照耶和华的吩咐而行，为你们赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 今天所行的，是照耶和华的吩咐而行，为你们赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 像今天所行的都是耶和华吩咐行的，为你们赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: What has been done today was commanded by the Lord to make atonement for you.
verses.textEnEsv: As has been done today, the Lord has commanded to be done to make atonement for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: As he has done this day, so the Lord has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.
verses.textEnNlt: Everything we have done today was commanded by the Lord in order to purify you, making you right with him.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has commanded us to do as has been done this day, to make atonement on your behalf.
verses.textEn: What has been done today was commanded by the Lord to make atonement for you.

verses.textZh: 七天之内，你们昼夜都住在会幕门口，遵守耶和华的吩咐，免得你们死亡，因为耶和华是这样吩咐我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 七天之内，你们昼夜都住在会幕门口，遵守耶和华的吩咐，免得你们死亡，因为耶和华是这样吩咐我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 七天你们要昼夜住在会幕门口，遵守耶和华的吩咐，免得你们死亡，因为所吩咐我的就是这样。」
verses.textEnNiv: You must stay at the entrance to the tent of meeting day and night for seven days and do what the Lord requires, so you will not die; for that is what I have been commanded."
verses.textEnEsv: At the entrance of the tent of meeting you shall remain day and night for seven days, performing what the Lord has charged, so that you do not die, for so I have been commanded."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall stay at the door of the tabernacle of meeting day and night for seven days, and keep the charge of the Lord, so that you may not die; for so I have been commanded."
verses.textEnNlt: Now stay at the entrance of the Tabernacle day and night for seven days, and do everything the Lord requires. If you fail to do this, you will die, for this is what the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnNasb: At the doorway of the tent of meeting, moreover, you shall remain day and night for seven days and fulfill your duty to the Lord, so that you will not die; for so I have been commanded."
verses.textEn: You must stay at the entrance to the tent of meeting day and night for seven days and do what the Lord requires, so you will not die; for that is what I have been commanded."

verses.textZh: 于是亚伦和他的儿子行了耶和华借着摩西吩咐的一切事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚伦和他的儿子行了耶和华借着摩西吩咐的一切事。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚伦和他儿子行了耶和华藉着摩西所吩咐的一切事。
verses.textEnNiv: So Aaron and his sons did everything the Lord commanded through Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron and his sons did all the things that the Lord commanded by Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Aaron and his sons did all the things that the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: So Aaron and his sons did everything the Lord had commanded through Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Aaron and his sons did all the things which the Lord had commanded through Moses.
verses.textEn: So Aaron and his sons did everything the Lord commanded through Moses.

verses.textZh: 到了第八天，摩西把亚伦和他的儿子，以及以色列的众长老都召了来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第八天，摩西把亚伦和他的儿子，以及以色列的众长老都召了来；
verses.textZhCuv: 到了第八天，摩西召了亚伦和他儿子，并以色列的众长老来，
verses.textEnNiv: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: On the eighth day Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: It came to pass on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: After the ordination ceremony, on the eighth day, Moses called together Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel;
verses.textEn: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

verses.textZh: 摩西对亚伦说："你要取一头公牛犊来作赎罪祭，一只公绵羊作燔祭，两样都要没有残疾的；献在耶和华的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对亚伦说："你要取一头公牛犊来作赎罪祭，一只公绵羊作燔祭，两样都要没有残疾的；献在耶和华的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 对亚伦说：「你当取牛群中的一只公牛犊作赎罪祭，一只公绵羊作燔祭，都要没有残疾的，献在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to Aaron, "Take a bull calf for your sin offering and a ram for your burnt offering, both without defect, and present them before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and he said to Aaron, "Take for yourself a bull calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without blemish, and offer them before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to Aaron, "Take for yourself a young bull as a sin offering and a ram as a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He said to Aaron, "Take a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without defects, and present them to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and he said to Aaron, "Take for yourself a calf, a bull, as a sin offering and a ram as a burnt offering, both without defect, and offer them before the Lord.
verses.textEn: He said to Aaron, "Take a bull calf for your sin offering and a ram for your burnt offering, both without defect, and present them before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你也要告诉以色列人：你们要取一只公山羊作赎罪祭，又取一头一岁的牛犊和一只一岁的绵羊羔作燔祭，两样都要没有残疾的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要告诉以色列人：你们要取一只公山羊作赎罪祭，又取一头一岁的牛犊和一只一岁的绵羊羔作燔祭，两样都要没有残疾的；
verses.textZhCuv: 你也要对以色列人说：『你们当取一只公山羊作赎罪祭，又取一只牛犊和一只绵羊羔，都要一岁、没有残疾的，作燔祭，
verses.textEnNiv: Then say to the Israelites: ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb—both a year old and without defect—for a burnt offering,
verses.textEnEsv: And say to the people of Israel, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both a year old without blemish, for a burnt offering,
verses.textEnNkjv: And to the children of Israel you shall speak, saying, ‘Take a kid of the goats as a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, as a burnt offering,
verses.textEnNlt: Then tell the Israelites, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, and take a calf and a lamb, both a year old and without defects, for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat as a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both one year old, without defect, as a burnt offering,
verses.textEn: Then say to the Israelites: ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb—both a year old and without defect—for a burnt offering,

verses.textZh: 又取一头公牛和一只公绵羊作平安祭，宰献在耶和华面前；又取用油调和的素祭，因为今天耶和华要向你们显现。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又取一头公牛和一只公绵羊作平安祭，宰献在耶和华面前；又取用油调和的素祭，因为今天耶和华要向你们显现。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又取一只公牛，一只公绵羊作平安祭，献在耶和华面前，并取调油的素祭，因为今天耶和华要向你们显现。』」
verses.textEnNiv: and an ox and a ram for a fellowship offering to sacrifice before the Lord , together with a grain offering mixed with olive oil. For today the Lord will appear to you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and an ox and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the Lord , and a grain offering mixed with oil, for today the Lord will appear to you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: also a bull and a ram as peace offerings, to sacrifice before the Lord, and a grain offering mixed with oil; for today the Lord will appear to you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Also take a bull and a ram for a peace offering and flour moistened with olive oil for a grain offering. Present all these offerings to the Lord because the Lord will appear to you today.’"
verses.textEnNasb: and an ox and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the Lord, and a grain offering mixed with oil; for today the Lord will appear to you.’ "
verses.textEn: and an ox and a ram for a fellowship offering to sacrifice before the Lord , together with a grain offering mixed with olive oil. For today the Lord will appear to you.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是他们把摩西所吩咐的，带到会幕前面；全体会众都走近来，站在耶和华的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们把摩西所吩咐的，带到会幕前面；全体会众都走近来，站在耶和华的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他们把摩西所吩咐的，带到会幕前；全会众都近前来，站在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: They took the things Moses commanded to the front of the tent of meeting, and the entire assembly came near and stood before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought what Moses commanded in front of the tent of meeting, and all the congregation drew near and stood before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So they brought what Moses commanded before the tabernacle of meeting. And all the congregation drew near and stood before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people presented all these things at the entrance of the Tabernacle, just as Moses had commanded. Then the whole community came forward and stood before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the tent of meeting, and the whole congregation came near and stood before the Lord.
verses.textEn: They took the things Moses commanded to the front of the tent of meeting, and the entire assembly came near and stood before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 摩西说："这是耶和华吩咐你们的事，你们要照着行，耶和华的荣耀就要向你们显现。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："这是耶和华吩咐你们的事，你们要照着行，耶和华的荣耀就要向你们显现。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「这是耶和华吩咐你们所当行的；耶和华的荣光就要向你们显现。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said, "This is what the Lord has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the Lord may appear to you."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said, "This is the thing that the Lord commanded you to do, that the glory of the Lord may appear to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said, "This is the thing which the Lord commanded you to do, and the glory of the Lord will appear to you."
verses.textEnNlt: And Moses said, "This is what the Lord has commanded you to do so that the glory of the Lord may appear to you."
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses said, "This is the thing which the Lord has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the Lord may appear to you."
verses.textEn: Then Moses said, "This is what the Lord has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the Lord may appear to you."

verses.textZh: 然后摩西对亚伦说："走到祭坛那里，献上你的赎罪祭和燔祭，为自己和人民赎罪；又献上人民的供物，按着耶和华的吩咐，为他们赎罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后摩西对亚伦说："走到祭坛那里，献上你的赎罪祭和燔祭，为自己和人民赎罪；又献上人民的供物，按着耶和华的吩咐，为他们赎罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对亚伦说：「你就近坛前，献你的赎罪祭和燔祭，为自己与百姓赎罪，又献上百姓的供物，为他们赎罪，都照耶和华所吩咐的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to Aaron, "Come to the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and the people; sacrifice the offering that is for the people and make atonement for them, as the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Draw near to the altar and offer your sin offering and your burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and for the people, and bring the offering of the people and make atonement for them, as the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to Aaron, "Go to the altar, offer your sin offering and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself and for the people. Offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as the Lord commanded."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Come to the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering to purify yourself and the people. Then present the offerings of the people to purify them, making them right with the Lord , just as he has commanded."
verses.textEnNasb: Moses then said to Aaron, "Come near to the altar and offer your sin offering and your burnt offering, so that you may make atonement for yourself and for the people; then make the offering for the people, so that you may make atonement for them, just as the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEn: Moses said to Aaron, "Come to the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and the people; sacrifice the offering that is for the people and make atonement for them, as the Lord has commanded."

verses.textZh: 于是亚伦走近祭坛，宰杀那为自己献的赎罪祭牛犊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚伦走近祭坛，宰杀那为自己献的赎罪祭牛犊。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，亚伦就近坛前，宰了为自己作赎罪祭的牛犊。
verses.textEnNiv: So Aaron came to the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.
verses.textEnEsv: So Aaron drew near to the altar and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Aaron therefore went to the altar and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
verses.textEnNlt: So Aaron went to the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.
verses.textEnNasb: So Aaron came near to the altar and slaughtered the calf of the sin offering which was for himself.
verses.textEn: So Aaron came to the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的儿子奉上血，他就把手指蘸在血里，抹在祭坛的四角上，把剩下的血倒在祭坛脚那里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的儿子奉上血，他就把手指蘸在血里，抹在祭坛的四角上，把剩下的血倒在祭坛脚那里；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦的儿子把血奉给他，他就把指头蘸在血中，抹在坛的四角上，又把血倒在坛脚那里。
verses.textEnNiv: His sons brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood and put it on the horns of the altar; the rest of the blood he poured out at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of Aaron presented the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar and poured out the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him. And he dipped his finger in the blood, put it on the horns of the altar, and poured the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: His sons brought him the blood, and he dipped his finger in it and put it on the horns of the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Aaron’s sons then presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood and put some on the horns of the altar, and poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEn: His sons brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood and put it on the horns of the altar; the rest of the blood he poured out at the base of the altar.

verses.textZh: 赎罪祭牲的脂肪、肾和肝叶，他都焚烧在祭坛上，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 赎罪祭牲的脂肪、肾和肝叶，他都焚烧在祭坛上，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有赎罪祭的脂油和腰子，并肝上取的网子，都烧在坛上，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的；
verses.textEnNiv: On the altar he burned the fat, the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver from the sin offering, as the Lord commanded Moses;
verses.textEnEsv: But the fat and the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver from the sin offering he burned on the altar, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the fat, the kidneys, and the fatty lobe from the liver of the sin offering he burned on the altar, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he burned on the altar the fat, the kidneys, and the long lobe of the liver from the sin offering, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: The fat and the kidneys and the lobe of the liver of the sin offering he then offered up in smoke on the altar, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: On the altar he burned the fat, the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver from the sin offering, as the Lord commanded Moses;

verses.textZh: 至于肉和皮，却在营外用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于肉和皮，却在营外用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用火将肉和皮烧在营外。
verses.textEnNiv: the flesh and the hide he burned up outside the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: The flesh and the skin he burned up with fire outside the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: The flesh and the hide he burned with fire outside the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: The meat and the hide, however, he burned outside the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: The flesh and the hide, however, he burned with fire outside the camp.
verses.textEn: the flesh and the hide he burned up outside the camp.

verses.textZh: 亚伦宰杀了燔祭牲，他的儿子把血递给他，泼在祭坛的周围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦宰杀了燔祭牲，他的儿子把血递给他，泼在祭坛的周围。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦宰了燔祭牲，他儿子把血递给他，他就洒在坛的周围，
verses.textEnNiv: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering. His sons handed him the blood, and he splashed it against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he killed the burnt offering, and Aaron’s sons handed him the blood, and he threw it against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented to him the blood, which he sprinkled all around on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Aaron slaughtered the animal for the burnt offering. His sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons brought the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
verses.textEn: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering. His sons handed him the blood, and he splashed it against the sides of the altar.

verses.textZh: 他们跟着把燔祭牲一块一块连头递给他，焚烧在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们跟着把燔祭牲一块一块连头递给他，焚烧在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又把燔祭一块一块地、连头递给他，他都烧在坛上；
verses.textEnNiv: They handed him the burnt offering piece by piece, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And they handed the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head, and he burned them on the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they presented the burnt offering to him, with its pieces and head, and he burned them on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they handed him each piece of the burnt offering, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: They brought the burnt offering to him in pieces, with the head, and he offered them up in smoke on the altar.
verses.textEn: They handed him the burnt offering piece by piece, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.

verses.textZh: 亚伦又洗净了内脏和腿，在祭坛的燔祭上焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦又洗净了内脏和腿，在祭坛的燔祭上焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 又洗了脏腑和腿，烧在坛上的燔祭上。
verses.textEnNiv: He washed the internal organs and the legs and burned them on top of the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And he washed the entrails and the legs and burned them with the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he washed the entrails and the legs, and burned them with the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he washed the internal organs and the legs and burned them on the altar along with the rest of the burnt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: He also washed the entrails and the legs, and offered them up in smoke with the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.textEn: He washed the internal organs and the legs and burned them on top of the burnt offering on the altar.

verses.textZh: 他把人民的供物献上，又把那为人民作赎罪祭的公山羊牵来，宰杀了，献为赎罪祭，和先前献的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把人民的供物献上，又把那为人民作赎罪祭的公山羊牵来，宰杀了，献为赎罪祭，和先前献的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他奉上百姓的供物，把那给百姓作赎罪祭的公山羊宰了，为罪献上，和先献的一样；
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron then brought the offering that was for the people. He took the goat for the people’s sin offering and slaughtered it and offered it for a sin offering as he did with the first one.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he presented the people’s offering and took the goat of the sin offering that was for the people and killed it and offered it as a sin offering, like the first one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and killed it and offered it for sin, like the first one.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Aaron presented the offerings of the people. He slaughtered the people’s goat and presented it as an offering for their sin, just as he had first done with the offering for his own sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and slaughtered it and offered it for sin, like the first.
