verses.textEn: Aaron then brought the offering that was for the people. He took the goat for the people’s sin offering and slaughtered it and offered it for a sin offering as he did with the first one.

verses.textZh: 然后他按着规则献上燔祭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后他按着规则献上燔祭，
verses.textZhCuv: 也奉上燔祭，照例而献。
verses.textEnNiv: He brought the burnt offering and offered it in the prescribed way.
verses.textEnEsv: And he presented the burnt offering and offered it according to the rule.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought the burnt offering and offered it according to the prescribed manner.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he presented the burnt offering and sacrificed it in the prescribed way.
verses.textEnNasb: He also presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
verses.textEn: He brought the burnt offering and offered it in the prescribed way.

verses.textZh: 又献上素祭，从其中取了满满的一把，在祭坛上焚烧。这是在早晨的燔祭以外的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又献上素祭，从其中取了满满的一把，在祭坛上焚烧。这是在早晨的燔祭以外的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又奉上素祭，从其中取一满把，烧在坛上；这是在早晨的燔祭以外。
verses.textEnNiv: He also brought the grain offering, took a handful of it and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning’s burnt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And he presented the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar, besides the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
verses.textEnNlt: He also presented the grain offering, burning a handful of the flour mixture on the altar, in addition to the regular burnt offering for the morning.
verses.textEnNasb: Next he presented the grain offering, and filled his hand with some of it and offered it up in smoke on the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.
verses.textEn: He also brought the grain offering, took a handful of it and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning’s burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 亚伦又宰杀了那为人民作平安祭的公牛和公绵羊；亚伦的儿子把血递给他，泼在祭坛的周围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦又宰杀了那为人民作平安祭的公牛和公绵羊；亚伦的儿子把血递给他，泼在祭坛的周围。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦宰了那给百姓作平安祭的公牛和公绵羊。他儿子把血递给他，他就洒在坛的周围；
verses.textEnNiv: He slaughtered the ox and the ram as the fellowship offering for the people. His sons handed him the blood, and he splashed it against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he killed the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings for the people. And Aaron’s sons handed him the blood, and he threw it against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also killed the bull and the ram as sacrifices of peace offerings, which were for the people. And Aaron’s sons presented to him the blood, which he sprinkled all around on the altar,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Aaron slaughtered the bull and the ram for the people’s peace offering. His sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he slaughtered the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings which was for the people; and Aaron’s sons brought the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
verses.textEn: He slaughtered the ox and the ram as the fellowship offering for the people. His sons handed him the blood, and he splashed it against the sides of the altar.

verses.textZh: 他们又把公牛和公绵羊的脂肪、肥尾巴、遮盖内脏的脂肪、两个肾和肝叶，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又把公牛和公绵羊的脂肪、肥尾巴、遮盖内脏的脂肪、两个肾和肝叶，
verses.textZhCuv: 又把公牛和公绵羊的脂油、肥尾巴，并盖脏的脂油与腰子，和肝上的网子，都递给他；
verses.textEnNiv: But the fat portions of the ox and the ram—the fat tail, the layer of fat, the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver—
verses.textEnEsv: But the fat pieces of the ox and of the ram, the fat tail and that which covers the entrails and the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver—
verses.textEnNkjv: and the fat from the bull and the ram—the fatty tail, what covers the entrails and the kidneys, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver;
verses.textEnNlt: Then he took the fat of the bull and the ram—the fat of the broad tail and from around the internal organs—along with the kidneys and the long lobes of the livers.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the portions of fat from the ox and from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver,
verses.textEn: But the fat portions of the ox and the ram—the fat tail, the layer of fat, the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver—

verses.textZh: 都放在胸上，亚伦就把脂肪在祭坛上焚烧；
verses.textZhCnvs: 都放在胸上，亚伦就把脂肪在祭坛上焚烧；
verses.textZhCuv: 把脂油放在胸上，他就把脂油烧在坛上。
verses.textEnNiv: these they laid on the breasts, and then Aaron burned the fat on the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: they put the fat pieces on the breasts, and he burned the fat pieces on the altar,
verses.textEnNkjv: and they put the fat on the breasts. Then he burned the fat on the altar;
verses.textEnNlt: He placed these fat portions on top of the breasts of these animals and burned them on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: they now placed the portions of fat on the breasts; and he offered them up in smoke on the altar.
verses.textEn: these they laid on the breasts, and then Aaron burned the fat on the altar.

verses.textZh: 至于胸和右后腿，亚伦拿来作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；都是照着摩西吩咐的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于胸和右后腿，亚伦拿来作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；都是照着摩西吩咐的。
verses.textZhCuv: 胸和右腿，亚伦当作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，都是照摩西所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh before the Lord as a wave offering, as Moses commanded.
verses.textEnEsv: but the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave offering before the Lord , as Moses commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved as a wave offering before the Lord, as Moses had commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron then lifted up the breasts and right thighs as a special offering to the Lord , just as Moses had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: But the breasts and the right thigh Aaron presented as a wave offering before the Lord, just as Moses had commanded.
verses.textEn: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh before the Lord as a wave offering, as Moses commanded.

verses.textZh: 亚伦向众人举起手，为他们祝福；他献了赎罪祭、燔祭和平安祭，就下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦向众人举起手，为他们祝福；他献了赎罪祭、燔祭和平安祭，就下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦向百姓举手，为他们祝福。他献了赎罪祭、燔祭、平安祭就下来了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them. And having sacrificed the sin offering, the burnt offering and the fellowship offering, he stepped down.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them, and he came down from offering the sin offering and the burnt offering and the peace offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Aaron lifted his hand toward the people, blessed them, and came down from offering the sin offering, the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: After that, Aaron raised his hands toward the people and blessed them. Then, after presenting the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offering, he stepped down from the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them, and he stepped down after making the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
verses.textEn: Then Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them. And having sacrificed the sin offering, the burnt offering and the fellowship offering, he stepped down.

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦进了会幕，出来就为众人祝福；耶和华的荣耀向众民显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦进了会幕，出来就为众人祝福；耶和华的荣耀向众民显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦进入会幕，又出来为百姓祝福，耶和华的荣光就向众民显现。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses and Aaron then went into the tent of meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and when they came out they blessed the people, and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of meeting, and came out and blessed the people. Then the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses and Aaron went into the Tabernacle, and when they came back out, they blessed the people again, and the glory of the Lord appeared to the whole community.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting. When they came out and blessed the people, the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.
verses.textEn: Moses and Aaron then went into the tent of meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.

verses.textZh: 有火从耶和华面前出来，烧尽了祭坛上的燔祭和脂肪；众民看见了，就大声欢呼，俯伏在地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有火从耶和华面前出来，烧尽了祭坛上的燔祭和脂肪；众民看见了，就大声欢呼，俯伏在地。
verses.textZhCuv: 有火从耶和华面前出来，在坛上烧尽燔祭和脂油；众民一见，就都欢呼，俯伏在地。
verses.textEnNiv: Fire came out from the presence of the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. And when all the people saw it, they shouted for joy and fell facedown.
verses.textEnEsv: And fire came out from before the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the pieces of fat on the altar, and when all the people saw it, they shouted and fell on their faces.
verses.textEnNkjv: and fire came out from before the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the fat on the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted and fell on their faces.
verses.textEnNlt: Fire blazed forth from the Lord ’s presence and consumed the burnt offering and the fat on the altar. When the people saw this, they shouted with joy and fell face down on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Then fire went out from the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the portions of fat on the altar; and when all the people saw it, they shouted and fell face downward.
verses.textEn: Fire came out from the presence of the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. And when all the people saw it, they shouted for joy and fell facedown.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的儿子拿答和亚比户各拿着自己的香炉，盛上火，加上香，在耶和华面前献上平常的火，是耶和华没有命令他们献的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的儿子拿答和亚比户各拿着自己的香炉，盛上火，加上香，在耶和华面前献上平常的火，是耶和华没有命令他们献的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦的儿子拿答、亚比户各拿自己的香炉，盛上火，加上香，在耶和华面前献上凡火，是耶和华没有吩咐他们的，
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron’s sons Nadab and Abihu took their censers, put fire in them and added incense; and they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord , contrary to his command.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer and put fire in it and laid incense on it and offered unauthorized fire before the Lord , which he had not commanded them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer and put fire in it, put incense on it, and offered profane fire before the Lord, which He had not commanded them.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron’s sons Nadab and Abihu put coals of fire in their incense burners and sprinkled incense over them. In this way, they disobeyed the Lord by burning before him the wrong kind of fire, different than he had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took their respective firepans, and after putting fire in them, placed incense on the fire and offered strange fire before the Lord, which He had not commanded them.
verses.textEn: Aaron’s sons Nadab and Abihu took their censers, put fire in them and added incense; and they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord , contrary to his command.

verses.textZh: 那时有火从耶和华面前出来，把他们烧灭，他们就死在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时有火从耶和华面前出来，把他们烧灭，他们就死在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 就有火从耶和华面前出来，把他们烧灭，他们就死在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: So fire came out from the presence of the Lord and consumed them, and they died before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And fire came out from before the Lord and consumed them, and they died before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So fire went out from the Lord and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So fire blazed forth from the Lord ’s presence and burned them up, and they died there before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And fire came out from the presence of the Lord and consumed them, and they died before the Lord.
verses.textEn: So fire came out from the presence of the Lord and consumed them, and they died before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 于是摩西对亚伦说："这就是耶和华曾经告诉我们的，他说： ‘在亲近我的人中，我要显为圣， 在众人面前，我要得荣耀。’" 亚伦就默然无语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西对亚伦说："这就是耶和华曾经告诉我们的，他说： ‘在亲近我的人中，我要显为圣， 在众人面前，我要得荣耀。’" 亚伦就默然无语。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西对亚伦说：「这就是耶和华所说：『我在亲近我的人中要显为圣；在众民面前，我要得荣耀。』」亚伦就默默不言。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses then said to Aaron, "This is what the Lord spoke of when he said: " ‘Among those who approach me I will be proved holy; in the sight of all the people I will be honored.’ " Aaron remained silent.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses said to Aaron, "This is what the Lord has said: ‘Among those who are near me I will be sanctified, and before all the people I will be glorified.’" And Aaron held his peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to Aaron, "This is what the Lord spoke, saying: ‘By those who come near Me I must be regarded as holy; And before all the people I must be glorified.’ " So Aaron held his peace.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said to Aaron, "This is what the Lord meant when he said, ‘I will display my holiness through those who come near me. I will display my glory before all the people.’" And Aaron was silent.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to Aaron, "It is what the Lord spoke, saying, ‘By those who come near Me I will be treated as holy, And before all the people I will be honored.’ " So Aaron, therefore, kept silent.
verses.textEn: Moses then said to Aaron, "This is what the Lord spoke of when he said: " ‘Among those who approach me I will be proved holy; in the sight of all the people I will be honored.’ " Aaron remained silent.

verses.textZh: 摩西把亚伦叔父乌薛的儿子米沙利和以利撒反召了来，对他们说："你们上前来，把你们的兄弟从圣所前抬到营外去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把亚伦叔父乌薛的儿子米沙利和以利撒反召了来，对他们说："你们上前来，把你们的兄弟从圣所前抬到营外去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西召了亚伦叔父乌薛的儿子米沙利、以利撒反来，对他们说：「上前来，把你们的亲属从圣所前抬到营外。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel, and said to them, "Come here; carry your cousins outside the camp, away from the front of the sanctuary."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, "Come near; carry your brothers away from the front of the sanctuary and out of the camp."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, "Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses called for Mishael and Elzaphan, Aaron’s cousins, the sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel. He said to them, "Come forward and carry away the bodies of your relatives from in front of the sanctuary to a place outside the camp."
verses.textEnNasb: Moses called also to Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel, and said to them, "Come forward, carry your relatives away from the front of the sanctuary to an area outside of the camp."
verses.textEn: Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel, and said to them, "Come here; carry your cousins outside the camp, away from the front of the sanctuary."

verses.textZh: 于是二人走近来，照着摩西的吩咐，把他们连同他们的衣服抬到营外去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是二人走近来，照着摩西的吩咐，把他们连同他们的衣服抬到营外去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是二人上前来，把他们穿着袍子抬到营外，是照摩西所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: So they came and carried them, still in their tunics, outside the camp, as Moses ordered.
verses.textEnEsv: So they came near and carried them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses had said.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went near and carried them by their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.
verses.textEnNlt: So they came forward and picked them up by their garments and carried them out of the camp, just as Moses had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: So they came forward and carried them, still in their tunics, to an area outside the camp, just as Moses had said.
verses.textEn: So they came and carried them, still in their tunics, outside the camp, as Moses ordered.

verses.textZh: 摩西对亚伦和他的儿子以利亚撒和以他玛说："你们不要披头散发，不可撕裂你们的衣服，免得你们死亡，又免得耶和华向全体会众发怒。你们的亲族，以色列全家，却要为耶和华所烧死的人哀哭 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对亚伦和他的儿子以利亚撒和以他玛说："你们不要披头散发，不可撕裂你们的衣服，免得你们死亡，又免得耶和华向全体会众发怒。你们的亲族，以色列全家，却要为耶和华所烧死的人哀哭 。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对亚伦和他儿子以利亚撒、以他玛说：「不可蓬头散发，也不可撕裂衣裳，免得你们死亡，又免得耶和华向会众发怒；只要你们的弟兄以色列全家为耶和华所发的火哀哭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, "Do not let your hair become unkempt and do not tear your clothes, or you will die and the Lord will be angry with the whole community. But your relatives, all the Israelites, may mourn for those the Lord has destroyed by fire.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar his sons, "Do not let the hair of your heads hang loose, and do not tear your clothes, lest you die, and wrath come upon all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning that the Lord has kindled.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons, "Do not uncover your heads nor tear your clothes, lest you die, and wrath come upon all the people. But let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the Lord has kindled.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, "Do not show grief by leaving your hair uncombed or by tearing your clothes. If you do, you will die, and the Lord ’s anger will strike the whole community of Israel. However, the rest of the Israelites, your relatives, may mourn because of the Lord ’s fiery destruction of Nadab and Abihu.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to Aaron and to his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, "Do not uncover your heads nor tear your clothes, so that you do not die and He does not become wrathful against all the congregation. But your kinsmen, the entire house of Israel, shall weep for the burning which the Lord has brought about.
verses.textEn: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, "Do not let your hair become unkempt and do not tear your clothes, or you will die and the Lord will be angry with the whole community. But your relatives, all the Israelites, may mourn for those the Lord has destroyed by fire.

verses.textZh: 你们也不可走出会幕的门口，免得你们死亡，因为耶和华的膏油在你们身上。"他们就照着摩西的话行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也不可走出会幕的门口，免得你们死亡，因为耶和华的膏油在你们身上。"他们就照着摩西的话行。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也不可出会幕的门，恐怕你们死亡，因为耶和华的膏油在你们的身上。」他们就照摩西的话行了。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not leave the entrance to the tent of meeting or you will die, because the Lord ’s anointing oil is on you." So they did as Moses said.
verses.textEnEsv: And do not go outside the entrance of the tent of meeting, lest you die, for the anointing oil of the Lord is upon you." And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of meeting, lest you die, for the anointing oil of the Lord is upon you." And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must not leave the entrance of the Tabernacle or you will die, for you have been anointed with the Lord ’s anointing oil." So they did as Moses commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not even go out from the doorway of the tent of meeting, or you will die; for the Lord’s anointing oil is upon you." So they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.textEn: Do not leave the entrance to the tent of meeting or you will die, because the Lord ’s anointing oil is on you." So they did as Moses said.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Aaron,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Aaron,
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord then spoke to Aaron, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Aaron,

verses.textZh: "你和你的儿子一起进会幕的时候，淡酒烈酒都不可喝，免得你们死亡，这要作你们世世代代永远的律例；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你和你的儿子一起进会幕的时候，淡酒烈酒都不可喝，免得你们死亡，这要作你们世世代代永远的律例；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你和你儿子进会幕的时候，清酒、浓酒都不可喝，免得你们死亡；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: "You and your sons are not to drink wine or other fermented drink whenever you go into the tent of meeting, or you will die. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come,
verses.textEnEsv: "Drink no wine or strong drink, you or your sons with you, when you go into the tent of meeting, lest you die. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not drink wine or intoxicating drink, you, nor your sons with you, when you go into the tabernacle of meeting, lest you die. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations,
verses.textEnNlt: "You and your descendants must never drink wine or any other alcoholic drink before going into the Tabernacle. If you do, you will die. This is a permanent law for you, and it must be observed from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not drink wine or strong drink, neither you nor your sons with you, when you come into the tent of meeting, so that you do not die—it is a permanent statute throughout your generations—
verses.textEn: "You and your sons are not to drink wine or other fermented drink whenever you go into the tent of meeting, or you will die. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come,

verses.textZh: 使你们可以把圣的和俗的，洁净的和不洁净的，分辨清楚；
verses.textZhCnvs: 使你们可以把圣的和俗的，洁净的和不洁净的，分辨清楚；
verses.textZhCuv: 使你们可以将圣的、俗的，洁净的、不洁净的，分别出来；
verses.textEnNiv: so that you can distinguish between the holy and the common, between the unclean and the clean,
verses.textEnEsv: You are to distinguish between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean,
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may distinguish between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean,
verses.textEnNlt: You must distinguish between what is sacred and what is common, between what is ceremonially unclean and what is clean.
verses.textEnNasb: and to make a distinction between the holy and the profane, and between the unclean and the clean,
verses.textEn: so that you can distinguish between the holy and the common, between the unclean and the clean,

verses.textZh: 可以把耶和华借着摩西告诉以色列人的一切律例，教训他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 可以把耶和华借着摩西告诉以色列人的一切律例，教训他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又使你们可以将耶和华藉摩西晓谕以色列人的一切律例教训他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: and so you can teach the Israelites all the decrees the Lord has given them through Moses."
verses.textEnEsv: and you are to teach the people of Israel all the statutes that the Lord has spoken to them by Moses."
verses.textEnNkjv: and that you may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the Lord has spoken to them by the hand of Moses."
verses.textEnNlt: And you must teach the Israelites all the decrees that the Lord has given them through Moses."
verses.textEnNasb: and so as to teach the sons of Israel all the statutes which the Lord has spoken to them through Moses."
verses.textEn: and so you can teach the Israelites all the decrees the Lord has given them through Moses."

verses.textZh: 摩西对亚伦和他剩下的儿子以利亚撒和以他玛说："献给耶和华的火祭中剩下的素祭，你们要拿来在祭坛旁边作无酵饼吃，因为这是至圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对亚伦和他剩下的儿子以利亚撒和以他玛说："献给耶和华的火祭中剩下的素祭，你们要拿来在祭坛旁边作无酵饼吃，因为这是至圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对亚伦和他剩下的儿子以利亚撒、以他玛说：「你们献给耶和华火祭中所剩的素祭，要在坛旁不带酵而吃，因为是至圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to Aaron and his remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, "Take the grain offering left over from the food offerings prepared without yeast and presented to the Lord and eat it beside the altar, for it is most holy.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses spoke to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his surviving sons: "Take the grain offering that is left of the Lord ’s food offerings, and eat it unleavened beside the altar, for it is most holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons who were left: "Take the grain offering that remains of the offerings made by fire to the Lord, and eat it without leaven beside the altar; for it is most holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said to Aaron and his remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, "Take what is left of the grain offering after a portion has been presented as a special gift to the Lord , and eat it beside the altar. Make sure it contains no yeast, for it is most holy.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his surviving sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, "Take the grain offering that is left over from the Lord’s offerings by fire and eat it as unleavened bread beside the altar, for it is most holy.
verses.textEn: Moses said to Aaron and his remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, "Take the grain offering left over from the food offerings prepared without yeast and presented to the Lord and eat it beside the altar, for it is most holy.

verses.textZh: 你们要在圣洁的地方吃，在献与耶和华的火祭中，这是你和你儿子的分，因为耶和华是这样吩咐我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在圣洁的地方吃，在献与耶和华的火祭中，这是你和你儿子的分，因为耶和华是这样吩咐我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要在圣处吃；因为在献给耶和华的火祭中，这是你的分和你儿子的分；所吩咐我的本是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Eat it in the sanctuary area, because it is your share and your sons’ share of the food offerings presented to the Lord ; for so I have been commanded.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your due and your sons’ due, from the Lord ’s food offerings, for so I am commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your due and your sons’ due, of the sacrifices made by fire to the Lord; for so I have been commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: You must eat it in a sacred place, for it has been given to you and your descendants as your portion of the special gifts presented to the Lord . These are the commands I have been given.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your allotted portion and your sons’ allotted portion from the Lord’s offerings by fire; for so I have been commanded.
verses.textEn: Eat it in the sanctuary area, because it is your share and your sons’ share of the food offerings presented to the Lord ; for so I have been commanded.

verses.textZh: 至于作摇祭的胸和作举祭的后腿，你们也要在洁净的地方吃，你和你的儿女要一起吃，这是从以色列人献的平安祭中，给你和你儿子的分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于作摇祭的胸和作举祭的后腿，你们也要在洁净的地方吃，你和你的儿女要一起吃，这是从以色列人献的平安祭中，给你和你儿子的分。
verses.textZhCuv: 所摇的胸，所举的腿，你们要在洁净地方吃。你和你的儿女都要同吃；因为这些是从以色列人平安祭中给你，当你的分和你儿子的分。
verses.textEnNiv: But you and your sons and your daughters may eat the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. Eat them in a ceremonially clean place; they have been given to you and your children as your share of the Israelites’ fellowship offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: But the breast that is waved and the thigh that is contributed you shall eat in a clean place, you and your sons and your daughters with you, for they are given as your due and your sons’ due from the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering you shall eat in a clean place, you, your sons, and your daughters with you; for they are your due and your sons’ due, which are given from the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But the breast and thigh that were lifted up as a special offering may be eaten in any place that is ceremonially clean. These parts have been given to you and your descendants as your portion of the peace offerings presented by the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The breast of the wave offering, however, and the thigh of the offering you may eat in a clean place, you and your sons and your daughters with you; for they have been given as your allotted portion and your sons’ allotted portion from the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: But you and your sons and your daughters may eat the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. Eat them in a ceremonially clean place; they have been given to you and your children as your share of the Israelites’ fellowship offerings.

verses.textZh: 至于作举祭的后腿，作摇祭的胸，他们要与火祭的脂肪一同带来，当作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。这都要归给你和与你在一起的儿子，当作永远的律例，都是照着耶和华所吩咐的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于作举祭的后腿，作摇祭的胸，他们要与火祭的脂肪一同带来，当作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。这都要归给你和与你在一起的儿子，当作永远的律例，都是照着耶和华所吩咐的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所举的腿，所摇的胸，他们要与火祭的脂油一同带来当摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这要归你和你儿子，当作永得的分，都是照耶和华所吩咐的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The thigh that was presented and the breast that was waved must be brought with the fat portions of the food offerings, to be waved before the Lord as a wave offering. This will be the perpetual share for you and your children, as the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnEsv: The thigh that is contributed and the breast that is waved they shall bring with the food offerings of the fat pieces to wave for a wave offering before the Lord , and it shall be yours and your sons’ with you as a due forever, as the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnNkjv: The thigh of the heave offering and the breast of the wave offering they shall bring with the offerings of fat made by fire, to offer as a wave offering before the Lord. And it shall be yours and your sons’ with you, by a statute forever, as the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnNlt: You must lift up the thigh and breast as a special offering to the Lord , along with the fat of the special gifts. These parts will belong to you and your descendants as your permanent right, just as the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnNasb: They shall bring the thigh offered by lifting up and the breast offered by waving, along with the offerings by fire of the portions of fat, to present as a wave offering before the Lord; so it shall be a thing perpetually due you and your sons with you, just as the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEn: The thigh that was presented and the breast that was waved must be brought with the fat portions of the food offerings, to be waved before the Lord as a wave offering. This will be the perpetual share for you and your children, as the Lord has commanded."

verses.textZh: 那时，摩西急切地寻找那作赎罪祭的公山羊，发现已经烧了；他就向亚伦剩下的儿子以利亚撒和以他玛发怒，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，摩西急切地寻找那作赎罪祭的公山羊，发现已经烧了；他就向亚伦剩下的儿子以利亚撒和以他玛发怒，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当下摩西急切地寻找作赎罪祭的公山羊，谁知已经焚烧了，便向亚伦剩下的儿子以利亚撒、以他玛发怒，说：
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses inquired about the goat of the sin offering and found that it had been burned up, he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s remaining sons, and asked,
verses.textEnEsv: Now Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and behold, it was burned up! And he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the surviving sons of Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses made careful inquiry about the goat of the sin offering, and there it was—burned up. And he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Moses then asked them what had happened to the goat of the sin offering. When he discovered it had been burned up, he became very angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s remaining sons.
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses searched carefully for the goat of the sin offering, and behold, it had been burned! So he was angry with Aaron’s surviving sons Eleazar and Ithamar, saying,
verses.textEn: When Moses inquired about the goat of the sin offering and found that it had been burned up, he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s remaining sons, and asked,

verses.textZh: "这赎罪祭是至圣的，耶和华又把祭肉给你们，要叫你们担当会众的罪孽，在耶和华面前为他们赎罪，你们为甚么没有在圣洁的地方吃呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "这赎罪祭是至圣的，耶和华又把祭肉给你们，要叫你们担当会众的罪孽，在耶和华面前为他们赎罪，你们为甚么没有在圣洁的地方吃呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 「这赎罪祭既是至圣的，主又给了你们，为要你们担当会众的罪孽，在耶和华面前为他们赎罪，你们为何没有在圣所吃呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the sanctuary area? It is most holy; it was given to you to take away the guilt of the community by making atonement for them before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Why have you not eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is a thing most holy and has been given to you that you may bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the Lord ?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Why have you not eaten the sin offering in a holy place, since it is most holy, and God has given it to you to bear the guilt of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the Lord?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the sacred area?" he demanded. "It is a holy offering! The Lord has given it to you to remove the guilt of the community and to purify the people, making them right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Why did you not eat the sin offering at the holy place? For it is most holy, and He gave it to you to take away the guilt of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the sanctuary area? It is most holy; it was given to you to take away the guilt of the community by making atonement for them before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 这祭牲的血既然没有带进圣所里去，你们就应该照着我所吩咐的，在圣所里吃这祭肉。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这祭牲的血既然没有带进圣所里去，你们就应该照着我所吩咐的，在圣所里吃这祭肉。"
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，这祭牲的血并没有拿到圣所里去，你们本当照我所吩咐的，在圣所里吃这祭肉。」
verses.textEnNiv: Since its blood was not taken into the Holy Place, you should have eaten the goat in the sanctuary area, as I commanded."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly ought to have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded."
verses.textEnNkjv: See! Its blood was not brought inside the holy place; indeed you should have eaten it in a holy place, as I commanded."
verses.textEnNlt: Since the animal’s blood was not brought into the Holy Place, you should have eaten the meat in the sacred area as I ordered you."
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, since its blood had not been brought inside, into the sanctuary, you certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, just as I commanded!"
verses.textEn: Since its blood was not taken into the Holy Place, you should have eaten the goat in the sanctuary area, as I commanded."

verses.textZh: 亚伦对摩西说："今天他们在耶和华面前已经献了赎罪祭和燔祭，而且有这样的灾祸临到我；如果今天我吃了赎罪祭的祭肉，耶和华怎能看为美好呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦对摩西说："今天他们在耶和华面前已经献了赎罪祭和燔祭，而且有这样的灾祸临到我；如果今天我吃了赎罪祭的祭肉，耶和华怎能看为美好呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦对摩西说：「今天他们在耶和华面前献上赎罪祭和燔祭，我又遇见这样的灾，若今天吃了赎罪祭，耶和华岂能看为美呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron replied to Moses, "Today they sacrificed their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord , but such things as this have happened to me. Would the Lord have been pleased if I had eaten the sin offering today?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron said to Moses, "Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord , and yet such things as these have happened to me! If I had eaten the sin offering today, would the Lord have approved?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Aaron said to Moses, "Look, this day they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord, and such things have befallen me! If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been accepted in the sight of the Lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Aaron answered Moses, "Today my sons presented both their sin offering and their burnt offering to the Lord . And yet this tragedy has happened to me. If I had eaten the people’s sin offering on such a tragic day as this, would the Lord have been pleased?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Aaron said to Moses, "Behold, this very day they presented their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord. When things like these happened to me, if I had eaten a sin offering today, would it have been good in the sight of the Lord?"
verses.textEn: Aaron replied to Moses, "Today they sacrificed their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord , but such things as this have happened to me. Would the Lord have been pleased if I had eaten the sin offering today?"

verses.textZh: 摩西听了，也觉得合理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西听了，也觉得合理。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西听见这话，便以为美。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses heard this, he was satisfied.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Moses heard that, he approved.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Moses heard that, he was content.
verses.textEnNlt: And when Moses heard this, he was satisfied.
verses.textEnNasb: When Moses heard that, it was good in his sight.
verses.textEn: When Moses heard this, he was satisfied.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying to them,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord spoke again to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.textZh: "你们要告诉以色列人：地上所有的走兽中，你们可以吃的动物，就是这些：
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要告诉以色列人：地上所有的走兽中，你们可以吃的动物，就是这些：
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们晓谕以色列人说，在地上一切走兽中可吃的乃是这些：
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Of all the animals that live on land, these are the ones you may eat:
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, saying, These are the living things that you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the animals which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth:
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. "Of all the land animals, these are the ones you may use for food.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘These are the creatures which you may eat from all the animals that are on the earth.
verses.textEn: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Of all the animals that live on land, these are the ones you may eat:

verses.textZh: 分蹄有趾而且反刍的走兽，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 分蹄有趾而且反刍的走兽，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡蹄分两瓣、倒嚼的走兽，你们都可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: You may eat any animal that has a divided hoof and that chews the cud.
verses.textEnEsv: Whatever parts the hoof and is cloven-footed and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: Among the animals, whatever divides the hoof, having cloven hooves and chewing the cud—that you may eat.
verses.textEnNlt: You may eat any animal that has completely split hooves and chews the cud.
verses.textEnNasb: Whatever has a divided hoof, showing split hoofs, and chews the cud, among the animals, that you may eat.
verses.textEn: You may eat any animal that has a divided hoof and that chews the cud.

verses.textZh: 但你们不可吃下列反刍，或分蹄的走兽动物：骆驼，因为牠反刍却不分蹄，你们应以为不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们不可吃下列反刍，或分蹄的走兽动物：骆驼，因为牠反刍却不分蹄，你们应以为不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那倒嚼或分蹄之中不可吃的乃是：骆驼－因为倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘There are some that only chew the cud or only have a divided hoof, but you must not eat them. The camel, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is ceremonially unclean for you.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, among those that chew the cud or part the hoof, you shall not eat these: The camel, because it chews the cud but does not part the hoof, is unclean to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless these you shall not eat among those that chew the cud or those that have cloven hooves: the camel, because it chews the cud but does not have cloven hooves, is unclean to you;
verses.textEnNlt: You may not, however, eat the following animals that have split hooves or that chew the cud, but not both. The camel chews the cud but does not have split hooves, so it is ceremonially unclean for you.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, you are not to eat of these, among those which chew the cud, or among those which have a divided hoof: the camel, for though it chews cud, it does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean to you.
verses.textEn: " ‘There are some that only chew the cud or only have a divided hoof, but you must not eat them. The camel, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is ceremonially unclean for you.

verses.textZh: 石貛 ，因为牠反刍却不分蹄，你们应以为不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 石貛 ，因为牠反刍却不分蹄，你们应以为不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙番－因为倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
verses.textEnNiv: The hyrax, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
verses.textEnEsv: And the rock badger, because it chews the cud but does not part the hoof, is unclean to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: the rock hyrax, because it chews the cud but does not have cloven hooves, is unclean to you;
verses.textEnNlt: The hyrax chews the cud but does not have split hooves, so it is unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise, the rock hyrax, for though it chews cud, it does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean to you.
verses.textEn: The hyrax, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.

verses.textZh: 兔子，因为牠反刍却不分蹄，你们应以为不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 兔子，因为牠反刍却不分蹄，你们应以为不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 兔子－因为倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
verses.textEnNiv: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
verses.textEnEsv: And the hare, because it chews the cud but does not part the hoof, is unclean to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: the hare, because it chews the cud but does not have cloven hooves, is unclean to you;
verses.textEnNlt: The hare chews the cud but does not have split hooves, so it is unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: The rabbit also, for though it chews cud, it does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean to you.
verses.textEn: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.

verses.textZh: 猪，因为牠分蹄有趾却不反刍，你们应以为不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 猪，因为牠分蹄有趾却不反刍，你们应以为不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 猪－因为蹄分两瓣，却不倒嚼，就与你们不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: And the pig, though it has a divided hoof, does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you.
verses.textEnEsv: And the pig, because it parts the hoof and is cloven-footed but does not chew the cud, is unclean to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the swine, though it divides the hoof, having cloven hooves, yet does not chew the cud, is unclean to you.
verses.textEnNlt: The pig has evenly split hooves but does not chew the cud, so it is unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: And the pig, for though it has a divided hoof, and so it shows a split hoof, it does not chew cud; it is unclean to you.
verses.textEn: And the pig, though it has a divided hoof, does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you.

verses.textZh: 这些走兽的肉你们不可吃，牠们的尸体你们不可摸，你们应视为不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些走兽的肉你们不可吃，牠们的尸体你们不可摸，你们应视为不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些兽的肉，你们不可吃；死的，你们不可摸，都与你们不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they are unclean for you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not eat any of their flesh, and you shall not touch their carcasses; they are unclean to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch. They are unclean to you.
verses.textEnNlt: You may not eat the meat of these animals or even touch their carcasses. They are ceremonially unclean for you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not eat any of their flesh nor touch their carcasses; they are unclean to you.
verses.textEn: You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they are unclean for you.

verses.textZh: "水中所有的活物你们可以吃的，就是这些：凡是在水中，有翅有鳞的，不论是在海里或是河里的，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: "水中所有的活物你们可以吃的，就是这些：凡是在水中，有翅有鳞的，不论是在海里或是河里的，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 「水中可吃的乃是这些：凡在水里、海里、河里、有翅有鳞的，都可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Of all the creatures living in the water of the seas and the streams you may eat any that have fins and scales.
verses.textEnEsv: "These you may eat, of all that are in the waters. Everything in the waters that has fins and scales, whether in the seas or in the rivers, you may eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘These you may eat of all that are in the water: whatever in the water has fins and scales, whether in the seas or in the rivers—that you may eat.
verses.textEnNlt: "Of all the marine animals, these are ones you may use for food. You may eat anything from the water if it has both fins and scales, whether taken from salt water or from streams.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘These you may eat, of whatever is in the water: everything that has fins and scales, in the water, in the seas, or in the rivers, you may eat.
verses.textEn: " ‘Of all the creatures living in the water of the seas and the streams you may eat any that have fins and scales.

verses.textZh: 在水中游动或生存在水中的活物，无论是在海里或是河里，若是没有翅和鳞的，你们都要当作可憎之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在水中游动或生存在水中的活物，无论是在海里或是河里，若是没有翅和鳞的，你们都要当作可憎之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在海里、河里，并一切水里游动的活物，无翅无鳞的，你们都当以为可憎。
verses.textEnNiv: But all creatures in the seas or streams that do not have fins and scales—whether among all the swarming things or among all the other living creatures in the water—you are to regard as unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: But anything in the seas or the rivers that does not have fins and scales, of the swarming creatures in the waters and of the living creatures that are in the waters, is detestable to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But all in the seas or in the rivers that do not have fins and scales, all that move in the water or any living thing which is in the water, they are an abomination to you.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must never eat animals from the sea or from rivers that do not have both fins and scales. They are detestable to you. This applies both to little creatures that live in shallow water and to all creatures that live in deep water.
verses.textEnNasb: But whatever is in the seas and in the rivers that does not have fins and scales among all the teeming life of the water, and among all the living creatures that are in the water, they are detestable things to you,
verses.textEn: But all creatures in the seas or streams that do not have fins and scales—whether among all the swarming things or among all the other living creatures in the water—you are to regard as unclean.

verses.textZh: 牠们是你们憎恶之物；牠们的肉，你们不可吃；牠们的尸体，你们要憎恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们是你们憎恶之物；牠们的肉，你们不可吃；牠们的尸体，你们要憎恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些无翅无鳞、以为可憎的，你们不可吃它的肉；死的也当以为可憎。
verses.textEnNiv: And since you are to regard them as unclean, you must not eat their meat; you must regard their carcasses as unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall regard them as detestable; you shall not eat any of their flesh, and you shall detest their carcasses.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall be an abomination to you; you shall not eat their flesh, but you shall regard their carcasses as an abomination.
verses.textEnNlt: They will always be detestable to you. You must never eat their meat or even touch their dead bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: and they shall be detestable to you; you may not eat any of their flesh, and you shall detest their carcasses.
verses.textEn: And since you are to regard them as unclean, you must not eat their meat; you must regard their carcasses as unclean.

verses.textZh: 所有在水里没有翅和鳞的活物，你们都要当作可憎之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有在水里没有翅和鳞的活物，你们都要当作可憎之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡水里无翅无鳞的，你们都当以为可憎。
verses.textEnNiv: Anything living in the water that does not have fins and scales is to be regarded as unclean by you.
verses.textEnEsv: Everything in the waters that does not have fins and scales is detestable to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whatever in the water does not have fins or scales—that shall be an abomination to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Any marine animal that does not have both fins and scales is detestable to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Whatever in the water does not have fins and scales is detestable to you.
verses.textEn: Anything living in the water that does not have fins and scales is to be regarded as unclean by you.

verses.textZh: "在鸟类中，你们要憎恶，也不可吃这些雀鸟：兀鹰 、鵰、鹫、
verses.textZhCnvs: "在鸟类中，你们要憎恶，也不可吃这些雀鸟：兀鹰 、鵰、鹫、
verses.textZhCuv: 「雀鸟中你们当以为可憎、不可吃的乃是：雕、狗头雕、红头雕、
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘These are the birds you are to regard as unclean and not eat because they are unclean: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,
verses.textEnEsv: "And these you shall detest among the birds; they shall not be eaten; they are detestable: the eagle, the bearded vulture, the black vulture,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And these you shall regard as an abomination among the birds; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the buzzard,
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the birds that are detestable to you. You must never eat them: the griffon vulture, the bearded vulture, the black vulture,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Moreover, these you shall detest among the birds; they are detestable, not to be eaten: the eagle, the vulture, and the buzzard,
verses.textEn: " ‘These are the birds you are to regard as unclean and not eat because they are unclean: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

verses.textZh: 鸢、猎鹰等隼类，
verses.textZhCnvs: 鸢、猎鹰等隼类，
verses.textZhCuv: 鹞鹰、小鹰与其类；
verses.textEnNiv: the red kite, any kind of black kite,
verses.textEnEsv: the kite, the falcon of any kind,
verses.textEnNkjv: the kite, and the falcon after its kind;
verses.textEnNlt: the kite, falcons of all kinds,
verses.textEnNasb: the red kite, the falcon in its kind,
verses.textEn: the red kite, any kind of black kite,

verses.textZh: 所有乌鸦类，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有乌鸦类，
verses.textZhCuv: 乌鸦与其类；
verses.textEnNiv: any kind of raven,
verses.textEnEsv: every raven of any kind,
verses.textEnNkjv: every raven after its kind,
verses.textEnNlt: ravens of all kinds,
verses.textEnNasb: every raven in its kind,
verses.textEn: any kind of raven,

verses.textZh: 鸵鸟、猫头鹰、海鸥、苍鹭等鹰类。
verses.textZhCnvs: 鸵鸟、猫头鹰、海鸥、苍鹭等鹰类。
verses.textZhCuv: 鸵鸟、夜鹰、鱼鹰、鹰与其类；
verses.textEnNiv: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
verses.textEnEsv: the ostrich, the nighthawk, the sea gull, the hawk of any kind,
verses.textEnNkjv: the ostrich, the short-eared owl, the sea gull, and the hawk after its kind;
verses.textEnNlt: the eagle owl, the short-eared owl, the seagull, hawks of all kinds,
verses.textEnNasb: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, and the hawk in its kind,
verses.textEn: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

verses.textZh: 鸱鹗、鸬鸶、大鸱枭、
verses.textZhCnvs: 鸱鹗、鸬鸶、大鸱枭、
verses.textZhCuv: 鸮鸟、鸬鹚、猫头鹰、
verses.textEnNiv: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,
verses.textEnEsv: the little owl, the cormorant, the short-eared owl,
verses.textEnNkjv: the little owl, the fisher owl, and the screech owl;
verses.textEnNlt: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,
verses.textEnNasb: the little owl, the cormorant, and the great owl,
verses.textEn: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

verses.textZh: 白鹭、塘鹅、鸨、
verses.textZhCnvs: 白鹭、塘鹅、鸨、
verses.textZhCuv: 角鸱、鹈鹕、秃雕、
verses.textEnNiv: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,
verses.textEnEsv: the barn owl, the tawny owl, the carrion vulture,
verses.textEnNkjv: the white owl, the jackdaw, and the carrion vulture;
verses.textEnNlt: the barn owl, the desert owl, the Egyptian vulture,
verses.textEnNasb: the white owl, the pelican, and the carrion vulture,
verses.textEn: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

verses.textZh: 鹳、红鹤等鹭鸶类，戴胜和蝙蝠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 鹳、红鹤等鹭鸶类，戴胜和蝙蝠。
verses.textZhCuv: 鹳、鹭鸶与其类；戴𬸊与蝙蝠。
verses.textEnNiv: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.
verses.textEnEsv: the stork, the heron of any kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.textEnNkjv: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.textEnNlt: the stork, herons of all kinds, the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.textEnNasb: the stork, the heron in its kinds, the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.textEn: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.

verses.textZh: "凡有翅膀、四足爬行的生物，你们都要当作可憎之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: "凡有翅膀、四足爬行的生物，你们都要当作可憎之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡有翅膀用四足爬行的物，你们都当以为可憎。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are to be regarded as unclean by you.
verses.textEnEsv: "All winged insects that go on all fours are detestable to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘All flying insects that creep on all fours shall be an abomination to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not eat winged insects that walk along the ground; they are detestable to you.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘All the winged insects that walk on all fours are detestable to you.
verses.textEn: " ‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are to be regarded as unclean by you.

verses.textZh: 但在所有有翅膀、四足爬行的生物中，如果有足有腿，能在地上蹦跳的，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但在所有有翅膀、四足爬行的生物中，如果有足有腿，能在地上蹦跳的，你们都可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是有翅膀用四足爬行的物中，有足有腿，在地上蹦跳的，你们还可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: There are, however, some flying insects that walk on all fours that you may eat: those that have jointed legs for hopping on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet among the winged insects that go on all fours you may eat those that have jointed legs above their feet, with which to hop on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet these you may eat of every flying insect that creeps on all fours: those which have jointed legs above their feet with which to leap on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: You may, however, eat winged insects that walk along the ground and have jointed legs so they can jump.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet these you may eat among all the winged insects that walk on all fours: those which have jointed legs above their feet with which to jump on the earth.
verses.textEn: There are, however, some flying insects that walk on all fours that you may eat: those that have jointed legs for hopping on the ground.

verses.textZh: 在昆虫中，你们可以吃这些：蝗虫类、蚂蚱类、蟋蟀类和蚱蜢类。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在昆虫中，你们可以吃这些：蝗虫类、蚂蚱类、蟋蟀类和蚱蜢类。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中有蝗虫、蚂蚱、蟋蟀与其类；蚱蜢与其类；这些你们都可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Of these you may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket or grasshopper.
verses.textEnEsv: Of them you may eat: the locust of any kind, the bald locust of any kind, the cricket of any kind, and the grasshopper of any kind.
verses.textEnNkjv: These you may eat: the locust after its kind, the destroying locust after its kind, the cricket after its kind, and the grasshopper after its kind.
verses.textEnNlt: The insects you are permitted to eat include all kinds of locusts, bald locusts, crickets, and grasshoppers.
verses.textEnNasb: These of them you may eat: the locust in its kinds, the devastating locust in its kinds, the cricket in its kinds, and the grasshopper in its kinds.
verses.textEn: Of these you may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket or grasshopper.

verses.textZh: 但是其他所有有翅膀四足的生物，你们都要当作可憎之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是其他所有有翅膀四足的生物，你们都要当作可憎之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 但是有翅膀有四足的爬物，你们都当以为可憎。
verses.textEnNiv: But all other flying insects that have four legs you are to regard as unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: But all other winged insects that have four feet are detestable to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But all other flying insects which have four feet shall be an abomination to you.
verses.textEnNlt: All other winged insects that walk along the ground are detestable to you.
verses.textEnNasb: But all other winged insects which are four-footed are detestable to you.
verses.textEn: But all other flying insects that have four legs you are to regard as unclean.

verses.textZh: "以下事物，会使你们成为不洁：触摸动物尸体的，就不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以下事物，会使你们成为不洁：触摸动物尸体的，就不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「这些都能使你们不洁净。凡摸了死的，必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘You will make yourselves unclean by these; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: "And by these you shall become unclean. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘By these you shall become unclean; whoever touches the carcass of any of them shall be unclean until evening;
verses.textEnNlt: "The following creatures will make you ceremonially unclean. If any of you touch their carcasses, you will be defiled until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘By these, moreover, you will be made unclean; whoever touches their carcasses becomes unclean until evening,
verses.textEn: " ‘You will make yourselves unclean by these; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 拾起牠们的尸体的，就要洗净自己的衣服，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拾起牠们的尸体的，就要洗净自己的衣服，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡拿了死的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: and whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: whoever carries part of the carcass of any of them shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening:
verses.textEnNlt: If you pick up their carcasses, you must wash your clothes, and you will remain defiled until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: and whoever picks up any of their carcasses shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: Whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 所有分蹄却无趾的、不反刍的走兽，你们应以为不洁净，触摸牠们的，就不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有分蹄却无趾的、不反刍的走兽，你们应以为不洁净，触摸牠们的，就不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡走兽分蹄不成两瓣、也不倒嚼的，是与你们不洁净；凡摸了的就不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Every animal that does not have a divided hoof or that does not chew the cud is unclean for you; whoever touches the carcass of any of them will be unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: Every animal that parts the hoof but is not cloven-footed or does not chew the cud is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: The carcass of any animal which divides the foot, but is not cloven-hoofed or does not chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches it shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: "Any animal that has split hooves that are not evenly divided or that does not chew the cud is unclean for you. If you touch the carcass of such an animal, you will be defiled.
verses.textEnNasb: As for all the animals which have a divided hoof but do not show a split hoof, or do not chew the cud, they are unclean to you; whoever touches them becomes unclean.
verses.textEn: " ‘Every animal that does not have a divided hoof or that does not chew the cud is unclean for you; whoever touches the carcass of any of them will be unclean.

verses.textZh: 所有用四足行走的动物中，用脚掌行走的，你们应以为不洁净，触摸牠们尸体的，都不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有用四足行走的动物中，用脚掌行走的，你们应以为不洁净，触摸牠们尸体的，都不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡四足的走兽，用掌行走的，是与你们不洁净；摸其尸的，必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textEnNiv: Of all the animals that walk on all fours, those that walk on their paws are unclean for you; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And all that walk on their paws, among the animals that go on all fours, are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening,
verses.textEnNkjv: And whatever goes on its paws, among all kinds of animals that go on all fours, those are unclean to you. Whoever touches any such carcass shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: Of the animals that walk on all fours, those that have paws are unclean. If you touch the carcass of such an animal, you will be defiled until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: Also whatever walks on its paws, among all the creatures that walk on all fours, are unclean to you; whoever touches their carcasses becomes unclean until evening,
verses.textEn: Of all the animals that walk on all fours, those that walk on their paws are unclean for you; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 拾起牠们尸体的，就要洗净自己的衣服，并且不洁净到晚上。以上这些你们应以为不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拾起牠们尸体的，就要洗净自己的衣服，并且不洁净到晚上。以上这些你们应以为不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿其尸的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服。这些是与你们不洁净的。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who picks up their carcasses must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening. These animals are unclean for you.
verses.textEnEsv: and he who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening; they are unclean to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever carries any such carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening. It is unclean to you.
verses.textEnNlt: If you pick up its carcass, you must wash your clothes, and you will remain defiled until evening. These animals are unclean for you.
verses.textEnNasb: and the one who picks up their carcasses shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening; they are unclean to you.
verses.textEn: Anyone who picks up their carcasses must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening. These animals are unclean for you.

verses.textZh: "在地上爬行的生物中，你们应以为不洁净的是这些：鼬鼠、鼫鼠、蜥蜴这一类，
verses.textZhCnvs: "在地上爬行的生物中，你们应以为不洁净的是这些：鼬鼠、鼫鼠、蜥蜴这一类，
verses.textZhCuv: 「地上爬物与你们不洁净的乃是这些：鼬鼠、鼫鼠、蜥蜴与其类；
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Of the animals that move along the ground, these are unclean for you: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,
verses.textEnEsv: "And these are unclean to you among the swarming things that swarm on the ground: the mole rat, the mouse, the great lizard of any kind,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘These also shall be unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the mole, the mouse, and the large lizard after its kind;
verses.textEnNlt: "Of the small animals that scurry along the ground, these are unclean for you: the mole rat, the rat, large lizards of all kinds,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now these are to you the unclean among the swarming things which swarm on the earth: the mole, the mouse, and the great lizard in its kinds,
verses.textEn: " ‘Of the animals that move along the ground, these are unclean for you: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

verses.textZh: 以及壁虎、龙子、守宫、蛇医、变色龙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及壁虎、龙子、守宫、蛇医、变色龙。
verses.textZhCuv: 壁虎、龙子、守宫、蛇医、蝘蜓。
verses.textEnNiv: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink and the chameleon.
verses.textEnEsv: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the lizard, the sand lizard, and the chameleon.
verses.textEnNkjv: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the sand reptile, the sand lizard, and the chameleon.
verses.textEnNlt: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the common lizard, the sand lizard, and the chameleon.
verses.textEnNasb: the gecko, the crocodile, the lizard, the sand reptile, and the chameleon.
verses.textEn: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink and the chameleon.

verses.textZh: 在所有爬行的生物中，你们应以这些为不洁净；牠们死了以后，触摸牠们的，都不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在所有爬行的生物中，你们应以这些为不洁净；牠们死了以后，触摸牠们的，都不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些爬物都是与你们不洁净的。在它死了以后，凡摸了的，必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textEnNiv: Of all those that move along the ground, these are unclean for you. Whoever touches them when they are dead will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: These are unclean to you among all that swarm. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: All these small animals are unclean for you. If any of you touch the dead body of such an animal, you will be defiled until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: These are to you the unclean among all the swarming things; whoever touches them when they are dead becomes unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: Of all those that move along the ground, these are unclean for you. Whoever touches them when they are dead will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 牠们当中死了的，掉在甚么东西上，无论是木器或是衣服，皮子或是布袋等任何器具，都成为不洁净，要放在水中。但仍不洁净到晚上，以后就真洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们当中死了的，掉在甚么东西上，无论是木器或是衣服，皮子或是布袋等任何器具，都成为不洁净，要放在水中。但仍不洁净到晚上，以后就真洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中死了的，掉在什么东西上，这东西就不洁净，无论是木器、衣服、皮子、口袋，不拘是做什么工用的器皿，须要放在水中，必不洁净到晚上，到晚上才洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: When one of them dies and falls on something, that article, whatever its use, will be unclean, whether it is made of wood, cloth, hide or sackcloth. Put it in water; it will be unclean till evening, and then it will be clean.
verses.textEnEsv: And anything on which any of them falls when they are dead shall be unclean, whether it is an article of wood or a garment or a skin or a sack, any article that is used for any purpose. It must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening; then it shall be clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: Anything on which any of them falls, when they are dead shall be unclean, whether it is any item of wood or clothing or skin or sack, whatever item it is, in which any work is done, it must be put in water. And it shall be unclean until evening; then it shall be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: If such an animal dies and falls on something, that object will be unclean. This is true whether the object is made of wood, cloth, leather, or burlap. Whatever its use, you must dip it in water, and it will remain defiled until evening. After that, it will be ceremonially clean and may be used again.
verses.textEnNasb: Also anything on which one of them may fall when they are dead becomes unclean, including any wooden article, or clothing, or a hide, or a sack—any article of which use is made—it shall be put in the water and be unclean until evening, then it becomes clean.
verses.textEn: When one of them dies and falls on something, that article, whatever its use, will be unclean, whether it is made of wood, cloth, hide or sackcloth. Put it in water; it will be unclean till evening, and then it will be clean.

verses.textZh: 牠们当中死了的，掉在甚么瓦器里，其中不论是甚么，都成为不洁净，你们要把瓦器打碎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们当中死了的，掉在甚么瓦器里，其中不论是甚么，都成为不洁净，你们要把瓦器打碎。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有死了掉在瓦器里的，其中不拘有什么，就不洁净，你们要把这瓦器打破了。
verses.textEnNiv: If one of them falls into a clay pot, everything in it will be unclean, and you must break the pot.
verses.textEnEsv: And if any of them falls into any earthenware vessel, all that is in it shall be unclean, and you shall break it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Any earthen vessel into which any of them falls you shall break; and whatever is in it shall be unclean:
verses.textEnNlt: "If such an animal falls into a clay pot, everything in the pot will be defiled, and the pot must be smashed.
verses.textEnNasb: As for any earthenware vessel into which one of them may fall, whatever is in it becomes unclean and you shall break the vessel.
verses.textEn: If one of them falls into a clay pot, everything in it will be unclean, and you must break the pot.

verses.textZh: 瓦器的水若是滴在任何食物上，食物就成了不洁净，若是滴在装了饮料的器皿里，饮料也成为不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 瓦器的水若是滴在任何食物上，食物就成了不洁净，若是滴在装了饮料的器皿里，饮料也成为不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中一切可吃的食物，沾水的就不洁净，并且那样器皿中一切可喝的，也必不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: Any food you are allowed to eat that has come into contact with water from any such pot is unclean, and any liquid that is drunk from such a pot is unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: Any food in it that could be eaten, on which water comes, shall be unclean. And all drink that could be drunk from every such vessel shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: in such a vessel, any edible food upon which water falls becomes unclean, and any drink that may be drunk from it becomes unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: If the water from such a container spills on any food, the food will be defiled. And any beverage in such a container will be defiled.
verses.textEnNasb: Any of the food which may be eaten, on which water comes, shall become unclean, and any liquid which may be drunk in every vessel shall become unclean.
verses.textEn: Any food you are allowed to eat that has come into contact with water from any such pot is unclean, and any liquid that is drunk from such a pot is unclean.

verses.textZh: 牠们尸体的任何部分掉在甚么东西上，那东西就不洁净，无论是炉或是锅，都成为不洁净，应该打碎；你们应以这些为不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们尸体的任何部分掉在甚么东西上，那东西就不洁净，无论是炉或是锅，都成为不洁净，应该打碎；你们应以这些为不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中已死的，若有一点掉在什么物件上，那物件就不洁净，不拘是炉子，是锅台，就要打碎，都不洁净，也必与你们不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: Anything that one of their carcasses falls on becomes unclean; an oven or cooking pot must be broken up. They are unclean, and you are to regard them as unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: And everything on which any part of their carcass falls shall be unclean. Whether oven or stove, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean and shall remain unclean for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And everything on which a part of any such carcass falls shall be unclean; whether it is an oven or cooking stove, it shall be broken down; for they are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Any object on which the carcass of such an animal falls will be defiled. If it is an oven or hearth, it must be destroyed, for it is defiled, and you must treat it accordingly.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, everything on which part of their carcass may fall becomes unclean; an oven or a stove shall be smashed; they are unclean and shall continue as unclean to you.
verses.textEn: Anything that one of their carcasses falls on becomes unclean; an oven or cooking pot must be broken up. They are unclean, and you are to regard them as unclean.

verses.textZh: 但是水源和储水池仍算是洁净的。只有触摸水中尸体的，才是不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是水源和储水池仍算是洁净的。只有触摸水中尸体的，才是不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 但是泉源或是聚水的池子仍是洁净；惟挨了那死的，就不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: A spring, however, or a cistern for collecting water remains clean, but anyone who touches one of these carcasses is unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, a spring or a cistern holding water shall be clean, but whoever touches a carcass in them shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern, in which there is plenty of water, shall be clean, but whatever touches any such carcass becomes unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: "However, if the carcass of such an animal falls into a spring or a cistern, the water will still be clean. But anyone who touches the carcass will be defiled.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, a spring or a cistern collecting water shall be clean, though the one who touches their carcass shall be unclean.
verses.textEn: A spring, however, or a cistern for collecting water remains clean, but anyone who touches one of these carcasses is unclean.

verses.textZh: 牠们尸体的一部分掉在要播种的种子上，种子还是洁净的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们尸体的一部分掉在要播种的种子上，种子还是洁净的；
verses.textZhCuv: 若是死的，有一点掉在要种的子粒上，子粒仍是洁净；
verses.textEnNiv: If a carcass falls on any seeds that are to be planted, they remain clean.
verses.textEnEsv: And if any part of their carcass falls upon any seed grain that is to be sown, it is clean,
verses.textEnNkjv: And if a part of any such carcass falls on any planting seed which is to be sown, it remains clean.
verses.textEnNlt: If the carcass falls on seed grain to be planted in the field, the seed will still be considered clean.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if a part of their carcass falls on any seed for sowing which is to be sown, it is clean.
verses.textEn: If a carcass falls on any seeds that are to be planted, they remain clean.

verses.textZh: 但是，如果种子已经浇了水，牠们尸体的一部分才掉在种子上面，你们应以这种子为不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，如果种子已经浇了水，牠们尸体的一部分才掉在种子上面，你们应以这种子为不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 若水已经浇在子粒上，那死的有一点掉在上头，这子粒就与你们不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: But if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.
verses.textEnEsv: but if water is put on the seed and any part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if water is put on the seed, and if a part of any such carcass falls on it, it becomes unclean to you.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the seed is wet when the carcass falls on it, the seed will be defiled.
verses.textEnNasb: But if water is put on the seed and a part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.
verses.textEn: But if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.

verses.textZh: "一只你们可以吃的走兽死了，谁摸了牠的尸体，就不洁净到晚上；
verses.textZhCnvs: "一只你们可以吃的走兽死了，谁摸了牠的尸体，就不洁净到晚上；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们可吃的走兽若是死了，有人摸它，必不洁净到晚上；
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If an animal that you are allowed to eat dies, anyone who touches its carcass will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: "And if any animal which you may eat dies, whoever touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if any animal which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: "If an animal you are permitted to eat dies and you touch its carcass, you will be defiled until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Also if one of the animals dies which you have for food, the one who touches its carcass becomes unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: " ‘If an animal that you are allowed to eat dies, anyone who touches its carcass will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 谁吃了牠的尸体，就要洗净自己的衣服，并且不洁净到晚上；谁拾起这尸体，也要洗净自己的衣服，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁吃了牠的尸体，就要洗净自己的衣服，并且不洁净到晚上；谁拾起这尸体，也要洗净自己的衣服，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人吃那死了的走兽，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服；拿了死走兽的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who eats some of its carcass must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening. Anyone who picks up the carcass must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: and whoever eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening. And whoever carries the carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: If you eat any of its meat or carry away its carcass, you must wash your clothes, and you will remain defiled until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: He, too, who eats some of its carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening, and the one who picks up its carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: Anyone who eats some of its carcass must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening. Anyone who picks up the carcass must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: "所有在地上爬行的动物，都是可憎之物，都不可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所有在地上爬行的动物，都是可憎之物，都不可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡地上的爬物是可憎的，都不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Every creature that moves along the ground is to be regarded as unclean; it is not to be eaten.
verses.textEnEsv: "Every swarming thing that swarms on the ground is detestable; it shall not be eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And every creeping thing that creeps on the earth shall be an abomination. It shall not be eaten.
verses.textEnNlt: "All small animals that scurry along the ground are detestable, and you must never eat them.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now every swarming thing that swarms on the earth is detestable, not to be eaten.
verses.textEn: " ‘Every creature that moves along the ground is to be regarded as unclean; it is not to be eaten.

verses.textZh: 凡是用肚子，或用四足或是多足在地上爬行的动物，你们都不可吃，因为牠们是可憎之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是用肚子，或用四足或是多足在地上爬行的动物，你们都不可吃，因为牠们是可憎之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡用肚子行走的和用四足行走的，或是有许多足的，就是一切爬在地上的，你们都不可吃，因为是可憎的。
verses.textEnNiv: You are not to eat any creature that moves along the ground, whether it moves on its belly or walks on all fours or on many feet; it is unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, any swarming thing that swarms on the ground, you shall not eat, for they are detestable.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whatever crawls on its belly, whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet among all creeping things that creep on the earth—these you shall not eat, for they are an abomination.
verses.textEnNlt: This includes all animals that slither along on their bellies, as well as those with four legs and those with many feet. All such animals that scurry along the ground are detestable, and you must never eat them.
verses.textEnNasb: Whatever crawls on its belly, and whatever walks on all fours, whatever has many feet, in regard to every swarming thing that swarms on the earth, you shall not eat them, because they are detestable.
verses.textEn: You are not to eat any creature that moves along the ground, whether it moves on its belly or walks on all fours or on many feet; it is unclean.

verses.textZh: 你们不可因任何爬行的动物使自己成为可憎的，也不可因牠们玷污自己，以致不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不可因任何爬行的动物使自己成为可憎的，也不可因牠们玷污自己，以致不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不可因什么爬物使自己成为可憎的，也不可因这些使自己不洁净，以致染了污秽。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not defile yourselves by any of these creatures. Do not make yourselves unclean by means of them or be made unclean by them.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not make yourselves detestable with any swarming thing that swarms, and you shall not defile yourselves with them, and become unclean through them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps; nor shall you make yourselves unclean with them, lest you be defiled by them.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not defile yourselves by touching them. You must not make yourselves ceremonially unclean because of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not make yourselves detestable through any of the swarming things that swarm; and you shall not make yourselves unclean with them so that you become unclean.
verses.textEn: Do not defile yourselves by any of these creatures. Do not make yourselves unclean by means of them or be made unclean by them.

verses.textZh: 因为我是耶和华你们的神，所以你们要使自己成为圣洁。你们要分别为圣，因为我是圣洁的。你们不可因在地上爬行的任何动物玷污自己，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我是耶和华你们的神，所以你们要使自己成为圣洁。你们要分别为圣，因为我是圣洁的。你们不可因在地上爬行的任何动物玷污自己，
verses.textZhCuv: 我是耶和华－你们的神；所以你们要成为圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。你们也不可在地上的爬物污秽自己。
verses.textEnNiv: I am the Lord your God; consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am holy. Do not make yourselves unclean by any creature that moves along the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: For I am the Lord your God. Consecrate yourselves therefore, and be holy, for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any swarming thing that crawls on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am the Lord your God. You shall therefore consecrate yourselves, and you shall be holy; for I am holy. Neither shall you defile yourselves with any creeping thing that creeps on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am the Lord your God. You must consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am holy. So do not defile yourselves with any of these small animals that scurry along the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am the Lord your God. Consecrate yourselves therefore, and be holy, because I am holy. And you shall not make yourselves unclean with any of the swarming things that swarm on the earth.
verses.textEn: I am the Lord your God; consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am holy. Do not make yourselves unclean by any creature that moves along the ground.

verses.textZh: 因为我是耶和华，曾把你们从埃及地领上来，为要作你们的神；你们要分别为圣，因为我是圣洁的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我是耶和华，曾把你们从埃及地领上来，为要作你们的神；你们要分别为圣，因为我是圣洁的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我是把你们从埃及地领出来的耶和华，要作你们的神；所以你们要圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I am the Lord , who brought you up out of Egypt to be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.
verses.textEnEsv: For I am the Lord who brought you up out of the land of Egypt to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am the Lord who brings you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
verses.textEnNlt: For I, the Lord , am the one who brought you up from the land of Egypt, that I might be your God. Therefore, you must be holy because I am holy.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am the Lord who brought you up from the land of Egypt, to be your God; so you shall be holy, because I am holy.’ "
verses.textEn: I am the Lord , who brought you up out of Egypt to be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.

verses.textZh: 以上就是有关走兽、飞禽、所有在水中游行的动物，和所有在地上爬行的动物的律例，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上就是有关走兽、飞禽、所有在水中游行的动物，和所有在地上爬行的动物的律例，
verses.textZhCuv: 这是走兽、飞鸟，和水中游动的活物，并地上爬物的条例。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘These are the regulations concerning animals, birds, every living thing that moves about in the water and every creature that moves along the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the law about beast and bird and every living creature that moves through the waters and every creature that swarms on the ground,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘This is the law of the animals and the birds and every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the instructions regarding land animals, birds, marine creatures, and animals that scurry along the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the law regarding the animal and the bird, and every living thing that moves in the waters and everything that swarms on the earth,
verses.textEn: " ‘These are the regulations concerning animals, birds, every living thing that moves about in the water and every creature that moves along the ground.

verses.textZh: 为要把不洁净的和洁净的，可吃的生物和不可吃的生物，分别出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要把不洁净的和洁净的，可吃的生物和不可吃的生物，分别出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把洁净的和不洁净的，可吃的与不可吃的活物，都分别出来。
verses.textEnNiv: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between living creatures that may be eaten and those that may not be eaten.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean and between the living creature that may be eaten and the living creature that may not be eaten.
