verses.textEnNkjv: to distinguish between the unclean and the clean, and between the animal that may be eaten and the animal that may not be eaten.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: By these instructions you will know what is unclean and clean, and which animals may be eaten and which may not be eaten."
verses.textEnNasb: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the edible creature and the creature which is not to be eaten.
verses.textEn: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between living creatures that may be eaten and those that may not be eaten.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人：如果有妇人怀孕，生了男孩，她就不洁净七天，好象患病污秽的日子不洁净一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人：如果有妇人怀孕，生了男孩，她就不洁净七天，好象患病污秽的日子不洁净一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：若有妇人怀孕生男孩，她就不洁净七天，像在月经污秽的日子不洁净一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be ceremonially unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her monthly period.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, saying, If a woman conceives and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days. As at the time of her menstruation, she shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘If a woman has conceived, and borne a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her customary impurity she shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. If a woman becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son, she will be ceremonially unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her menstrual period.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: ‘When a woman gives birth and delivers a male child, then she shall be unclean for seven days; as she is in the days of her menstruation, she shall be unclean.
verses.textEn: "Say to the Israelites: ‘A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be ceremonially unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her monthly period.

verses.textZh: 第八天男婴要受割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第八天男婴要受割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 第八天，要给婴孩行割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: On the eighth day the boy is to be circumcised.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.textEnNlt: On the eighth day the boy’s foreskin must be circumcised.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.textEn: On the eighth day the boy is to be circumcised.

verses.textZh: 妇人洁净产血的时期要住在家三十三天；得洁净的日子未满之前，她不可触摸任何圣物，也不可进入圣洁的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人洁净产血的时期要住在家三十三天；得洁净的日子未满之前，她不可触摸任何圣物，也不可进入圣洁的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人在产血不洁之中，要家居三十三天。她洁净的日子未满，不可摸圣物，也不可进入圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the woman must wait thirty-three days to be purified from her bleeding. She must not touch anything sacred or go to the sanctuary until the days of her purification are over.
verses.textEnEsv: Then she shall continue for thirty-three days in the blood of her purifying. She shall not touch anything holy, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.
verses.textEnNkjv: She shall then continue in the blood of her purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary until the days of her purification are fulfilled.
verses.textEnNlt: After waiting thirty-three days, she will be purified from the bleeding of childbirth. During this time of purification, she must not touch anything that is set apart as holy. And she must not enter the sanctuary until her time of purification is over.
verses.textEnNasb: And she shall stay at home in her condition of blood purification for thirty-three days; she shall not touch any consecrated thing, nor enter the sanctuary until the days of her purification are completed.
verses.textEn: Then the woman must wait thirty-three days to be purified from her bleeding. She must not touch anything sacred or go to the sanctuary until the days of her purification are over.

verses.textZh: 如果她生了女孩，就不洁净十四天，像月经污秽的日子一样；妇人洁净产血的时期，要住在家里六十六天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果她生了女孩，就不洁净十四天，像月经污秽的日子一样；妇人洁净产血的时期，要住在家里六十六天。
verses.textZhCuv: 她若生女孩，就不洁净两个七天，像污秽的时候一样，要在产血不洁之中，家居六十六天。
verses.textEnNiv: If she gives birth to a daughter, for two weeks the woman will be unclean, as during her period. Then she must wait sixty-six days to be purified from her bleeding.
verses.textEnEsv: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her menstruation. And she shall continue in the blood of her purifying for sixty-six days.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her customary impurity, and she shall continue in the blood of her purification sixty-six days.
verses.textEnNlt: If a woman gives birth to a daughter, she will be ceremonially unclean for two weeks, just as she is unclean during her menstrual period. After waiting sixty-six days, she will be purified from the bleeding of childbirth.
verses.textEnNasb: But if she gives birth to a female child, then she shall be unclean for two weeks, as in her menstruation; and she shall stay at home in her condition of blood purification for sixty-six days.
verses.textEn: If she gives birth to a daughter, for two weeks the woman will be unclean, as during her period. Then she must wait sixty-six days to be purified from her bleeding.

verses.textZh: "洁净的日子满了，不论是为男孩或是为女孩，她都要用一只一岁的绵羊羔作燔祭，一只雏鸽，或一只斑鸠作赎罪祭，带到会幕门口那里，交给祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: "洁净的日子满了，不论是为男孩或是为女孩，她都要用一只一岁的绵羊羔作燔祭，一只雏鸽，或一只斑鸠作赎罪祭，带到会幕门口那里，交给祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 「满了洁净的日子，无论是为男孩是为女孩，她要把一岁的羊羔为燔祭，一只雏鸽或是一只斑鸠为赎罪祭，带到会幕门口交给祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When the days of her purification for a son or daughter are over, she is to bring to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting a year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a dove for a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: "And when the days of her purifying are completed, whether for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting a lamb a year old for a burnt offering, and a pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘When the days of her purification are fulfilled, whether for a son or a daughter, she shall bring to the priest a lamb of the first year as a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove as a sin offering, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the time of purification is completed for either a son or a daughter, the woman must bring a one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or turtledove for a purification offering. She must bring her offerings to the priest at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘When the days of her purification are completed, for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the doorway of the tent of meeting a one-year-old lamb as a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove as a sin offering.
verses.textEn: " ‘When the days of her purification for a son or daughter are over, she is to bring to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting a year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a dove for a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司把供物献在耶和华面前，为她赎罪，她的血就洁净了。以上是生育男女的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司把供物献在耶和华面前，为她赎罪，她的血就洁净了。以上是生育男女的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要献在耶和华面前，为她赎罪，她的血源就洁净了。这条例是为生育的妇人，无论是生男生女。
verses.textEnNiv: He shall offer them before the Lord to make atonement for her, and then she will be ceremonially clean from her flow of blood. " ‘These are the regulations for the woman who gives birth to a boy or a girl.
verses.textEnEsv: and he shall offer it before the Lord and make atonement for her. Then she shall be clean from the flow of her blood. This is the law for her who bears a child, either male or female.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall offer it before the Lord, and make atonement for her. And she shall be clean from the flow of her blood. This is the law for her who has borne a male or a female.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will then present them to the Lord to purify her. Then she will be ceremonially clean again after her bleeding at childbirth. These are the instructions for a woman after the birth of a son or a daughter.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall offer it before the Lord and make atonement for her, and she shall be cleansed from the flow of her blood. This is the law for her who gives birth to a child, whether a male or a female.
verses.textEn: He shall offer them before the Lord to make atonement for her, and then she will be ceremonially clean from her flow of blood. " ‘These are the regulations for the woman who gives birth to a boy or a girl.

verses.textZh: 她的经济能力若是不够献一只羊羔，她可以拿两只斑鸠，或是两只雏鸽，一只作燔祭，一只作赎罪祭；祭司要为她赎罪，她就洁净了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她的经济能力若是不够献一只羊羔，她可以拿两只斑鸠，或是两只雏鸽，一只作燔祭，一只作赎罪祭；祭司要为她赎罪，她就洁净了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她的力量若不够献一只羊羔，她就要取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，一只为燔祭，一只为赎罪祭。祭司要为她赎罪，她就洁净了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if she cannot afford a lamb, she is to bring two doves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And if she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. And the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if she is not able to bring a lamb, then she may bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons—one as a burnt offering and the other as a sin offering. So the priest shall make atonement for her, and she will be clean.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "If a woman cannot afford to bring a lamb, she must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons. One will be for the burnt offering and the other for the purification offering. The priest will sacrifice them to purify her, and she will be ceremonially clean."
verses.textEnNasb: But if she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young doves, the one as a burnt offering and the other as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she will be clean.’ "
verses.textEn: But if she cannot afford a lamb, she is to bring two doves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.’ "

verses.textZh: "如果有人在皮肉上生了瘤，或癣，或火斑，后来皮肉变成了大痲风病症 ，就要把他带到一个作祭司的亚伦子孙那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人在皮肉上生了瘤，或癣，或火斑，后来皮肉变成了大痲风病症 ，就要把他带到一个作祭司的亚伦子孙那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人的肉皮上若长了疖子，或长了癣，或长了火斑，在他肉皮上成了大麻风的灾病，就要将他带到祭司亚伦或亚伦作祭司的一个子孙面前。
verses.textEnNiv: "When anyone has a swelling or a rash or a shiny spot on their skin that may be a defiling skin disease, they must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons who is a priest.
verses.textEnEsv: "When a person has on the skin of his body a swelling or an eruption or a spot, and it turns into a case of leprous disease on the skin of his body, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons the priests,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When a man has on the skin of his body a swelling, a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes on the skin of his body like a leprous sore, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons the priests.
verses.textEnNlt: "If anyone has a swelling or a rash or discolored skin that might develop into a serious skin disease, that person must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons.
verses.textEnNasb: "When someone has on the skin of his body a swelling, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes an infection of leprosy on the skin of his body, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons the priests.
verses.textEn: "When anyone has a swelling or a rash or a shiny spot on their skin that may be a defiling skin disease, they must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons who is a priest.

verses.textZh: 祭司要察看皮肉上的病症；如果患处的毛已经变白 ，病症的现象又深透皮下的肉，就是大痲风病症，祭司发现这样，就要宣布他为不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要察看皮肉上的病症；如果患处的毛已经变白 ，病症的现象又深透皮下的肉，就是大痲风病症，祭司发现这样，就要宣布他为不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要察看肉皮上的灾病，若灾病处的毛已经变白，灾病的现象深于肉上的皮，这便是大麻风的灾病。祭司要察看他，定他为不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to examine the sore on the skin, and if the hair in the sore has turned white and the sore appears to be more than skin deep, it is a defiling skin disease. When the priest examines that person, he shall pronounce them ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: and the priest shall examine the diseased area on the skin of his body. And if the hair in the diseased area has turned white and the disease appears to be deeper than the skin of his body, it is a case of leprous disease. When the priest has examined him, he shall pronounce him unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall examine the sore on the skin of the body; and if the hair on the sore has turned white, and the sore appears to be deeper than the skin of his body, it is a leprous sore. Then the priest shall examine him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will examine the affected area of the skin. If the hair in the affected area has turned white and the problem appears to be more than skin-deep, it is a serious skin disease, and the priest who examines it must pronounce the person ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall look at the infected area on the skin of the body, and if the hair in the infection has turned white and the infection appears to be deeper than the skin of his body, it is an infection of leprosy; when the priest has looked at him, he shall pronounce him unclean.
verses.textEn: The priest is to examine the sore on the skin, and if the hair in the sore has turned white and the sore appears to be more than skin deep, it is a defiling skin disease. When the priest examines that person, he shall pronounce them ceremonially unclean.

verses.textZh: 火斑若是在他的皮肉上发白，但没有深透皮肤的现象，上面的毛也没有变白，祭司就要把患者隔离七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 火斑若是在他的皮肉上发白，但没有深透皮肤的现象，上面的毛也没有变白，祭司就要把患者隔离七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 若火斑在他肉皮上是白的，现象不深于皮，其上的毛也没有变白，祭司就要将有灾病的人关锁七天。
verses.textEnNiv: If the shiny spot on the skin is white but does not appear to be more than skin deep and the hair in it has not turned white, the priest is to isolate the affected person for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: But if the spot is white in the skin of his body and appears no deeper than the skin, and the hair in it has not turned white, the priest shall shut up the diseased person for seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the bright spot is white on the skin of his body, and does not appear to be deeper than the skin, and its hair has not turned white, then the priest shall isolate the one who has the sore seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: "But if the affected area of the skin is only a white discoloration and does not appear to be more than skin-deep, and if the hair on the spot has not turned white, the priest will quarantine the person for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: But if the bright spot is white on the skin of his body, and it does not appear to be deeper than the skin, and the hair on it has not turned white, then the priest shall isolate the person who has the infection for seven days.
verses.textEn: If the shiny spot on the skin is white but does not appear to be more than skin deep and the hair in it has not turned white, the priest is to isolate the affected person for seven days.

verses.textZh: 到了第七天，祭司要察看他，如果看见病情止住了，皮上的患处没有蔓延，祭司还要把他再隔离七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第七天，祭司要察看他，如果看见病情止住了，皮上的患处没有蔓延，祭司还要把他再隔离七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 第七天，祭司要察看他，若看灾病止住了，没有在皮上发散，祭司还要将他关锁七天。
verses.textEnNiv: On the seventh day the priest is to examine them, and if he sees that the sore is unchanged and has not spread in the skin, he is to isolate them for another seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall examine him on the seventh day, and if in his eyes the disease is checked and the disease has not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him up for another seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall examine him on the seventh day; and indeed if the sore appears to be as it was, and the sore has not spread on the skin, then the priest shall isolate him another seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: On the seventh day the priest will make another examination. If he finds the affected area has not changed and the problem has not spread on the skin, the priest will quarantine the person for seven more days.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest shall look at him on the seventh day, and if in his eyes the infection has not changed and the infection has not spread on the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.
verses.textEn: On the seventh day the priest is to examine them, and if he sees that the sore is unchanged and has not spread in the skin, he is to isolate them for another seven days.

verses.textZh: 到了第七天，祭司要再察看他；如果看见患处色泽变淡，也没有在皮上蔓延，祭司就要宣布他为洁净，这不过是癣；他洗净衣服，就得洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第七天，祭司要再察看他；如果看见患处色泽变淡，也没有在皮上蔓延，祭司就要宣布他为洁净，这不过是癣；他洗净衣服，就得洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 第七天，祭司要再察看他，若灾病发暗，而且没有在皮上发散，祭司要定他为洁净，原来是癣；那人就要洗衣服，得为洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: On the seventh day the priest is to examine them again, and if the sore has faded and has not spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce them clean; it is only a rash. They must wash their clothes, and they will be clean.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall examine him again on the seventh day, and if the diseased area has faded and the disease has not spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only an eruption. And he shall wash his clothes and be clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall examine him again on the seventh day; and indeed if the sore has faded, and the sore has not spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only a scab, and he shall wash his clothes and be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: On the seventh day the priest will make another examination. If he finds the affected area has faded and has not spread, the priest will pronounce the person ceremonially clean. It was only a rash. The person’s clothing must be washed, and the person will be ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall then look at him again on the seventh day, and if the infected area has faded and the infection has not spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only a rash. And he shall wash his clothes and be clean.
verses.textEn: On the seventh day the priest is to examine them again, and if the sore has faded and has not spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce them clean; it is only a rash. They must wash their clothes, and they will be clean.

verses.textZh: 但是祭司察看，宣布他洁净以后，癣若是在皮上蔓延，他就要再次给祭司察看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是祭司察看，宣布他洁净以后，癣若是在皮上蔓延，他就要再次给祭司察看。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他为得洁净，将身体给祭司察看以后，癣若在皮上发散开了，他要再将身体给祭司察看。
verses.textEnNiv: But if the rash does spread in their skin after they have shown themselves to the priest to be pronounced clean, they must appear before the priest again.
verses.textEnEsv: But if the eruption spreads in the skin, after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall appear again before the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the scab should at all spread over the skin, after he has been seen by the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen by the priest again.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the rash continues to spread after the person has been examined by the priest and has been pronounced clean, the infected person must return to be examined again.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if the rash spreads farther on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall appear again to the priest.
verses.textEn: But if the rash does spread in their skin after they have shown themselves to the priest to be pronounced clean, they must appear before the priest again.

verses.textZh: 祭司要察看他；如果发现癣在皮上蔓延了，祭司就要宣布他为不洁净；这是大痲风。

verses.textEn: The priest is to examine that person, and if the rash has spread in the skin, he shall pronounce them unclean; it is a defiling skin disease.

verses.textZh: 祭司要察看；如果发现有深透皮肤的现象，上面的毛也变白了，祭司就要宣布他为不洁净；这就是在疮中发作出来的痲风病。

verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要察看，若现象洼于皮，其上的毛也变白了，就要定他为不洁净，是大麻风的灾病发在疮中。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to examine it, and if it appears to be more than skin deep and the hair in it has turned white, the priest shall pronounce that person unclean. It is a defiling skin disease that has broken out where the boil was.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall look, and if it appears deeper than the skin and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a case of leprous disease that has broken out in the boil.
verses.textEnNkjv: and if, when the priest sees it, it indeed appears deeper than the skin, and its hair has turned white, the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a leprous sore which has broken out of the boil.
verses.textEnNlt: If the priest examines it and finds it to be more than skin-deep, and if the hair in the affected area has turned white, the priest must pronounce the person ceremonially unclean. The boil has become a serious skin disease.
verses.textEnNasb: and the priest shall look, and behold, if it appears to be deeper than the skin, and the hair on it has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is the infection of leprosy, it has broken out in the boil.
verses.textEn: The priest is to examine it, and if it appears to be more than skin deep and the hair in it has turned white, the priest shall pronounce that person unclean. It is a defiling skin disease that has broken out where the boil was.

verses.textZh: 但如果祭司察看病情，看见上面没有白毛，也没有深透皮肤，只是发暗而已，祭司就要把他隔离七天；

verses.textZhCuv: 祭司若察看，其上没有白毛，也没有洼于皮，乃是发暗，就要将他关锁七天。
verses.textEnNiv: But if, when the priest examines it, there is no white hair in it and it is not more than skin deep and has faded, then the priest is to isolate them for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: But if the priest examines it and there is no white hair in it and it is not deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall shut him up seven days.

verses.textEnNlt: But if the priest finds no white hair on the affected area and the problem appears to be no more than skin-deep and has faded, the priest must quarantine the person for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: But if the priest looks at it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it and it is not deeper than the skin and is faded, then the priest shall isolate him for seven days;
verses.textEn: But if, when the priest examines it, there is no white hair in it and it is not more than skin deep and has faded, then the priest is to isolate them for seven days.

verses.textZh: 如果在皮肤上蔓延，祭司就要宣布他为不洁净；这就是痲风病。

verses.textEnEsv: And if it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a disease.

verses.textEnNasb: and if it spreads farther on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infection.
verses.textEn: If it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce them unclean; it is a defiling disease.

verses.textZh: 火斑若是在原处止住，没有蔓延，就是疮的疤痕，祭司就要宣布他为洁净。

verses.textEnNiv: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the sore, and if it has not spread in the skin and appears to be no more than skin deep, the priest shall pronounce them clean. They must wash their clothes, and they will be clean.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the seventh day the priest shall examine the itch, and if the itch has not spread in the skin and it appears to be no deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. And he shall wash his clothes and be clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the scale; and indeed if the scale has not spread over the skin, and does not appear deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: On the seventh day he will examine the sore again. If it has not spread and appears to be no more than skin-deep, the priest will pronounce the person ceremonially clean. The person’s clothing must be washed, and the person will be ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the seventh day the priest shall look at the scale, and if the scale has not spread in the skin and it appears to be no deeper than the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean; and he shall wash his clothes and be clean.
verses.textEn: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the sore, and if it has not spread in the skin and appears to be no more than skin deep, the priest shall pronounce them clean. They must wash their clothes, and they will be clean.

verses.textEnNlt: But if the scabby sore begins to spread after the person is pronounced clean,
verses.textEnNasb: But if the scale spreads farther in the skin after his cleansing,
verses.textEn: But if the sore does spread in the skin after they are pronounced clean,

verses.textEnEsv: then the priest shall examine him, and if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest need not seek for the yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the priest shall examine him; and indeed if the scale has spread over the skin, the priest need not seek for yellow hair. He is unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: the priest must do another examination. If he finds that the sore has spread, the priest does not need to look for yellow hair. The infected person is ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: then the priest shall look at him, and if the scale has spread on the skin, the priest need not look for the yellowish hair; he is unclean.
verses.textEn: the priest is to examine them, and if he finds that the sore has spread in the skin, he does not need to look for yellow hair; they are unclean.

verses.textZh: 如果祭司认为，癞痢已经止住，那里也长了黑毛；癞痢已经痊愈，那人就洁净了，祭司要宣布他为洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果祭司认为，癞痢已经止住，那里也长了黑毛；癞痢已经痊愈，那人就洁净了，祭司要宣布他为洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司若看头疥已经止住，其间也长了黑毛，头疥已然痊愈，那人是洁净了，就要定他为洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: If, however, the sore is unchanged so far as the priest can see, and if black hair has grown in it, the affected person is healed. They are clean, and the priest shall pronounce them clean.
verses.textEnEsv: But if in his eyes the itch is unchanged and black hair has grown in it, the itch is healed and he is clean, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the scale appears to be at a standstill, and there is black hair grown up in it, the scale has healed. He is clean, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the color of the scabby sore does not change and black hair has grown on it, it has healed. The priest will then pronounce the person ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: If in his sight the scale has remained, however, and black hair has grown in it, the scale has healed, and he is clean; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.textEn: If, however, the sore is unchanged so far as the priest can see, and if black hair has grown in it, the affected person is healed. They are clean, and the priest shall pronounce them clean.

verses.textEnNiv: the priest is to examine them, and if the spots are dull white, it is a harmless rash that has broken out on the skin; they are clean.
verses.textEnEsv: the priest shall look, and if the spots on the skin of the body are of a dull white, it is leukoderma that has broken out in the skin; he is clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the priest shall look; and indeed if the bright spots on the skin of the body are dull white, it is a white spot that grows on the skin. He is clean.
verses.textEnNlt: the priest must examine the affected area. If he finds that the shiny patches are only pale white, this is a harmless skin rash, and the person is ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: then the priest shall look, and if the bright spots on the skin of their bodies are a faint white, it is eczema that has broken out on the skin; he is clean.
verses.textEn: the priest is to examine them, and if the spots are dull white, it is a harmless rash that has broken out on the skin; they are clean.

verses.textZh: "人的头发若是掉下了，只不过是秃头，还是洁净的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人的头发若是掉下了，只不过是秃头，还是洁净的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人头上的发若掉了，他不过是头秃，还是洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: "A man who has lost his hair and is bald is clean.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man’s hair falls out from his head, he is bald; he is clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As for the man whose hair has fallen from his head, he is bald, but he is clean.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man loses his hair and his head becomes bald, he is still ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now if a man loses the hair of his head, he is only bald; he is clean.
verses.textEn: "A man who has lost his hair and is bald is clean.

verses.textZh: 人的头顶上若是掉下了头发，只不过是秃额，他还是洁净的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的头顶上若是掉下了头发，只不过是秃额，他还是洁净的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他顶前若掉了头发，他不过是顶门秃，还是洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: If he has lost his hair from the front of his scalp and has a bald forehead, he is clean.
verses.textEnEsv: And if a man’s hair falls out from his forehead, he has baldness of the forehead; he is clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: He whose hair has fallen from his forehead, he is bald on the forehead, but he is clean.
verses.textEnNlt: And if he loses hair on his forehead, he simply has a bald forehead; he is still clean.
verses.textEnNasb: And if his head becomes bald at the front and sides, he is bald on the forehead; he is clean.
verses.textEn: If he has lost his hair from the front of his scalp and has a bald forehead, he is clean.

verses.textZh: 但是头顶秃处或是额前秃处，若有白中带红的病症，这就是痲风病，在他的头顶秃处或是额前处发作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是头顶秃处或是额前秃处，若有白中带红的病症，这就是痲风病，在他的头顶秃处或是额前处发作。
verses.textZhCuv: 头秃处或是顶门秃处若有白中带红的灾病，这就是大麻风发在他头秃处或是顶门秃处，
verses.textEnNiv: But if he has a reddish-white sore on his bald head or forehead, it is a defiling disease breaking out on his head or forehead.
verses.textEnEsv: But if there is on the bald head or the bald forehead a reddish-white diseased area, it is a leprous disease breaking out on his bald head or his bald forehead.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if there is on the bald head or bald forehead a reddish-white sore, it is leprosy breaking out on his bald head or his bald forehead.
verses.textEnNlt: However, if a reddish white sore appears on the bald area on top of his head or on his forehead, this is a skin disease.
verses.textEnNasb: But if on the bald head or the bald forehead there occurs a reddish-white infection, it is leprosy breaking out on his bald head or on his bald forehead.
verses.textEn: But if he has a reddish-white sore on his bald head or forehead, it is a defiling disease breaking out on his head or forehead.

verses.textZh: 祭司就要察看，如果发现在他头顶秃处或是额前秃处，有白中带红的浮肿病症，像皮肉上痲风病的现象，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司就要察看，如果发现在他头顶秃处或是额前秃处，有白中带红的浮肿病症，像皮肉上痲风病的现象，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司就要察看，他起的那灾病若在头秃处或是顶门秃处有白中带红的，像肉皮上大麻风的现象，
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to examine him, and if the swollen sore on his head or forehead is reddish-white like a defiling skin disease,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the priest shall examine him, and if the diseased swelling is reddish-white on his bald head or on his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprous disease in the skin of the body,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall examine it; and indeed if the swelling of the sore is reddish-white on his bald head or on his bald forehead, as the appearance of leprosy on the skin of the body,
verses.textEnNlt: The priest must examine him, and if he finds swelling around the reddish white sore anywhere on the man’s head and it looks like a skin disease,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest shall look at him; and if the swelling of the infection is reddish-white on his bald head or on his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,
verses.textEn: The priest is to examine him, and if the swollen sore on his head or forehead is reddish-white like a defiling skin disease,

verses.textZh: 那人就是患了痲风病，就不洁净；祭司要宣布他为不洁净，那人头上染了痲风。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人就是患了痲风病，就不洁净；祭司要宣布他为不洁净，那人头上染了痲风。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人就是长大麻风，不洁净的，祭司总要定他为不洁净，他的灾病是在头上。
verses.textEnNiv: the man is diseased and is unclean. The priest shall pronounce him unclean because of the sore on his head.
verses.textEnEsv: he is a leprous man, he is unclean. The priest must pronounce him unclean; his disease is on his head.
verses.textEnNkjv: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean; his sore is on his head.
verses.textEnNlt: the man is indeed infected with a skin disease and is unclean. The priest must pronounce him ceremonially unclean because of the sore on his head.
verses.textEnNasb: he is a leprous man, he is unclean. The priest must pronounce him unclean; his infection is on his head.
verses.textEn: the man is diseased and is unclean. The priest shall pronounce him unclean because of the sore on his head.

verses.textZh: "身上患有痲风病的人，要撕裂自己的衣服，披头散发，遮盖上唇喊叫：‘不洁净！不洁净！’
verses.textZhCnvs: "身上患有痲风病的人，要撕裂自己的衣服，披头散发，遮盖上唇喊叫：‘不洁净！不洁净！’
verses.textZhCuv: 「身上有长大麻风灾病的，他的衣服要撕裂，也要蓬头散发，蒙着上唇，喊叫说：『不洁净了！不洁净了！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone with such a defiling disease must wear torn clothes, let their hair be unkempt, cover the lower part of their face and cry out, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’
verses.textEnEsv: "The leprous person who has the disease shall wear torn clothes and let the hair of his head hang loose, and he shall cover his upper lip and cry out, ‘Unclean, unclean.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now the leper on whom the sore is, his clothes shall be torn and his head bare; and he shall cover his mustache, and cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’
verses.textEnNlt: "Those who suffer from a serious skin disease must tear their clothing and leave their hair uncombed. They must cover their mouth and call out, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’
verses.textEnNasb: "As for the person who has the leprous infection, his clothes shall be torn and the hair of his head shall be uncovered, and he shall cover his mustache and call out, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’
verses.textEn: "Anyone with such a defiling disease must wear torn clothes, let their hair be unkempt, cover the lower part of their face and cry out, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

verses.textZh: 在他患病的日子里，他是不洁净的；他既然不洁净，就要独居，住在营外。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他患病的日子里，他是不洁净的；他既然不洁净，就要独居，住在营外。
verses.textZhCuv: 灾病在他身上的日子，他便是不洁净；他既是不洁净，就要独居营外。」
verses.textEnNiv: As long as they have the disease they remain unclean. They must live alone; they must live outside the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall remain unclean as long as he has the disease. He is unclean. He shall live alone. His dwelling shall be outside the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall be unclean. All the days he has the sore he shall be unclean. He is unclean, and he shall dwell alone; his dwelling shall be outside the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: As long as the serious disease lasts, they will be ceremonially unclean. They must live in isolation in their place outside the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall remain unclean all the days during which he has the infection; he is unclean. He shall live alone; he shall live outside the camp.
verses.textEn: As long as they have the disease they remain unclean. They must live alone; they must live outside the camp.

verses.textZh: "染了痲风病的衣服，无论是羊毛衣服或是麻布衣服；
verses.textZhCnvs: "染了痲风病的衣服，无论是羊毛衣服或是麻布衣服；
verses.textZhCuv: 「染了大麻风灾病的衣服，无论是羊毛衣服、是麻布衣服，
verses.textEnNiv: "As for any fabric that is spoiled with a defiling mold—any woolen or linen clothing,
verses.textEnEsv: "When there is a case of leprous disease in a garment, whether a woolen or a linen garment,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also, if a garment has a leprous plague in it, whether it is a woolen garment or a linen garment,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now suppose mildew contaminates some woolen or linen clothing,
verses.textEnNasb: "When a garment has a mark of leprosy in it, whether it is a wool garment or a linen garment,
verses.textEn: "As for any fabric that is spoiled with a defiling mold—any woolen or linen clothing,

verses.textZh: 不论是编结的或是纺织的；是麻布的或是羊毛的；是皮子或是皮子做成的任何物件；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不论是编结的或是纺织的；是麻布的或是羊毛的；是皮子或是皮子做成的任何物件；
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是在经上、在纬上，是麻布的、是羊毛的，是在皮子上，或在皮子做的什么物件上，
verses.textEnNiv: any woven or knitted material of linen or wool, any leather or anything made of leather—
verses.textEnEsv: in warp or woof of linen or wool, or in a skin or in anything made of skin,
verses.textEnNkjv: whether it is in the warp or woof of linen or wool, whether in leather or in anything made of leather,
verses.textEnNlt: woolen or linen fabric, the hide of an animal, or anything made of leather.
verses.textEnNasb: whether in warp or woof, of linen or of wool, whether in leather or in any article made of leather,
verses.textEn: any woven or knitted material of linen or wool, any leather or anything made of leather—

verses.textZh: 病症若是在衣服或皮子、编结物或纺织物，或任何皮子做成的器具上发绿或发红，那就是发霉 的现象，要给祭司察看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 病症若是在衣服或皮子、编结物或纺织物，或任何皮子做成的器具上发绿或发红，那就是发霉 的现象，要给祭司察看。
verses.textZhCuv: 或在衣服上、皮子上，经上、纬上，或在皮子做的什么物件上，这灾病若是发绿，或是发红，是大麻风的灾病，要给祭司察看。
verses.textEnNiv: if the affected area in the fabric, the leather, the woven or knitted material, or any leather article, is greenish or reddish, it is a defiling mold and must be shown to the priest.
verses.textEnEsv: if the disease is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin or in the warp or the woof or in any article made of skin, it is a case of leprous disease, and it shall be shown to the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: and if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment or in the leather, whether in the warp or in the woof, or in anything made of leather, it is a leprous plague and shall be shown to the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: If the contaminated area in the clothing, the animal hide, the fabric, or the leather article has turned greenish or reddish, it is contaminated with mildew and must be shown to the priest.
verses.textEnNasb: if the mark is greenish or reddish in the garment or in the leather, whether in the warp or in the woof, or in any article of leather, it is a leprous mark and it shall be shown to the priest.
verses.textEn: if the affected area in the fabric, the leather, the woven or knitted material, or any leather article, is greenish or reddish, it is a defiling mold and must be shown to the priest.

verses.textZh: 祭司要察看那现象，把染了病症之物隔离七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要察看那现象，把染了病症之物隔离七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司就要察看那灾病，把染了灾病的物件关锁七天。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to examine the affected area and isolate the article for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall examine the disease and shut up that which has the disease for seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall examine the plague and isolate that which has the plague seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: After examining the affected spot, the priest will put the article in quarantine for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest shall look at the mark and shall quarantine the article with the mark for seven days.
verses.textEn: The priest is to examine the affected area and isolate the article for seven days.

verses.textZh: 到了第七天，祭司要察看那病症；如果那病症在衣服、编结物、纺织物、皮子，或是任何皮子做成的物件上蔓延，这就是顽恶的霉，那件物件就不洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第七天，祭司要察看那病症；如果那病症在衣服、编结物、纺织物、皮子，或是任何皮子做成的物件上蔓延，这就是顽恶的霉，那件物件就不洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 第七天，他要察看那灾病，灾病或在衣服上，经上、纬上，皮子上，若发散，这皮子无论当作何用，这灾病是蚕食的大麻风，都是不洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: On the seventh day he is to examine it, and if the mold has spread in the fabric, the woven or knitted material, or the leather, whatever its use, it is a persistent defiling mold; the article is unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he shall examine the disease on the seventh day. If the disease has spread in the garment, in the warp or the woof, or in the skin, whatever be the use of the skin, the disease is a persistent leprous disease; it is unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp or in the woof, in the leather or in anything made of leather, the plague is an active leprosy. It is unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: On the seventh day the priest must inspect it again. If the contaminated area has spread, the clothing or fabric or leather is clearly contaminated by a serious mildew and is ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall then look at the mark on the seventh day; if the mark has spread in the garment, whether in the warp or in the woof, or in the leather, whatever the purpose for which the leather is used, the mark is a leprous malignancy, it is unclean.
verses.textEn: On the seventh day he is to examine it, and if the mold has spread in the fabric, the woven or knitted material, or the leather, whatever its use, it is a persistent defiling mold; the article is unclean.

verses.textZh: 染上病症的衣服，无论是编结的或是纺织的，是羊毛或是麻布，或任何皮子做的物件，都要烧掉。因为那是顽恶的霉，所以要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 染上病症的衣服，无论是编结的或是纺织的，是羊毛或是麻布，或任何皮子做的物件，都要烧掉。因为那是顽恶的霉，所以要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 那染了灾病的衣服，或是经上、纬上，羊毛上，麻衣上，或是皮子做的什么物件上，他都要焚烧；因为这是蚕食的大麻风，必在火中焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: He must burn the fabric, the woven or knitted material of wool or linen, or any leather article that has been spoiled; because the defiling mold is persistent, the article must be burned.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall burn the garment, or the warp or the woof, the wool or the linen, or any article made of skin that is diseased, for it is a persistent leprous disease. It shall be burned in the fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall therefore burn that garment in which is the plague, whether warp or woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, for it is an active leprosy; the garment shall be burned in the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest must burn the item—the clothing, the woolen or linen fabric, or piece of leather—for it has been contaminated by a serious mildew. It must be completely destroyed by fire.
verses.textEnNasb: So he shall burn the garment, whether it is the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or any article of leather, in which the mark occurs; for it is a leprous malignancy. It shall be burned in the fire.
verses.textEn: He must burn the fabric, the woven or knitted material of wool or linen, or any leather article that has been spoiled; because the defiling mold is persistent, the article must be burned.

verses.textZh: "但如果祭司察看病症，在衣服、编结物、纺织物，或是皮子做的任何物件上，没有蔓延，

verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司就要吩咐人把它洗净，然后再隔离七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司就要吩咐他们，把染了灾病的物件洗了，再关锁七天。
verses.textEnNiv: he shall order that the spoiled article be washed. Then he is to isolate it for another seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing in which is the disease, and he shall shut it up for another seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing in which is the plague; and he shall isolate it another seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: the priest will order the object to be washed and then quarantined for seven more days.

verses.textEn: he shall order that the spoiled article be washed. Then he is to isolate it for another seven days.

verses.textZh: 洗净以后，祭司要察看；如果看见那病症没有转变，虽然没有蔓延，那物件仍是不洁净；要用火把它烧掉，因为里外都腐蚀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗净以后，祭司要察看；如果看见那病症没有转变，虽然没有蔓延，那物件仍是不洁净；要用火把它烧掉，因为里外都腐蚀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 洗过以后，祭司要察看，那物件若没有变色，灾病也没有消散，那物件就不洁净，是透重的灾病，无论正面反面，都要在火中焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: After the article has been washed, the priest is to examine it again, and if the mold has not changed its appearance, even though it has not spread, it is unclean. Burn it, no matter which side of the fabric has been spoiled.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall examine the diseased thing after it has been washed. And if the appearance of the diseased area has not changed, though the disease has not spread, it is unclean. You shall burn it in the fire, whether the rot is on the back or on the front.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall examine the plague after it has been washed; and indeed if the plague has not changed its color, though the plague has not spread, it is unclean, and you shall burn it in the fire; it continues eating away, whether the damage is outside or inside.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the priest must examine the object again. If he finds that the contaminated area has not changed color after being washed, even if it did not spread, the object is defiled. It must be completely burned up, whether the contaminated spot is on the inside or outside.
verses.textEnNasb: After the article with the mark has been washed, the priest shall again look, and if the mark has not changed its appearance, even if the mark has not spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire, whether an eating away has produced bareness on the back or on the front of it.
verses.textEn: After the article has been washed, the priest is to examine it again, and if the mold has not changed its appearance, even though it has not spread, it is unclean. Burn it, no matter which side of the fabric has been spoiled.

verses.textZh: "但如果祭司察看的时候，看见它洗净以后，色泽暗淡了，就要把那部分从衣服或是皮子、编结物或纺织物上撕下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "但如果祭司察看的时候，看见它洗净以后，色泽暗淡了，就要把那部分从衣服或是皮子、编结物或纺织物上撕下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 洗过以后，祭司要察看，若见那灾病发暗，他就要把那灾病从衣服上，皮子上，经上、纬上，都撕去。
verses.textEnNiv: If, when the priest examines it, the mold has faded after the article has been washed, he is to tear the spoiled part out of the fabric, the leather, or the woven or knitted material.
verses.textEnEsv: "But if the priest examines, and if the diseased area has faded after it has been washed, he shall tear it out of the garment or the skin or the warp or the woof.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the priest examines it, and indeed the plague has faded after washing it, then he shall tear it out of the garment, whether out of the warp or out of the woof, or out of the leather.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the priest examines it and finds that the contaminated area has faded after being washed, he must cut the spot from the clothing, the fabric, or the leather.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if the priest looks, and indeed the mark has faded after it has been washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment or out of the leather, whether from the warp or from the woof;
verses.textEn: If, when the priest examines it, the mold has faded after the article has been washed, he is to tear the spoiled part out of the fabric, the leather, or the woven or knitted material.

verses.textZh: 如果病症再出现在剩下的衣服、编结物、纺织物或任何皮子做的物件上，那就是病症仍然发作，染了病症的物件，要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果病症再出现在剩下的衣服、编结物、纺织物或任何皮子做的物件上，那就是病症仍然发作，染了病症的物件，要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 若仍现在衣服上，或是经上、纬上、皮子做的什么物件上，这就是灾病又发了，必用火焚烧那染灾病的物件。
verses.textEnNiv: But if it reappears in the fabric, in the woven or knitted material, or in the leather article, it is a spreading mold; whatever has the mold must be burned.
verses.textEnEsv: Then if it appears again in the garment, in the warp or the woof, or in any article made of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn with fire whatever has the disease.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp or in the woof, or in anything made of leather, it is a spreading plague; you shall burn with fire that in which is the plague.
verses.textEnNlt: If the spot later reappears on the clothing, the fabric, or the leather article, the mildew is clearly spreading, and the contaminated object must be burned up.
verses.textEnNasb: yet if it appears again in the garment, whether in the warp or in the woof, or in any article of leather, it is an outbreak; the article with the mark shall be burned in the fire.
verses.textEn: But if it reappears in the fabric, in the woven or knitted material, or in the leather article, it is a spreading mold; whatever has the mold must be burned.

verses.textZh: 如果病症离开了，经过洗净，剩下的衣服，无论编结的或是纺织的，或任何皮子做的物件，只要再洗一次，就洁净了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果病症离开了，经过洗净，剩下的衣服，无论编结的或是纺织的，或任何皮子做的物件，只要再洗一次，就洁净了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所洗的衣服，或是经，或是纬，或是皮子做的什么物件，若灾病离开了，要再洗，就洁净了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Any fabric, woven or knitted material, or any leather article that has been washed and is rid of the mold, must be washed again. Then it will be clean."
verses.textEnEsv: But the garment, or the warp or the woof, or any article made of skin from which the disease departs when you have washed it, shall then be washed a second time, and be clean."
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you wash the garment, either warp or woof, or whatever is made of leather, if the plague has disappeared from it, then it shall be washed a second time, and shall be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the spot disappears from the clothing, the fabric, or the leather article after it has been washed, it must be washed again; then it will be ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: But the garment, whether the warp or the woof, or any article of leather from which the mark has disappeared when you washed it, shall then be washed a second time and will be clean."
verses.textEn: Any fabric, woven or knitted material, or any leather article that has been washed and is rid of the mold, must be washed again. Then it will be clean."

verses.textZh: 以上是与羊毛衣服或是麻布衣服、编结的或纺织的或任何皮子做的物件有关的发霉律例，可以断定洁净，或是不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上是与羊毛衣服或是麻布衣服、编结的或纺织的或任何皮子做的物件有关的发霉律例，可以断定洁净，或是不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是大麻风灾病的条例，无论是在羊毛衣服上，麻布衣服上，经上、纬上，和皮子做的什么物件上，可以定为洁净或是不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the regulations concerning defiling molds in woolen or linen clothing, woven or knitted material, or any leather article, for pronouncing them clean or unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the law for a case of leprous disease in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp or the woof, or in any article made of skin, to determine whether it is clean or unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the law of the leprous plague in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp or woof, or in anything made of leather, to pronounce it clean or to pronounce it unclean."
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the instructions for dealing with mildew that contaminates woolen or linen clothing or fabric or anything made of leather. This is how the priest will determine whether these items are ceremonially clean or unclean."
verses.textEnNasb: This is the law for the mark of leprosy in a garment of wool or linen, whether in the warp or in the woof, or in any article of leather, for pronouncing it clean or unclean.
verses.textEn: These are the regulations concerning defiling molds in woolen or linen clothing, woven or knitted material, or any leather article, for pronouncing them clean or unclean.

verses.textZh: "患痲风病的人得洁净的日子，应守的律例如下：人要带他去见祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: "患痲风病的人得洁净的日子，应守的律例如下：人要带他去见祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 长大麻风得洁净的日子，其例乃是这样：要带他去见祭司；
verses.textEnNiv: "These are the regulations for any diseased person at the time of their ceremonial cleansing, when they are brought to the priest:
verses.textEnEsv: "This shall be the law of the leprous person for the day of his cleansing. He shall be brought to the priest,
verses.textEnNkjv: "This shall be the law of the leper for the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest.

verses.textZh: 就要吩咐人为那求洁净的人，拿两只洁净的活鸟、香柏木、朱红色线和牛膝草来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就要吩咐人为那求洁净的人，拿两只洁净的活鸟、香柏木、朱红色线和牛膝草来。
verses.textZhCuv: 就要吩咐人为那求洁净的拿两只洁净的活鸟和香柏木、朱红色线，并牛膝草来。
verses.textEnNiv: the priest shall order that two live clean birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop be brought for the person to be cleansed.
verses.textEnEsv: the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two live clean birds and cedarwood and scarlet yarn and hyssop.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the priest shall command to take for him who is to be cleansed two living and clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.
verses.textEnNlt: he will perform a purification ceremony, using two live birds that are ceremonially clean, a stick of cedar, some scarlet yarn, and a hyssop branch.
verses.textEnNasb: then the priest shall give orders to take two live clean birds, cedar wood, a scarlet string, and hyssop for the one who is to be cleansed.
verses.textEn: the priest shall order that two live clean birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop be brought for the person to be cleansed.

verses.textZh: 祭司要吩咐人用瓦器盛活水，把一只鸟宰杀在上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要吩咐人用瓦器盛活水，把一只鸟宰杀在上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要吩咐用瓦器盛活水，把一只鸟宰在上面。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the priest shall order that one of the birds be killed over fresh water in a clay pot.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthenware vessel over fresh water.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will order that one bird be slaughtered over a clay pot filled with fresh water.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall also give orders to slaughter the one bird in an earthenware vessel over running water.
verses.textEn: Then the priest shall order that one of the birds be killed over fresh water in a clay pot.

verses.textZh: 至于那只活鸟，祭司要把牠与香柏木、朱红色线和牛膝草一起拿来，把这些物品和活鸟一同蘸于那在活水上宰杀的鸟血中，
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那只活鸟，祭司要把牠与香柏木、朱红色线和牛膝草一起拿来，把这些物品和活鸟一同蘸于那在活水上宰杀的鸟血中，
verses.textZhCuv: 至于那只活鸟，祭司要把它和香柏木、朱红色线并牛膝草一同蘸于宰在活水上的鸟血中，
verses.textEnNiv: He is then to take the live bird and dip it, together with the cedar wood, the scarlet yarn and the hyssop, into the blood of the bird that was killed over the fresh water.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall take the live bird with the cedarwood and the scarlet yarn and the hyssop, and dip them and the live bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the fresh water.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the living bird, he shall take it, the cedar wood and the scarlet and the hyssop, and dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.
verses.textEnNlt: He will take the live bird, the cedar stick, the scarlet yarn, and the hyssop branch, and dip them into the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over the fresh water.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the live bird, he shall take it together with the cedar wood, the scarlet string, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the live bird in the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over the running water.
verses.textEn: He is then to take the live bird and dip it, together with the cedar wood, the scarlet yarn and the hyssop, into the blood of the bird that was killed over the fresh water.

verses.textZh: 然后向那患痲风病求洁净的人身上弹七次，就可以宣布他洁净；又让那只活鸟飞到田野去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后向那患痲风病求洁净的人身上弹七次，就可以宣布他洁净；又让那只活鸟飞到田野去。
verses.textZhCuv: 用以在那长大麻风求洁净的人身上洒七次，就定他为洁净，又把活鸟放在田野里。
verses.textEnNiv: Seven times he shall sprinkle the one to be cleansed of the defiling disease, and then pronounce them clean. After that, he is to release the live bird in the open fields.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall sprinkle it seven times on him who is to be cleansed of the leprous disease. Then he shall pronounce him clean and shall let the living bird go into the open field.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall sprinkle it seven times on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose in the open field.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will then sprinkle the blood of the dead bird seven times on the person being purified of the skin disease. When the priest has purified the person, he will release the live bird in the open field to fly away.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall then sprinkle seven times the one who is to be cleansed from the leprosy and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the live bird go free over the open field.
verses.textEn: Seven times he shall sprinkle the one to be cleansed of the defiling disease, and then pronounce them clean. After that, he is to release the live bird in the open fields.

verses.textZh: 那得洁净的人要洗自己的衣服，剃去身上所有的毛发，用水洗澡，就洁净了；然后他可以进营，只是还要在自己的帐幕外住七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那得洁净的人要洗自己的衣服，剃去身上所有的毛发，用水洗澡，就洁净了；然后他可以进营，只是还要在自己的帐幕外住七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 求洁净的人当洗衣服，剃去毛发，用水洗澡，就洁净了；然后可以进营，只是要在自己的帐棚外居住七天。
verses.textEnNiv: "The person to be cleansed must wash their clothes, shave off all their hair and bathe with water; then they will be ceremonially clean. After this they may come into the camp, but they must stay outside their tent for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: And he who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes and shave off all his hair and bathe himself in water, and he shall be clean. And after that he may come into the camp, but live outside his tent seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, and shall stay outside his tent seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: "The persons being purified must then wash their clothes, shave off all their hair, and bathe themselves in water. Then they will be ceremonially clean and may return to the camp. However, they must remain outside their tents for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: The one to be cleansed shall then wash his clothes and shave off all his hair, and bathe in water and be clean. And afterward he may enter the camp, but he shall stay outside his tent for seven days.
verses.textEn: "The person to be cleansed must wash their clothes, shave off all their hair and bathe with water; then they will be ceremonially clean. After this they may come into the camp, but they must stay outside their tent for seven days.

verses.textZh: 第七天，他要把身上一切的毛发都剃去；头发、胡须、眉毛和身上一切的毛发都剃去；又要洗衣服，用水洗身，就洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第七天，他要把身上一切的毛发都剃去；头发、胡须、眉毛和身上一切的毛发都剃去；又要洗衣服，用水洗身，就洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 第七天，再把头上所有的头发与胡须、眉毛，并全身的毛，都剃了；又要洗衣服，用水洗身，就洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: On the seventh day they must shave off all their hair; they must shave their head, their beard, their eyebrows and the rest of their hair. They must wash their clothes and bathe themselves with water, and they will be clean.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the seventh day he shall shave off all his hair from his head, his beard, and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair, and then he shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: But on the seventh day he shall shave all the hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows—all his hair he shall shave off. He shall wash his clothes and wash his body in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: On the seventh day they must again shave all the hair from their heads, including the hair of the beard and eyebrows. They must also wash their clothes and bathe themselves in water. Then they will be ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it shall be on the seventh day that he shall shave off all his hair: he shall shave his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair. He shall then wash his clothes and bathe his body in water and be clean.
verses.textEn: On the seventh day they must shave off all their hair; they must shave their head, their beard, their eyebrows and the rest of their hair. They must wash their clothes and bathe themselves with water, and they will be clean.

verses.textZh: "第八天，他要取两只没有残疾的公羊羔和一只没有残疾一岁的母羊羔，又要把调油的细面三公斤作素祭，以及三分之一公升油一同取来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "第八天，他要取两只没有残疾的公羊羔和一只没有残疾一岁的母羊羔，又要把调油的细面三公斤作素祭，以及三分之一公升油一同取来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「第八天，他要取两只没有残疾的公羊羔和一只没有残疾、一岁的母羊羔，又要把调油的细面伊法十分之三为素祭，并油一罗革，一同取来。
verses.textEnNiv: "On the eighth day they must bring two male lambs and one ewe lamb a year old, each without defect, along with three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil for a grain offering, and one log of oil.
verses.textEnEsv: "And on the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb a year old without blemish, and a grain offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And on the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without blemish, one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and one log of oil.
verses.textEnNlt: "On the eighth day each person being purified must bring two male lambs and a one-year-old female lamb, all with no defects, along with a grain offering of six quarts of choice flour moistened with olive oil, and a cup of olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now on the eighth day he is to take two male lambs without defect, and a yearling ewe lamb without defect, and three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and one log of oil;
verses.textEn: "On the eighth day they must bring two male lambs and one ewe lamb a year old, each without defect, along with three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil for a grain offering, and one log of oil.

verses.textZh: 行洁净礼的祭司领那求洁净的人拿着这些祭物站在会幕门口，耶和华的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行洁净礼的祭司领那求洁净的人拿着这些祭物站在会幕门口，耶和华的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 行洁净之礼的祭司要将那求洁净的人和这些东西安置在会幕门口、耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest who pronounces them clean shall present both the one to be cleansed and their offerings before the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed and these things before the Lord , at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest who makes him clean shall present the man who is to be made clean, and those things, before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the officiating priest will present that person for purification, along with the offerings, before the Lord at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: and the priest who is going to pronounce him clean shall present the person to be cleansed and the offerings before the Lord at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: The priest who pronounces them clean shall present both the one to be cleansed and their offerings before the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 祭司取一只公羊羔，献作赎愆祭，取三分之一公升油一同献上；祭司把这两样当作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司取一只公羊羔，献作赎愆祭，取三分之一公升油一同献上；祭司把这两样当作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要取一只公羊羔献为赎愆祭，和那一罗革油一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；
verses.textEnNiv: "Then the priest is to take one of the male lambs and offer it as a guilt offering, along with the log of oil; he shall wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall take one of the male lambs and offer it for a guilt offering, along with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall take one male lamb and offer it as a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them as a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will take one of the male lambs and the olive oil and present them as a guilt offering, lifting them up as a special offering before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest shall take the one male lamb and bring it as a guilt offering, with the log of oil, and present them as a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Then the priest is to take one of the male lambs and offer it as a guilt offering, along with the log of oil; he shall wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.

verses.textZh: 他要在圣洁的地方，就是宰杀赎罪祭牲和燔祭牲的地方，宰杀那只公羊羔，因为赎愆祭牲，像赎罪祭牲一样，是至圣的，要归祭司；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要在圣洁的地方，就是宰杀赎罪祭牲和燔祭牲的地方，宰杀那只公羊羔，因为赎愆祭牲，像赎罪祭牲一样，是至圣的，要归祭司；
verses.textZhCuv: 把公羊羔宰于圣地，就是宰赎罪祭牲和燔祭牲之地。赎愆祭要归祭司，与赎罪祭一样，是至圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: He is to slaughter the lamb in the sanctuary area where the sin offering and the burnt offering are slaughtered. Like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest; it is most holy.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall kill the lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary. For the guilt offering, like the sin offering, belongs to the priest; it is most holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall kill the lamb in the place where he kills the sin offering and the burnt offering, in a holy place; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.
verses.textEnNlt: He will then slaughter the male lamb in the sacred area where sin offerings and burnt offerings are slaughtered. As with the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest. It is a most holy offering.
verses.textEnNasb: Next he shall slaughter the male lamb in the place where they slaughter the sin offering and the burnt offering, at the place of the sanctuary—for the guilt offering, like the sin offering, belongs to the priest; it is most holy.
verses.textEn: He is to slaughter the lamb in the sanctuary area where the sin offering and the burnt offering are slaughtered. Like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest; it is most holy.

verses.textZh: 祭司要取些赎愆祭牲的血，抹在得洁净的人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，以及右脚的大拇趾上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要取些赎愆祭牲的血，抹在得洁净的人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，以及右脚的大拇趾上。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要取些赎愆祭牲的血，抹在求洁净人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot.
verses.textEnEsv: The priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt offering, and the priest shall put it on the lobe of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will then take some of the blood of the guilt offering and apply it to the lobe of the right ear, the thumb of the right hand, and the big toe of the right foot of the person being purified.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall then take some of the blood of the guilt offering, and the priest shall put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.textEn: The priest is to take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot.

verses.textZh: 祭司又从那三分之一公升油中，取出一点来，倒在自己的左掌里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司又从那三分之一公升油中，取出一点来，倒在自己的左掌里；
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要从那一罗革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌里，
verses.textEnNiv: The priest shall then take some of the log of oil, pour it in the palm of his own left hand,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the priest shall take some of the log of oil and pour it into the palm of his own left hand
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his own left hand.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall also take some of the log of oil, and pour it into his left palm;
verses.textEn: The priest shall then take some of the log of oil, pour it in the palm of his own left hand,

verses.textZh: 把右手的一个指头，蘸在左掌的油里，在耶和华面前用指头把油弹七次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把右手的一个指头，蘸在左掌的油里，在耶和华面前用指头把油弹七次。
verses.textZhCuv: 把右手的一个指头蘸在左手的油里，在耶和华面前用指头弹七次。
verses.textEnNiv: dip his right forefinger into the oil in his palm, and with his finger sprinkle some of it before the Lord seven times.
verses.textEnEsv: and dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand and sprinkle some oil with his finger seven times before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He will dip his right finger into the oil in his palm and sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: the priest shall then dip his right-hand finger into the oil that is in his left palm, and with his finger sprinkle some of the oil seven times before the Lord.
verses.textEn: dip his right forefinger into the oil in his palm, and with his finger sprinkle some of it before the Lord seven times.

verses.textZh: 然后祭司要把手中剩下的油，抹在那得洁净的人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，以及右脚的大拇趾上，就是抹在赎愆祭牲的血上。

verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to put some of the oil remaining in his palm on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And some of the oil that remains in his hand the priest shall put on the lobe of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And of the rest of the oil in his hand, the priest shall put some on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the blood of the trespass offering.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will then apply some of the oil in his palm over the blood from the guilt offering that is on the lobe of the right ear, the thumb of the right hand, and the big toe of the right foot of the person being purified.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the remaining oil which is in his palm, the priest shall put some on the right ear lobe of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the blood of the guilt offering;
verses.textEn: The priest is to put some of the oil remaining in his palm on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司要把手中剩下的油，抹在那得洁净的人的头上；祭司在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要把手中剩下的油，抹在那得洁净的人的头上；祭司在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司手里所剩的油要抹在那求洁净人的头上，在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed and make atonement for them before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed. Then the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed. So the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will apply the oil remaining in his hand to the head of the person being purified. Through this process, the priest will purify the person before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: as for the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s palm, he shall put it on the head of the one to be cleansed. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the Lord.
verses.textEn: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed and make atonement for them before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 祭司要献赎罪祭，为那得洁净的人赎罪，使他脱离污秽，然后宰杀燔祭牲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要献赎罪祭，为那得洁净的人赎罪，使他脱离污秽，然后宰杀燔祭牲。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要献赎罪祭，为那本不洁净、求洁净的人赎罪；然后要宰燔祭牲，
verses.textEnNiv: "Then the priest is to sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from their uncleanness. After that, the priest shall slaughter the burnt offering

verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed from his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering.

verses.textEn: "Then the priest is to sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from their uncleanness. After that, the priest shall slaughter the burnt offering

verses.textEnNiv: and offer it on the altar, together with the grain offering, and make atonement for them, and they will be clean.

verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the grain offering on the altar. So the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall offer up the burnt offering and the grain offering on the altar. So the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be clean.
verses.textEn: and offer it on the altar, together with the grain offering, and make atonement for them, and they will be clean.

verses.textZh: "但如果他贫穷，经济能力不足，他只要拿一只公绵羊羔作赎愆祭，摇一摇为他赎罪；要把调油的细面一公斤作素祭，和三分之一公升的油一同拿来；
verses.textZhCnvs: "但如果他贫穷，经济能力不足，他只要拿一只公绵羊羔作赎愆祭，摇一摇为他赎罪；要把调油的细面一公斤作素祭，和三分之一公升的油一同拿来；
verses.textZhCuv: 「他若贫穷不能预备够数，就要取一只公羊羔作赎愆祭，可以摇一摇，为他赎罪；也要把调油的细面伊法十分之一为素祭，和油一罗革一同取来；
verses.textEnNiv: "If, however, they are poor and cannot afford these, they must take one male lamb as a guilt offering to be waved to make atonement for them, together with a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil for a grain offering, a log of oil,
verses.textEnEsv: "But if he is poor and cannot afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a guilt offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, and a log of oil;
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if he is poor and cannot afford it, then he shall take one male lamb as a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, a log of oil,
verses.textEnNlt: "But anyone who is too poor and cannot afford these offerings may bring one male lamb for a guilt offering, to be lifted up as a special offering for purification. The person must also bring two quarts of choice flour moistened with olive oil for the grain offering and a cup of olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if he is poor and his means are insufficient, then he is to take one male lamb for a guilt offering as a wave offering to make atonement for him, and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and a log of oil,
verses.textEn: "If, however, they are poor and cannot afford these, they must take one male lamb as a guilt offering to be waved to make atonement for them, together with a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil for a grain offering, a log of oil,
