verses.textZh: 要把房屋拆毁，把房屋里的石头、木头，以及所有的灰泥都搬到城外不洁净的地方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把房屋拆毁，把房屋里的石头、木头，以及所有的灰泥都搬到城外不洁净的地方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就要拆毁房子，把石头、木头、灰泥都搬到城外不洁净之处。
verses.textEnNiv: It must be torn down—its stones, timbers and all the plaster—and taken out of the town to an unclean place.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall break down the house, its stones and timber and all the plaster of the house, and he shall carry them out of the city to an unclean place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall break down the house, its stones, its timber, and all the plaster of the house, and he shall carry them outside the city to an unclean place.
verses.textEnNlt: It must be torn down, and all its stones, timbers, and plaster must be carried out of town to the place designated as ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: The owner shall therefore tear down the house, its stones, its timbers, and all the plaster of the house, and he shall take them outside the city to an unclean place.
verses.textEn: It must be torn down—its stones, timbers and all the plaster—and taken out of the town to an unclean place.

verses.textZh: 在房屋被关闭的期间，进去的人必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在房屋被关闭的期间，进去的人必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 在房子封锁的时候，进去的人必不洁净到晚上；
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone who goes into the house while it is closed up will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, whoever enters the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover he who goes into the house at all while it is shut up shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who enter the house during the period of quarantine will be ceremonially unclean until evening,
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, whoever goes into the house during the time that he has quarantined it, becomes unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: "Anyone who goes into the house while it is closed up will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 在房屋里睡觉的人，要洗净自己的衣服；在房屋里吃饭的人，也要洗净自己的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在房屋里睡觉的人，要洗净自己的衣服；在房屋里吃饭的人，也要洗净自己的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 在房子里躺着的必洗衣服；在房子里吃饭的也必洗衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who sleeps or eats in the house must wash their clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: and whoever sleeps in the house shall wash his clothes, and whoever eats in the house shall wash his clothes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes, and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.
verses.textEnNlt: and all who sleep or eat in the house must wash their clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise, whoever lies down in the house shall wash his clothes, and whoever eats in the house shall wash his clothes.
verses.textEn: Anyone who sleeps or eats in the house must wash their clothes.

verses.textZh: "房屋粉刷以后，祭司进去察看，如果看见病症在房屋里没有蔓延，祭司就要宣布那房屋为洁净，因为已经复原了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "房屋粉刷以后，祭司进去察看，如果看见病症在房屋里没有蔓延，祭司就要宣布那房屋为洁净，因为已经复原了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「房子墁了以后，祭司若进去察看，见灾病在房内没有发散，就要定房子为洁净，因为灾病已经消除。
verses.textEnNiv: "But if the priest comes to examine it and the mold has not spread after the house has been plastered, he shall pronounce the house clean, because the defiling mold is gone.
verses.textEnEsv: "But if the priest comes and looks, and if the disease has not spread in the house after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, for the disease is healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if the priest comes in and examines it, and indeed the plague has not spread in the house after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
verses.textEnNlt: "But if the priest returns for his inspection and finds that the mildew has not reappeared in the house after the fresh plastering, he will pronounce it clean because the mildew is clearly gone.
verses.textEnNasb: "If, on the other hand, the priest comes in and makes an inspection and the spot has not indeed spread in the house after the house has been replastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean because the spot has not reappeared.
verses.textEn: "But if the priest comes to examine it and the mold has not spread after the house has been plastered, he shall pronounce the house clean, because the defiling mold is gone.

verses.textZh: 为了洁净那房屋，祭司要拿两只鸟、香柏木、朱红色线和牛膝草；
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了洁净那房屋，祭司要拿两只鸟、香柏木、朱红色线和牛膝草；
verses.textZhCuv: 要为洁净房子取两只鸟和香柏木、朱红色线并牛膝草，
verses.textEnNiv: To purify the house he is to take two birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop.
verses.textEnEsv: And for the cleansing of the house he shall take two small birds, with cedarwood and scarlet yarn and hyssop,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall take, to cleanse the house, two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.
verses.textEnNlt: To purify the house the priest must take two birds, a stick of cedar, some scarlet yarn, and a hyssop branch.
verses.textEnNasb: To cleanse the house then, he shall take two birds, cedar wood, a scarlet string, and hyssop,
verses.textEn: To purify the house he is to take two birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop.

verses.textZh: 把一只鸟，在盛着活水的瓦器上宰杀；
verses.textZhCnvs: 把一只鸟，在盛着活水的瓦器上宰杀；
verses.textZhCuv: 用瓦器盛活水，把一只鸟宰在上面，
verses.textEnNiv: He shall kill one of the birds over fresh water in a clay pot.
verses.textEnEsv: and shall kill one of the birds in an earthenware vessel over fresh water
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water;
verses.textEnNlt: He will slaughter one of the birds over a clay pot filled with fresh water.
verses.textEnNasb: and he shall slaughter the one bird in an earthenware vessel over running water.
verses.textEn: He shall kill one of the birds over fresh water in a clay pot.

verses.textZh: 然后拿香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色线和那只活鸟，都一同蘸在被宰杀的鸟血和活水中，向房屋弹七次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后拿香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色线和那只活鸟，都一同蘸在被宰杀的鸟血和活水中，向房屋弹七次。
verses.textZhCuv: 把香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色线，并那活鸟，都蘸在被宰的鸟血中与活水中，用以洒房子七次。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he is to take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet yarn and the live bird, dip them into the blood of the dead bird and the fresh water, and sprinkle the house seven times.
verses.textEnEsv: and shall take the cedarwood and the hyssop and the scarlet yarn, along with the live bird, and dip them in the blood of the bird that was killed and in the fresh water and sprinkle the house seven times.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.
verses.textEnNlt: He will take the cedar stick, the hyssop branch, the scarlet yarn, and the live bird, and dip them into the blood of the slaughtered bird and into the fresh water. Then he will sprinkle the house seven times.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, and the scarlet string, with the live bird, and dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird as well as in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.
verses.textEn: Then he is to take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet yarn and the live bird, dip them into the blood of the dead bird and the fresh water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

verses.textZh: 他就用鸟血、活水、活鸟、香柏木、牛膝草和朱红色线，洁净了那房屋；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就用鸟血、活水、活鸟、香柏木、牛膝草和朱红色线，洁净了那房屋；
verses.textZhCuv: 要用鸟血、活水、活鸟、香柏木、牛膝草，并朱红色线，洁净那房子。
verses.textEnNiv: He shall purify the house with the bird’s blood, the fresh water, the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop and the scarlet yarn.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird and with the fresh water and with the live bird and with the cedarwood and hyssop and scarlet yarn.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird and the running water and the living bird, with the cedar wood, the hyssop, and the scarlet.
verses.textEnNlt: When the priest has purified the house in exactly this way,
verses.textEnNasb: So he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird and with the running water, along with the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop, and the scarlet string.
verses.textEn: He shall purify the house with the bird’s blood, the fresh water, the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop and the scarlet yarn.

verses.textZh: 然后让那只活鸟飞到城外的田野里去；他为房屋赎罪，房屋就洁净了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后让那只活鸟飞到城外的田野里去；他为房屋赎罪，房屋就洁净了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但要把活鸟放在城外田野里。这样洁净房子 ，房子就洁净了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he is to release the live bird in the open fields outside the town. In this way he will make atonement for the house, and it will be clean."
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall let the live bird go out of the city into the open country. So he shall make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall let the living bird loose outside the city in the open field, and make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: he will release the live bird in the open fields outside the town. Through this process, the priest will purify the house, and it will be ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: However, he shall let the live bird go free outside the city into the open field. So he shall make atonement for the house, and it will be clean."
verses.textEn: Then he is to release the live bird in the open fields outside the town. In this way he will make atonement for the house, and it will be clean."

verses.textEnEsv: This is the law for any case of leprous disease: for an itch,
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the law for any leprous sore and scale,
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the instructions for dealing with serious skin diseases, including scabby sores;
verses.textEnNasb: This is the law for any spot of leprosy—even for a scale,
verses.textEn: These are the regulations for any defiling skin disease, for a sore,

verses.textEnNasb: and for the leprous garment or house,

verses.textZhCuv: 以及疖子、癣、火斑所立的条例，

verses.textEnEsv: and for a swelling or an eruption or a spot,

verses.textZh: 指示人知道甚么时候不洁净，甚么时候洁净。这是痲风病的律例。

verses.textZhCuv: 指明何时为洁净，何时为不洁净。这是大麻风的条例。
verses.textEnNiv: to determine when something is clean or unclean. These are the regulations for defiling skin diseases and defiling molds.

verses.textEn: to determine when something is clean or unclean. These are the regulations for defiling skin diseases and defiling molds.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord also spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.textZh: "你们要告诉以色列人，对他们说：如果男子的下体有异常排泄，他的排泄物是不洁净的，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要告诉以色列人，对他们说：如果男子的下体有异常排泄，他的排泄物是不洁净的，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们晓谕以色列人说：人若身患漏症，他因这漏症就不洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When any man has an unusual bodily discharge, such a discharge is unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, When any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. "Any man who has a bodily discharge is ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and say to them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When any man has an unusual bodily discharge, such a discharge is unclean.

verses.textZh: 这异常排泄就使他不洁净；无论下体仍有排泄流出，或是下体的排泄已经止住了，他都是不洁净的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这异常排泄就使他不洁净；无论下体仍有排泄流出，或是下体的排泄已经止住了，他都是不洁净的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他患漏症，无论是下流的，是止住的，都是不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: Whether it continues flowing from his body or is blocked, it will make him unclean. This is how his discharge will bring about uncleanness:
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the law of his uncleanness for a discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body is blocked up by his discharge, it is his uncleanness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this shall be his uncleanness in regard to his discharge—whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body is stopped up by his discharge, it is his uncleanness.
verses.textEnNlt: This defilement is caused by his discharge, whether the discharge continues or stops. In either case the man is unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: This, moreover, shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: it is his uncleanness whether his body allows its discharge to flow or whether his body obstructs its discharge.
verses.textEn: Whether it continues flowing from his body or is blocked, it will make him unclean. This is how his discharge will bring about uncleanness:

verses.textZh: 有异常排泄的人睡过的床，都是不洁净的；他坐过的家具，都必不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有异常排泄的人睡过的床，都是不洁净的；他坐过的家具，都必不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所躺的床都为不洁净，所坐的物也为不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Any bed the man with a discharge lies on will be unclean, and anything he sits on will be unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: Every bed on which the one with the discharge lies shall be unclean, and everything on which he sits shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every bed is unclean on which he who has the discharge lies, and everything on which he sits shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: Any bed on which the man with the discharge lies and anything on which he sits will be ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: Every bed on which the man with the discharge lies becomes unclean, and everything on which he sits becomes unclean.
verses.textEn: " ‘Any bed the man with a discharge lies on will be unclean, and anything he sits on will be unclean.

verses.textZh: 谁触摸他的床，都要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁触摸他的床，都要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡摸那床的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who touches his bed must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And anyone who touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: So if you touch the man’s bed, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone, moreover, who touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening;
verses.textEn: Anyone who touches his bed must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 谁坐了有异常排泄的人所坐过的家具，要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁坐了有异常排泄的人所坐过的家具，要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 那坐患漏症人所坐之物的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever sits on anything that the man with a discharge sat on must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever sits on anything on which the one with the discharge has sat shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who sits on anything on which he who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: If you sit where the man with the discharge has sat, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: and whoever sits on the thing on which the man with the discharge has been sitting, shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: Whoever sits on anything that the man with a discharge sat on must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 触摸了有异常排泄的人的身体，就要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 触摸了有异常排泄的人的身体，就要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 那摸患漏症人身体的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Whoever touches the man who has a discharge must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever touches the body of the one with the discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: If you touch the man with the discharge, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: Also whoever touches the man with the discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: " ‘Whoever touches the man who has a discharge must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 有异常排泄症的人，若是吐唾沫在洁净的人身上，那人就要洁净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有异常排泄症的人，若是吐唾沫在洁净的人身上，那人就要洁净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 若患漏症人吐在洁净的人身上，那人必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If the man with the discharge spits on anyone who is clean, they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And if the one with the discharge spits on someone who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: If the man spits on you, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: Or if the man with the discharge spits on one who is clean, he too shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: " ‘If the man with the discharge spits on anyone who is clean, they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 有异常排泄的人坐过的鞍，都不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有异常排泄的人坐过的鞍，都不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 患漏症人所骑的鞍子也为不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Everything the man sits on when riding will be unclean,
verses.textEnEsv: And any saddle on which the one with the discharge rides shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: Any saddle on which he who has the discharge rides shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: Any saddle blanket on which the man rides will be ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: Every saddle on which the man with the discharge rides becomes unclean.
verses.textEn: " ‘Everything the man sits on when riding will be unclean,

verses.textZh: 谁触摸他身下任何东西，都不洁净到晚上；拿了这些东西的，要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁触摸他身下任何东西，都不洁净到晚上；拿了这些东西的，要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡摸了他身下之物的，必不洁净到晚上；拿了那物的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.textEnNiv: and whoever touches any of the things that were under him will be unclean till evening; whoever picks up those things must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. And whoever carries such things shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until evening. He who carries any of those things shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: If you touch anything that was under the man, you will be unclean until evening. You must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever then touches any of the things which were under him shall be unclean until evening, and the one who carries them shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: and whoever touches any of the things that were under him will be unclean till evening; whoever picks up those things must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 谁触摸有异常排泄的人，而没有洗手，就要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁触摸有异常排泄的人，而没有洗手，就要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 患漏症的人没有用水涮手，无论摸了谁，谁必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Anyone the man with a discharge touches without rinsing his hands with water must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: Anyone whom the one with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whomever the one who has the discharge touches, and has not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: If the man touches you without first rinsing his hands, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise, whomever the man with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: " ‘Anyone the man with a discharge touches without rinsing his hands with water must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 有异常排泄的人摸过的瓦器，必须打碎；他摸过的任何木器，都要用水洗净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有异常排泄的人摸过的瓦器，必须打碎；他摸过的任何木器，都要用水洗净。
verses.textZhCuv: 患漏症人所摸的瓦器就必打破；所摸的一切木器也必用水涮洗。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘A clay pot that the man touches must be broken, and any wooden article is to be rinsed with water.
verses.textEnEsv: And an earthenware vessel that the one with the discharge touches shall be broken, and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.textEnNkjv: The vessel of earth that he who has the discharge touches shall be broken, and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.textEnNlt: Any clay pot the man touches must be broken, and any wooden utensil he touches must be rinsed with water.
verses.textEnNasb: However, an earthenware vessel which the man with the discharge touches shall be broken, and every wooden vessel shall be rinsed in water.
verses.textEn: " ‘A clay pot that the man touches must be broken, and any wooden article is to be rinsed with water.

verses.textZh: "有异常排泄的人痊愈的时候，就要为自己得洁净计算七天，洗净自己的衣服，用活水洗身，就洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "有异常排泄的人痊愈的时候，就要为自己得洁净计算七天，洗净自己的衣服，用活水洗身，就洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「患漏症的人痊愈了，就要为洁净自己计算七天，也必洗衣服，用活水洗身，就洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When a man is cleansed from his discharge, he is to count off seven days for his ceremonial cleansing; he must wash his clothes and bathe himself with fresh water, and he will be clean.
verses.textEnEsv: "And when the one with a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes. And he shall bathe his body in fresh water and shall be clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And when he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing, wash his clothes, and bathe his body in running water; then he shall be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the man with the discharge is healed, he must count off seven days for the period of purification. Then he must wash his clothes and bathe himself in fresh water, and he will be ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now when the man with the discharge becomes cleansed from his discharge, then he shall count off for himself seven days for his cleansing; he shall then wash his clothes and bathe his body in running water and will become clean.
verses.textEn: " ‘When a man is cleansed from his discharge, he is to count off seven days for his ceremonial cleansing; he must wash his clothes and bathe himself with fresh water, and he will be clean.

verses.textZh: 第八天，他要带两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，来到耶和华面前，在会幕门口交给祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第八天，他要带两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，来到耶和华面前，在会幕门口交给祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 第八天，要取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，来到会幕门口、耶和华面前，把鸟交给祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: On the eighth day he must take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord to the entrance to the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves or two pigeons and come before the Lord to the entrance of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and come before the Lord, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and give them to the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: On the eighth day he must get two turtledoves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord at the entrance of the Tabernacle and give his offerings to the priest.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young doves, and come before the Lord to the doorway of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest;
verses.textEn: On the eighth day he must take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord to the entrance to the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.

verses.textZh: 祭司要把牠们献上，一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭；祭司因那人的异常排泄，要在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要把牠们献上，一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭；祭司因那人的异常排泄，要在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要献上一只为赎罪祭，一只为燔祭；因那人患的漏症，祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to sacrifice them, the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement before the Lord for the man because of his discharge.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall use them, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord for his discharge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall offer them, the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord because of his discharge.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will offer one bird for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. Through this process, the priest will purify the man before the Lord for his discharge.
verses.textEnNasb: and the priest shall offer them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the Lord because of his discharge.
verses.textEn: The priest is to sacrifice them, the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement before the Lord for the man because of his discharge.

verses.textZh: "人若是遗精，就要用水把全身洗净，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人若是遗精，就要用水把全身洗净，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若梦遗，他必不洁净到晚上，并要用水洗全身。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body with water, and he will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man has an emission of semen, he shall bathe his whole body in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall wash all his body in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: "Whenever a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his entire body in water, and he will remain ceremonially unclean until the next evening.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if a man has a seminal emission, he shall bathe all his body in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: " ‘When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 无论是衣服或是皮革，被精液染污，都要用水洗净，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是衣服或是皮革，被精液染污，都要用水洗净，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是衣服是皮子，被精所染，必不洁净到晚上，并要用水洗。
verses.textEnNiv: Any clothing or leather that has semen on it must be washed with water, and it will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And every garment and every skin on which the semen comes shall be washed with water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And any garment and any leather on which there is semen, it shall be washed with water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: Any clothing or leather with semen on it must be washed in water, and it will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: As for any garment or any leather on which there is a seminal emission, it shall be washed with water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: Any clothing or leather that has semen on it must be washed with water, and it will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 至于女人，男人若是与她同睡性交，两人都要用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于女人，男人若是与她同睡性交，两人都要用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 若男女交合，两个人必不洁净到晚上，并要用水洗澡。
verses.textEnNiv: When a man has sexual relations with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both of them must bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man lies with a woman and has an emission of semen, both of them shall bathe themselves in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, when a woman lies with a man, and there is an emission of semen, they shall bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: After a man and a woman have sexual intercourse, they must each bathe in water, and they will remain unclean until the next evening.
verses.textEnNasb: If a man sleeps with a woman so that there is a seminal emission, they shall both bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: When a man has sexual relations with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both of them must bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: "如果女人身上排泄的是经血，她必污秽七天；摸她的，都不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果女人身上排泄的是经血，她必污秽七天；摸她的，都不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「女人行经，必污秽七天；凡摸她的，必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When a woman has her regular flow of blood, the impurity of her monthly period will last seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: "When a woman has a discharge, and the discharge in her body is blood, she shall be in her menstrual impurity for seven days, and whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If a woman has a discharge, and the discharge from her body is blood, she shall be set apart seven days; and whoever touches her shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: "Whenever a woman has her menstrual period, she will be ceremonially unclean for seven days. Anyone who touches her during that time will be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘When a woman has a discharge, if her discharge in her body is blood, she shall continue in her menstrual impurity for seven days; and whoever touches her shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: " ‘When a woman has her regular flow of blood, the impurity of her monthly period will last seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 在她污秽的时期，她躺过的东西，都不洁净；她坐过的东西，也都不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在她污秽的时期，她躺过的东西，都不洁净；她坐过的东西，也都不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 女人在污秽之中，凡她所躺的物件都为不洁净，所坐的物件也都不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Anything she lies on during her period will be unclean, and anything she sits on will be unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: And everything on which she lies during her menstrual impurity shall be unclean. Everything also on which she sits shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: Everything that she lies on during her impurity shall be unclean; also everything that she sits on shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: Anything on which the woman lies or sits during the time of her period will be unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: Everything also on which she lies during her menstrual impurity shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.
verses.textEn: " ‘Anything she lies on during her period will be unclean, and anything she sits on will be unclean.

verses.textZh: 触摸她的床的，都要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 触摸她的床的，都要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡摸她床的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who touches her bed will be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: If any of you touch her bed, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone who touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: Anyone who touches her bed will be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 触摸她坐过的任何家具，都要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 触摸她坐过的任何家具，都要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡摸她所坐什么物件的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who touches anything she sits on will be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever touches anything on which she sits shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever touches anything that she sat on shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: If you touch any object she has sat on, you must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever touches any object on which she sits shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: Anyone who touches anything she sits on will be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 在女人的床上，或是在她坐过的家具上，如果有别的东西，人摸了它，就不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在女人的床上，或是在她坐过的家具上，如果有别的东西，人摸了它，就不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 在女人的床上，或在她坐的物上，若有别的物件，人一摸了，必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textEnNiv: Whether it is the bed or anything she was sitting on, when anyone touches it, they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: Whether it is the bed or anything on which she sits, when he touches it he shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anything is on her bed or on anything on which she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: This includes her bed or any other object she has sat on; you will be unclean until evening if you touch it.
verses.textEnNasb: Whether it be on the bed or on the thing on which she is sitting, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: Whether it is the bed or anything she was sitting on, when anyone touches it, they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 男人若是与那女人同睡，染上她的污秽，就不洁净七天；他躺过的床都不洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 男人若是与那女人同睡，染上她的污秽，就不洁净七天；他躺过的床都不洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 男人若与那女人同房，染了她的污秽，就要七天不洁净；所躺的床也为不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with her and her monthly flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days; any bed he lies on will be unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: And if any man lies with her and her menstrual impurity comes upon him, he shall be unclean seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if any man lies with her at all, so that her impurity is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: If a man has sexual intercourse with her and her blood touches him, her menstrual impurity will be transmitted to him. He will remain unclean for seven days, and any bed on which he lies will be unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: If a man actually sleeps with her so that her menstrual impurity is on him, he shall be unclean seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with her and her monthly flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days; any bed he lies on will be unclean.

verses.textZh: "女人若是在月经污秽期以外，血漏多日；或是月经污秽期过长，患有血漏症；她在这些血漏的日子是不洁净的，好象她在月经污秽的日子不洁净一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "女人若是在月经污秽期以外，血漏多日；或是月经污秽期过长，患有血漏症；她在这些血漏的日子是不洁净的，好象她在月经污秽的日子不洁净一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 「女人若在经期以外患多日的血漏，或是经期过长，有了漏症，她就因这漏症不洁净，与她在经期不洁净一样。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When a woman has a discharge of blood for many days at a time other than her monthly period or has a discharge that continues beyond her period, she will be unclean as long as she has the discharge, just as in the days of her period.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, not at the time of her menstrual impurity, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her impurity, all the days of the discharge she shall continue in uncleanness. As in the days of her impurity, she shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, other than at the time of her customary impurity, or if it runs beyond her usual time of impurity, all the days of her unclean discharge shall be as the days of her customary impurity. She shall be unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a woman has a flow of blood for many days that is unrelated to her menstrual period, or if the blood continues beyond the normal period, she is ceremonially unclean. As during her menstrual period, the woman will be unclean as long as the discharge continues.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if a woman has a discharge of her blood for many days, not at the period of her menstrual impurity, or if she has a discharge beyond that period, for all the days of her impure discharge she shall continue as though in her menstrual impurity; she is unclean.
verses.textEn: " ‘When a woman has a discharge of blood for many days at a time other than her monthly period or has a discharge that continues beyond her period, she will be unclean as long as she has the discharge, just as in the days of her period.

verses.textZh: 她在血漏症的日子躺过的床，都像她在月经污秽时的床一样；她所坐过的家具，都不洁净，像月经污秽的时候一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她在血漏症的日子躺过的床，都像她在月经污秽时的床一样；她所坐过的家具，都不洁净，像月经污秽的时候一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 她在患漏症的日子所躺的床、所坐的物都要看为不洁净，与她月经的时候一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Any bed she lies on while her discharge continues will be unclean, as is her bed during her monthly period, and anything she sits on will be unclean, as during her period.
verses.textEnEsv: Every bed on which she lies, all the days of her discharge, shall be to her as the bed of her impurity. And everything on which she sits shall be unclean, as in the uncleanness of her menstrual impurity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every bed on which she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her impurity; and whatever she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.
verses.textEnNlt: Any bed she lies on and any object she sits on during that time will be unclean, just as during her normal menstrual period.
verses.textEnNasb: Any bed on which she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her like her bed at menstruation; and every object on which she sits shall be unclean, like her uncleanness at that time.
verses.textEn: Any bed she lies on while her discharge continues will be unclean, as is her bed during her monthly period, and anything she sits on will be unclean, as during her period.

verses.textZh: 触摸这些东西的，都不洁净；要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 触摸这些东西的，都不洁净；要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡摸这些物件的，就为不洁净，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who touches them will be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever touches those things shall be unclean; he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: If any of you touch these things, you will be ceremonially unclean. You must wash your clothes and bathe yourself in water, and you will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise, whoever touches them shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: Anyone who touches them will be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 女人的血漏若是洁净了，她要计算七天，然后就洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 女人的血漏若是洁净了，她要计算七天，然后就洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 女人的漏症若好了，就要计算七天，然后才为洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When she is cleansed from her discharge, she must count off seven days, and after that she will be ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnEsv: But if she is cleansed of her discharge, she shall count for herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count for herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the woman’s bleeding stops, she must count off seven days. Then she will be ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: When she becomes clean from her discharge, she shall count off for herself seven days; and afterward she will be clean.
verses.textEn: " ‘When she is cleansed from her discharge, she must count off seven days, and after that she will be ceremonially clean.

verses.textZh: 第八天，她要拿两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽，带到会幕门口，交给祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第八天，她要拿两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽，带到会幕门口，交给祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 第八天，要取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，带到会幕门口给祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: On the eighth day she must take two doves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or two pigeons and bring them to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: On the eighth day she must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons and present them to the priest at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young doves, and bring them to the priest, to the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: On the eighth day she must take two doves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 祭司要献一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭；祭司要在耶和华面前，因那妇人血漏的不洁，为她赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要献一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭；祭司要在耶和华面前，因那妇人血漏的不洁，为她赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要献一只为赎罪祭，一只为燔祭；因那人血漏不洁，祭司要在耶和华面前为她赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to sacrifice one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement for her before the Lord for the uncleanness of her discharge.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall use one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for her before the Lord for her unclean discharge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall offer the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for her before the Lord for the discharge of her uncleanness.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will offer one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. Through this process, the priest will purify her before the Lord for the ceremonial impurity caused by her bleeding.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest shall offer the one as a sin offering, and the other as a burnt offering. So the priest shall make atonement on her behalf before the Lord because of her impure discharge.’
verses.textEn: The priest is to sacrifice one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement for her before the Lord for the uncleanness of her discharge.

verses.textZh: "你们要这样叫以色列人远离他们的不洁，免得他们玷污我在他们中间的会幕，他们就因自己的不洁而死亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要这样叫以色列人远离他们的不洁，免得他们玷污我在他们中间的会幕，他们就因自己的不洁而死亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要这样使以色列人与他们的污秽隔绝，免得他们玷污我的帐幕，就因自己的污秽死亡。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘You must keep the Israelites separate from things that make them unclean, so they will not die in their uncleanness for defiling my dwelling place, which is among them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus you shall keep the people of Israel separate from their uncleanness, lest they die in their uncleanness by defiling my tabernacle that is in their midst."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, lest they die in their uncleanness when they defile My tabernacle that is among them.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is how you will guard the people of Israel from ceremonial uncleanness. Otherwise they would die, for their impurity would defile my Tabernacle that stands among them.
verses.textEnNasb: "And so you shall keep the sons of Israel separated from their uncleanness, so that they will not die in their uncleanness by their defiling My tabernacle that is among them."
verses.textEn: " ‘You must keep the Israelites separate from things that make them unclean, so they will not die in their uncleanness for defiling my dwelling place, which is among them.’ "

verses.textZh: 以上是关于因为异常排泄和遗精，成为不洁净，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上是关于因为异常排泄和遗精，成为不洁净，
verses.textZhCuv: 这是患漏症和梦遗而不洁净的，
verses.textEnNiv: These are the regulations for a man with a discharge, for anyone made unclean by an emission of semen,
verses.textEnEsv: This is the law for him who has a discharge and for him who has an emission of semen, becoming unclean thereby;
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the law for one who has a discharge, and for him who emits semen and is unclean thereby,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the instructions for dealing with anyone who has a bodily discharge—a man who is unclean because of an emission of semen
verses.textEnNasb: This is the law for the one with a discharge, and for the man who has a seminal emission so that he is unclean by it,
verses.textEn: These are the regulations for a man with a discharge, for anyone made unclean by an emission of semen,

verses.textZh: 以及患病污秽的妇女和患血漏的男女，还有男人与不洁净的女人同睡的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及患病污秽的妇女和患血漏的男女，还有男人与不洁净的女人同睡的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 并有月经病的和患漏症的，无论男女，并人与不洁净女人同房的条例。
verses.textEnNiv: for a woman in her monthly period, for a man or a woman with a discharge, and for a man who has sexual relations with a woman who is ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: also for her who is unwell with her menstrual impurity, that is, for anyone, male or female, who has a discharge, and for the man who lies with a woman who is unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: and for her who is indisposed because of her customary impurity, and for one who has a discharge, either man or woman, and for him who lies with her who is unclean.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: or a woman during her menstrual period. It applies to any man or woman who has a bodily discharge, and to a man who has sexual intercourse with a woman who is ceremonially unclean."
verses.textEnNasb: and for the woman who is ill because of menstrual impurity, and for the one who has a discharge, whether a male or a female, or a man who sleeps with an unclean woman.
verses.textEn: for a woman in her monthly period, for a man or a woman with a discharge, and for a man who has sexual relations with a woman who is ceremonially unclean.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的两个儿子走近耶和华面前而死亡以后，耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的两个儿子走近耶和华面前而死亡以后，耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦的两个儿子近到耶和华面前死了。死了之后，耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron who died when they approached the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before the Lord and died,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered profane fire before the Lord, and died;
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron’s two sons, who died after they entered the Lord ’s presence and burned the wrong kind of fire before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they had approached the presence of the Lord and died.
verses.textEn: The Lord spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron who died when they approached the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你要告诉你的哥哥亚伦，不可随时进入圣所的幔子里面，到约柜上的施恩座，免得他死亡，因为我在施恩座上的彩云中显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉你的哥哥亚伦，不可随时进入圣所的幔子里面，到约柜上的施恩座，免得他死亡，因为我在施恩座上的彩云中显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 「要告诉你哥哥亚伦，不可随时进圣所的幔子内、到柜上的施恩座前，免得他死亡，因为我要从云中显现在施恩座上。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses: "Tell your brother Aaron that he is not to come whenever he chooses into the Most Holy Place behind the curtain in front of the atonement cover on the ark, or else he will die. For I will appear in the cloud over the atonement cover.
verses.textEnEsv: and the Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron your brother not to come at any time into the Holy Place inside the veil, before the mercy seat that is on the ark, so that he may not die. For I will appear in the cloud over the mercy seat.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the Lord said to Moses: "Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Holy Place inside the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark, lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud above the mercy seat.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses, "Warn your brother, Aaron, not to enter the Most Holy Place behind the inner curtain whenever he chooses; if he does, he will die. For the Ark’s cover—the place of atonement—is there, and I myself am present in the cloud above the atonement cover.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said to Moses: "Tell your brother Aaron that he shall not enter at any time into the Holy Place inside the veil, before the atoning cover which is on the ark, or he will die; for I will appear in the cloud over the atoning cover.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses: "Tell your brother Aaron that he is not to come whenever he chooses into the Most Holy Place behind the curtain in front of the atonement cover on the ark, or else he will die. For I will appear in the cloud over the atonement cover.

verses.textZh: 亚伦进入圣所时要带一头公牛犊作赎罪祭，一只公绵羊作燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦进入圣所时要带一头公牛犊作赎罪祭，一只公绵羊作燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦进圣所，要带一只公牛犊为赎罪祭，一只公绵羊为燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is how Aaron is to enter the Most Holy Place: He must first bring a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: But in this way Aaron shall come into the Holy Place: with a bull from the herd for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus Aaron shall come into the Holy Place: with the blood of a young bull as a sin offering, and of a ram as a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: "When Aaron enters the sanctuary area, he must follow these instructions fully. He must bring a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: Aaron shall enter the Holy Place with this: with a bull as a sin offering and a ram as a burnt offering.
verses.textEn: "This is how Aaron is to enter the Most Holy Place: He must first bring a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 他要穿上细麻布的圣内袍，也要把细麻布的裤子穿在身上，腰束细麻布的带子，头戴细麻布礼冠；这些就是圣衣。他要先用水洗身，然后才穿上圣衣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要穿上细麻布的圣内袍，也要把细麻布的裤子穿在身上，腰束细麻布的带子，头戴细麻布礼冠；这些就是圣衣。他要先用水洗身，然后才穿上圣衣。
verses.textZhCuv: 要穿上细麻布圣内袍，把细麻布裤子穿在身上，腰束细麻布带子，头戴细麻布冠冕；这都是圣服。他要用水洗身，然后穿戴。
verses.textEnNiv: He is to put on the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments next to his body; he is to tie the linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are sacred garments; so he must bathe himself with water before he puts them on.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall put on the holy linen coat and shall have the linen undergarment on his body, and he shall tie the linen sash around his waist, and wear the linen turban; these are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water and then put them on.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall put the holy linen tunic and the linen trousers on his body; he shall be girded with a linen sash, and with the linen turban he shall be attired. These are holy garments. Therefore he shall wash his body in water, and put them on.
verses.textEnNlt: He must put on his linen tunic and the linen undergarments worn next to his body. He must tie the linen sash around his waist and put the linen turban on his head. These are sacred garments, so he must bathe himself in water before he puts them on.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall put on the holy linen tunic, and the linen undergarments shall be next to his body, and he shall be wrapped about the waist with the linen sash and the linen turban wound around his forehead (these are holy garments). He shall bathe his body in water and put them on.
verses.textEn: He is to put on the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments next to his body; he is to tie the linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are sacred garments; so he must bathe himself with water before he puts them on.

verses.textZh: 他要从以色列的会众中，取两只公山羊作赎罪祭，一只公绵羊作燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要从以色列的会众中，取两只公山羊作赎罪祭，一只公绵羊作燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 要从以色列会众取两只公山羊为赎罪祭，一只公绵羊为燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: From the Israelite community he is to take two male goats for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall take from the congregation of the people of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats as a sin offering, and one ram as a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron must take from the community of Israel two male goats for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall take from the congregation of the sons of Israel two male goats as a sin offering, and one ram as a burnt offering.
verses.textEn: From the Israelite community he is to take two male goats for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 亚伦为自己的罪献上作赎罪祭的公牛，为自己和家人赎罪，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦为自己的罪献上作赎罪祭的公牛，为自己和家人赎罪，
verses.textZhCuv: 「亚伦要把赎罪祭的公牛奉上，为自己和本家赎罪；
verses.textEnNiv: "Aaron is to offer the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household.
verses.textEnEsv: "Aaron shall offer the bull as a sin offering for himself and shall make atonement for himself and for his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Aaron shall offer the bull as a sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
verses.textEnNlt: "Aaron will present his own bull as a sin offering to purify himself and his family, making them right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then Aaron shall offer the bull as the sin offering, which is for himself, so that he may make atonement for himself and for his household.
verses.textEn: "Aaron is to offer the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household.

verses.textZh: 然后把两只公山羊牵来，放在会幕门口，耶和华的面前；
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后把两只公山羊牵来，放在会幕门口，耶和华的面前；
verses.textZhCuv: 也要把两只公山羊安置在会幕门口、耶和华面前，
verses.textEnNiv: Then he is to take the two goats and present them before the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he shall take the two goats and set them before the Lord at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall take the two goats and present them before the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he must take the two male goats and present them to the Lord at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall then take the two goats and present them before the Lord at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: Then he is to take the two goats and present them before the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 亚伦要为这两只山羊抽签：一签归耶和华，另一签归阿撒泻勒 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦要为这两只山羊抽签：一签归耶和华，另一签归阿撒泻勒 。
verses.textZhCuv: 为那两只羊拈阄，一阄归与耶和华，一阄归与阿撒泻勒。
verses.textEnNiv: He is to cast lots for the two goats—one lot for the Lord and the other for the scapegoat.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron shall cast lots over the two goats, one lot for the Lord and the other lot for Azazel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the Lord and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.textEnNlt: He is to cast sacred lots to determine which goat will be reserved as an offering to the Lord and which will carry the sins of the people to the wilderness of Azazel.
verses.textEnNasb: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats, one lot for the Lord and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.textEn: He is to cast lots for the two goats—one lot for the Lord and the other for the scapegoat.

verses.textZh: 亚伦要把那抽签归耶和华的山羊，献作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦要把那抽签归耶和华的山羊，献作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦要把那拈阄归与耶和华的羊献为赎罪祭，
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron shall bring the goat whose lot falls to the Lord and sacrifice it for a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the Lord and use it as a sin offering,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Aaron shall bring the goat on which the Lord’s lot fell, and offer it as a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron will then present as a sin offering the goat chosen by lot for the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then Aaron shall offer the goat on which the lot for the Lord fell, and make it a sin offering.
verses.textEn: Aaron shall bring the goat whose lot falls to the Lord and sacrifice it for a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 至于那抽签归阿撒泻勒的山羊，却要活活地摆在耶和华面前，用来赎罪，然后叫人把牠送到旷野，归阿撒泻勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那抽签归阿撒泻勒的山羊，却要活活地摆在耶和华面前，用来赎罪，然后叫人把牠送到旷野，归阿撒泻勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那拈阄归与阿撒泻勒的羊要活着安置在耶和华面前，用以赎罪，打发人送到旷野去，归与阿撒泻勒。
verses.textEnNiv: But the goat chosen by lot as the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the Lord to be used for making atonement by sending it into the wilderness as a scapegoat.
verses.textEnEsv: but the goat on which the lot fell for Azazel shall be presented alive before the Lord to make atonement over it, that it may be sent away into the wilderness to Azazel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the goat on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the Lord, to make atonement upon it, and to let it go as the scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: The other goat, the scapegoat chosen by lot to be sent away, will be kept alive, standing before the Lord . When it is sent away to Azazel in the wilderness, the people will be purified and made right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: But the goat on which the lot for the scapegoat fell shall be presented alive before the Lord, to make atonement upon it, to send it into the wilderness as the scapegoat.
verses.textEn: But the goat chosen by lot as the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the Lord to be used for making atonement by sending it into the wilderness as a scapegoat.

verses.textZh: "亚伦要先为自己献上作赎罪祭的公牛，为自己和家人赎罪，他要把那为自己作赎罪祭的公牛宰杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: "亚伦要先为自己献上作赎罪祭的公牛，为自己和家人赎罪，他要把那为自己作赎罪祭的公牛宰杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 「亚伦要把赎罪祭的公牛牵来宰了，为自己和本家赎罪；
verses.textEnNiv: "Aaron shall bring the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household, and he is to slaughter the bull for his own sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: "Aaron shall present the bull as a sin offering for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house. He shall kill the bull as a sin offering for himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And Aaron shall bring the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull as the sin offering which is for himself.
verses.textEnNlt: "Aaron will present his own bull as a sin offering to purify himself and his family, making them right with the Lord . After he has slaughtered the bull as a sin offering,
verses.textEnNasb: "Then Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering which is for himself and make atonement for himself and for his household, and he shall slaughter the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.
verses.textEn: "Aaron shall bring the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household, and he is to slaughter the bull for his own sin offering.

verses.textZh: 从耶和华面前的祭坛上，拿一个盛满火炭的香炉，又拿一捧捣细的芬芳香料，带进幔子里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 从耶和华面前的祭坛上，拿一个盛满火炭的香炉，又拿一捧捣细的芬芳香料，带进幔子里，
verses.textZhCuv: 拿香炉，从耶和华面前的坛上盛满火炭，又拿一捧捣细的香料，都带入幔子内，
verses.textEnNiv: He is to take a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the Lord and two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense and take them behind the curtain.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from the altar before the Lord , and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and he shall bring it inside the veil
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from the altar before the Lord, with his hands full of sweet incense beaten fine, and bring it inside the veil.
verses.textEnNlt: he will fill an incense burner with burning coals from the altar that stands before the Lord . Then he will take two handfuls of fragrant powdered incense and will carry the burner and the incense behind the inner curtain.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall take a firepan full of coals of fire from upon the altar before the Lord and two handfuls of finely ground sweet incense, and bring it inside the veil.
verses.textEn: He is to take a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the Lord and two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense and take them behind the curtain.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华面前把香放在火上，使香的烟云遮掩约柜上的施恩座，免得他死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华面前把香放在火上，使香的烟云遮掩约柜上的施恩座，免得他死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶和华面前，把香放在火上，使香的烟云遮掩法柜上的施恩座，免得他死亡；
verses.textEnNiv: He is to put the incense on the fire before the Lord , and the smoke of the incense will conceal the atonement cover above the tablets of the covenant law, so that he will not die.
verses.textEnEsv: and put the incense on the fire before the Lord , that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is over the testimony, so that he does not die.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall put the incense on the fire before the Lord, that the cloud of incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the Testimony, lest he die.
verses.textEnNlt: There in the Lord ’s presence he will put the incense on the burning coals so that a cloud of incense will rise over the Ark’s cover—the place of atonement—that rests on the Ark of the Covenant. If he follows these instructions, he will not die.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall put the incense on the fire before the Lord, so that the cloud of incense may cover the atoning cover that is on the ark of the testimony, otherwise he will die.
verses.textEn: He is to put the incense on the fire before the Lord , and the smoke of the incense will conceal the atonement cover above the tablets of the covenant law, so that he will not die.

verses.textZh: 他要取些公牛的血，用指头弹在施恩座的东面，再用指头在施恩座的前面，弹血七次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要取些公牛的血，用指头弹在施恩座的东面，再用指头在施恩座的前面，弹血七次。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要取些公牛的血，用指头弹在施恩座的东面，又在施恩座的前面弹血七次。
verses.textEnNiv: He is to take some of the bull’s blood and with his finger sprinkle it on the front of the atonement cover; then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the atonement cover.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall take some of the blood of the bull and sprinkle it with his finger on the front of the mercy seat on the east side, and in front of the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall take some of the blood of the bull and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east side; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he must take some of the blood of the bull, dip his finger in it, and sprinkle it on the east side of the atonement cover. He must sprinkle blood seven times with his finger in front of the atonement cover.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, he shall take some of the blood of the bull and sprinkle it with his finger on the atoning cover on the east side; also in front of the atoning cover he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.textEn: He is to take some of the bull’s blood and with his finger sprinkle it on the front of the atonement cover; then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the atonement cover.

verses.textZh: "然后他要宰杀那为人民作赎罪祭的公山羊，把血带进幔子里，弹羊血在施恩座的上面和施恩座的前面，好象弹公牛的血一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "然后他要宰杀那为人民作赎罪祭的公山羊，把血带进幔子里，弹羊血在施恩座的上面和施恩座的前面，好象弹公牛的血一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 「随后他要宰那为百姓作赎罪祭的公山羊，把羊的血带入幔子内，弹在施恩座的上面和前面，好像弹公牛的血一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "He shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and take its blood behind the curtain and do with it as he did with the bull’s blood: He shall sprinkle it on the atonement cover and in front of it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people and bring its blood inside the veil and do with its blood as he did with the blood of the bull, sprinkling it over the mercy seat and in front of the mercy seat.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering, which is for the people, bring its blood inside the veil, do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then Aaron must slaughter the first goat as a sin offering for the people and carry its blood behind the inner curtain. There he will sprinkle the goat’s blood over the atonement cover and in front of it, just as he did with the bull’s blood.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering, which is for the people, and bring its blood inside the veil and do with its blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the atoning cover and in front of the atoning cover.
verses.textEn: "He shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and take its blood behind the curtain and do with it as he did with the bull’s blood: He shall sprinkle it on the atonement cover and in front of it.

verses.textZh: 他要为圣所赎罪，使圣所脱离以色列人的不洁和他们的过犯，就是他们的一切罪孽。然后他又要为会幕同样的赎罪。因为会幕和他们在一起，在他们的不洁中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要为圣所赎罪，使圣所脱离以色列人的不洁和他们的过犯，就是他们的一切罪孽。然后他又要为会幕同样的赎罪。因为会幕和他们在一起，在他们的不洁中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 他因以色列人诸般的污秽、过犯，就是他们一切的罪愆，当这样在圣所行赎罪之礼，并因会幕在他们污秽之中，也要照样而行。
verses.textEnNiv: In this way he will make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the uncleanness and rebellion of the Israelites, whatever their sins have been. He is to do the same for the tent of meeting, which is among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus he shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleannesses of the people of Israel and because of their transgressions, all their sins. And so he shall do for the tent of meeting, which dwells with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, for all their sins; and so he shall do for the tabernacle of meeting which remains among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.textEnNlt: Through this process, he will purify the Most Holy Place, and he will do the same for the entire Tabernacle, because of the defiling sin and rebellion of the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the impurities of the sons of Israel and because of their unlawful acts regarding all their sins; and he shall do so for the tent of meeting which remains with them in the midst of their impurities.
verses.textEn: In this way he will make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the uncleanness and rebellion of the Israelites, whatever their sins have been. He is to do the same for the tent of meeting, which is among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

verses.textZh: 他进入至圣所赎罪的时候，会幕里不可有人；直到他为自己和家人，以及以色列全体会众，赎了罪出来为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他进入至圣所赎罪的时候，会幕里不可有人；直到他为自己和家人，以及以色列全体会众，赎了罪出来为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 他进圣所赎罪的时候，会幕里不可有人，直等到他为自己和本家并以色列全会众赎了罪出来。
verses.textEnNiv: No one is to be in the tent of meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make atonement in the Most Holy Place until he comes out, having made atonement for himself, his household and the whole community of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: No one may be in the tent of meeting from the time he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place until he comes out and has made atonement for himself and for his house and for all the assembly of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: There shall be no man in the tabernacle of meeting when he goes in to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, that he may make atonement for himself, for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: No one else is allowed inside the Tabernacle when Aaron enters it for the purification ceremony in the Most Holy Place. No one may enter until he comes out again after purifying himself, his family, and all the congregation of Israel, making them right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: When he goes in to make atonement in the Holy Place, no one shall be in the tent of meeting until he comes out, so that he may make atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
verses.textEn: No one is to be in the tent of meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make atonement in the Most Holy Place until he comes out, having made atonement for himself, his household and the whole community of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他出来，就到耶和华面前的祭坛那里，为坛赎罪。他要取一点公牛的血和山羊的血，抹祭坛的四角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他出来，就到耶和华面前的祭坛那里，为坛赎罪。他要取一点公牛的血和山羊的血，抹祭坛的四角。
verses.textZhCuv: 他出来，要到耶和华面前的坛那里，在坛上行赎罪之礼，又要取些公牛的血和公山羊的血，抹在坛上四角的周围；
verses.textEnNiv: "Then he shall come out to the altar that is before the Lord and make atonement for it. He shall take some of the bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before the Lord and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the blood of the bull and some of the blood of the goat, and put it on the horns of the altar all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall go out to the altar that is before the Lord, and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the blood of the bull and some of the blood of the goat, and put it on the horns of the altar all around.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then Aaron will come out to purify the altar that stands before the Lord . He will do this by taking some of the blood from the bull and the goat and putting it on each of the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before the Lord and make atonement for it; he shall take some of the blood from the bull and some of the blood from the goat, and put it on the horns of the altar on all sides.
verses.textEn: "Then he shall come out to the altar that is before the Lord and make atonement for it. He shall take some of the bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.

verses.textZh: 又用指头向祭坛弹血七次，洁净祭坛，使它分别为圣，脱离以色列人的不洁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用指头向祭坛弹血七次，洁净祭坛，使它分别为圣，脱离以色列人的不洁。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要用指头把血弹在坛上七次，洁净了坛，从坛上除掉以色列人诸般的污秽，使坛成圣。」
verses.textEnNiv: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and to consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleannesses of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, cleanse it, and consecrate it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he must sprinkle the blood with his finger seven times over the altar. In this way, he will cleanse it from Israel’s defilement and make it holy.
verses.textEnNasb: With his finger he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it seven times and cleanse it, and consecrate it from the impurities of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and to consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

verses.textZh: "亚伦为圣所、会幕和祭坛赎了罪以后，就要把那只活山羊献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "亚伦为圣所、会幕和祭坛赎了罪以后，就要把那只活山羊献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「亚伦为圣所和会幕并坛献完了赎罪祭，就要把那只活着的公山羊奉上。
verses.textEnNiv: "When Aaron has finished making atonement for the Most Holy Place, the tent of meeting and the altar, he shall bring forward the live goat.
verses.textEnEsv: "And when he has made an end of atoning for the Holy Place and the tent of meeting and the altar, he shall present the live goat.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And when he has made an end of atoning for the Holy Place, the tabernacle of meeting, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat.
verses.textEnNlt: "When Aaron has finished purifying the Most Holy Place and the Tabernacle and the altar, he must present the live goat.
verses.textEnNasb: "When he finishes atoning for the Holy Place and the tent of meeting and the altar, he shall offer the live goat.
verses.textEn: "When Aaron has finished making atonement for the Most Holy Place, the tent of meeting and the altar, he shall bring forward the live goat.

verses.textZh: 亚伦两手按在那只活山羊头上，承认以色列人的一切罪孽和他们的过犯，就是他们一切罪孽。把它们都归在那山羊的头上；然后经由已预定的人，把羊送到旷野里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦两手按在那只活山羊头上，承认以色列人的一切罪孽和他们的过犯，就是他们一切罪孽。把它们都归在那山羊的头上；然后经由已预定的人，把羊送到旷野里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 两手按在羊头上，承认以色列人诸般的罪孽过犯，就是他们一切的罪愆，把这罪都归在羊的头上，藉着所派之人的手，送到旷野去。
verses.textEnNiv: He is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the wickedness and rebellion of the Israelites—all their sins—and put them on the goat’s head. He shall send the goat away into the wilderness in the care of someone appointed for the task.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over it all the iniquities of the people of Israel, and all their transgressions, all their sins. And he shall put them on the head of the goat and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is in readiness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, confess over it all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, concerning all their sins, putting them on the head of the goat, and shall send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a suitable man.
verses.textEnNlt: He will lay both of his hands on the goat’s head and confess over it all the wickedness, rebellion, and sins of the people of Israel. In this way, he will transfer the people’s sins to the head of the goat. Then a man specially chosen for the task will drive the goat into the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Aaron shall lay both of his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over it all the wrongdoings of the sons of Israel and all their unlawful acts regarding all their sins; and he shall place them on the head of the goat and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who stands ready.
verses.textEn: He is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the wickedness and rebellion of the Israelites—all their sins—and put them on the goat’s head. He shall send the goat away into the wilderness in the care of someone appointed for the task.

verses.textZh: 那只山羊就担当他们的一切罪孽，把它们带到一个完全隔离的地；所以那人要把那只山羊送到旷野里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那只山羊就担当他们的一切罪孽，把它们带到一个完全隔离的地；所以那人要把那只山羊送到旷野里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把这羊放在旷野，这羊要担当他们一切的罪孽，带到无人之地。
verses.textEnNiv: The goat will carry on itself all their sins to a remote place; and the man shall release it in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: The goat shall bear all their iniquities on itself to a remote area, and he shall let the goat go free in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: The goat shall bear on itself all their iniquities to an uninhabited land; and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: As the goat goes into the wilderness, it will carry all the people’s sins upon itself into a desolate land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the goat shall carry on itself all their wrongdoings to an isolated territory; he shall release the goat in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: The goat will carry on itself all their sins to a remote place; and the man shall release it in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: "亚伦要进会幕，把他进圣所时所穿的细麻布衣服脱下，放在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "亚伦要进会幕，把他进圣所时所穿的细麻布衣服脱下，放在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「亚伦要进会幕，把他进圣所时所穿的细麻布衣服脱下，放在那里，
verses.textEnNiv: "Then Aaron is to go into the tent of meeting and take off the linen garments he put on before he entered the Most Holy Place, and he is to leave them there.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting and shall take off the linen garments that he put on when he went into the Holy Place and shall leave them there.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of meeting, shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.
verses.textEnNlt: "When Aaron goes back into the Tabernacle, he must take off the linen garments he was wearing when he entered the Most Holy Place, and he must leave the garments there.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting and take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.
verses.textEn: "Then Aaron is to go into the tent of meeting and take off the linen garments he put on before he entered the Most Holy Place, and he is to leave them there.

verses.textZh: 然后在圣洁的地方用水洗身，穿回自己的衣服出来，把自己的燔祭和众民的燔祭献上，为自己和众民赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后在圣洁的地方用水洗身，穿回自己的衣服出来，把自己的燔祭和众民的燔祭献上，为自己和众民赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要在圣处用水洗身，穿上衣服，出来，把自己的燔祭和百姓的燔祭献上，为自己和百姓赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: He shall bathe himself with water in the sanctuary area and put on his regular garments. Then he shall come out and sacrifice the burnt offering for himself and the burnt offering for the people, to make atonement for himself and for the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall bathe his body in water in a holy place and put on his garments and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people and make atonement for himself and for the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall wash his body with water in a holy place, put on his garments, come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he must bathe himself with water in a sacred place, put on his regular garments, and go out to sacrifice a burnt offering for himself and a burnt offering for the people. Through this process, he will purify himself and the people, making them right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall bathe his body with water in a holy place and put on his clothes, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
verses.textEn: He shall bathe himself with water in the sanctuary area and put on his regular garments. Then he shall come out and sacrifice the burnt offering for himself and the burnt offering for the people, to make atonement for himself and for the people.

verses.textZh: 赎罪祭牲的脂肪，他要焚烧在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 赎罪祭牲的脂肪，他要焚烧在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 赎罪祭牲的脂油要在坛上焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: He shall also burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And the fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: He must then burn all the fat of the sin offering on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall offer up in smoke the fat of the sin offering on the altar.
verses.textEn: He shall also burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.

verses.textZh: 那送走归阿撒泻勒的山羊的人，要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗身，然后才可以进到营里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那送走归阿撒泻勒的山羊的人，要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗身，然后才可以进到营里。
verses.textZhCuv: 那放羊归与阿撒泻勒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。
verses.textEnNiv: "The man who releases the goat as a scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.
