verses.textEnEsv: And he who lets the goat go to Azazel shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who released the goat as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: "The man chosen to drive the scapegoat into the wilderness of Azazel must wash his clothes and bathe himself in water. Then he may return to the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who released the goat as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes and bathe his body with water; then afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.textEn: "The man who releases the goat as a scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.

verses.textZh: 那作赎罪祭的公牛和作赎罪祭的公山羊，牠们的血既然被带进去为圣所赎罪，牠们的身体就要搬出营外去；牠们的皮、肉和粪都要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那作赎罪祭的公牛和作赎罪祭的公山羊，牠们的血既然被带进去为圣所赎罪，牠们的身体就要搬出营外去；牠们的皮、肉和粪都要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 作赎罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既带入圣所赎罪，这牛羊就要搬到营外，将皮、肉、粪用火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: The bull and the goat for the sin offerings, whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to make atonement, must be taken outside the camp; their hides, flesh and intestines are to be burned up.
verses.textEnEsv: And the bull for the sin offering and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp. Their skin and their flesh and their dung shall be burned up with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: The bull for the sin offering and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp. And they shall burn in the fire their skins, their flesh, and their offal.
verses.textEnNlt: "The bull and the goat presented as sin offerings, whose blood Aaron takes into the Most Holy Place for the purification ceremony, will be carried outside the camp. The animals’ hides, internal organs, and dung are all to be burned.
verses.textEnNasb: But the bull of the sin offering and the goat of the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be taken outside the camp, and they shall burn their hides, their flesh, and their refuse in the fire.
verses.textEn: The bull and the goat for the sin offerings, whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to make atonement, must be taken outside the camp; their hides, flesh and intestines are to be burned up.

verses.textZh: 那烧祭牲的人要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗身，然后才可以进营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那烧祭牲的人要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗身，然后才可以进营。
verses.textZhCuv: 焚烧的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。」
verses.textEnNiv: The man who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: And he who burns them shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he who burns them shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: The man who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself in water before returning to the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the one who burns them shall wash his clothes and bathe his body with water; and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.textEn: The man who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.

verses.textZh: "每逢七月十日，你们要刻苦己心，无论是本地人，或是寄居在你们中间的外人，甚么的工，你们都不可作，这要作你们永远的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: "每逢七月十日，你们要刻苦己心，无论是本地人，或是寄居在你们中间的外人，甚么的工，你们都不可作，这要作你们永远的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 「每逢七月初十日，你们要刻苦己心，无论是本地人，是寄居在你们中间的外人，什么工都不可做；这要作你们永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month you must deny yourselves and not do any work—whether native-born or a foreigner residing among you—
verses.textEnEsv: "And it shall be a statute to you forever that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict yourselves and shall do no work, either the native or the stranger who sojourns among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This shall be a statute forever for you: In the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether a native of your own country or a stranger who dwells among you.
verses.textEnNlt: "On the tenth day of the appointed month in early autumn, you must deny yourselves. Neither native-born Israelites nor foreigners living among you may do any kind of work. This is a permanent law for you.
verses.textEnNasb: "This shall be a permanent statute for you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall humble yourselves and not do any work, whether the native, or the stranger who resides among you;
verses.textEn: "This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month you must deny yourselves and not do any work—whether native-born or a foreigner residing among you—

verses.textZh: 因为在这一天，他要为你们赎罪，使你们洁净，脱离你们一切罪孽，使你们在耶和华面前成为洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在这一天，他要为你们赎罪，使你们洁净，脱离你们一切罪孽，使你们在耶和华面前成为洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 因在这日要为你们赎罪，使你们洁净。你们要在耶和华面前得以洁净，脱尽一切的罪愆。
verses.textEnNiv: because on this day atonement will be made for you, to cleanse you. Then, before the Lord , you will be clean from all your sins.
verses.textEnEsv: For on this day shall atonement be made for you to cleanse you. You shall be clean before the Lord from all your sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: For on that day the priest shall make atonement for you, to cleanse you, that you may be clean from all your sins before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day offerings of purification will be made for you, and you will be purified in the Lord ’s presence from all your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: for it is on this day that atonement shall be made for you to cleanse you; you will be clean from all your sins before the Lord.
verses.textEn: because on this day atonement will be made for you, to cleanse you. Then, before the Lord , you will be clean from all your sins.

verses.textZh: 这是完全休歇的安息，你们要刻苦己心。这是永远的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是完全休歇的安息，你们要刻苦己心。这是永远的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 这日你们要守为圣安息日，要刻苦己心；这为永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: It is a day of sabbath rest, and you must deny yourselves; it is a lasting ordinance.
verses.textEnEsv: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict yourselves; it is a statute forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is a sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be a Sabbath day of complete rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. This is a permanent law for you.
verses.textEnNasb: It is to be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, so that you may humble yourselves; it is a permanent statute.
verses.textEn: It is a day of sabbath rest, and you must deny yourselves; it is a lasting ordinance.

verses.textZh: 那被膏立，承受圣职，接替他父亲作祭司的，要穿上细麻布衣服，就是圣洁的衣服，进行赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那被膏立，承受圣职，接替他父亲作祭司的，要穿上细麻布衣服，就是圣洁的衣服，进行赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 那受膏、接续他父亲承接圣职的祭司要穿上细麻布的圣衣，行赎罪之礼。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest is to make atonement. He is to put on the sacred linen garments
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest who is anointed and consecrated as priest in his father’s place shall make atonement, wearing the holy linen garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest, who is anointed and consecrated to minister as priest in his father’s place, shall make atonement, and put on the linen clothes, the holy garments;
verses.textEnNlt: In future generations, the purification ceremony will be performed by the priest who has been anointed and ordained to serve as high priest in place of his ancestor Aaron. He will put on the holy linen garments
verses.textEnNasb: So the priest who is anointed and ordained to serve as priest in his father’s place shall make atonement: he shall put on the linen garments, the holy garments,
verses.textEn: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest is to make atonement. He is to put on the sacred linen garments

verses.textZh: 他要为至圣所赎罪，又为会幕和祭坛赎罪，以及为祭司们和全体会众赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要为至圣所赎罪，又为会幕和祭坛赎罪，以及为祭司们和全体会众赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要在至圣所和会幕与坛行赎罪之礼，并要为众祭司和会众的百姓赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: and make atonement for the Most Holy Place, for the tent of meeting and the altar, and for the priests and all the members of the community.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall make atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar, and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary, and he shall make atonement for the tabernacle of meeting and for the altar, and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: and purify the Most Holy Place, the Tabernacle, the altar, the priests, and the entire congregation.
verses.textEnNasb: and make atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar. He shall also make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
verses.textEn: and make atonement for the Most Holy Place, for the tent of meeting and the altar, and for the priests and all the members of the community.

verses.textZh: 每年一次，要因以色列人一切的罪，为他们赎罪。这是你们永远的律例。"于是亚伦照着耶和华吩咐摩西的去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每年一次，要因以色列人一切的罪，为他们赎罪。这是你们永远的律例。"于是亚伦照着耶和华吩咐摩西的去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 这要作你们永远的定例－就是因以色列人一切的罪，要一年一次为他们赎罪。」 于是，亚伦照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: Atonement is to be made once a year for all the sins of the Israelites." And it was done, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And this shall be a statute forever for you, that atonement may be made for the people of Israel once in the year because of all their sins." And Aaron did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel, for all their sins, once a year." And he did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: This is a permanent law for you, to purify the people of Israel from their sins, making them right with the Lord once each year." Moses followed all these instructions exactly as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now you shall have this as a permanent statute, to make atonement for the sons of Israel for all their sins once every year." And just as the Lord had commanded Moses, so he did.
verses.textEn: "This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: Atonement is to be made once a year for all the sins of the Israelites." And it was done, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉亚伦和他的儿子，以及以色列人，对他们说：这是耶和华的吩咐：
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉亚伦和他的儿子，以及以色列人，对他们说：这是耶和华的吩咐：
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕亚伦和他儿子并以色列众人说，耶和华所吩咐的乃是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: ‘This is what the Lord has commanded:
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the people of Israel and say to them, This is the thing that the Lord has commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to Aaron, to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which the Lord has commanded, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to Aaron and his sons and all the people of Israel. This is what the Lord has commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord has commanded, saying,
verses.textEn: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: ‘This is what the Lord has commanded:

verses.textZh: 以色列家的任何人，不论在营内，或在营外，宰杀公牛、绵羊或山羊，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家的任何人，不论在营内，或在营外，宰杀公牛、绵羊或山羊，
verses.textZhCuv: 凡以色列家中的人宰公牛，或是绵羊羔，或是山羊，不拘宰于营内营外，
verses.textEnNiv: Any Israelite who sacrifices an ox, a lamb or a goat in the camp or outside of it
verses.textEnEsv: If any one of the house of Israel kills an ox or a lamb or a goat in the camp, or kills it outside the camp,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whatever man of the house of Israel who kills an ox or lamb or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,
verses.textEnNlt: "If any native Israelite sacrifices a bull or a lamb or a goat anywhere inside or outside the camp
verses.textEnNasb: "Anyone from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox, a lamb, or a goat in the camp, or slaughters it outside the camp,
verses.textEn: Any Israelite who sacrifices an ox, a lamb or a goat in the camp or outside of it

verses.textZh: 而不牵到会幕门口，耶和华的帐幕面前，献给耶和华作供物，流血的罪就要归到那人身上；他既然流了牲畜的血，就必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而不牵到会幕门口，耶和华的帐幕面前，献给耶和华作供物，流血的罪就要归到那人身上；他既然流了牲畜的血，就必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 若未曾牵到会幕门口、耶和华的帐幕前献给耶和华为供物，流血的罪必归到那人身上。他流了血，要从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the tent of meeting to present it as an offering to the Lord in front of the tabernacle of the Lord —that person shall be considered guilty of bloodshed; they have shed blood and must be cut off from their people.
verses.textEnEsv: and does not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to offer it as a gift to the Lord in front of the tabernacle of the Lord , bloodguilt shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood, and that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: and does not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of meeting to offer an offering to the Lord before the tabernacle of the Lord, the guilt of bloodshed shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people,
verses.textEnNlt: instead of bringing it to the entrance of the Tabernacle to present it as an offering to the Lord , that person will be as guilty as a murderer. Such a person has shed blood and will be cut off from the community.
verses.textEnNasb: and has not brought it to the doorway of the tent of meeting to present it as an offering to the Lord in front of the tabernacle of the Lord, bloodshed is to be counted against that person. He has shed blood, and that person shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.textEn: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the tent of meeting to present it as an offering to the Lord in front of the tabernacle of the Lord —that person shall be considered guilty of bloodshed; they have shed blood and must be cut off from their people.

verses.textZh: 这条例的目的是要以色列人把他们惯常在田野里宰杀的祭牲，带去给耶和华，到会幕门口交给祭司，好象献给耶和华作平安祭那样宰杀牲畜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这条例的目的是要以色列人把他们惯常在田野里宰杀的祭牲，带去给耶和华，到会幕门口交给祭司，好象献给耶和华作平安祭那样宰杀牲畜。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是为要使以色列人把他们在田野里所献的祭带到会幕门口、耶和华面前，交给祭司，献与耶和华为平安祭。
verses.textEnNiv: This is so the Israelites will bring to the Lord the sacrifices they are now making in the open fields. They must bring them to the priest, that is, to the Lord , at the entrance to the tent of meeting and sacrifice them as fellowship offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: This is to the end that the people of Israel may bring their sacrifices that they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to the Lord , to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and sacrifice them as sacrifices of peace offerings to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices which they offer in the open field, that they may bring them to the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of meeting, to the priest, and offer them as peace offerings to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The purpose of this rule is to stop the Israelites from sacrificing animals in the open fields. It will ensure that they bring their sacrifices to the priest at the entrance of the Tabernacle, so he can present them to the Lord as peace offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: This shall be done so that the sons of Israel will bring their sacrifices which they were sacrificing in the open field—so that they will bring them to the Lord at the doorway of the tent of meeting to the priest, and sacrifice them as sacrifices of peace offerings to the Lord.
verses.textEn: This is so the Israelites will bring to the Lord the sacrifices they are now making in the open fields. They must bring them to the priest, that is, to the Lord , at the entrance to the tent of meeting and sacrifice them as fellowship offerings.

verses.textZh: 祭司要把血泼在会幕门口耶和华的祭坛上，把脂肪焚烧，献给耶和华作馨香的祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要把血泼在会幕门口耶和华的祭坛上，把脂肪焚烧，献给耶和华作馨香的祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要把血洒在会幕门口、耶和华的坛上，把脂油焚烧，献给耶和华为馨香的祭。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to splash the blood against the altar of the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting and burn the fat as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall throw the blood on the altar of the Lord at the entrance of the tent of meeting and burn the fat for a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood on the altar of the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the priest will be able to splatter the blood against the Lord ’s altar at the entrance of the Tabernacle, and he will burn the fat as a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the altar of the Lord at the doorway of the tent of meeting, and offer up the fat in smoke as a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The priest is to splash the blood against the altar of the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting and burn the fat as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们不可再杀祭牲，献给那些山羊，就是他们所随从行邪淫的鬼神。这要作他们世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不可再杀祭牲，献给那些山羊，就是他们所随从行邪淫的鬼神。这要作他们世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不可再献祭给他们行邪淫所随从的鬼魔 ；这要作他们世世代代永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: They must no longer offer any of their sacrifices to the goat idols to whom they prostitute themselves. This is to be a lasting ordinance for them and for the generations to come.’
verses.textEnEsv: So they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to goat demons, after whom they whore. This shall be a statute forever for them throughout their generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall no more offer their sacrifices to demons, after whom they have played the harlot. This shall be a statute forever for them throughout their generations." ’
verses.textEnNlt: The people must no longer be unfaithful to the Lord by offering sacrifices to the goat idols. This is a permanent law for them, to be observed from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall no longer offer their sacrifices to the goat demons with which they play the prostitute. This shall be a permanent statute to them throughout their generations." ’
verses.textEn: They must no longer offer any of their sacrifices to the goat idols to whom they prostitute themselves. This is to be a lasting ordinance for them and for the generations to come.’

verses.textZh: "你要对他们说：以色列家的任何人，或是在你们中间寄居的外人，献燔祭或是平安祭的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要对他们说：以色列家的任何人，或是在你们中间寄居的外人，献燔祭或是平安祭的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要晓谕他们说：凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，献燔祭或是平安祭，
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to them: ‘Any Israelite or any foreigner residing among them who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice
verses.textEnEsv: "And you shall say to them, Any one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who sojourn among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also you shall say to them: ‘Whatever man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who dwell among you, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.textEnNlt: "Give them this command as well. If any native Israelite or foreigner living among you offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you shall say to them, ‘Anyone from the house of Israel, or from the strangers who reside among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.textEn: "Say to them: ‘Any Israelite or any foreigner residing among them who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice

verses.textZh: 如果不牵到会幕门口，把牠献给耶和华，那人就必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果不牵到会幕门口，把牠献给耶和华，那人就必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 若不带到会幕门口献给耶和华，那人必从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: and does not bring it to the entrance to the tent of meeting to sacrifice it to the Lord must be cut off from the people of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: and does not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to offer it to the Lord , that man shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: and does not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, to offer it to the Lord, that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.textEnNlt: but does not bring it to the entrance of the Tabernacle to offer it to the Lord , that person will be cut off from the community.
verses.textEnNasb: and does not bring it to the doorway of the tent of meeting to offer it to the Lord, that person also shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEn: and does not bring it to the entrance to the tent of meeting to sacrifice it to the Lord must be cut off from the people of Israel.

verses.textZh: "以色列家的任何人，或是在你们中间寄居的外人，如果吃了任何血，我必向那吃血的人变脸，把他从自己的族人中剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列家的任何人，或是在你们中间寄居的外人，如果吃了任何血，我必向那吃血的人变脸，把他从自己的族人中剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，若吃什么血，我必向那吃血的人变脸，把他从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I will set my face against any Israelite or any foreigner residing among them who eats blood, and I will cut them off from the people.
verses.textEnEsv: "If any one of the house of Israel or of the strangers who sojourn among them eats any blood, I will set my face against that person who eats blood and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And whatever man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who dwell among you, who eats any blood, I will set My face against that person who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.textEnNlt: "And if any native Israelite or foreigner living among you eats or drinks blood in any form, I will turn against that person and cut him off from the community of your people,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And anyone from the house of Israel, or from the strangers who reside among them, who eats any blood, I will set My face against that person who eats the blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.textEn: " ‘I will set my face against any Israelite or any foreigner residing among them who eats blood, and I will cut them off from the people.

verses.textZh: 因为动物的生命是在血里，我指定这祭坛上的血代替你们的生命，因为血里有生命，所以能代赎生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为动物的生命是在血里，我指定这祭坛上的血代替你们的生命，因为血里有生命，所以能代赎生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为活物的生命是在血中。我把这血赐给你们，可以在坛上为你们的生命赎罪；因血里有生命，所以能赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: For the life of a creature is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for yourselves on the altar; it is the blood that makes atonement for one’s life.
verses.textEnEsv: For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it for you on the altar to make atonement for your souls, for it is the blood that makes atonement by the life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement for the soul.’
verses.textEnNlt: for the life of the body is in its blood. I have given you the blood on the altar to purify you, making you right with the Lord . It is the blood, given in exchange for a life, that makes purification possible.
verses.textEnNasb: For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood by reason of the life that makes atonement.’
verses.textEn: For the life of a creature is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for yourselves on the altar; it is the blood that makes atonement for one’s life.

verses.textZh: 所以我对以色列人说：你们中间任何人都不可吃血，在你们中间寄居的外人也不可吃血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我对以色列人说：你们中间任何人都不可吃血，在你们中间寄居的外人也不可吃血。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我对以色列人说：你们都不可吃血；寄居在你们中间的外人也不可吃血。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I say to the Israelites, "None of you may eat blood, nor may any foreigner residing among you eat blood."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I have said to the people of Israel, No person among you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger who sojourns among you eat blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I said to the children of Israel, ‘No one among you shall eat blood, nor shall any stranger who dwells among you eat blood.’
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I have said to the people of Israel, ‘You must never eat or drink blood—neither you nor the foreigners living among you.’
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I said to the sons of Israel, ‘No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who resides among you eat blood.’
verses.textEn: Therefore I say to the Israelites, "None of you may eat blood, nor may any foreigner residing among you eat blood."

verses.textZh: 任何以色列人，或是在你们中间寄居的外人中，有人打猎得了可以吃的禽兽，总要放尽牠的血，用泥土掩盖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 任何以色列人，或是在你们中间寄居的外人中，有人打猎得了可以吃的禽兽，总要放尽牠的血，用泥土掩盖。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡以色列人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，若打猎得了可吃的禽兽，必放出它的血来，用土掩盖。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Any Israelite or any foreigner residing among you who hunts any animal or bird that may be eaten must drain out the blood and cover it with earth,
verses.textEnEsv: "Any one also of the people of Israel, or of the strangers who sojourn among them, who takes in hunting any beast or bird that may be eaten shall pour out its blood and cover it with earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whatever man of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who dwell among you, who hunts and catches any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood and cover it with dust;
verses.textEnNlt: "And if any native Israelite or foreigner living among you goes hunting and kills an animal or bird that is approved for eating, he must drain its blood and cover it with earth.
verses.textEnNasb: So when anyone from the sons of Israel, or from the strangers who reside among them, while hunting catches an animal or a bird which may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood and cover it with dirt.
verses.textEn: " ‘Any Israelite or any foreigner residing among you who hunts any animal or bird that may be eaten must drain out the blood and cover it with earth,

verses.textZh: "因为所有动物的生命就在牠们的血中 ，所以我对以色列人说：任何动物的血，你们都不可吃；因为所有动物的血，就是牠的生命；吃血的，必被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为所有动物的生命就在牠们的血中 ，所以我对以色列人说：任何动物的血，你们都不可吃；因为所有动物的血，就是牠的生命；吃血的，必被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 「论到一切活物的生命，就在血中。所以我对以色列人说：无论什么活物的血，你们都不可吃，因为一切活物的血就是他的生命。凡吃了血的，必被剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: because the life of every creature is its blood. That is why I have said to the Israelites, "You must not eat the blood of any creature, because the life of every creature is its blood; anyone who eats it must be cut off."
verses.textEnEsv: For the life of every creature is its blood: its blood is its life. Therefore I have said to the people of Israel, You shall not eat the blood of any creature, for the life of every creature is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: for it is the life of all flesh. Its blood sustains its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, ‘You shall not eat the blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.’
verses.textEnNlt: The life of every creature is in its blood. That is why I have said to the people of Israel, ‘You must never eat or drink blood, for the life of any creature is in its blood.’ So whoever consumes blood will be cut off from the community.
verses.textEnNasb: "For as for the life of all flesh, its blood is identified with its life. Therefore I said to the sons of Israel, ‘You are not to eat the blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood; whoever eats it shall be cut off.’
verses.textEn: because the life of every creature is its blood. That is why I have said to the Israelites, "You must not eat the blood of any creature, because the life of every creature is its blood; anyone who eats it must be cut off."

verses.textZh: 吃了自死的，或是被野兽撕裂的动物，无论是本地人或是寄居的，都要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上，以后他才算洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃了自死的，或是被野兽撕裂的动物，无论是本地人或是寄居的，都要洗净自己的衣服，用水洗澡，并且不洁净到晚上，以后他才算洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡吃自死的，或是被野兽撕裂的，无论是本地人，是寄居的，必不洁净到晚上，都要洗衣服，用水洗身，到了晚上才为洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Anyone, whether native-born or foreigner, who eats anything found dead or torn by wild animals must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be ceremonially unclean till evening; then they will be clean.
verses.textEnEsv: And every person who eats what dies of itself or what is torn by beasts, whether he is a native or a sojourner, shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening; then he shall be clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And every person who eats what died naturally or what was torn by beasts, whether he is a native of your own country or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening. Then he shall be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: "And if any native-born Israelites or foreigners eat the meat of an animal that died naturally or was torn up by wild animals, they must wash their clothes and bathe themselves in water. They will remain ceremonially unclean until evening, but then they will be clean.
verses.textEnNasb: And any person who eats an animal which dies or is torn by animals, whether he is a native or a stranger, shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and remain unclean until evening; then he will become clean.
verses.textEn: " ‘Anyone, whether native-born or foreigner, who eats anything found dead or torn by wild animals must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be ceremonially unclean till evening; then they will be clean.

verses.textZh: 但是，如果他不洗净衣服，也不洗身，他就要担当自己的罪责。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，如果他不洗净衣服，也不洗身，他就要担当自己的罪责。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但他若不洗衣服，也不洗身，就必担当他的罪孽。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if they do not wash their clothes and bathe themselves, they will be held responsible.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But if he does not wash them or bathe his flesh, he shall bear his iniquity."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if he does not wash them or bathe his body, then he shall bear his guilt."
verses.textEnNlt: But if they do not wash their clothes and bathe themselves, they will be punished for their sin."
verses.textEnNasb: But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe his body, then he shall bear the responsibility for his guilt."
verses.textEn: But if they do not wash their clothes and bathe themselves, they will be held responsible.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人，对他们说：我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人，对他们说：我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 你们从前住过的埃及地，那里的居民的行为，你们不可随从；我要领你们到的迦南地，那里的居民的行为，你们也不可仿效。你们不可跟随他们的风俗行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们从前住过的埃及地，那里的居民的行为，你们不可随从；我要领你们到的迦南地，那里的居民的行为，你们也不可仿效。你们不可跟随他们的风俗行。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们从前住的埃及地，那里人的行为，你们不可效法，我要领你们到的迦南地，那里人的行为也不可效法，也不可照他们的恶俗行。
verses.textEnNiv: You must not do as they do in Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. Do not follow their practices.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived, and you shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, to which I am bringing you. You shall not walk in their statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to the doings of the land of Egypt, where you dwelt, you shall not do; and according to the doings of the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you, you shall not do; nor shall you walk in their ordinances.
verses.textEnNlt: So do not act like the people in Egypt, where you used to live, or like the people of Canaan, where I am taking you. You must not imitate their way of life.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not do what is done in the land of Egypt where you lived, nor are you to do what is done in the land of Canaan where I am bringing you; you shall not walk in their statutes.
verses.textEn: You must not do as they do in Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. Do not follow their practices.

verses.textZh: 你们要遵行我的典章，谨守我的律例，要遵照奉行；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要遵行我的典章，谨守我的律例，要遵照奉行；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要遵我的典章，守我的律例，按此而行。我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: You must obey my laws and be careful to follow my decrees. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall follow my rules and keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall observe My judgments and keep My ordinances, to walk in them: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: You must obey all my regulations and be careful to obey my decrees, for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: You are to perform My judgments and keep My statutes, to live in accord with them; I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: You must obey my laws and be careful to follow my decrees. I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 所以你们要谨守我的律例和典章；人应该遵行这些，按照它们生活，我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要谨守我的律例和典章；人应该遵行这些，按照它们生活，我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要守我的律例典章；人若遵行，就必因此活着。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep my decrees and laws, for the person who obeys them will live by them. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my rules; if a person does them, he shall live by them: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall therefore keep My statutes and My judgments, which if a man does, he shall live by them: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: If you obey my decrees and my regulations, you will find life through them. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall keep My statutes and My judgments, which, if a person follows them, then he will live by them; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: Keep my decrees and laws, for the person who obeys them will live by them. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们任何人都不可亲近骨肉之亲，揭露她的下体；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们任何人都不可亲近骨肉之亲，揭露她的下体；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们都不可露骨肉之亲的下体，亲近他们。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘No one is to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "None of you shall approach any one of his close relatives to uncover nakedness. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘None of you shall approach anyone who is near of kin to him, to uncover his nakedness: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must never have sexual relations with a close relative, for I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘None of you shall approach any blood relative of his to uncover nakedness; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘No one is to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你不可揭露你父亲的下体，就是你母亲的下体；她是你的母亲，你不可揭露她的下体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可揭露你父亲的下体，就是你母亲的下体；她是你的母亲，你不可揭露她的下体。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可露你母亲的下体，羞辱了你父亲。她是你的母亲，不可露她的下体。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not dishonor your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; do not have relations with her.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, which is the nakedness of your mother; she is your mother, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: The nakedness of your father or the nakedness of your mother you shall not uncover. She is your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not violate your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; you must not have sexual relations with her.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, that is, the nakedness of your mother. She is your mother; you are not to uncover her nakedness.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not dishonor your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; do not have relations with her.

verses.textZh: 你父亲的妻子的下体，你不可揭露；那本是你父亲的下体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你父亲的妻子的下体，你不可揭露；那本是你父亲的下体。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可露你继母的下体；这本是你父亲的下体。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your father’s wife; that would dishonor your father.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife; it is your father’s nakedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: The nakedness of your father’s wife you shall not uncover; it is your father’s nakedness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with any of your father’s wives, for this would violate your father.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife; it is your father’s nakedness.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your father’s wife; that would dishonor your father.

verses.textZh: 你姊妹的下体，无论是异母同父的，或是异父同母的，是在家里生的，或是在外面生的，你都不可揭露她们的下体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你姊妹的下体，无论是异母同父的，或是异父同母的，是在家里生的，或是在外面生的，你都不可揭露她们的下体。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的姊妹，不拘是异母同父的，是异父同母的，无论是生在家生在外的，都不可露她们的下体。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether brought up in the family or in another home.
verses.textEnNkjv: The nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or elsewhere, their nakedness you shall not uncover.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with your sister or half sister, whether she is your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born into your household or someone else’s.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the nakedness of your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether born in the household or born outside the household, you shall not uncover their nakedness.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.

verses.textZh: 你的孙女，或是你的外孙女的下体，你都不可揭露，因为她们的下体就是你自己的下体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的孙女，或是你的外孙女的下体，你都不可揭露，因为她们的下体就是你自己的下体。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可露你孙女或是外孙女的下体，露了她们的下体就是露了自己的下体。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter; that would dishonor you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter or of your daughter’s daughter, for their nakedness is your own nakedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: The nakedness of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, their nakedness you shall not uncover; for theirs is your own nakedness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with your granddaughter, whether she is your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, for this would violate yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: The nakedness of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, their nakedness you shall not uncover; for their nakedness is yours.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter; that would dishonor you.

verses.textZh: 你的继母为你父亲所生的女儿的下体，是你的妹妹，你不可揭露她的下体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的继母为你父亲所生的女儿的下体，是你的妹妹，你不可揭露她的下体。
verses.textZhCuv: 你继母从你父亲生的女儿本是你的妹妹，不可露她的下体。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father’s wife, born to your father; she is your sister.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, brought up in your father’s family, since she is your sister.
verses.textEnNkjv: The nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, begotten by your father—she is your sister—you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with your stepsister, the daughter of any of your father’s wives, for she is your sister.
verses.textEnNasb: The nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, born to your father, she is your sister; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father’s wife, born to your father; she is your sister.

verses.textZh: 你不可揭露你姑母的下体；她是你父亲的骨肉之亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可揭露你姑母的下体；她是你父亲的骨肉之亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可露你姑母的下体；她是你父亲的骨肉之亲。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister; she is your father’s relative.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister; she is near of kin to your father.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with your father’s sister, for she is your father’s close relative.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister; she is your father’s blood relative.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.

verses.textZh: 你不可揭露你姨母的下体；她是你母亲的骨肉之亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可揭露你姨母的下体；她是你母亲的骨肉之亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可露你姨母的下体；她是你母亲的骨肉之亲。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, because she is your mother’s close relative.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s relative.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is near of kin to your mother.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s close relative.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s blood relative.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, because she is your mother’s close relative.

verses.textZh: 你不可揭露你叔伯的下体，不可亲近他的妻子，她本是你的婶母。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可揭露你叔伯的下体，不可亲近他的妻子，她本是你的婶母。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可亲近你伯叔之妻，羞辱了你伯叔；她是你的伯叔母。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not dishonor your father’s brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations; she is your aunt.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, that is, you shall not approach his wife; she is your aunt.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife; she is your aunt.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not violate your uncle, your father’s brother, by having sexual relations with his wife, for she is your aunt.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife; she is your aunt.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not dishonor your father’s brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations; she is your aunt.

verses.textZh: 你不可揭露你儿媳的下体；她是你儿子的妻子，你不可揭露她的下体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可揭露你儿媳的下体；她是你儿子的妻子，你不可揭露她的下体。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可露你儿妇的下体；她是你儿子的妻，不可露她的下体。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife; do not have relations with her.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law; she is your son’s wife, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law—she is your son’s wife—you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law; she is your son’s wife, so you must not have sexual relations with her.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife; do not have relations with her.

verses.textZh: 你不可揭露你兄弟妻子的下体；那本是你兄弟的下体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可揭露你兄弟妻子的下体；那本是你兄弟的下体。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可露你弟兄妻子的下体；这本是你弟兄的下体。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife; that would dishonor your brother.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife; it is your brother’s nakedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife; it is your brother’s nakedness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife, for this would violate your brother.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife; it is your brother’s nakedness.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife; that would dishonor your brother.

verses.textZh: 你不可揭露一个妇人的下体，又揭露她女儿的下体；不可娶她的孙女，或是她的外孙女，揭露她的下体；她们是骨肉之亲，这是丑恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可揭露一个妇人的下体，又揭露她女儿的下体；不可娶她的孙女，或是她的外孙女，揭露她的下体；她们是骨肉之亲，这是丑恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可露了妇人的下体，又露她女儿的下体，也不可娶她孙女或是外孙女，露她们的下体；她们是骨肉之亲，这本是大恶。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. Do not have sexual relations with either her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter; they are her close relatives. That is wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and of her daughter, and you shall not take her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter to uncover her nakedness; they are relatives; it is depravity.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, nor shall you take her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near of kin to her. It is wickedness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. And do not take her granddaughter, whether her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter, and have sexual relations with her. They are close relatives, and this would be a wicked act.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and of her daughter, nor shall you take her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are blood relatives. It is an outrageous sin.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. Do not have sexual relations with either her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter; they are her close relatives. That is wickedness.

verses.textZh: 妻子还活着的时候，你不可另娶她的姊妹，作她的情敌，揭露她的下体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妻子还活着的时候，你不可另娶她的姊妹，作她的情敌，揭露她的下体。
verses.textZhCuv: 你妻还在的时候，不可另娶她的姊妹作对头，露她的下体。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not take your wife’s sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is living.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not take a woman as a rival wife to her sister, uncovering her nakedness while her sister is still alive.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor shall you take a woman as a rival to her sister, to uncover her nakedness while the other is alive.
verses.textEnNlt: "While your wife is living, do not marry her sister and have sexual relations with her, for they would be rivals.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall not marry a woman in addition to her sister as a second wife while she is alive, to uncover her nakedness.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not take your wife’s sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is living.

verses.textZh: "在污秽不洁中的妇女，你不可亲近她，揭露她的下体。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在污秽不洁中的妇女，你不可亲近她，揭露她的下体。
verses.textZhCuv: 「女人行经不洁净的时候，不可露她的下体，与她亲近。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not approach a woman to have sexual relations during the uncleanness of her monthly period.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness while she is in her menstrual uncleanness.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Also you shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness as long as she is in her customary impurity.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with a woman during her period of menstrual impurity.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Also you shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness during her menstrual impurity.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not approach a woman to have sexual relations during the uncleanness of her monthly period.

verses.textZh: 你不可与你同伴的妻子私通，因她而玷污自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可与你同伴的妻子私通，因她而玷污自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可与邻舍的妻行淫，玷污自己。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your neighbor’s wife and defile yourself with her.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not lie sexually with your neighbor’s wife and so make yourself unclean with her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover you shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, to defile yourself with her.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not defile yourself by having sexual intercourse with your neighbor’s wife.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall not have sexual intercourse with your neighbor’s wife, to be defiled with her.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with your neighbor’s wife and defile yourself with her.

verses.textZh: 你不可把你的子孙献给摩洛，也不可亵渎你神的名；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可把你的子孙献给摩洛，也不可亵渎你神的名；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可使你的儿女经火归与摩洛，也不可亵渎你神的名。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molek, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not give any of your children to offer them to Molech, and so profane the name of your God: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall not let any of your descendants pass through the fire to Molech, nor shall you profane the name of your God: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not permit any of your children to be offered as a sacrifice to Molech, for you must not bring shame on the name of your God. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not give any of your children to offer them to Molech, nor shall you profane the name of your God; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molek, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你不可与男人同睡交合，像与女人同睡交合一样，这是可憎的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可与男人同睡交合，像与女人同睡交合一样，这是可憎的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可与男人苟合，像与女人一样；这本是可憎恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with a man as one does with a woman; that is detestable.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not lie with a male as with a woman; it is an abomination.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not lie with a male as with a woman. It is an abomination.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not practice homosexuality, having sex with another man as with a woman. It is a detestable sin.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not sleep with a male as one sleeps with a female; it is an abomination.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with a man as one does with a woman; that is detestable.

verses.textZh: 你不可与任何走兽同睡交合，因牠而玷污自己；女人也不可站在走兽面前，与牠交合；这是逆性的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可与任何走兽同睡交合，因牠而玷污自己；女人也不可站在走兽面前，与牠交合；这是逆性的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可与兽淫合，玷污自己。女人也不可站在兽前，与它淫合；这本是逆性的事。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with an animal and defile yourself with it. A woman must not present herself to an animal to have sexual relations with it; that is a perversion.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not lie with any animal and so make yourself unclean with it, neither shall any woman give herself to an animal to lie with it: it is perversion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor shall you mate with any animal, to defile yourself with it. Nor shall any woman stand before an animal to mate with it. It is perversion.
verses.textEnNlt: "A man must not defile himself by having sex with an animal. And a woman must not offer herself to a male animal to have intercourse with it. This is a perverse act.
verses.textEnNasb: Also you shall not have sexual intercourse with any animal to be defiled with it, nor shall any woman stand before an animal to mate with it; it is a perversion.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with an animal and defile yourself with it. A woman must not present herself to an animal to have sexual relations with it; that is a perversion.

verses.textZh: "你们不可让这些事的任何一件玷污自己，因为我将要从你们面前赶出去的各族，就是被这些事玷污了自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不可让这些事的任何一件玷污自己，因为我将要从你们面前赶出去的各族，就是被这些事玷污了自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在这一切的事上，你们都不可玷污自己；因为我在你们面前所逐出的列邦，在这一切的事上玷污了自己；
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, because this is how the nations that I am going to drive out before you became defiled.
verses.textEnEsv: "Do not make yourselves unclean by any of these things, for by all these the nations I am driving out before you have become unclean,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Do not defile yourselves with any of these things; for by all these the nations are defiled, which I am casting out before you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, for the people I am driving out before you have defiled themselves in all these ways.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Do not defile yourselves by any of these things; for by all these things the nations which I am driving out from you have become defiled.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, because this is how the nations that I am going to drive out before you became defiled.

verses.textZh: 连地也被玷污，所以我追讨那地的罪孽，那地就把居民吐出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 连地也被玷污，所以我追讨那地的罪孽，那地就把居民吐出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 连地也玷污了，所以我追讨那地的罪孽，那地也吐出它的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the land was defiled; so I punished it for its sin, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.
verses.textEnEsv: and the land became unclean, so that I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the land is defiled; therefore I visit the punishment of its iniquity upon it, and the land vomits out its inhabitants.
verses.textEnNlt: Because the entire land has become defiled, I am punishing the people who live there. I will cause the land to vomit them out.
verses.textEnNasb: For the land has become defiled, therefore I have brought its punishment upon it, so the land has vomited out its inhabitants.
verses.textEn: Even the land was defiled; so I punished it for its sin, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.

verses.textZh: 所以，你们要谨守我的律例和典章；这一切可憎的事，无论是本地人或是在你们中间寄居的外人，一件都不可作
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们要谨守我的律例和典章；这一切可憎的事，无论是本地人或是在你们中间寄居的外人，一件都不可作
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，你们要守我的律例典章。这一切可憎恶的事，无论是本地人，是寄居在你们中间的外人，都不可行，（
verses.textEnNiv: But you must keep my decrees and my laws. The native-born and the foreigners residing among you must not do any of these detestable things,
verses.textEnEsv: But you shall keep my statutes and my rules and do none of these abominations, either the native or the stranger who sojourns among you
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall therefore keep My statutes and My judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations, either any of your own nation or any stranger who dwells among you
verses.textEnNlt: You must obey all my decrees and regulations. You must not commit any of these detestable sins. This applies both to native-born Israelites and to the foreigners living among you.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, you are to keep My statutes and My judgments, and you shall not do any of these abominations, neither the native, nor the stranger who resides among you
verses.textEn: But you must keep my decrees and my laws. The native-born and the foreigners residing among you must not do any of these detestable things,

verses.textZhCuv: 在你们以先居住那地的人行了这一切可憎恶的事，地就玷污了，）
verses.textEnNiv: for all these things were done by the people who lived in the land before you, and the land became defiled.
verses.textEnEsv: (for the people of the land, who were before you, did all of these abominations, so that the land became unclean),
verses.textEnNkjv: (for all these abominations the men of the land have done, who were before you, and thus the land is defiled),
verses.textEnNlt: "All these detestable activities are practiced by the people of the land where I am taking you, and this is how the land has become defiled.
verses.textEnNasb: (for the people of the land who were there before you did all these abominations, and the land has become defiled),
verses.textEn: for all these things were done by the people who lived in the land before you, and the land became defiled.

verses.textZh: 免得你们玷污那地，那地就把你们吐出去，像吐出了在你们以前的各民族一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得你们玷污那地，那地就把你们吐出去，像吐出了在你们以前的各民族一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 免得你们玷污那地的时候，地就把你们吐出，像吐出在你们以先的国民一样。
verses.textEnNiv: And if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it vomited out the nations that were before you.
verses.textEnEsv: lest the land vomit you out when you make it unclean, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest the land vomit you out also when you defile it, as it vomited out the nations that were before you.
verses.textEnNlt: So do not defile the land and give it a reason to vomit you out, as it will vomit out the people who live there now.
verses.textEnNasb: so that the land will not vomit you out should you defile it, as it has vomited out the nation which was there before you.
verses.textEn: And if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it vomited out the nations that were before you.

verses.textZh: 无论甚么人，行了一件这些可憎的事，必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论甚么人，行了一件这些可憎的事，必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论什么人，行了其中可憎的一件事，必从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Everyone who does any of these detestable things—such persons must be cut off from their people.
verses.textEnEsv: For everyone who does any of these abominations, the persons who do them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever commits any of these abominations, the persons who commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.textEnNlt: Whoever commits any of these detestable sins will be cut off from the community of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever does any of these abominations, those persons who do so shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.textEn: " ‘Everyone who does any of these detestable things—such persons must be cut off from their people.

verses.textZh: 所以你们要谨守我的吩咐，免得你们行那些可憎的风俗，就是你们以前的人所行的，玷污了自己。我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要谨守我的吩咐，免得你们行那些可憎的风俗，就是你们以前的人所行的，玷污了自己。我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要守我所吩咐的，免得你们随从那些可憎的恶俗，就是在你们以先的人所常行的，以致玷污了自己。我是耶和华－你们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: Keep my requirements and do not follow any of the detestable customs that were practiced before you came and do not defile yourselves with them. I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: So keep my charge never to practice any of these abominable customs that were practiced before you, and never to make yourselves unclean by them: I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore you shall keep My ordinance, so that you do not commit any of these abominable customs which were committed before you, and that you do not defile yourselves by them: I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: So obey my instructions, and do not defile yourselves by committing any of these detestable practices that were committed by the people who lived in the land before you. I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNasb: So you are to keep your commitment to Me not to practice any of the abominable customs which have been practiced before you, so that you do not defile yourselves with them; I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEn: Keep my requirements and do not follow any of the detestable customs that were practiced before you came and do not defile yourselves with them. I am the Lord your God.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord also said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列全体会众，对他们说：你们要分别为圣，因为我耶和华你们的神是圣洁的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列全体会众，对他们说：你们要分别为圣，因为我耶和华你们的神是圣洁的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列全会众说：你们要圣洁，因为我耶和华－你们的神是圣洁的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the entire assembly of Israel and say to them: ‘Be holy because I, the Lord your God, am holy.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to all the congregation of the people of Israel and say to them, You shall be holy, for I the Lord your God am holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘You shall be holy, for I the Lord your God am holy.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the entire community of Israel. You must be holy because I, the Lord your God, am holy.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to all the congregation of the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘You shall be holy, for I the Lord your God am holy.
verses.textEn: "Speak to the entire assembly of Israel and say to them: ‘Be holy because I, the Lord your God, am holy.

verses.textZh: 各人要孝敬父母，也要谨守我的安息日；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各人要孝敬父母，也要谨守我的安息日；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们各人都当孝敬父母，也要守我的安息日。我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Each of you must respect your mother and father, and you must observe my Sabbaths. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Every one of you shall revere his mother and his father, and you shall keep my Sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Every one of you shall revere his mother and his father, and keep My Sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Each of you must show great respect for your mother and father, and you must always observe my Sabbath days of rest. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Every one of you shall revere his mother and his father, and you shall keep My Sabbaths; I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: " ‘Each of you must respect your mother and father, and you must observe my Sabbaths. I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 你们不可转向偶像，也不可为自己铸造神像；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不可转向偶像，也不可为自己铸造神像；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不可偏向虚无的神，也不可为自己铸造神像。我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not turn to idols or make metal gods for yourselves. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves any gods of cast metal: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Do not turn to idols, nor make for yourselves molded gods: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not put your trust in idols or make metal images of gods for yourselves. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves cast metal gods; I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not turn to idols or make metal gods for yourselves. I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "如果你们献平安祭给耶和华，要使你们所献的蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你们献平安祭给耶和华，要使你们所献的蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们献平安祭给耶和华的时候，要献得可蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When you sacrifice a fellowship offering to the Lord , sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the Lord , you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if you offer a sacrifice of a peace offering to the Lord, you shall offer it of your own free will.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you sacrifice a peace offering to the Lord , offer it properly so you will be accepted by God.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now when you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the Lord, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.
verses.textEn: " ‘When you sacrifice a fellowship offering to the Lord , sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

verses.textZh: 祭牲的肉，要在你们献的那一天和第二天吃；如果有剩下的，到了第三天，就要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭牲的肉，要在你们献的那一天和第二天吃；如果有剩下的，到了第三天，就要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 这祭物要在献的那一天和第二天吃，若有剩到第三天的，就必用火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it or on the next day; anything left over until the third day must be burned up.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it or on the day after, and anything left over until the third day shall be burned up with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. And if any remains until the third day, it shall be burned in the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The sacrifice must be eaten on the same day you offer it or on the next day. Whatever is left over until the third day must be completely burned up.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be eaten on the same day you offer it, and on the next day; but what remains until the third day shall be burned with fire.
verses.textEn: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it or on the next day; anything left over until the third day must be burned up.

verses.textZh: 如果在第三天吃平安祭肉，这祭肉已经成为不洁净，不蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果在第三天吃平安祭肉，这祭肉已经成为不洁净，不蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三天若再吃，这就为可憎恶的，必不蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is impure and will not be accepted.
verses.textEnEsv: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is tainted; it will not be accepted,
verses.textEnNkjv: And if it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It shall not be accepted.
verses.textEnNlt: If any of the sacrifice is eaten on the third day, it will be contaminated, and I will not accept it.
verses.textEnNasb: So if it is eaten at all on the third day, it is unclean; it will not be accepted.
verses.textEn: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is impure and will not be accepted.

verses.textZh: 那吃祭肉的人，要担当自己的罪责，因为他亵渎了耶和华的圣物；那人必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那吃祭肉的人，要担当自己的罪责，因为他亵渎了耶和华的圣物；那人必从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡吃的人必担当他的罪孽；因为他亵渎了耶和华的圣物，那人必从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever eats it will be held responsible because they have desecrated what is holy to the Lord ; they must be cut off from their people.
verses.textEnEsv: and everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned what is holy to the Lord , and that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the hallowed offering of the Lord; and that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who eats it on the third day will be punished for defiling what is holy to the Lord and will be cut off from the community.
verses.textEnNasb: And everyone who eats it will bear the consequences for his guilt, because he has profaned the holy thing of the Lord; and that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEn: Whoever eats it will be held responsible because they have desecrated what is holy to the Lord ; they must be cut off from their people.

verses.textZh: "你们收割庄稼的时候，不可把角落的谷物都割尽，也不可拾取收割时遗下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们收割庄稼的时候，不可把角落的谷物都割尽，也不可拾取收割时遗下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在你们的地收割庄稼，不可割尽田角，也不可拾取所遗落的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not reap your field right up to its edge, neither shall you gather the gleanings after your harvest.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, nor shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you harvest the crops of your land, do not harvest the grain along the edges of your fields, and do not pick up what the harvesters drop.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not reap to the very edges of your field, nor shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
verses.textEn: " ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.

verses.textZh: 不可把你葡萄园的果子都摘尽，也不可拾取你葡萄园中掉下的；要把它们留给穷人和寄居的外人；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可把你葡萄园的果子都摘尽，也不可拾取你葡萄园中掉下的；要把它们留给穷人和寄居的外人；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可摘尽葡萄园的果子，也不可拾取葡萄园所掉的果子；要留给穷人和寄居的。我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not go over your vineyard a second time or pick up the grapes that have fallen. Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not strip your vineyard bare, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the sojourner: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall not glean your vineyard, nor shall you gather every grape of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and the stranger: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: It is the same with your grape crop—do not strip every last bunch of grapes from the vines, and do not pick up the grapes that fall to the ground. Leave them for the poor and the foreigners living among you. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall not glean your vineyard, nor shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the needy and for the stranger. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Do not go over your vineyard a second time or pick up the grapes that have fallen. Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "你们不可偷窃，不可欺骗，不可彼此说谎。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不可偷窃，不可欺骗，不可彼此说谎。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们不可偷盗，不可欺骗，也不可彼此说谎。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not steal. " ‘Do not lie. " ‘Do not deceive one another.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not steal; you shall not deal falsely; you shall not lie to one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not steal, nor deal falsely, nor lie to one another.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not steal. "Do not deceive or cheat one another.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not steal, nor deal falsely, nor lie to one another.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not steal. " ‘Do not lie. " ‘Do not deceive one another.

verses.textZh: 不可奉我的名起假誓，亵渎你神的名；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可奉我的名起假誓，亵渎你神的名；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可指着我的名起假誓，亵渎你神的名。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not swear falsely by my name and so profane the name of your God. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not swear by my name falsely, and so profane the name of your God: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall not swear by My name falsely, nor shall you profane the name of your God: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not bring shame on the name of your God by using it to swear falsely. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall not swear falsely by My name, so as to profane the name of your God; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not swear falsely by my name and so profane the name of your God. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "不可欺压你的邻舍，也不可抢夺他的东西；雇工的工钱，不可扣留在你那里到早晨。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可欺压你的邻舍，也不可抢夺他的东西；雇工的工钱，不可扣留在你那里到早晨。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可欺压你的邻舍，也不可抢夺他的物。雇工人的工价，不可在你那里过夜，留到早晨。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not defraud or rob your neighbor. " ‘Do not hold back the wages of a hired worker overnight.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not oppress your neighbor or rob him. The wages of a hired worker shall not remain with you all night until the morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not cheat your neighbor, nor rob him. The wages of him who is hired shall not remain with you all night until morning.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not defraud or rob your neighbor. "Do not make your hired workers wait until the next day to receive their pay.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. The wages of a hired worker are not to remain with you all night until morning.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not defraud or rob your neighbor. " ‘Do not hold back the wages of a hired worker overnight.

verses.textZh: 不可咒骂聋子，也不可把绊脚石放在瞎子面前；却要敬畏你的神；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可咒骂聋子，也不可把绊脚石放在瞎子面前；却要敬畏你的神；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可咒骂聋子，也不可将绊脚石放在瞎子面前，只要敬畏你的神。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block in front of the blind, but fear your God. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind, but shall fear your God: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not insult the deaf or cause the blind to stumble. You must fear your God; I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not curse a person who is deaf, nor put a stumbling block before a person who is blind, but you shall revere your God; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block in front of the blind, but fear your God. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们审判的时候，不可行不义；不可偏袒穷人，也不可偏帮有权势的人；只要按着公义审判你的邻舍。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们审判的时候，不可行不义；不可偏袒穷人，也不可偏帮有权势的人；只要按着公义审判你的邻舍。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们施行审判，不可行不义；不可偏护穷人，也不可重看有势力的人，只要按着公义审判你的邻舍。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not pervert justice; do not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the great, but judge your neighbor fairly.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall do no injustice in court. You shall not be partial to the poor or defer to the great, but in righteousness shall you judge your neighbor.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty. In righteousness you shall judge your neighbor.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not twist justice in legal matters by favoring the poor or being partial to the rich and powerful. Always judge people fairly.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not do injustice in judgment; you shall not show partiality to the poor nor give preference to the great, but you are to judge your neighbor fairly.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not pervert justice; do not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the great, but judge your neighbor fairly.

verses.textZh: 你不可在你的族人中，到处搬弄是非，也不可危害你的邻舍 ；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可在你的族人中，到处搬弄是非，也不可危害你的邻舍 ；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可在民中往来搬弄是非，也不可与邻舍为敌，置之于死 。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not go about spreading slander among your people. " ‘Do not do anything that endangers your neighbor’s life. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people, and you shall not stand up against the life of your neighbor: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not go about as a talebearer among your people; nor shall you take a stand against the life of your neighbor: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not spread slanderous gossip among your people. "Do not stand idly by when your neighbor’s life is threatened. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not go about as a slanderer among your people; and you are not to jeopardize the life of your neighbor. I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not go about spreading slander among your people. " ‘Do not do anything that endangers your neighbor’s life. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你不可心里恨你的兄弟；应坦诚责备你的邻舍，免得你因他担当罪过。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你不可心里恨你的兄弟；应坦诚责备你的邻舍，免得你因他担当罪过。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可心里恨你的弟兄；总要指摘你的邻舍，免得因他担罪。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not hate a fellow Israelite in your heart. Rebuke your neighbor frankly so you will not share in their guilt.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not hate your brother in your heart, but you shall reason frankly with your neighbor, lest you incur sin because of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not nurse hatred in your heart for any of your relatives. Confront people directly so you will not be held guilty for their sin.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not hate your fellow countryman in your heart; you may certainly rebuke your neighbor, but you are not to incur sin because of him.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not hate a fellow Israelite in your heart. Rebuke your neighbor frankly so you will not share in their guilt.

verses.textZh: 不可报复，也不可向你的族人怀恨，却要爱你的邻舍好象爱自己；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可报复，也不可向你的族人怀恨，却要爱你的邻舍好象爱自己；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可报仇，也不可埋怨你本国的子民，却要爱人如己。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against anyone among your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not take vengeance or bear a grudge against the sons of your own people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against a fellow Israelite, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not take vengeance, nor hold any grudge against the sons of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against anyone among your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们要谨守我的律例。不可使你的牲畜与不同类的交合；在你的田里不可撒两种不同类的种子；两样料子作成的衣服，你不可穿在身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要谨守我的律例。不可使你的牲畜与不同类的交合；在你的田里不可撒两种不同类的种子；两样料子作成的衣服，你不可穿在身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要守我的律例。不可叫你的牲畜与异类配合；不可用两样搀杂的种种你的地，也不可用两样搀杂的料做衣服穿在身上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Keep my decrees. " ‘Do not mate different kinds of animals. " ‘Do not plant your field with two kinds of seed. " ‘Do not wear clothing woven of two kinds of material.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall keep my statutes. You shall not let your cattle breed with a different kind. You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed, nor shall you wear a garment of cloth made of two kinds of material.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall keep My statutes. You shall not let your livestock breed with another kind. You shall not sow your field with mixed seed. Nor shall a garment of mixed linen and wool come upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must obey all my decrees. "Do not mate two different kinds of animals. Do not plant your field with two different kinds of seed. Do not wear clothing woven from two different kinds of thread.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You are to keep My statutes. You shall not cross-breed two kinds of your cattle; you shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed, nor wear a garment of two kinds of material mixed together.
verses.textEn: " ‘Keep my decrees. " ‘Do not mate different kinds of animals. " ‘Do not plant your field with two kinds of seed. " ‘Do not wear clothing woven of two kinds of material.

verses.textZh: 如果人与女子同睡交合，而那女子是个婢女，已经许配了人，但还没有赎身，或是还没有得着自由，就应受惩罚，但不可把二人处死，因为婢女还没有得着自由。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人与女子同睡交合，而那女子是个婢女，已经许配了人，但还没有赎身，或是还没有得着自由，就应受惩罚，但不可把二人处死，因为婢女还没有得着自由。
verses.textZhCuv: 「婢女许配了丈夫，还没有被赎、得释放，人若与她行淫，二人要受刑罚，却不把他们治死，因为婢女还没有得自由。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man sleeps with a female slave who is promised to another man but who has not been ransomed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. Yet they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man lies sexually with a woman who is a slave, assigned to another man and not yet ransomed or given her freedom, a distinction shall be made. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free;
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Whoever lies carnally with a woman who is betrothed to a man as a concubine, and who has not at all been redeemed nor given her freedom, for this there shall be scourging; but they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man has sex with a slave girl whose freedom has never been purchased but who is committed to become another man’s wife, he must pay full compensation to her master. But since she is not a free woman, neither the man nor the woman will be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if a man has sexual relations with a woman who is a slave acquired for another man, but who has in no way been redeemed nor given her freedom, there shall be punishment; they shall not, however, be put to death, because she was not free.
