verses.textEn: " ‘If a man sleeps with a female slave who is promised to another man but who has not been ransomed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. Yet they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.

verses.textZh: 那人要把他的赎愆祭，就是一只作赎愆祭的公绵羊，带到会幕门口，耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人要把他的赎愆祭，就是一只作赎愆祭的公绵羊，带到会幕门口，耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人要把赎愆祭，就是一只公绵羊牵到会幕门口、耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the tent of meeting for a guilt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: but he shall bring his compensation to the Lord , to the entrance of the tent of meeting, a ram for a guilt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall bring his trespass offering to the Lord, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, a ram as a trespass offering.
verses.textEnNlt: The man, however, must bring a ram as a guilt offering and present it to the Lord at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall bring his guilt offering to the Lord to the doorway of the tent of meeting, a ram as a guilt offering.
verses.textEn: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the tent of meeting for a guilt offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 祭司要用那只作赎愆祭的公绵羊，在耶和华面前，为他所犯的罪赎罪，他所犯的罪必蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要用那只作赎愆祭的公绵羊，在耶和华面前，为他所犯的罪赎罪，他所犯的罪必蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要用赎愆祭的羊在耶和华面前赎他所犯的罪，他的罪就必蒙赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: With the ram of the guilt offering the priest is to make atonement for him before the Lord for the sin he has committed, and his sin will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering before the Lord for his sin that he has committed, and he shall be forgiven for the sin that he has committed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the Lord for his sin which he has committed. And the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will then purify him before the Lord with the ram of the guilt offering, and the man’s sin will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall also make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering before the Lord for his sin which he has committed, and the sin which he has committed will be forgiven him.
verses.textEn: With the ram of the guilt offering the priest is to make atonement for him before the Lord for the sin he has committed, and his sin will be forgiven.

verses.textZh: "你们进了那地，栽种了各样可作食物的果树的时候，你们要视初结的果子为不洁净，好象未受割礼的人。头三年的果子，你们不可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们进了那地，栽种了各样可作食物的果树的时候，你们要视初结的果子为不洁净，好象未受割礼的人。头三年的果子，你们不可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们到了迦南地，栽种各样结果子的树木，就要以所结的果子如未受割礼的一样。三年之久，你们要以这些果子，如未受割礼的，是不可吃的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When you enter the land and plant any kind of fruit tree, regard its fruit as forbidden. For three years you are to consider it forbidden ; it must not be eaten.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you come into the land and plant any kind of tree for food, then you shall regard its fruit as forbidden. Three years it shall be forbidden to you; it must not be eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as uncircumcised. Three years it shall be as uncircumcised to you. It shall not be eaten.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you enter the land and plant fruit trees, leave the fruit unharvested for the first three years and consider it forbidden. Do not eat it.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now when you enter the land and plant all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you; it shall not be eaten.
verses.textEn: " ‘When you enter the land and plant any kind of fruit tree, regard its fruit as forbidden. For three years you are to consider it forbidden ; it must not be eaten.

verses.textZh: 第四年所结的一切果子，应分别为圣，是作称颂耶和华的供物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第四年所结的一切果子，应分别为圣，是作称颂耶和华的供物。
verses.textZhCuv: 但第四年所结的果子全要成为圣，用以赞美耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: In the fourth year all its fruit will be holy, an offering of praise to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, an offering of praise to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, a praise to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: In the fourth year the entire crop must be consecrated to the Lord as a celebration of praise.
verses.textEnNasb: And in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, an offering of praise to the Lord.
verses.textEn: In the fourth year all its fruit will be holy, an offering of praise to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 到了第五年，你们才吃树上所结的果子，你们这样作，你们的生产就必增加；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第五年，你们才吃树上所结的果子，你们这样作，你们的生产就必增加；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 第五年，你们要吃那树上的果子，好叫树给你们结果子更多。我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit. In this way your harvest will be increased. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: But in the fifth year you may eat of its fruit, to increase its yield for you: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the fifth year you may eat its fruit, that it may yield to you its increase: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, in the fifth year you may eat the fruit. If you follow this pattern, your harvest will increase. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: But in the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, so that its yield may increase for you; I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit. In this way your harvest will be increased. I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "你们不可吃带血的东西，不可占卜，不可算命。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不可吃带血的东西，不可占卜，不可算命。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们不可吃带血的物；不可用法术，也不可观兆。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not eat any meat with the blood still in it. " ‘Do not practice divination or seek omens.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not eat any flesh with the blood in it. You shall not interpret omens or tell fortunes.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not eat anything with the blood, nor shall you practice divination or soothsaying.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not eat meat that has not been drained of its blood. "Do not practice fortune-telling or witchcraft.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood. You shall not practice divination nor soothsaying.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not eat any meat with the blood still in it. " ‘Do not practice divination or seek omens.

verses.textZh: 不可剃两边的头发，胡须的周围也不可刮掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可剃两边的头发，胡须的周围也不可刮掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 头的周围 不可剃，胡须的周围也不可损坏。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not cut the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not round off the hair on your temples or mar the edges of your beard.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not shave around the sides of your head, nor shall you disfigure the edges of your beard.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not trim off the hair on your temples or trim your beards.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not round off the hairline of your heads, nor trim the edges of your beard.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not cut the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.

verses.textZh: 不可为死人的缘故，割伤你们的身体，也不可在你们的身上刺花纹；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可为死人的缘故，割伤你们的身体，也不可在你们的身上刺花纹；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可为死人用刀划身，也不可在身上刺花纹。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not cut your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not make any cuts on your body for the dead or tattoo yourselves: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not cut your bodies for the dead, and do not mark your skin with tattoos. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not make any cuts in your body for the dead, nor make any tattoo marks on yourselves: I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not cut your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "不可辱没你的女儿，使她作娼妓，免得这地淫乱，充满丑恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可辱没你的女儿，使她作娼妓，免得这地淫乱，充满丑恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可辱没你的女儿，使她为娼妓，恐怕地上的人专向淫乱，地就满了大恶。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not degrade your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will turn to prostitution and be filled with wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: "Do not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, lest the land fall into prostitution and the land become full of depravity.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Do not prostitute your daughter, to cause her to be a harlot, lest the land fall into harlotry, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be filled with prostitution and wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Do not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, so that the land does not fall into prostitution, and the land does not become full of outrageous sin.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not degrade your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will turn to prostitution and be filled with wickedness.

verses.textZh: 你们要谨守我的安息日，敬畏我的圣所；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨守我的安息日，敬畏我的圣所；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要守我的安息日，敬我的圣所。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall keep my Sabbaths and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall keep My Sabbaths and reverence My sanctuary: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Keep my Sabbath days of rest, and show reverence toward my sanctuary. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall keep My Sabbaths and revere My sanctuary; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们不可转向那些交鬼的和行法术的；不可求问他们，玷污自己；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不可转向那些交鬼的和行法术的；不可求问他们，玷污自己；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可偏向那些交鬼的和行巫术的；不可求问他们，以致被他们玷污了。我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not turn to mediums or seek out spiritists, for you will be defiled by them. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: "Do not turn to mediums or necromancers; do not seek them out, and so make yourselves unclean by them: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Give no regard to mediums and familiar spirits; do not seek after them, to be defiled by them: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not defile yourselves by turning to mediums or to those who consult the spirits of the dead. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Do not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out to be defiled by them. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not turn to mediums or seek out spiritists, for you will be defiled by them. I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "在白发的人面前，你要起立；要尊敬老年人，又要敬畏你的神；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在白发的人面前，你要起立；要尊敬老年人，又要敬畏你的神；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在白发的人面前，你要站起来；也要尊敬老人，又要敬畏你的神。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Stand up in the presence of the aged, show respect for the elderly and revere your God. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall stand up before the gray head and honor the face of an old man, and you shall fear your God: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall rise before the gray headed and honor the presence of an old man, and fear your God: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Stand up in the presence of the elderly, and show respect for the aged. Fear your God. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall stand up in the presence of the grayheaded and honor elders, and you shall fear your God; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Stand up in the presence of the aged, show respect for the elderly and revere your God. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "如果有外人在你们的地方，与你们一起寄居，你们不可欺负他。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有外人在你们的地方，与你们一起寄居，你们不可欺负他。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them.
verses.textEnEsv: "When a stranger sojourns with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if a stranger dwells with you in your land, you shall not mistreat him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not take advantage of foreigners who live among you in your land.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘When a stranger resides with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
verses.textEn: " ‘When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them.

verses.textZh: 与你们一起寄居的外人，要看他像你们中间的本地人一样；你要爱他好象爱自己，因为你们在埃及地也曾作过寄居的人；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 与你们一起寄居的外人，要看他像你们中间的本地人一样；你要爱他好象爱自己，因为你们在埃及地也曾作过寄居的人；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall treat the stranger who sojourns with you as the native among you, and you shall love him as yourself, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: The stranger who dwells among you shall be to you as one born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Treat them like native-born Israelites, and love them as you love yourself. Remember that you were once foreigners living in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: The stranger who resides with you shall be to you as the native among you, and you shall love him as yourself, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "你们审判的时候，在度、量、衡上，都不可偏差。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们审判的时候，在度、量、衡上，都不可偏差。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们施行审判，不可行不义；在尺、秤、升、斗上也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not use dishonest standards when measuring length, weight or quantity.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall do no wrong in judgment, in measures of length or weight or quantity.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall do no injustice in judgment, in measurement of length, weight, or volume.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not use dishonest standards when measuring length, weight, or volume.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall do no wrong in judgment, in measurement of weight, or volume.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not use dishonest standards when measuring length, weight or quantity.

verses.textZh: 要用公正的天平，公正的法码，公正的升斗，公正的容器；我是耶和华你们的神，就是曾把你们从埃及地领出来的那位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要用公正的天平，公正的法码，公正的升斗，公正的容器；我是耶和华你们的神，就是曾把你们从埃及地领出来的那位。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用公道天平、公道法码、公道升斗、公道秤。我是耶和华－你们的神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: Use honest scales and honest weights, an honest ephah and an honest hin. I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall have honest scales, honest weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Your scales and weights must be accurate. Your containers for measuring dry materials or liquids must be accurate. I am the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall have accurate balances, accurate weights, an accurate ephah, and an accurate hin; I am the Lord your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Use honest scales and honest weights, an honest ephah and an honest hin. I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 你们要谨守遵行我的一切律例和一切典章；我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨守遵行我的一切律例和一切典章；我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要谨守遵行我一切的律例典章。我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Keep all my decrees and all my laws and follow them. I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall observe all my statutes and all my rules, and do them: I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore you shall observe all My statutes and all My judgments, and perform them: I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "You must be careful to keep all of my decrees and regulations by putting them into practice. I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall keep all My statutes and all My ordinances, and do them; I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: " ‘Keep all my decrees and all my laws and follow them. I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要对以色列人说：任何以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的儿子献给摩洛，必要把他处死；本地的人要用石头把他打死。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要对以色列人说：任何以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的儿子献给摩洛，必要把他处死；本地的人要用石头把他打死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你还要晓谕以色列人说：凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的儿女献给摩洛的，总要治死他；本地人要用石头把他打死。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Any Israelite or any foreigner residing in Israel who sacrifices any of his children to Molek is to be put to death. The members of the community are to stone him.
verses.textEnEsv: "Say to the people of Israel, Any one of the people of Israel or of the strangers who sojourn in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Again, you shall say to the children of Israel: ‘Whoever of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who dwell in Israel, who gives any of his descendants to Molech, he shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the people of Israel these instructions, which apply both to native Israelites and to the foreigners living in Israel. "If any of them offer their children as a sacrifice to Molech, they must be put to death. The people of the community must stone them to death.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also say to the sons of Israel: ‘Anyone from the sons of Israel or from the strangers residing in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech, shall certainly be put to death; the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.textEn: "Say to the Israelites: ‘Any Israelite or any foreigner residing in Israel who sacrifices any of his children to Molek is to be put to death. The members of the community are to stone him.

verses.textZh: 我也要向那人变脸，把他从他的族人中剪除，因为他把自己的儿子献给摩洛，玷污了我的圣所，亵渎了我的圣名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也要向那人变脸，把他从他的族人中剪除，因为他把自己的儿子献给摩洛，玷污了我的圣所，亵渎了我的圣名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除；因为他把儿女献给摩洛，玷污我的圣所，亵渎我的圣名。
verses.textEnNiv: I myself will set my face against him and will cut him off from his people; for by sacrificing his children to Molek, he has defiled my sanctuary and profaned my holy name.
verses.textEnEsv: I myself will set my face against that man and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given one of his children to Molech, to make my sanctuary unclean and to profane my holy name.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will set My face against that man, and will cut him off from his people, because he has given some of his descendants to Molech, to defile My sanctuary and profane My holy name.
verses.textEnNlt: I myself will turn against them and cut them off from the community, because they have defiled my sanctuary and brought shame on my holy name by offering their children to Molech.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also set My face against that man and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given some of his children to Molech, so as to defile My sanctuary and to profane My holy name.
verses.textEn: I myself will set my face against him and will cut him off from his people; for by sacrificing his children to Molek, he has defiled my sanctuary and profaned my holy name.

verses.textZh: 如果有人把他的儿子献给摩洛，而本地的人掩目不看，不把他处死，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人把他的儿子献给摩洛，而本地的人掩目不看，不把他处死，
verses.textZhCuv: 那人把儿女献给摩洛，本地人若佯为不见，不把他治死，
verses.textEnNiv: If the members of the community close their eyes when that man sacrifices one of his children to Molek and if they fail to put him to death,
verses.textEnEsv: And if the people of the land do at all close their eyes to that man when he gives one of his children to Molech, and do not put him to death,
verses.textEnNkjv: And if the people of the land should in any way hide their eyes from the man, when he gives some of his descendants to Molech, and they do not kill him,
verses.textEnNlt: And if the people of the community ignore those who offer their children to Molech and refuse to execute them,
verses.textEnNasb: If the people of the land, however, should ever disregard that man when he gives any of his children to Molech, so as not to put him to death,
verses.textEn: If the members of the community close their eyes when that man sacrifices one of his children to Molek and if they fail to put him to death,

verses.textZh: 我就要向那人和他的家族变脸，把他和所有跟随他与摩洛行邪淫的人，都从他们的族人中剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就要向那人和他的家族变脸，把他和所有跟随他与摩洛行邪淫的人，都从他们的族人中剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就要向这人和他的家变脸，把他和一切随他与摩洛行邪淫的人都从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: I myself will set my face against him and his family and will cut them off from their people together with all who follow him in prostituting themselves to Molek.
verses.textEnEsv: then I will set my face against that man and against his clan and will cut them off from among their people, him and all who follow him in whoring after Molech.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will set My face against that man and against his family; and I will cut him off from his people, and all who prostitute themselves with him to commit harlotry with Molech.
verses.textEnNlt: I myself will turn against them and their families and will cut them off from the community. This will happen to all who commit spiritual prostitution by worshiping Molech.
verses.textEnNasb: then I Myself will set My face against that man and against his family, and I will cut off from among their people both him and all those who play the prostitute with him, by playing the prostitute with Molech.
verses.textEn: I myself will set my face against him and his family and will cut them off from their people together with all who follow him in prostituting themselves to Molek.

verses.textZh: "如果有人转向交鬼的和行法术的，随从他们行淫，我必向那人变脸，把他从他的族人中剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人转向交鬼的和行法术的，随从他们行淫，我必向那人变脸，把他从他的族人中剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人偏向交鬼的和行巫术的，随他们行邪淫，我要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I will set my face against anyone who turns to mediums and spiritists to prostitute themselves by following them, and I will cut them off from their people.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a person turns to mediums and necromancers, whoring after them, I will set my face against that person and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And the person who turns to mediums and familiar spirits, to prostitute himself with them, I will set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will also turn against those who commit spiritual prostitution by putting their trust in mediums or in those who consult the spirits of the dead. I will cut them off from the community.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘As for the person who turns to mediums and to spiritists, to play the prostitute with them, I will also set My face against that person and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.textEn: " ‘I will set my face against anyone who turns to mediums and spiritists to prostitute themselves by following them, and I will cut them off from their people.

verses.textZh: 所以你们要使自己成为圣洁。你们要分别为圣，因为我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要使自己成为圣洁。你们要分别为圣，因为我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们要自洁成圣，因为我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Consecrate yourselves therefore, and be holy, for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: So set yourselves apart to be holy, for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall consecrate yourselves therefore and be holy, for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: " ‘Consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 你们要谨守遵行我的律例，我是使你们分别为圣的耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨守遵行我的律例，我是使你们分别为圣的耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要谨守遵行我的律例；我是叫你们成圣的耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep my decrees and follow them. I am the Lord , who makes you holy.
verses.textEnEsv: Keep my statutes and do them; I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall keep My statutes, and perform them: I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
verses.textEnNlt: Keep all my decrees by putting them into practice, for I am the Lord who makes you holy.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall keep My statutes and practice them; I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
verses.textEn: Keep my decrees and follow them. I am the Lord , who makes you holy.

verses.textZh: "咒骂自己父母的，必要把他处死；他咒骂自己的父母，必须承担流血的罪责。
verses.textZhCnvs: "咒骂自己父母的，必要把他处死；他咒骂自己的父母，必须承担流血的罪责。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡咒骂父母的，总要治死他；他咒骂了父母，他的罪 要归到他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death. Because they have cursed their father or mother, their blood will be on their own head.
verses.textEnEsv: For anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death; he has cursed his father or his mother; his blood is upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who dishonors father or mother must be put to death. Such a person is guilty of a capital offense.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘If there is anyone who curses his father or his mother, he shall certainly be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother, and has brought his own death upon himself.
verses.textEn: " ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death. Because they have cursed their father or mother, their blood will be on their own head.

verses.textZh: "如果有人与别人的妻子通奸，就是与邻舍的妻子通奸，奸夫和淫妇都要处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人与别人的妻子通奸，就是与邻舍的妻子通奸，奸夫和淫妇都要处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「与邻舍之妻行淫的，奸夫淫妇都必治死。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—with the wife of his neighbor—both the adulterer and the adulteress are to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man commits adultery with the wife of his neighbor, both the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress, shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, both the man and the woman who have committed adultery must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘If there is a man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, one who commits adultery with his friend’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress must be put to death.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—with the wife of his neighbor—both the adulterer and the adulteress are to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 如果有人与父亲的妻子同睡，就是揭露了他父亲的下体，必要把他们二人处死；他们必须承担流血的罪责。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人与父亲的妻子同睡，就是揭露了他父亲的下体，必要把他们二人处死；他们必须承担流血的罪责。
verses.textZhCuv: 与继母行淫的，就是羞辱了他父亲，总要把他们二人治死，罪要归到他们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with his father’s wife, he has dishonored his father. Both the man and the woman are to be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness; both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness; both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man violates his father by having sex with one of his father’s wives, both the man and the woman must be put to death, for they are guilty of a capital offense.
verses.textEnNasb: If there is a man who sleeps with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them must be put to death, they have brought their own deaths upon themselves.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with his father’s wife, he has dishonored his father. Both the man and the woman are to be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

verses.textZh: 如果有人与儿媳同睡，必要把他们二人处死；他们犯了乱伦的罪，必须承担流血的罪责。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人与儿媳同睡，必要把他们二人处死；他们犯了乱伦的罪，必须承担流血的罪责。
verses.textZhCuv: 与儿妇同房的，总要把他们二人治死；他们行了逆伦的事，罪要归到他们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with his daughter-in-law, both of them are to be put to death. What they have done is a perversion; their blood will be on their own heads.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death; they have committed perversion; their blood is upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed perversion. Their blood shall be upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man has sex with his daughter-in-law, both must be put to death. They have committed a perverse act and are guilty of a capital offense.
verses.textEnNasb: If there is a man who sleeps with his daughter-in-law, both of them must be put to death. They have committed incest, and have brought their own deaths upon themselves.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with his daughter-in-law, both of them are to be put to death. What they have done is a perversion; their blood will be on their own heads.

verses.textZh: 如果有人与男人同睡，像与女人同睡一样，他们二人行了可憎的事，必要把他们处死，他们必须承担流血的罪责。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人与男人同睡，像与女人同睡一样，他们二人行了可憎的事，必要把他们处死，他们必须承担流血的罪责。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若与男人苟合，像与女人一样，他们二人行了可憎的事，总要把他们治死，罪要归到他们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with a man as one does with a woman, both of them have done what is detestable. They are to be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man lies with a male as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination; they shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man lies with a male as he lies with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man practices homosexuality, having sex with another man as with a woman, both men have committed a detestable act. They must both be put to death, for they are guilty of a capital offense.
verses.textEnNasb: If there is a man who sleeps with a male as those who sleep with a woman, both of them have committed a detestable act; they must be put to death. They have brought their own deaths upon themselves.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with a man as one does with a woman, both of them have done what is detestable. They are to be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

verses.textZh: 如果有人娶妻，又娶岳母，就是行了丑恶的事，要把他们三人用火烧死，好使你们中间不再有丑恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人娶妻，又娶岳母，就是行了丑恶的事，要把他们三人用火烧死，好使你们中间不再有丑恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若娶妻，并娶其母，便是大恶，要把这三人用火焚烧，使你们中间免去大恶。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is wicked. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that no wickedness will be among you.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man takes a woman and her mother also, it is depravity; he and they shall be burned with fire, that there may be no depravity among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man marries a woman and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man marries both a woman and her mother, he has committed a wicked act. The man and both women must be burned to death to wipe out such wickedness from among you.
verses.textEnNasb: If there is a man who marries a woman and her mother, it is an outrageous sin; both he and they shall be burned with fire, so that there will be no such outrageous sin in your midst.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is wicked. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that no wickedness will be among you.

verses.textZh: 如果有人与走兽同睡，必要把他处死，也要杀死那走兽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人与走兽同睡，必要把他处死，也要杀死那走兽。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若与兽淫合，总要治死他，也要杀那兽。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with an animal, he is to be put to death, and you must kill the animal.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death, and you shall kill the animal.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man mates with an animal, he shall surely be put to death, and you shall kill the animal.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man has sex with an animal, he must be put to death, and the animal must be killed.
verses.textEnNasb: If there is a man who has sexual intercourse with an animal, he must be put to death; you shall also kill the animal.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with an animal, he is to be put to death, and you must kill the animal.

verses.textZh: 女人若是亲近任何走兽，与牠交合，你们要杀了那女人和走兽；必要把他们处死；他们必须承担流血的罪责。
verses.textZhCnvs: 女人若是亲近任何走兽，与牠交合，你们要杀了那女人和走兽；必要把他们处死；他们必须承担流血的罪责。
verses.textZhCuv: 女人若与兽亲近，与它淫合，你要杀那女人和那兽，总要把他们治死，罪要归到他们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a woman approaches an animal to have sexual relations with it, kill both the woman and the animal. They are to be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.
verses.textEnEsv: If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal; they shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a woman approaches any animal and mates with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood is upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a woman presents herself to a male animal to have intercourse with it, she and the animal must both be put to death. You must kill both, for they are guilty of a capital offense.
verses.textEnNasb: If there is a woman who approaches any animal to mate with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal; they must be put to death. They have brought their own deaths upon themselves.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a woman approaches an animal to have sexual relations with it, kill both the woman and the animal. They are to be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

verses.textZh: "如果有人娶了自己的姊妹，无论是异母同父的，或是异父同母的，他见了她的下体，她也见了他的下体，这是可耻的事；他们二人必要从自己族人的眼前被剪除。他揭露了自己姊妹的下体，必须担当自己的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人娶了自己的姊妹，无论是异母同父的，或是异父同母的，他见了她的下体，她也见了他的下体，这是可耻的事；他们二人必要从自己族人的眼前被剪除。他揭露了自己姊妹的下体，必须担当自己的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若娶他的姊妹，无论是异母同父的，是异父同母的，彼此见了下体，这是可耻的事；他们必在本民的眼前被剪除。他露了姊妹的下体，必担当自己的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man marries his sister, the daughter of either his father or his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They are to be publicly removed from their people. He has dishonored his sister and will be held responsible.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man takes his sister, a daughter of his father or a daughter of his mother, and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a disgrace, and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness, and he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If a man takes his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter, and sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness, it is a wicked thing. And they shall be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his guilt.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man marries his sister, the daughter of either his father or his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a shameful disgrace. They must be publicly cut off from the community. Since the man has violated his sister, he will be punished for his sin.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘If there is a man who takes his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter, so that he sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness, it is a disgrace; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the sons of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he bears his guilt.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man marries his sister, the daughter of either his father or his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They are to be publicly removed from their people. He has dishonored his sister and will be held responsible.

verses.textZh: 如果有人与患血漏病的妇人同睡，揭露了她的下体，就揭露了她的血源，妇人也揭露了她自己的血源，他们二人必要从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人与患血漏病的妇人同睡，揭露了她的下体，就揭露了她的血源，妇人也揭露了她自己的血源，他们二人必要从自己的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人有月经，若与她同房，露了她的下体，就是露了妇人的血源，妇人也露了自己的血源，二人必从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with a woman during her monthly period, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has also uncovered it. Both of them are to be cut off from their people.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man lies with a woman during her menstrual period and uncovers her nakedness, he has made naked her fountain, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man lies with a woman during her sickness and uncovers her nakedness, he has exposed her flow, and she has uncovered the flow of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from their people.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man has sexual relations with a woman during her menstrual period, both of them must be cut off from the community, for together they have exposed the source of her blood flow.
verses.textEnNasb: If there is a man who sleeps with a menstruous woman and uncovers her nakedness, he has exposed her flow, and she has uncovered the flow of her blood; so both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with a woman during her monthly period, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has also uncovered it. Both of them are to be cut off from their people.

verses.textZh: 你不可揭露姨母，或是姑母的下体，因为这是揭露了骨肉之亲的下体；这样作的人要担当自己的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可揭露姨母，或是姑母的下体，因为这是揭露了骨肉之亲的下体；这样作的人要担当自己的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可露姨母或是姑母的下体，这是露了骨肉之亲的下体；二人必担当自己的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with the sister of either your mother or your father, for that would dishonor a close relative; both of you would be held responsible.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister or of your father’s sister, for that is to make naked one’s relative; they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister nor of your father’s sister, for that would uncover his near of kin. They shall bear their guilt.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not have sexual relations with your aunt, whether your mother’s sister or your father’s sister. This would dishonor a close relative. Both parties are guilty and will be punished for their sin.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister or of your father’s sister, for such a one has uncovered his blood relative; they will bear their guilt.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not have sexual relations with the sister of either your mother or your father, for that would dishonor a close relative; both of you would be held responsible.

verses.textZh: 如果有人与叔伯的妻子同睡，就是揭露了叔伯的下体，这样作的人要担当自己的罪；他们必无子女而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人与叔伯的妻子同睡，就是揭露了叔伯的下体，这样作的人要担当自己的罪；他们必无子女而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若与伯叔之妻同房，就羞辱了他的伯叔；二人要担当自己的罪，必无子女而死。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with his aunt, he has dishonored his uncle. They will be held responsible; they will die childless.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness; they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man has sex with his uncle’s wife, he has violated his uncle. Both the man and woman will be punished for their sin, and they will die childless.
verses.textEnNasb: If there is a man who sleeps with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness; they will bear their sin. They will die childless.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man has sexual relations with his aunt, he has dishonored his uncle. They will be held responsible; they will die childless.

verses.textZh: 如果有人娶了兄弟的妻子为妻，这是污秽的事，揭露了自己兄弟的下体；这样作的人必无子女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人娶了兄弟的妻子为妻，这是污秽的事，揭露了自己兄弟的下体；这样作的人必无子女。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若娶弟兄之妻，这本是污秽的事，羞辱了他的弟兄；二人必无子女。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity; he has dishonored his brother. They will be childless.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has violated his brother, and the guilty couple will remain childless.
verses.textEnNasb: If there is a man who takes his brother’s wife, it is detestable; he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They will be childless.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity; he has dishonored his brother. They will be childless.

verses.textZh: "所以你们要谨守遵行我的一切律例和一切典章，免得我将要领你们进去居住的那地，把你们吐出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所以你们要谨守遵行我的一切律例和一切典章，免得我将要领你们进去居住的那地，把你们吐出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以，你们要谨守遵行我一切的律例典章，免得我领你们去住的那地把你们吐出。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Keep all my decrees and laws and follow them, so that the land where I am bringing you to live may not vomit you out.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my rules and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to live may not vomit you out.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall therefore keep all My statutes and all My judgments, and perform them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must keep all my decrees and regulations by putting them into practice; otherwise the land to which I am bringing you as your new home will vomit you out.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You are therefore to keep all My statutes and all My ordinances, and do them, so that the land to which I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.
verses.textEn: " ‘Keep all my decrees and laws and follow them, so that the land where I am bringing you to live may not vomit you out.

verses.textZh: 我从你们面前逐出的各民族，你们不可随从他们的风俗；因为他们行了这一切事，所以我厌恶他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从你们面前逐出的各民族，你们不可随从他们的风俗；因为他们行了这一切事，所以我厌恶他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在你们面前所逐出的国民，你们不可随从他们的风俗；因为他们行了这一切的事，所以我厌恶他们。
verses.textEnNiv: You must not live according to the customs of the nations I am going to drive out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not walk in the customs of the nation that I am driving out before you, for they did all these things, and therefore I detested them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall not walk in the statutes of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they commit all these things, and therefore I abhor them.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not live according to the customs of the people I am driving out before you. It is because they do these shameful things that I detest them.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, you shall not follow the customs of the nation which I am going to drive out before you, because they did all these things; therefore I have felt disgust for them.
verses.textEn: You must not live according to the customs of the nations I am going to drive out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.

verses.textZh: 但我对你们说过，你们要承受他们的土地；我要把这流奶与蜜之地，赐给你们作产业。我是耶和华你们的神，把你们从万民中分别出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我对你们说过，你们要承受他们的土地；我要把这流奶与蜜之地，赐给你们作产业。我是耶和华你们的神，把你们从万民中分别出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我对你们说过，你们要承受他们的地，就是我要赐给你们为业、流奶与蜜之地。我是耶和华－你们的神，使你们与万民有分别的。
verses.textEnNiv: But I said to you, "You will possess their land; I will give it to you as an inheritance, a land flowing with milk and honey." I am the Lord your God, who has set you apart from the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: But I have said to you, ‘You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey.’ I am the Lord your God, who has separated you from the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I have said to you, "You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey." I am the Lord your God, who has separated you from the peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: But I have promised you, ‘You will possess their land because I will give it to you as your possession—a land flowing with milk and honey.’ I am the Lord your God, who has set you apart from all other people.
verses.textEnNasb: So I have said to you, "You are to take possession of their land, and I Myself will give it to you to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey." I am the Lord your God, who has singled you out from the peoples.
verses.textEn: But I said to you, "You will possess their land; I will give it to you as an inheritance, a land flowing with milk and honey." I am the Lord your God, who has set you apart from the nations.

verses.textZh: 所以你们要把洁净的和不洁净的走兽，洁净的和不洁净的飞禽分别出来；你们不可因着那些我为你们分别出来，不洁净的走兽、飞禽，或任何在地上爬行的动物，使自己成为可憎恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要把洁净的和不洁净的走兽，洁净的和不洁净的飞禽分别出来；你们不可因着那些我为你们分别出来，不洁净的走兽、飞禽，或任何在地上爬行的动物，使自己成为可憎恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要把洁净和不洁净的禽兽分别出来；不可因我给你们分为不洁净的禽兽，或是滋生在地上的活物，使自己成为可憎恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘You must therefore make a distinction between clean and unclean animals and between unclean and clean birds. Do not defile yourselves by any animal or bird or anything that moves along the ground—those that I have set apart as unclean for you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall therefore separate the clean beast from the unclean, and the unclean bird from the clean. You shall not make yourselves detestable by beast or by bird or by anything with which the ground crawls, which I have set apart for you to hold unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall therefore distinguish between clean animals and unclean, between unclean birds and clean, and you shall not make yourselves abominable by beast or by bird, or by any kind of living thing that creeps on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must therefore make a distinction between ceremonially clean and unclean animals, and between clean and unclean birds. You must not defile yourselves by eating any unclean animal or bird or creature that scurries along the ground. I have identified them as being unclean for you.
verses.textEnNasb: You are therefore to make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean bird and the clean; and you shall not make yourselves detestable by animal or by bird, or by anything that crawls on the ground, which I have distinguished for you as unclean.
verses.textEn: " ‘You must therefore make a distinction between clean and unclean animals and between unclean and clean birds. Do not defile yourselves by any animal or bird or anything that moves along the ground—those that I have set apart as unclean for you.

verses.textZh: 你们要归我为圣，因为我耶和华是圣洁的，我把你们从万民中分别出来，使你们归我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要归我为圣，因为我耶和华是圣洁的，我把你们从万民中分别出来，使你们归我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要归我为圣，因为我－耶和华是圣的，并叫你们与万民有分别，使你们作我的民。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to be holy to me because I, the Lord , am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be my own.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be holy to me, for I the Lord am holy and have separated you from the peoples, that you should be mine.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall be holy to Me, for I the Lord am holy, and have separated you from the peoples, that you should be Mine.
verses.textEnNlt: You must be holy because I, the Lord , am holy. I have set you apart from all other people to be my very own.
verses.textEnNasb: So you are to be holy to Me, for I the Lord am holy; and I have singled you out from the peoples to be Mine.
verses.textEn: You are to be holy to me because I, the Lord , am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be my own.

verses.textZh: "无论男女，是交鬼的或是行法术的，必要把他们处死，要用石头打死他们；他们必须承担流血的罪责。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "无论男女，是交鬼的或是行法术的，必要把他们处死，要用石头打死他们；他们必须承担流血的罪责。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「无论男女，是交鬼的或行巫术的，总要治死他们。人必用石头把他们打死，罪要归到他们身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘A man or woman who is a medium or spiritist among you must be put to death. You are to stone them; their blood will be on their own heads.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "A man or a woman who is a medium or a necromancer shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones; their blood shall be upon them."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘A man or a woman who is a medium, or who has familiar spirits, shall surely be put to death; they shall stone them with stones. Their blood shall be upon them.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Men and women among you who act as mediums or who consult the spirits of the dead must be put to death by stoning. They are guilty of a capital offense."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now a man or a woman who is a medium or a spiritist must be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones; they have brought their own deaths upon themselves.’ "
verses.textEn: " ‘A man or woman who is a medium or spiritist among you must be put to death. You are to stone them; their blood will be on their own heads.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要告诉亚伦子孙作祭司的，对他们说：祭司不可在自己的族人中因死人玷污自己，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要告诉亚伦子孙作祭司的，对他们说：祭司不可在自己的族人中因死人玷污自己，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你告诉亚伦子孙作祭司的说：祭司不可为民中的死人沾染自己，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: ‘A priest must not make himself ceremonially unclean for any of his people who die,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, No one shall make himself unclean for the dead among his people,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: ‘None shall defile himself for the dead among his people,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses, "Give the following instructions to the priests, the descendants of Aaron. "A priest must not make himself ceremonially unclean by touching the dead body of a relative.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: ‘No one shall defile himself for a dead person among his people,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: ‘A priest must not make himself ceremonially unclean for any of his people who die,

verses.textZh: 除非骨肉至亲，例如父母、儿女、兄弟，
verses.textZhCnvs: 除非骨肉至亲，例如父母、儿女、兄弟，
verses.textZhCuv: 除非为他骨肉之亲的父母、儿女、弟兄，
verses.textEnNiv: except for a close relative, such as his mother or father, his son or daughter, his brother,
verses.textEnEsv: except for his closest relatives, his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, his brother,
verses.textEnNkjv: except for his relatives who are nearest to him: his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, and his brother;
verses.textEnNlt: The only exceptions are his closest relatives—his mother or father, son or daughter, brother,
verses.textEnNasb: except for his relatives who are nearest to him, his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, and his brother,
verses.textEn: except for a close relative, such as his mother or father, his son or daughter, his brother,

verses.textZh: 或是仍是处女，未曾出嫁的姊妹等至亲，祭司才可以玷污自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是仍是处女，未曾出嫁的姊妹等至亲，祭司才可以玷污自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 和未曾出嫁、作处女的姊妹，才可以沾染自己。
verses.textEnNiv: or an unmarried sister who is dependent on him since she has no husband—for her he may make himself unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: or his virgin sister (who is near to him because she has had no husband; for her he may make himself unclean).
verses.textEnNkjv: also his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband, for her he may defile himself.
verses.textEnNlt: or his virgin sister who depends on him because she has no husband.
verses.textEnNasb: also for his virgin sister who is near to him because she has not had a husband; for her, he may defile himself.
verses.textEn: or an unmarried sister who is dependent on him since she has no husband—for her he may make himself unclean.

verses.textZh: 祭司不可为了姻亲而玷污，亵渎自己的圣职 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司不可为了姻亲而玷污，亵渎自己的圣职 。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司既在民中为首，就不可从俗沾染自己。
verses.textEnNiv: He must not make himself unclean for people related to him by marriage, and so defile himself.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall not make himself unclean as a husband among his people and so profane himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Otherwise he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
verses.textEnNlt: But a priest must not defile himself and make himself unclean for someone who is related to him only by marriage.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall not defile himself as a relative by marriage among his people, so as to profane himself.
verses.textEn: He must not make himself unclean for people related to him by marriage, and so defile himself.

verses.textZh: 祭司不可剃光头发，胡须的周围不可剃掉，也不可纹身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司不可剃光头发，胡须的周围不可剃掉，也不可纹身。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可使头光秃；不可剃除胡须的周围，也不可用刀划身。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Priests must not shave their heads or shave off the edges of their beards or cut their bodies.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not make bald patches on their heads, nor shave off the edges of their beards, nor make any cuts on their body.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘They shall not make any bald place on their heads, nor shall they shave the edges of their beards nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: "The priests must not shave their heads or trim their beards or cut their bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall not shave any area on their heads bald, nor shave off the edges of their beards, nor make any cuts in their flesh.
verses.textEn: " ‘Priests must not shave their heads or shave off the edges of their beards or cut their bodies.

verses.textZh: 他们要成为圣，归向他们的神，不可亵渎他们神的名，因为他们奉献耶和华的火祭，他们神的食物，所以他们要成为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要成为圣，归向他们的神，不可亵渎他们神的名，因为他们奉献耶和华的火祭，他们神的食物，所以他们要成为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 要归神为圣，不可亵渎神的名；因为耶和华的火祭，就是神的食物，是他们献的，所以他们要成为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: They must be holy to their God and must not profane the name of their God. Because they present the food offerings to the Lord , the food of their God, they are to be holy.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. For they offer the Lord ’s food offerings, the bread of their God; therefore they shall be holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and the bread of their God; therefore they shall be holy.
verses.textEnNlt: They must be set apart as holy to their God and must never bring shame on the name of God. They must be holy, for they are the ones who present the special gifts to the Lord , gifts of food for their God.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God, because they present the offerings by fire to the Lord, the food of their God; so they shall be holy.
verses.textEn: They must be holy to their God and must not profane the name of their God. Because they present the food offerings to the Lord , the food of their God, they are to be holy.

verses.textZh: 祭司不可娶被玷辱了的妓女为妻，也不可娶被丈夫离弃的女人为妻；因为祭司是归他的神为圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司不可娶被玷辱了的妓女为妻，也不可娶被丈夫离弃的女人为妻；因为祭司是归他的神为圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可娶妓女或被污的女人为妻，也不可娶被休的妇人为妻，因为祭司是归神为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘They must not marry women defiled by prostitution or divorced from their husbands, because priests are holy to their God.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not marry a prostitute or a woman who has been defiled, neither shall they marry a woman divorced from her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not take a wife who is a harlot or a defiled woman, nor shall they take a woman divorced from her husband; for the priest is holy to his God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Priests may not marry a woman defiled by prostitution, and they may not marry a woman who is divorced from her husband, for the priests are set apart as holy to their God.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute and profaned, nor shall they take a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.
verses.textEn: " ‘They must not marry women defiled by prostitution or divorced from their husbands, because priests are holy to their God.

verses.textZh: 所以你要使他分别为圣，因为他把食物献给你的神；你要以他为圣，因为我耶和华使你们分别为圣的，是圣洁的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要使他分别为圣，因为他把食物献给你的神；你要以他为圣，因为我耶和华使你们分别为圣的，是圣洁的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要使他成圣，因为他奉献你神的食物；你要以他为圣，因为我－使你们成圣的耶和华－是圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: Regard them as holy, because they offer up the food of your God. Consider them holy, because I the Lord am holy—I who make you holy.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I, the Lord , who sanctify you, am holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall consecrate him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the Lord, who sanctify you, am holy.
verses.textEnNlt: You must treat them as holy because they offer up food to your God. You must consider them holy because I, the Lord , am holy, and I make you holy.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall consecrate him, therefore, because he offers the food of your God. He shall be holy to you; for I the Lord, who sanctifies you, am holy.
verses.textEn: Regard them as holy, because they offer up the food of your God. Consider them holy, because I the Lord am holy—I who make you holy.

verses.textZh: 如果祭司的女儿羞辱自己去作妓女，就是羞辱了自己的父亲；她必须用火烧死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果祭司的女儿羞辱自己去作妓女，就是羞辱了自己的父亲；她必须用火烧死。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司的女儿若行淫辱没自己，就辱没了父亲，必用火将她焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a priest’s daughter defiles herself by becoming a prostitute, she disgraces her father; she must be burned in the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: And the daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by whoring, profanes her father; she shall be burned with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the harlot, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a priest’s daughter defiles herself by becoming a prostitute, she also defiles her father’s holiness, and she must be burned to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by prostitution, she profanes her father; she shall be burned with fire.
verses.textEn: " ‘If a priest’s daughter defiles herself by becoming a prostitute, she disgraces her father; she must be burned in the fire.

verses.textZh: "在兄弟中作大祭司的，头上倒了膏油，又受了圣职，得以穿著圣衣，就不可披头散发，也不可撕裂衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在兄弟中作大祭司的，头上倒了膏油，又受了圣职，得以穿著圣衣，就不可披头散发，也不可撕裂衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在弟兄中作大祭司、头上倒了膏油、又承接圣职、穿了圣衣的，不可蓬头散发，也不可撕裂衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The high priest, the one among his brothers who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and who has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair become unkempt or tear his clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: "The priest who is chief among his brothers, on whose head the anointing oil is poured and who has been consecrated to wear the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose nor tear his clothes.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘He who is the high priest among his brethren, on whose head the anointing oil was poured and who is consecrated to wear the garments, shall not uncover his head nor tear his clothes;
verses.textEnNlt: "The high priest has the highest rank of all the priests. The anointing oil has been poured on his head, and he has been ordained to wear the priestly garments. He must never leave his hair uncombed or tear his clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The priest who is highest among his brothers, on whose head the anointing oil has been poured and who has been consecrated to wear the garments, shall not uncover his head nor tear his clothes;
verses.textEn: " ‘The high priest, the one among his brothers who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and who has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair become unkempt or tear his clothes.

verses.textZh: 不可走近死尸，也不可为了父母玷污自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可走近死尸，也不可为了父母玷污自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可挨近死尸，也不可为父母沾染自己。
verses.textEnNiv: He must not enter a place where there is a dead body. He must not make himself unclean, even for his father or mother,
verses.textEnEsv: He shall not go in to any dead bodies nor make himself unclean, even for his father or for his mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor shall he go near any dead body, nor defile himself for his father or his mother;
verses.textEnNlt: He must not defile himself by going near a dead body. He may not make himself ceremonially unclean even for his father or mother.
verses.textEnNasb: nor shall he approach any dead person, nor defile himself even for his father or his mother;
verses.textEn: He must not enter a place where there is a dead body. He must not make himself unclean, even for his father or mother,

verses.textZh: 他不可走出圣所，也不可亵渎他神的圣所，因为他神膏立了他，使他分别为圣，我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不可走出圣所，也不可亵渎他神的圣所，因为他神膏立了他，使他分别为圣，我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可出圣所，也不可亵渎神的圣所，因为神膏油的冠冕在他头上。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: nor leave the sanctuary of his God or desecrate it, because he has been dedicated by the anointing oil of his God. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, lest he profane the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: nor shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He must not defile the sanctuary of his God by leaving it to attend to a dead person, for he has been made holy by the anointing oil of his God. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: nor shall he leave the sanctuary nor profane the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: nor leave the sanctuary of his God or desecrate it, because he has been dedicated by the anointing oil of his God. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他要娶处女为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要娶处女为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要娶处女为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The woman he marries must be a virgin.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.textEnNlt: "The high priest may marry only a virgin.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.textEn: " ‘The woman he marries must be a virgin.

verses.textZh: 寡妇、被休的妇人、受玷辱的妓女，他都不可以娶；他只可以娶自己族人中的处女为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 寡妇、被休的妇人、受玷辱的妓女，他都不可以娶；他只可以娶自己族人中的处女为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 寡妇或是被休的妇人，或是被污为妓的女人，都不可娶；只可娶本民中的处女为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: He must not marry a widow, a divorced woman, or a woman defiled by prostitution, but only a virgin from his own people,
verses.textEnEsv: A widow, or a divorced woman, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute, these he shall not marry. But he shall take as his wife a virgin of his own people,
verses.textEnNkjv: A widow or a divorced woman or a defiled woman or a harlot—these he shall not marry; but he shall take a virgin of his own people as wife.
verses.textEnNlt: He may not marry a widow, a woman who is divorced, or a woman who has defiled herself by prostitution. She must be a virgin from his own clan,
verses.textEnNasb: A widow, or a divorced woman, or one who is profaned by prostitution, these he shall not take; but rather he is to marry a virgin of his own people,
verses.textEn: He must not marry a widow, a divorced woman, or a woman defiled by prostitution, but only a virgin from his own people,

verses.textZh: 不可在自己的族人中，羞辱他的后裔，因为我是使他们分别为圣的耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可在自己的族人中，羞辱他的后裔，因为我是使他们分别为圣的耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不可在民中辱没他的儿女，因为我是叫他成圣的耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: so that he will not defile his offspring among his people. I am the Lord , who makes him holy.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: that he may not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the Lord who sanctifies him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor shall he profane his posterity among his people, for I the Lord sanctify him.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: so that he will not dishonor his descendants among his clan, for I am the Lord who makes him holy."
verses.textEnNasb: so that he will not profane his children among his people; for I am the Lord who sanctifies him.’ "
verses.textEn: so that he will not defile his offspring among his people. I am the Lord , who makes him holy.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉亚伦：你世世代代的后裔中，有残疾的，就不可走近来献他神的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉亚伦：你世世代代的后裔中，有残疾的，就不可走近来献他神的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你告诉亚伦说：你世世代代的后裔，凡有残疾的，都不可近前来献他神的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to Aaron: ‘For the generations to come none of your descendants who has a defect may come near to offer the food of his God.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to Aaron, saying, None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a blemish may approach to offer the bread of his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to Aaron, saying: ‘No man of your descendants in succeeding generations, who has any defect, may approach to offer the bread of his God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to Aaron: In all future generations, none of your descendants who has any defect will qualify to offer food to his God.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to Aaron, saying, ‘None of your descendants throughout their generations who has an impairment shall approach to offer the food of his God.
verses.textEn: "Say to Aaron: ‘For the generations to come none of your descendants who has a defect may come near to offer the food of his God.

verses.textZh: 因为有残疾的，无论是瞎眼、瘸腿、五官不正、畸形、
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有残疾的，无论是瞎眼、瘸腿、五官不正、畸形、
verses.textZhCuv: 因为凡有残疾的，无论是瞎眼的、瘸腿的、塌鼻子的、肢体有余的、
verses.textEnNiv: No man who has any defect may come near: no man who is blind or lame, disfigured or deformed;
verses.textEnEsv: For no one who has a blemish shall draw near, a man blind or lame, or one who has a mutilated face or a limb too long,
verses.textEnNkjv: For any man who has a defect shall not approach: a man blind or lame, who has a marred face or any limb too long,
verses.textEnNlt: No one who has a defect qualifies, whether he is blind, lame, disfigured, deformed,
verses.textEnNasb: For no one who has an impairment shall approach: a man who is blind, or one who limps, or one who has a slit nose, or one with any conspicuous feature,
verses.textEn: No man who has any defect may come near: no man who is blind or lame, disfigured or deformed;

verses.textZh: 断脚断手的、
verses.textZhCnvs: 断脚断手的、
verses.textZhCuv: 折脚折手的、
verses.textEnNiv: no man with a crippled foot or hand,
verses.textEnEsv: or a man who has an injured foot or an injured hand,
verses.textEnNkjv: a man who has a broken foot or broken hand,
verses.textEnNlt: or has a broken foot or arm,
verses.textEnNasb: or someone who has a broken foot or broken hand,
verses.textEn: no man with a crippled foot or hand,

verses.textZh: 驼背、矮小、眼睛有毛病、长癣、生疹，或是肾子损坏的，都不可走近来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 驼背、矮小、眼睛有毛病、长癣、生疹，或是肾子损坏的，都不可走近来，
verses.textZhCuv: 驼背的、矮矬的、眼睛有毛病的、长癣的、长疥的，或是损坏肾子的，都不可近前来。
verses.textEnNiv: or who is a hunchback or a dwarf, or who has any eye defect, or who has festering or running sores or damaged testicles.
verses.textEnEsv: or a hunchback or a dwarf or a man with a defect in his sight or an itching disease or scabs or crushed testicles.
verses.textEnNkjv: or is a hunchback or a dwarf, or a man who has a defect in his eye, or eczema or scab, or is a eunuch.
verses.textEnNlt: or is hunchbacked or dwarfed, or has a defective eye, or skin sores or scabs, or damaged testicles.
verses.textEnNasb: or a contorted back, or one who is a dwarf, or has a spot in his eye, or a festering rash or scabs, or crushed testicles.
verses.textEn: or who is a hunchback or a dwarf, or who has any eye defect, or who has festering or running sores or damaged testicles.

verses.textZh: 亚伦祭司的后裔中，有残疾的，都不可上前来献耶和华的火祭；他既有残疾，就不可上前来献他的神的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦祭司的后裔中，有残疾的，都不可上前来献耶和华的火祭；他既有残疾，就不可上前来献他的神的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司亚伦的后裔，凡有残疾的，都不可近前来，将火祭献给耶和华。他有残疾，不可近前来献神的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has any defect is to come near to present the food offerings to the Lord . He has a defect; he must not come near to offer the food of his God.
verses.textEnEsv: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a blemish shall come near to offer the Lord ’s food offerings; since he has a blemish, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: No man of the descendants of Aaron the priest, who has a defect, shall come near to offer the offerings made by fire to the Lord. He has a defect; he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.
verses.textEnNlt: No descendant of Aaron who has a defect may approach the altar to present special gifts to the Lord . Since he has a defect, he may not approach the altar to offer food to his God.
verses.textEnNasb: No man among the descendants of Aaron the priest who has an impairment is to come forward to offer the Lord’s offerings by fire; since he has an impairment, he shall not come forward to offer the food of his God.
verses.textEn: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has any defect is to come near to present the food offerings to the Lord . He has a defect; he must not come near to offer the food of his God.

verses.textZh: 他神的食物，无论是至圣的或是圣的，他都可以吃；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他神的食物，无论是至圣的或是圣的，他都可以吃；
verses.textZhCuv: 神的食物，无论是圣的，至圣的，他都可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: He may eat the most holy food of his God, as well as the holy food;
verses.textEnEsv: He may eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy and of the holy things,
verses.textEnNkjv: He may eat the bread of his God, both the most holy and the holy;
verses.textEnNlt: However, he may eat from the food offered to God, including the holy offerings and the most holy offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: He may eat the food of his God, both of the most holy and of the holy,
verses.textEn: He may eat the most holy food of his God, as well as the holy food;

verses.textZh: 只因他有残疾，他就不可进到幔子前，也不可上前到我的祭坛那里，免得亵渎我的圣所；我是使他们分别为圣的耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只因他有残疾，他就不可进到幔子前，也不可上前到我的祭坛那里，免得亵渎我的圣所；我是使他们分别为圣的耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但不可进到幔子前，也不可就近坛前；因为他有残疾，免得亵渎我的圣所。我是叫他成圣的耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: yet because of his defect, he must not go near the curtain or approach the altar, and so desecrate my sanctuary. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: but he shall not go through the veil or approach the altar, because he has a blemish, that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the Lord who sanctifies them."
verses.textEnNkjv: only he shall not go near the veil or approach the altar, because he has a defect, lest he profane My sanctuaries; for I the Lord sanctify them.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Yet because of his physical defect, he may not enter the room behind the inner curtain or approach the altar, for this would defile my holy places. I am the Lord who makes them holy."
verses.textEnNasb: only he shall not come up to the veil or approach the altar, since he has an impairment, so that he does not profane My sanctuaries. For I am the Lord who sanctifies them.’ "
verses.textEn: yet because of his defect, he must not go near the curtain or approach the altar, and so desecrate my sanctuary. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是摩西告诉亚伦和亚伦的儿子，以及所有以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西告诉亚伦和亚伦的儿子，以及所有以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，摩西晓谕亚伦和亚伦的子孙，并以色列众人。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses told it to Aaron and his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses gave these instructions to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: So Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉亚伦和他的儿子，叫他们谨慎处理以色列人分别为圣归给我的圣物，免得他们亵渎我的圣名；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉亚伦和他的儿子，叫他们谨慎处理以色列人分别为圣归给我的圣物，免得他们亵渎我的圣名；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐亚伦和他子孙说：要远离以色列人所分别为圣、归给我的圣物，免得亵渎我的圣名。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings the Israelites consecrate to me, so they will not profane my holy name. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons so that they abstain from the holy things of the people of Israel, which they dedicate to me, so that they do not profane my holy name: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they do not profane My holy name by what they dedicate to Me: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell Aaron and his sons to be very careful with the sacred gifts that the Israelites set apart for me, so they do not bring shame on my holy name. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Tell Aaron and his sons to be careful with the holy gifts of the sons of Israel, which they dedicate to Me, so as not to profane My holy name; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings the Israelites consecrate to me, so they will not profane my holy name. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你要对他们说：你们世世代代的后裔中，若是不洁净，却接近以色列人分别为圣归耶和华的圣物，那人必从我面前被剪除；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对他们说：你们世世代代的后裔中，若是不洁净，却接近以色列人分别为圣归耶和华的圣物，那人必从我面前被剪除；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对他们说：你们世世代代的后裔，凡身上有污秽、亲近以色列人所分别为圣、归耶和华圣物的，那人必在我面前剪除。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to them: ‘For the generations to come, if any of your descendants is ceremonially unclean and yet comes near the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the Lord , that person must be cut off from my presence. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Say to them, ‘If any one of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things that the people of Israel dedicate to the Lord , while he has an uncleanness, that person shall be cut off from my presence: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Say to them: ‘Whoever of all your descendants throughout your generations, who goes near the holy things which the children of Israel dedicate to the Lord, while he has uncleanness upon him, that person shall be cut off from My presence: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Give them the following instructions. "In all future generations, if any of your descendants is ceremonially unclean when he approaches the sacred offerings that the people of Israel consecrate to the Lord , he must be cut off from my presence. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Say to them, ‘Any man among all your descendants throughout your generations who approaches the holy gifts which the sons of Israel consecrate to the Lord, while he has an uncleanness, that person shall be cut off from My presence; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Say to them: ‘For the generations to come, if any of your descendants is ceremonially unclean and yet comes near the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the Lord , that person must be cut off from my presence. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亚伦的后裔中，患了痲风病，或是血漏症的，都不可吃圣物，直到他洁净了；触摸了任何尸体的不洁或遗精的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的后裔中，患了痲风病，或是血漏症的，都不可吃圣物，直到他洁净了；触摸了任何尸体的不洁或遗精的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦的后裔，凡长大麻风的，或是有漏症的，不可吃圣物，直等他洁净了。无论谁摸那因死尸不洁净的物 ，或是遗精的人，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a descendant of Aaron has a defiling skin disease or a bodily discharge, he may not eat the sacred offerings until he is cleansed. He will also be unclean if he touches something defiled by a corpse or by anyone who has an emission of semen,
verses.textEnEsv: None of the offspring of Aaron who has a leprous disease or a discharge may eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean through contact with the dead or a man who has had an emission of semen,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Whatever man of the descendants of Aaron, who is a leper or has a discharge, shall not eat the holy offerings until he is clean. And whoever touches anything made unclean by a corpse, or a man who has had an emission of semen,
verses.textEnNlt: "If any of Aaron’s descendants has a skin disease or any kind of discharge that makes him ceremonially unclean, he may not eat from the sacred offerings until he has been pronounced clean. He also becomes unclean by touching a corpse, or by having an emission of semen,
verses.textEnNasb: No man of the descendants of Aaron, who has leprosy or has a discharge, may eat of the holy gifts until he is clean. And one who touches anything made unclean by a corpse, or a man who has a seminal emission,
verses.textEn: " ‘If a descendant of Aaron has a defiling skin disease or a bodily discharge, he may not eat the sacred offerings until he is cleansed. He will also be unclean if he touches something defiled by a corpse or by anyone who has an emission of semen,

verses.textZh: 或是触摸了任何使他玷污的爬虫，或是摸了使他成为不洁净的人 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是触摸了任何使他玷污的爬虫，或是摸了使他成为不洁净的人 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 或是摸什么使他不洁净的爬物，或是摸那使他不洁净的人（不拘那人有什么不洁净），
verses.textEnNiv: or if he touches any crawling thing that makes him unclean, or any person who makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be.
verses.textEnEsv: and whoever touches a swarming thing by which he may be made unclean or a person from whom he may take uncleanness, whatever his uncleanness may be—
verses.textEnNkjv: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he would be made unclean, or any person by whom he would become unclean, whatever his uncleanness may be—
verses.textEnNlt: or by touching a small animal that is unclean, or by touching someone who is ceremonially unclean for any reason.
verses.textEnNasb: or a man who touches any swarming things by which he is made unclean, or touches any person by whom he is made unclean, whatever his uncleanness;
verses.textEn: or if he touches any crawling thing that makes him unclean, or any person who makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be.

verses.textZh: 摸了这些的人，必不洁净到晚上；如果他不用水洗身，就不可吃圣物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摸了这些的人，必不洁净到晚上；如果他不用水洗身，就不可吃圣物。
verses.textZhCuv: 摸了这些人、物的，必不洁净到晚上；若不用水洗身，就不可吃圣物。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who touches any such thing will be unclean till evening. He must not eat any of the sacred offerings unless he has bathed himself with water.
verses.textEnEsv: the person who touches such a thing shall be unclean until the evening and shall not eat of the holy things unless he has bathed his body in water.
verses.textEnNkjv: the person who has touched any such thing shall be unclean until evening, and shall not eat the holy offerings unless he washes his body with water.
verses.textEnNlt: The man who is defiled in any of these ways will remain unclean until evening. He may not eat from the sacred offerings until he has bathed himself in water.
