verses.textEnNasb: a person who touches any such thing shall be unclean until evening, and shall not eat of the holy gifts unless he has bathed his body in water.
verses.textEn: The one who touches any such thing will be unclean till evening. He must not eat any of the sacred offerings unless he has bathed himself with water.

verses.textZh: 日落之后，他就洁净了，可以吃圣物，因为那是他的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日落之后，他就洁净了，可以吃圣物，因为那是他的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 日落的时候，他就洁净了，然后可以吃圣物，因为这是他的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: When the sun goes down, he will be clean, and after that he may eat the sacred offerings, for they are his food.
verses.textEnEsv: When the sun goes down he shall be clean, and afterward he may eat of the holy things, because they are his food.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the sun goes down he shall be clean; and afterward he may eat the holy offerings, because it is his food.
verses.textEnNlt: When the sun goes down, he will be ceremonially clean again and may eat from the sacred offerings, for this is his food.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the sun sets, he will be clean, and afterward he may eat of the holy gifts, for it is his food.
verses.textEn: When the sun goes down, he will be clean, and after that he may eat the sacred offerings, for they are his food.

verses.textZh: 自死的或是野兽撕裂的动物，他都不可吃，免得玷污自己；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自死的或是野兽撕裂的动物，他都不可吃，免得玷污自己；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 自死的或是被野兽撕裂的，他不可吃，因此污秽自己。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, and so become unclean through it. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He shall not eat what dies of itself or is torn by beasts, and so make himself unclean by it: I am the Lord .’
verses.textEnNkjv: Whatever dies naturally or is torn by beasts he shall not eat, to defile himself with it: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He may not eat an animal that has died a natural death or has been torn apart by wild animals, for this would defile him. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He shall not eat an animal which dies or is torn by animals, becoming unclean by it; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, and so become unclean through it. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们要谨守我的命令，免得他们因亵渎，担罪而死；我是使他们分别为圣的耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要谨守我的命令，免得他们因亵渎，担罪而死；我是使他们分别为圣的耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以他们要守我所吩咐的，免得轻忽了，因此担罪而死。我是叫他们成圣的耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The priests are to perform my service in such a way that they do not become guilty and die for treating it with contempt. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall therefore keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it and die thereby when they profane it: I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘They shall therefore keep My ordinance, lest they bear sin for it and die thereby, if they profane it: I the Lord sanctify them.
verses.textEnNlt: "The priests must follow my instructions carefully. Otherwise they will be punished for their sin and will die for violating my instructions. I am the Lord who makes them holy.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall therefore perform their duty to Me, so that they do not bear sin because of it and die by it because they profane it; I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
verses.textEn: " ‘The priests are to perform my service in such a way that they do not become guilty and die for treating it with contempt. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.

verses.textZh: "所有外族人都不可吃圣物；寄居在祭司家里的人或是受雇的雇工，都不可吃圣物。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所有外族人都不可吃圣物；寄居在祭司家里的人或是受雇的雇工，都不可吃圣物。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡外人不可吃圣物；寄居在祭司家的，或是雇工人，都不可吃圣物；
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘No one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired worker eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: "A lay person shall not eat of a holy thing; no foreign guest of the priest or hired worker shall eat of a holy thing,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘No outsider shall eat the holy offering; one who dwells with the priest, or a hired servant, shall not eat the holy thing.
verses.textEnNlt: "No one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offerings. Even guests and hired workers in a priest’s home are not allowed to eat them.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘No layman, however, is to eat the holy gift; a foreign resident with the priest or a hired worker shall not eat the holy gift.
verses.textEn: " ‘No one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired worker eat it.

verses.textZh: 但是祭司用自己银子买来的仆人，就可以吃圣物；生在祭司家里的人，他们可以吃他的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是祭司用自己银子买来的仆人，就可以吃圣物；生在祭司家里的人，他们可以吃他的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若祭司买人，是他的钱买的，那人就可以吃圣物；生在他家的人也可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: But if a priest buys a slave with money, or if slaves are born in his household, they may eat his food.
verses.textEnEsv: but if a priest buys a slave as his property for money, the slave may eat of it, and anyone born in his house may eat of his food.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the priest buys a person with his money, he may eat it; and one who is born in his house may eat his food.
verses.textEnNlt: However, if the priest buys a slave for himself, the slave may eat from the sacred offerings. And if his slaves have children, they also may share his food.
verses.textEnNasb: But if a priest buys a slave as his property with his money, that person may eat of it, and those who are born in his house may eat of his food.
verses.textEn: But if a priest buys a slave with money, or if slaves are born in his household, they may eat his food.

verses.textZh: 祭司的女儿若是嫁给外族人，就不可吃举祭的圣物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司的女儿若是嫁给外族人，就不可吃举祭的圣物。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司的女儿若嫁外人，就不可吃举祭的圣物。
verses.textEnNiv: If a priest’s daughter marries anyone other than a priest, she may not eat any of the sacred contributions.
verses.textEnEsv: If a priest’s daughter marries a layman, she shall not eat of the contribution of the holy things.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she may not eat of the holy offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: If a priest’s daughter marries someone outside the priestly family, she may no longer eat the sacred offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: If a priest’s daughter is married to a layman, she shall not eat of the offering of the holy gifts.
verses.textEn: If a priest’s daughter marries anyone other than a priest, she may not eat any of the sacred contributions.

verses.textZh: 但祭司的女儿若是寡妇，或是被休的，而且没有孩子，又回到自己的父家，像她年轻的时候一样，她就可以吃她父亲的食物；只是任何外族人都不可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但祭司的女儿若是寡妇，或是被休的，而且没有孩子，又回到自己的父家，像她年轻的时候一样，她就可以吃她父亲的食物；只是任何外族人都不可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 但祭司的女儿若是寡妇，或是被休的，没有孩子，又归回父家，与她青年一样，就可以吃她父亲的食物；只是外人不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: But if a priest’s daughter becomes a widow or is divorced, yet has no children, and she returns to live in her father’s household as in her youth, she may eat her father’s food. No unauthorized person, however, may eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: But if a priest’s daughter is widowed or divorced and has no child and returns to her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s food; yet no lay person shall eat of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the priest’s daughter is a widow or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat her father’s food; but no outsider shall eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: But if she becomes a widow or is divorced and has no children to support her, and she returns to live in her father’s home as in her youth, she may eat her father’s food again. Otherwise, no one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: But if a priest’s daughter becomes a widow or divorced, and has no child and returns to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s food; but no layman shall eat of it.
verses.textEn: But if a priest’s daughter becomes a widow or is divorced, yet has no children, and she returns to live in her father’s household as in her youth, she may eat her father’s food. No unauthorized person, however, may eat it.

verses.textZh: 人若是误吃了圣物，就要加上五分之一，与圣物一起交给祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若是误吃了圣物，就要加上五分之一，与圣物一起交给祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人误吃了圣物，要照圣物的原数加上五分之一交给祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Anyone who eats a sacred offering by mistake must make restitution to the priest for the offering and add a fifth of the value to it.
verses.textEnEsv: And if anyone eats of a holy thing unintentionally, he shall add the fifth of its value to it and give the holy thing to the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if a man eats the holy offering unintentionally, then he shall restore a holy offering to the priest, and add one-fifth to it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Any such person who eats the sacred offerings without realizing it must pay the priest for the amount eaten, plus an additional 20 percent.
verses.textEnNasb: If, however, someone eats a holy food unintentionally, then he shall add to it a fifth of it and shall give the holy food to the priest.
verses.textEn: " ‘Anyone who eats a sacred offering by mistake must make restitution to the priest for the offering and add a fifth of the value to it.

verses.textZh: 祭司不可亵渎以色列人献上给耶和华的圣物，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司不可亵渎以色列人献上给耶和华的圣物，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司不可亵渎以色列人所献给耶和华的圣物，
verses.textEnNiv: The priests must not desecrate the sacred offerings the Israelites present to the Lord
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not profane the holy things of the people of Israel, which they contribute to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not profane the holy offerings of the children of Israel, which they offer to the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: The priests must not let the Israelites defile the sacred offerings brought to the Lord
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall not profane the holy gifts of the sons of Israel, which they offer to the Lord,
verses.textEn: The priests must not desecrate the sacred offerings the Israelites present to the Lord

verses.textZh: 免得他们因吃了圣物而担当罪孽过犯；因为我是使他们分别为圣的耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得他们因吃了圣物而担当罪孽过犯；因为我是使他们分别为圣的耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 免得他们在吃圣物上自取罪孽，因为我是叫他们成圣的耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: by allowing them to eat the sacred offerings and so bring upon them guilt requiring payment. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and so cause them to bear iniquity and guilt, by eating their holy things: for I am the Lord who sanctifies them."
verses.textEnNkjv: or allow them to bear the guilt of trespass when they eat their holy offerings; for I the Lord sanctify them.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: by allowing unauthorized people to eat them. This would bring guilt upon them and require them to pay compensation. I am the Lord who makes them holy."
verses.textEnNasb: and thereby bring upon them punishment for guilt by eating their holy gifts; for I am the Lord who sanctifies them.’ "
verses.textEn: by allowing them to eat the sacred offerings and so bring upon them guilt requiring payment. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉亚伦和亚伦的儿子，以及所有以色列人，对他们说：任何以色列家的人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，奉献供物的时候，无论是为还愿，或是甘心献给耶和华的燔祭，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉亚伦和亚伦的儿子，以及所有以色列人，对他们说：任何以色列家的人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，奉献供物的时候，无论是为还愿，或是甘心献给耶和华的燔祭，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕亚伦和他子孙，并以色列众人说：以色列家中的人，或在以色列中寄居的，凡献供物，无论是所许的愿，是甘心献的，就是献给耶和华作燔祭的，
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: ‘If any of you—whether an Israelite or a foreigner residing in Israel—presents a gift for a burnt offering to the Lord , either to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the people of Israel and say to them, When any one of the house of Israel or of the sojourners in Israel presents a burnt offering as his offering, for any of their vows or freewill offerings that they offer to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘Whatever man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, who offers his sacrifice for any of his vows or for any of his freewill offerings, which they offer to the Lord as a burnt offering—
verses.textEnNlt: "Give Aaron and his sons and all the Israelites these instructions, which apply both to native Israelites and to the foreigners living among you. "If you present a gift as a burnt offering to the Lord , whether it is to fulfill a vow or is a voluntary offering,
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, and to all the sons of Israel, and say to them, ‘Anyone of the house of Israel or of the strangers in Israel who presents his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their voluntary offerings, which they present to the Lord as a burnt offering—
verses.textEn: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: ‘If any of you—whether an Israelite or a foreigner residing in Israel—presents a gift for a burnt offering to the Lord , either to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,

verses.textZh: 就要把没有残疾的公牛，或公绵羊，或公山羊献上，才蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就要把没有残疾的公牛，或公绵羊，或公山羊献上，才蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 要将没有残疾的公牛，或是绵羊，或是山羊献上，如此方蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: you must present a male without defect from the cattle, sheep or goats in order that it may be accepted on your behalf.
verses.textEnEsv: if it is to be accepted for you it shall be a male without blemish, of the bulls or the sheep or the goats.
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall offer of your own free will a male without blemish from the cattle, from the sheep, or from the goats.
verses.textEnNlt: you will be accepted only if your offering is a male animal with no defects. It may be a bull, a ram, or a male goat.
verses.textEnNasb: for you to be accepted—it must be a male without defect from the cattle, the sheep, or the goats.
verses.textEn: you must present a male without defect from the cattle, sheep or goats in order that it may be accepted on your behalf.

verses.textZh: 有残疾的，你们都不可献上，因为这是不蒙悦纳的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有残疾的，你们都不可献上，因为这是不蒙悦纳的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有残疾的，你们不可献上，因为这不蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not bring anything with a defect, because it will not be accepted on your behalf.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not offer anything that has a blemish, for it will not be acceptable for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whatever has a defect, you shall not offer, for it shall not be acceptable on your behalf.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not present an animal with defects, because the Lord will not accept it on your behalf.
verses.textEnNasb: Whatever has a defect, you shall not offer, for it will not be accepted for you.
verses.textEn: Do not bring anything with a defect, because it will not be accepted on your behalf.

verses.textZh: 人若是为了还愿，或是甘心把牛羊献给耶和华作平安祭，总要献上一只完全、没有任何瑕疵的祭物，才蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若是为了还愿，或是甘心把牛羊献给耶和华作平安祭，总要献上一只完全、没有任何瑕疵的祭物，才蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡从牛群或是羊群中，将平安祭献给耶和华，为要还特许的愿，或是作甘心献的，所献的必纯全无残疾的才蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: When anyone brings from the herd or flock a fellowship offering to the Lord to fulfill a special vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without defect or blemish to be acceptable.
verses.textEnEsv: And when anyone offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the Lord to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering from the herd or from the flock, to be accepted it must be perfect; there shall be no blemish in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever offers a sacrifice of a peace offering to the Lord, to fulfill his vow, or a freewill offering from the cattle or the sheep, it must be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no defect in it.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you present a peace offering to the Lord from the herd or the flock, whether it is to fulfill a vow or is a voluntary offering, you must offer a perfect animal. It may have no defect of any kind.
verses.textEnNasb: When someone offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the Lord to fulfill a special vow or for a voluntary offering, of the herd or of the flock, it must be without defect to be accepted; there shall be no defect in it.
verses.textEn: When anyone brings from the herd or flock a fellowship offering to the Lord to fulfill a special vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without defect or blemish to be acceptable.

verses.textZh: 瞎眼、折伤、残废、伤口溃疡、长癣或生疹的牲畜，你们都不可献给耶和华，不可把这些当作火祭放在祭坛上献给耶和华，
verses.textZhCnvs: 瞎眼、折伤、残废、伤口溃疡、长癣或生疹的牲畜，你们都不可献给耶和华，不可把这些当作火祭放在祭坛上献给耶和华，
verses.textZhCuv: 瞎眼的、折伤的、残废的、有瘤子的、长癣的、长疥的都不可献给耶和华，也不可在坛上作为火祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not offer to the Lord the blind, the injured or the maimed, or anything with warts or festering or running sores. Do not place any of these on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Animals blind or disabled or mutilated or having a discharge or an itch or scabs you shall not offer to the Lord or give them to the Lord as a food offering on the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those that are blind or broken or maimed, or have an ulcer or eczema or scabs, you shall not offer to the Lord, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: You must not offer an animal that is blind, crippled, or injured, or that has a wart, a skin sore, or scabs. Such animals must never be offered on the altar as special gifts to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Those that are blind, fractured, maimed, or have a wart, a festering rash, or scabs, you shall not offer to the Lord, nor make of them an offering by fire on the altar to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Do not offer to the Lord the blind, the injured or the maimed, or anything with warts or festering or running sores. Do not place any of these on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 无论是公牛或是绵羊羔，如果肢体畸形或有缺陷的，你可以作甘心祭献上；如果作还愿祭献上，就不蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是公牛或是绵羊羔，如果肢体畸形或有缺陷的，你可以作甘心祭献上；如果作还愿祭献上，就不蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是公牛是绵羊羔，若肢体有余的，或是缺少的，只可作甘心祭献上；用以还愿，却不蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: You may, however, present as a freewill offering an ox or a sheep that is deformed or stunted, but it will not be accepted in fulfillment of a vow.
verses.textEnEsv: You may present a bull or a lamb that has a part too long or too short for a freewill offering, but for a vow offering it cannot be accepted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Either a bull or a lamb that has any limb too long or too short you may offer as a freewill offering, but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.textEnNlt: If a bull or lamb has a leg that is too long or too short, it may be offered as a voluntary offering, but it may not be offered to fulfill a vow.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for an ox or a lamb which has an overgrown or stunted member, you may present it as a voluntary offering, but for a vow it will not be accepted.
verses.textEn: You may, however, present as a freewill offering an ox or a sheep that is deformed or stunted, but it will not be accepted in fulfillment of a vow.

verses.textZh: 内脏损伤、压碎、破裂，或割掉的，你们都不可献与耶和华；在你们将来居住的地方，你们不可行这样的事；
verses.textZhCnvs: 内脏损伤、压碎、破裂，或割掉的，你们都不可献与耶和华；在你们将来居住的地方，你们不可行这样的事；
verses.textZhCuv: 肾子损伤的，或是压碎的，或是破裂的，或是骟了的，不可献给耶和华，在你们的地上也不可这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: You must not offer to the Lord an animal whose testicles are bruised, crushed, torn or cut. You must not do this in your own land,
verses.textEnEsv: Any animal that has its testicles bruised or crushed or torn or cut you shall not offer to the Lord ; you shall not do it within your land,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not offer to the Lord what is bruised or crushed, or torn or cut; nor shall you make any offering of them in your land.
verses.textEnNlt: If an animal has damaged testicles or is castrated, you may not offer it to the Lord . You must never do this in your own land,
verses.textEnNasb: Also anything with its testicles squashed, crushed, torn off, or cut off, you shall not offer to the Lord, nor sacrifice in your land,
verses.textEn: You must not offer to the Lord an animal whose testicles are bruised, crushed, torn or cut. You must not do this in your own land,

verses.textZh: 也不可从外人手里接受这一类的牲畜，作你们神的食物；因为这些都有损坏，有残疾，必不蒙悦纳。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不可从外人手里接受这一类的牲畜，作你们神的食物；因为这些都有损坏，有残疾，必不蒙悦纳。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这类的物，你们从外人的手，一样也不可接受作你们神的食物献上；因为这些都有损坏，有残疾，不蒙悦纳。」
verses.textEnNiv: and you must not accept such animals from the hand of a foreigner and offer them as the food of your God. They will not be accepted on your behalf, because they are deformed and have defects.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: neither shall you offer as the bread of your God any such animals gotten from a foreigner. Since there is a blemish in them, because of their mutilation, they will not be accepted for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor from a foreigner’s hand shall you offer any of these as the bread of your God, because their corruption is in them, and defects are in them. They shall not be accepted on your behalf.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: and you must not accept such an animal from foreigners and then offer it as a sacrifice to your God. Such animals will not be accepted on your behalf, for they are mutilated or defective."
verses.textEnNasb: nor shall you offer any of these animals taken from the hand of a foreigner as the food of your God; for their deformity is in them, they have an impairment. They will not be accepted for you.’ "
verses.textEn: and you must not accept such animals from the hand of a foreigner and offer them as the food of your God. They will not be accepted on your behalf, because they are deformed and have defects.’ "

verses.textZh: "公牛或是绵羊或是山羊生下来以后，七天要与牠的母亲在一起，从第八天开始，牠就可以蒙悦纳，作献给耶和华火祭的供物。
verses.textZhCnvs: "公牛或是绵羊或是山羊生下来以后，七天要与牠的母亲在一起，从第八天开始，牠就可以蒙悦纳，作献给耶和华火祭的供物。
verses.textZhCuv: 「才生的公牛，或是绵羊或是山羊，七天当跟着母；从第八天以后，可以当供物蒙悦纳，作为耶和华的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: "When a calf, a lamb or a goat is born, it is to remain with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on, it will be acceptable as a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "When an ox or sheep or goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother, and from the eighth day on it shall be acceptable as a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "When a bull or a sheep or a goat is born, it shall be seven days with its mother; and from the eighth day and thereafter it shall be accepted as an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "When a calf or lamb or goat is born, it must be left with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on, it will be acceptable as a special gift to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "When an ox or a sheep or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother, and from the eighth day on it will be considered acceptable as a sacrifice of an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: "When a calf, a lamb or a goat is born, it is to remain with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on, it will be acceptable as a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 无论是牛或羊，你们都不可在同一日之内宰杀母和子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是牛或羊，你们都不可在同一日之内宰杀母和子。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是母牛是母羊，不可同日宰母和子。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not slaughter a cow or a sheep and its young on the same day.
verses.textEnEsv: But you shall not kill an ox or a sheep and her young in one day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whether it is a cow or ewe, do not kill both her and her young on the same day.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must not slaughter a mother animal and her offspring on the same day, whether from the herd or the flock.
verses.textEnNasb: But, whether it is an ox or a sheep, you shall not slaughter both it and its young in one day.
verses.textEn: Do not slaughter a cow or a sheep and its young on the same day.

verses.textZh: 如果你们献感恩祭给耶和华，要献得可蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们献感恩祭给耶和华，要献得可蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们献感谢祭给耶和华，要献得可蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: "When you sacrifice a thank offering to the Lord , sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.
verses.textEnEsv: And when you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the Lord , you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when you offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the Lord, offer it of your own free will.
verses.textEnNlt: When you bring a thanksgiving offering to the Lord , sacrifice it properly so you will be accepted.
verses.textEnNasb: When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the Lord, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
verses.textEn: "When you sacrifice a thank offering to the Lord , sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

verses.textZh: 祭肉要当天吃完，一点都不可留到早晨；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭肉要当天吃完，一点都不可留到早晨；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 要当天吃，一点不可留到早晨。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: It must be eaten that same day; leave none of it till morning. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until morning: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: On the same day it shall be eaten; you shall leave none of it until morning: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Eat the entire sacrificial animal on the day it is presented. Do not leave any of it until the next morning. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until morning. I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: It must be eaten that same day; leave none of it till morning. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要谨守遵行我的诫命；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨守遵行我的诫命；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要谨守遵行我的诫命。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Keep my commands and follow them. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "So you shall keep my commandments and do them: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall keep My commandments, and perform them: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must faithfully keep all my commands by putting them into practice, for I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall keep My commandments, and do them; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Keep my commands and follow them. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们不可亵渎我的圣名，我在以色列人中间要被尊为圣；我是使你们分别为圣的耶和华，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不可亵渎我的圣名，我在以色列人中间要被尊为圣；我是使你们分别为圣的耶和华，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不可亵渎我的圣名；我在以色列人中，却要被尊为圣。我是叫你们成圣的耶和华，
verses.textEnNiv: Do not profane my holy name, for I must be acknowledged as holy by the Israelites. I am the Lord , who made you holy
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not profane my holy name, that I may be sanctified among the people of Israel. I am the Lord who sanctifies you,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not profane My holy name, but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel. I am the Lord who sanctifies you,
verses.textEnNlt: Do not bring shame on my holy name, for I will display my holiness among the people of Israel. I am the Lord who makes you holy.
verses.textEnNasb: "And you shall not profane My holy name, but I will be sanctified among the sons of Israel; I am the Lord who sanctifies you,
verses.textEn: Do not profane my holy name, for I must be acknowledged as holy by the Israelites. I am the Lord , who made you holy

verses.textZh: 曾把你们从埃及地领出来，要作你们的神；我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 曾把你们从埃及地领出来，要作你们的神；我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 把你们从埃及地领出来，作你们的神。我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: and who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God: I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: It was I who rescued you from the land of Egypt, that I might be your God. I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: who brought you out from the land of Egypt, to be your God; I am the Lord."
verses.textEn: and who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord spoke again to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人，对他们说：我指定的节日，就是耶和华指定的节日，你们应当召集圣会。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人，对他们说：我指定的节日，就是耶和华指定的节日，你们应当召集圣会。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：耶和华的节期，你们要宣告为圣会的节期。
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘These are my appointed festivals, the appointed festivals of the Lord , which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, These are the appointed feasts of the Lord that you shall proclaim as holy convocations; they are my appointed feasts.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘The feasts of the Lord, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, these are My feasts.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. These are the Lord ’s appointed festivals, which you are to proclaim as official days for holy assembly.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘The Lord’s appointed times which you shall proclaim as holy convocations—My appointed times are these:
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘These are my appointed festivals, the appointed festivals of the Lord , which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies.

verses.textZh: "六日要工作，但第七日是完全休歇的安息日，应当有圣会；甚么工你们都不可作；在你们的一切住处，这日是归耶和华的安息日。
verses.textZhCnvs: "六日要工作，但第七日是完全休歇的安息日，应当有圣会；甚么工你们都不可作；在你们的一切住处，这日是归耶和华的安息日。
verses.textZhCuv: 六日要做工，第七日是圣安息日，当有圣会；你们什么工都不可做。这是在你们一切的住处向耶和华守的安息日。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘There are six days when you may work, but the seventh day is a day of sabbath rest, a day of sacred assembly. You are not to do any work; wherever you live, it is a sabbath to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation. You shall do no work. It is a Sabbath to the Lord in all your dwelling places.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Six days shall work be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation. You shall do no work on it; it is the Sabbath of the Lord in all your dwellings.
verses.textEnNlt: "You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but the seventh day is a Sabbath day of complete rest, an official day for holy assembly. It is the Lord ’s Sabbath day, and it must be observed wherever you live.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For six days work may be done, but on the seventh day there is a Sabbath of complete rest, a holy convocation. You shall not do any work; it is a Sabbath to the Lord in all your dwellings.
verses.textEn: " ‘There are six days when you may work, but the seventh day is a day of sabbath rest, a day of sacred assembly. You are not to do any work; wherever you live, it is a sabbath to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "以下是耶和华的节日，你们在这些指定的日期要召集圣会。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以下是耶和华的节日，你们在这些指定的日期要召集圣会。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的节期，就是你们到了日期要宣告为圣会的，乃是这些。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘These are the Lord ’s appointed festivals, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times:
verses.textEnEsv: "These are the appointed feasts of the Lord , the holy convocations, which you shall proclaim at the time appointed for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘These are the feasts of the Lord, holy convocations which you shall proclaim at their appointed times.
verses.textEnNlt: "In addition to the Sabbath, these are the Lord ’s appointed festivals, the official days for holy assembly that are to be celebrated at their proper times each year.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘These are the appointed times of the Lord, holy convocations which you shall proclaim at the times appointed for them.
verses.textEn: " ‘These are the Lord ’s appointed festivals, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times:

verses.textZh: "正月十四日黄昏的时候 ，是耶和华的逾越节。
verses.textZhCnvs: "正月十四日黄昏的时候 ，是耶和华的逾越节。
verses.textZhCuv: 「正月十四日，黄昏的时候，是耶和华的逾越节。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord ’s Passover begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEnEsv: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at twilight, is the Lord ’s Passover.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the fourteenth day of the first month at twilight is the Lord’s Passover.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord ’s Passover begins at sundown on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEnNasb: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at twilight is the Lord’s Passover.
verses.textEn: The Lord ’s Passover begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.

verses.textZh: 这月十五日是耶和华的无酵节；你们要吃无酵饼七日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这月十五日是耶和华的无酵节；你们要吃无酵饼七日。
verses.textZhCuv: 这月十五日是向耶和华守的无酵节；你们要吃无酵饼七日。
verses.textEnNiv: On the fifteenth day of that month the Lord ’s Festival of Unleavened Bread begins; for seven days you must eat bread made without yeast.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the Lord ; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the Lord; seven days you must eat unleavened bread.
verses.textEnNlt: On the next day, the fifteenth day of the month, you must begin celebrating the Festival of Unleavened Bread. This festival to the Lord continues for seven days, and during that time the bread you eat must be made without yeast.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the fifteenth day of the same month there is the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the Lord; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
verses.textEn: On the fifteenth day of that month the Lord ’s Festival of Unleavened Bread begins; for seven days you must eat bread made without yeast.

verses.textZh: 第一天应当有圣会，甚么劳碌的工你们都不可作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一天应当有圣会，甚么劳碌的工你们都不可作。
verses.textZhCuv: 第一日当有圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做；
verses.textEnNiv: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
verses.textEnEsv: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation; you shall not do any ordinary work.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no customary work on it.
verses.textEnNlt: On the first day of the festival, all the people must stop their ordinary work and observe an official day for holy assembly.
verses.textEnNasb: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation; you shall not do any laborious work.
verses.textEn: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

verses.textZh: 这七天你们要每天献火祭给耶和华；第七日应当有圣会，甚么劳碌的工你们都不可作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这七天你们要每天献火祭给耶和华；第七日应当有圣会，甚么劳碌的工你们都不可作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要将火祭献给耶和华七日。第七日是圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。」
verses.textEnNiv: For seven days present a food offering to the Lord . And on the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But you shall present a food offering to the Lord for seven days. On the seventh day is a holy convocation; you shall not do any ordinary work."
verses.textEnNkjv: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the Lord for seven days. The seventh day shall be a holy convocation; you shall do no customary work on it.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For seven days you must present special gifts to the Lord . On the seventh day the people must again stop all their ordinary work to observe an official day for holy assembly."
verses.textEnNasb: But for seven days you shall present an offering by fire to the Lord. On the seventh day is a holy convocation; you shall not do any laborious work.’ "
verses.textEn: For seven days present a food offering to the Lord . And on the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人，对他们说：你们到了我赐给你们的地，收割庄稼的时候，要把初熟庄稼的一捆带到祭司那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人，对他们说：你们到了我赐给你们的地，收割庄稼的时候，要把初熟庄稼的一捆带到祭司那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我赐给你们的地，收割庄稼的时候，要将初熟的庄稼一捆带给祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land I am going to give you and you reap its harvest, bring to the priest a sheaf of the first grain you harvest.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, When you come into the land that I give you and reap its harvest, you shall bring the sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When you come into the land which I give to you, and reap its harvest, then you shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. When you enter the land I am giving you and you harvest its first crops, bring the priest a bundle of grain from the first cutting of your grain harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you enter the land which I am going to give to you and you gather its harvest, then you shall bring in the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land I am going to give you and you reap its harvest, bring to the priest a sheaf of the first grain you harvest.

verses.textZh: 他要在耶和华面前摇禾捆，在安息日的次日把它摇一摇，使你们蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要在耶和华面前摇禾捆，在安息日的次日把它摇一摇，使你们蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要把这一捆在耶和华面前摇一摇，使你们得蒙悦纳。祭司要在安息日的次日把这捆摇一摇。
verses.textEnNiv: He is to wave the sheaf before the Lord so it will be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.
verses.textEnEsv: and he shall wave the sheaf before the Lord , so that you may be accepted. On the day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall wave the sheaf before the Lord, to be accepted on your behalf; on the day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.textEnNlt: On the day after the Sabbath, the priest will lift it up before the Lord so it may be accepted on your behalf.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall wave the sheaf before the Lord for you to be accepted; on the day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.textEn: He is to wave the sheaf before the Lord so it will be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.

verses.textZh: 你们摇禾捆的时候，要把一只一岁、没有瑕疵的公绵羊作燔祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们摇禾捆的时候，要把一只一岁、没有瑕疵的公绵羊作燔祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 摇这捆的日子，你们要把一岁、没有残疾的公绵羊羔献给耶和华为燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: On the day you wave the sheaf, you must sacrifice as a burnt offering to the Lord a lamb a year old without defect,
verses.textEnEsv: And on the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb a year old without blemish as a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall offer on that day, when you wave the sheaf, a male lamb of the first year, without blemish, as a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: On that same day you must sacrifice a one-year-old male lamb with no defects as a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb one year old without defect as a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: On the day you wave the sheaf, you must sacrifice as a burnt offering to the Lord a lamb a year old without defect,

verses.textZh: 同献的素祭，是调油的细面两公斤，献给耶和华作馨香的火祭；同献的奠祭，是一公斤酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 同献的素祭，是调油的细面两公斤，献给耶和华作馨香的火祭；同献的奠祭，是一公斤酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 同献的素祭，就是调油的细面伊法十分之二，作为馨香的火祭，献给耶和华。同献的奠祭，要酒一欣四分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: together with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil—a food offering presented to the Lord , a pleasing aroma—and its drink offering of a quarter of a hin of wine.
verses.textEnEsv: And the grain offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, a food offering to the Lord with a pleasing aroma, and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, a fourth of a hin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its grain offering shall be two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the Lord, for a sweet aroma; and its drink offering shall be of wine, one-fourth of a hin.
verses.textEnNlt: With it you must present a grain offering consisting of four quarts of choice flour moistened with olive oil. It will be a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord . You must also offer one quart of wine as a liquid offering.
verses.textEnNasb: Its grain offering shall then be two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering by fire to the Lordfor a soothing aroma, with its drink offering, a fourth of a hin of wine.
verses.textEn: together with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil—a food offering presented to the Lord , a pleasing aroma—and its drink offering of a quarter of a hin of wine.

verses.textZh: 无论是饼，是烘过的谷粒，或是新穗子，你们都不可吃，直等到你们把神的供物带来的那天，才可以吃；这要在你们的一切住处，作世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是饼，是烘过的谷粒，或是新穗子，你们都不可吃，直等到你们把神的供物带来的那天，才可以吃；这要在你们的一切住处，作世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是饼，是烘的子粒，是新穗子，你们都不可吃，直等到把你们献给神的供物带来的那一天才可以吃。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。」
verses.textEnNiv: You must not eat any bread, or roasted or new grain, until the very day you bring this offering to your God. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall eat neither bread nor grain parched or fresh until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat neither bread nor parched grain nor fresh grain until the same day that you have brought an offering to your God; it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not eat any bread or roasted grain or fresh kernels on that day until you bring this offering to your God. This is a permanent law for you, and it must be observed from generation to generation wherever you live.
verses.textEnNasb: Until this very day, until you have brought in the offering of your God, you shall eat neither bread nor roasted grain nor new produce. It is to be a permanent statute throughout your generations in all your dwelling places.
verses.textEn: You must not eat any bread, or roasted or new grain, until the very day you bring this offering to your God. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

verses.textZh: "你们要从安息日的次日，把禾捆带来作摇祭那日起，计算整整七个星期；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要从安息日的次日，把禾捆带来作摇祭那日起，计算整整七个星期；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要从安息日的次日，献禾捆为摇祭的那日算起，要满了七个安息日。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, count off seven full weeks.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall count seven full weeks from the day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And you shall count for yourselves from the day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.
verses.textEnNlt: "From the day after the Sabbath—the day you bring the bundle of grain to be lifted up as a special offering—count off seven full weeks.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall also count for yourselves from the day after the Sabbath, from the day when you brought in the sheaf of the wave offering; there shall be seven complete Sabbaths.
verses.textEn: " ‘From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, count off seven full weeks.

verses.textZh: 到第七个星期的次日，共计五十天；那天你们要献新的素祭给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到第七个星期的次日，共计五十天；那天你们要献新的素祭给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 到第七个安息日的次日，共计五十天，又要将新素祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Count off fifty days up to the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall count fifty days to the day after the seventh Sabbath. Then you shall present a grain offering of new grain to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Count fifty days to the day after the seventh Sabbath; then you shall offer a new grain offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Keep counting until the day after the seventh Sabbath, fifty days later. Then present an offering of new grain to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall count fifty days to the day after the seventh Sabbath; then you shall present a new grain offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Count off fifty days up to the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 要从你们的住处把两个饼带来作摇祭，每个是用细面两公斤，加酵烤成的，当作初熟之物献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要从你们的住处把两个饼带来作摇祭，每个是用细面两公斤，加酵烤成的，当作初熟之物献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 要从你们的住处取出细面伊法十分之二，加酵，烤成两个摇祭的饼，当作初熟之物献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: From wherever you live, bring two loaves made of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour, baked with yeast, as a wave offering of firstfruits to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall bring from your dwelling places two loaves of bread to be waved, made of two tenths of an ephah. They shall be of fine flour, and they shall be baked with leaven, as firstfruits to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall bring from your dwellings two wave loaves of two-tenths of an ephah. They shall be of fine flour; they shall be baked with leaven. They are the firstfruits to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: From wherever you live, bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up before the Lord as a special offering. Make these loaves from four quarts of choice flour, and bake them with yeast. They will be an offering to the Lord from the first of your crops.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall bring in from your dwelling places two loaves of bread as a wave offering, made of two-tenths of an ephah; they shall be of a fine flour, baked with leaven as first fruits to the Lord.
verses.textEn: From wherever you live, bring two loaves made of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour, baked with yeast, as a wave offering of firstfruits to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要把一岁、没有瑕疵的绵羊羔七只，公牛犊一头，公绵羊两只，作献给耶和华的燔祭，牠们和同献的素祭、奠祭，是献给耶和华作馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把一岁、没有瑕疵的绵羊羔七只，公牛犊一头，公绵羊两只，作献给耶和华的燔祭，牠们和同献的素祭、奠祭，是献给耶和华作馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要将一岁、没有残疾的羊羔七只、公牛犊一只、公绵羊两只，和饼一同奉上。这些与同献的素祭和奠祭要作为燔祭献给耶和华，就是作馨香的火祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Present with this bread seven male lambs, each a year old and without defect, one young bull and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the Lord , together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall present with the bread seven lambs a year old without blemish, and one bull from the herd and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the Lord , with their grain offering and their drink offerings, a food offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall offer with the bread seven lambs of the first year, without blemish, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be as a burnt offering to the Lord, with their grain offering and their drink offerings, an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Along with the bread, present seven one-year-old male lambs with no defects, one young bull, and two rams as burnt offerings to the Lord . These burnt offerings, together with the grain offerings and liquid offerings, will be a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Along with the bread you shall present seven one-year-old male lambs without defect, and a bull of the herd and two rams; they are to be a burnt offering to the Lord, with their grain offering and their drink offerings, an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Present with this bread seven male lambs, each a year old and without defect, one young bull and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the Lord , together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们又要献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，两只一岁的公绵羊作平安祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们又要献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，两只一岁的公绵羊作平安祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭，两只一岁的公绵羊羔为平安祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then sacrifice one male goat for a sin offering and two lambs, each a year old, for a fellowship offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old as a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall sacrifice one kid of the goats as a sin offering, and two male lambs of the first year as a sacrifice of a peace offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you must offer one male goat as a sin offering and two one-year-old male lambs as a peace offering.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also offer one male goat as a sin offering, and two male lambs one year old as a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.textEn: Then sacrifice one male goat for a sin offering and two lambs, each a year old, for a fellowship offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司要把这些祭物与初熟祭的饼，一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，这些是耶和华的圣物，应归给祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要把这些祭物与初熟祭的饼，一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，这些是耶和华的圣物，应归给祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要把这些和初熟麦子做的饼一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这是献与耶和华为圣物归给祭司的。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to wave the two lambs before the Lord as a wave offering, together with the bread of the firstfruits. They are a sacred offering to the Lord for the priest.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits as a wave offering before the Lord , with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the Lord for the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits as a wave offering before the Lord, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the Lord for the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: "The priest will lift up the two lambs as a special offering to the Lord , together with the loaves representing the first of your crops. These offerings, which are holy to the Lord , belong to the priests.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall then wave them with the bread of the first fruits as a wave offering with two lambs before the Lord; they are to be holy to the Lord for the priest.
verses.textEn: The priest is to wave the two lambs before the Lord as a wave offering, together with the bread of the firstfruits. They are a sacred offering to the Lord for the priest.

verses.textZh: 在这一天你们要宣布，这是你们的圣会，甚么劳碌的工你们都不可作。这要在你们一切住处，作世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这一天你们要宣布，这是你们的圣会，甚么劳碌的工你们都不可作。这要在你们一切住处，作世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 当这日，你们要宣告圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: On that same day you are to proclaim a sacred assembly and do no regular work. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make a proclamation on the same day. You shall hold a holy convocation. You shall not do any ordinary work. It is a statute forever in all your dwelling places throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall proclaim on the same day that it is a holy convocation to you. You shall do no customary work on it. It shall be a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNlt: That same day will be proclaimed an official day for holy assembly, a day on which you do no ordinary work. This is a permanent law for you, and it must be observed from generation to generation wherever you live.
verses.textEnNasb: On this very day you shall make a proclamation as well; you are to have a holy convocation. You shall do no laborious work. It is to be a permanent statute in all your dwelling places throughout your generations.
verses.textEn: On that same day you are to proclaim a sacred assembly and do no regular work. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

verses.textZh: "你们收割你们的庄稼的时候，不可把角落的谷物割尽，也不可拾取你收割时遗下的；把它们留给穷人和寄居的外人；我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们收割你们的庄稼的时候，不可把角落的谷物割尽，也不可拾取你收割时遗下的；把它们留给穷人和寄居的外人；我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「在你们的地收割庄稼，不可割尽田角，也不可拾取所遗落的；要留给穷人和寄居的。我是耶和华－你们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and for the foreigner residing among you. I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not reap your field right up to its edge, nor shall you gather the gleanings after your harvest. You shall leave them for the poor and for the sojourner: I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field when you reap, nor shall you gather any gleaning from your harvest. You shall leave them for the poor and for the stranger: I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "When you harvest the crops of your land, do not harvest the grain along the edges of your fields, and do not pick up what the harvesters drop. Leave it for the poor and the foreigners living among you. I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, moreover, you shall not reap to the very edges of your field nor gather the gleaning of your harvest; you are to leave them for the needy and the stranger. I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEn: " ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and for the foreigner residing among you. I am the Lord your God.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Again the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人：七月初一，你们必须完全休歇，要吹号筒作记念，应当有圣会。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人：七月初一，你们必须完全休歇，要吹号筒作记念，应当有圣会。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：七月初一，你们要守为圣安息日，要吹角作纪念，当有圣会。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of sabbath rest, a sacred assembly commemorated with trumpet blasts.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall observe a day of solemn rest, a memorial proclaimed with blast of trumpets, a holy convocation.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a sabbath-rest, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. On the first day of the appointed month in early autumn, you are to observe a day of complete rest. It will be an official day for holy assembly, a day commemorated with loud blasts of a trumpet.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month on the first of the month you shall have a rest, a reminder by blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
verses.textEn: "Say to the Israelites: ‘On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of sabbath rest, a sacred assembly commemorated with trumpet blasts.

verses.textZh: 甚么劳碌的工你们都不可作；你们要献火祭给耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚么劳碌的工你们都不可作；你们要献火祭给耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 什么劳碌的工都不可做；要将火祭献给耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do no regular work, but present a food offering to the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not do any ordinary work, and you shall present a food offering to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall do no customary work on it; and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You must do no ordinary work on that day. Instead, you are to present special gifts to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not do any laborious work, but you shall present an offering by fire to the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: Do no regular work, but present a food offering to the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "七月初十是赎罪日；你们应当有圣会，要刻苦己心，献火祭给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: "七月初十是赎罪日；你们应当有圣会，要刻苦己心，献火祭给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 「七月初十是赎罪日；你们要守为圣会，并要刻苦己心，也要将火祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. Hold a sacred assembly and deny yourselves, and present a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Now on the tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. It shall be for you a time of holy convocation, and you shall afflict yourselves and present a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also the tenth day of this seventh month shall be the Day of Atonement. It shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Be careful to celebrate the Day of Atonement on the tenth day of that same month—nine days after the Festival of Trumpets. You must observe it as an official day for holy assembly, a day to deny yourselves and present special gifts to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "On exactly the tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement; it shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall humble yourselves and present an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: "The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. Hold a sacred assembly and deny yourselves, and present a food offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 在这一天，甚么工你们都不可作，因为这是赎罪日，要在耶和华你们的神面前为你们赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这一天，甚么工你们都不可作，因为这是赎罪日，要在耶和华你们的神面前为你们赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 当这日，什么工都不可做；因为是赎罪日，要在耶和华－你们的神面前赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not do any work on that day, because it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not do any work on that very day, for it is a Day of Atonement, to make atonement for you before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall do no work on that same day, for it is the Day of Atonement, to make atonement for you before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Do no work during that entire day because it is the Day of Atonement, when offerings of purification are made for you, making you right with the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not do any work on this very day, for it is a Day of Atonement, to make atonement on your behalf before the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Do not do any work on that day, because it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 在这一天，不刻苦己心的人，必从他的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这一天，不刻苦己心的人，必从他的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 当这日，凡不刻苦己心的，必从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who do not deny themselves on that day must be cut off from their people.
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever is not afflicted on that very day shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: For any person who is not afflicted in soul on that same day shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEnNlt: All who do not deny themselves that day will be cut off from God’s people.
verses.textEnNasb: If there is any person who does not humble himself on this very day, he shall be cut off from his people.
verses.textEn: Those who do not deny themselves on that day must be cut off from their people.

verses.textZh: 在这一天，作甚么工的人，我必把他从自己的族人中间消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这一天，作甚么工的人，我必把他从自己的族人中间消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡这日做什么工的，我必将他从民中除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: I will destroy from among their people anyone who does any work on that day.
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever does any work on that very day, that person I will destroy from among his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And any person who does any work on that same day, that person I will destroy from among his people.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will destroy anyone among you who does any work on that day.
verses.textEnNasb: As for any person who does any work on this very day, that person I will eliminate from among his people.
verses.textEn: I will destroy from among their people anyone who does any work on that day.

verses.textZh: 甚么工你们都不可作，这要在你们的一切住处作世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚么工你们都不可作，这要在你们的一切住处作世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们什么工都不可做。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: You shall do no work at all. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not do any work. It is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwelling places.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall do no manner of work; it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.textEnNlt: You must not do any work at all! This is a permanent law for you, and it must be observed from generation to generation wherever you live.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not do any work. It is to be a permanent statute throughout your generations in all your dwelling places.
verses.textEn: You shall do no work at all. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

verses.textZh: 这是你们完全休歇的安息日，并要刻苦己心；从这月初九晚上，到次日晚上，你们要守安息日。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是你们完全休歇的安息日，并要刻苦己心；从这月初九晚上，到次日晚上，你们要守安息日。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要守这日为圣安息日，并要刻苦己心。从这月初九日晚上到次日晚上，要守为安息日。」
verses.textEnNiv: It is a day of sabbath rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to observe your sabbath."
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be to you a Sabbath of solemn rest, and you shall afflict yourselves. On the ninth day of the month beginning at evening, from evening to evening shall you keep your Sabbath."
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be to you a sabbath of solemn rest, and you shall afflict your souls; on the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall celebrate your sabbath."
verses.textEnNlt: This will be a Sabbath day of complete rest for you, and on that day you must deny yourselves. This day of rest will begin at sundown on the ninth day of the month and extend until sundown on the tenth day."
verses.textEnNasb: It is to be a Sabbath of complete rest for you, and you shall humble yourselves; on the ninth of the month at evening, from evening until evening, you shall keep your Sabbath."
verses.textEn: It is a day of sabbath rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to observe your sabbath."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Again the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人：七月十五日是住棚节，要在耶和华面前守这七天的节期。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人：七月十五日是住棚节，要在耶和华面前守这七天的节期。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：这七月十五日是住棚节，要在耶和华面前守这节七日。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Israelites: ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month the Lord ’s Festival of Tabernacles begins, and it lasts for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month and for seven days is the Feast of Booths to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. Begin celebrating the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the appointed month—five days after the Day of Atonement. This festival to the Lord will last for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘On the fifteenth of this seventh month is the Feast of Booths for seven days to the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Say to the Israelites: ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month the Lord ’s Festival of Tabernacles begins, and it lasts for seven days.

verses.textZh: 第一天应当有圣会；甚么劳碌的工你们都不可作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一天应当有圣会；甚么劳碌的工你们都不可作。
verses.textZhCuv: 第一日当有圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。
verses.textEnNiv: The first day is a sacred assembly; do no regular work.
verses.textEnEsv: On the first day shall be a holy convocation; you shall not do any ordinary work.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the first day there shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work on it.
verses.textEnNlt: On the first day of the festival you must proclaim an official day for holy assembly, when you do no ordinary work.
verses.textEnNasb: On the first day is a holy convocation; you shall not do any laborious work.
verses.textEn: The first day is a sacred assembly; do no regular work.

verses.textZh: 这七天你们每天都要献火祭给耶和华；第八天应当有圣会，要献火祭给耶和华，这是集会的日子，甚么劳碌的工都不可作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这七天你们每天都要献火祭给耶和华；第八天应当有圣会，要献火祭给耶和华，这是集会的日子，甚么劳碌的工都不可作。
verses.textZhCuv: 七日内要将火祭献给耶和华。第八日当守圣会，要将火祭献给耶和华。这是严肃会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。
verses.textEnNiv: For seven days present food offerings to the Lord , and on the eighth day hold a sacred assembly and present a food offering to the Lord . It is the closing special assembly; do no regular work.
verses.textEnEsv: For seven days you shall present food offerings to the Lord . On the eighth day you shall hold a holy convocation and present a food offering to the Lord . It is a solemn assembly; you shall not do any ordinary work.
verses.textEnNkjv: For seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the Lord. On the eighth day you shall have a holy convocation, and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the Lord. It is a sacred assembly, and you shall do no customary work on it.
verses.textEnNlt: For seven days you must present special gifts to the Lord . The eighth day is another holy day on which you present your special gifts to the Lord . This will be a solemn occasion, and no ordinary work may be done that day.
verses.textEnNasb: For seven days you shall present an offering by fire to the Lord. On the eighth day you shall have a holy convocation and present an offering by fire to the Lord; it is an assembly. You shall not do any laborious work.
verses.textEn: For seven days present food offerings to the Lord , and on the eighth day hold a sacred assembly and present a food offering to the Lord . It is the closing special assembly; do no regular work.

verses.textZh: "以上是耶和华的节日，你们应当召集圣会，照着每日的规定献火祭给耶和华，就是燔祭、素祭、平安祭和奠祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以上是耶和华的节日，你们应当召集圣会，照着每日的规定献火祭给耶和华，就是燔祭、素祭、平安祭和奠祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「这是耶和华的节期，就是你们要宣告为圣会的节期；要将火祭、燔祭、素祭、祭物，并奠祭，各归各日，献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: (" ‘These are the Lord ’s appointed festivals, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies for bringing food offerings to the Lord —the burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings required for each day.
verses.textEnEsv: "These are the appointed feasts of the Lord , which you shall proclaim as times of holy convocation, for presenting to the Lord food offerings, burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings, each on its proper day,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘These are the feasts of the Lord which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the Lord, a burnt offering and a grain offering, a sacrifice and drink offerings, everything on its day—
verses.textEnNlt: ("These are the Lord ’s appointed festivals. Celebrate them each year as official days for holy assembly by presenting special gifts to the Lord —burnt offerings, grain offerings, sacrifices, and liquid offerings—each on its proper day.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘These are the appointed times of the Lord which you shall proclaim as holy convocations, to present offerings by fire to the Lord—burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings, each day’s matter on its own day—
verses.textEn: (" ‘These are the Lord ’s appointed festivals, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies for bringing food offerings to the Lord —the burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings required for each day.

verses.textZh: 此外，还有耶和华的安息日，你们的供物，你们的一切还愿祭和甘心献的祭，这些是你们当献给耶和华的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，还有耶和华的安息日，你们的供物，你们的一切还愿祭和甘心献的祭，这些是你们当献给耶和华的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是在耶和华的安息日以外，又在你们的供物和所许的愿，并甘心献给耶和华的以外。
verses.textEnNiv: These offerings are in addition to those for the Lord ’s Sabbaths and in addition to your gifts and whatever you have vowed and all the freewill offerings you give to the Lord .)
verses.textEnEsv: besides the Lord ’s Sabbaths and besides your gifts and besides all your vow offerings and besides all your freewill offerings, which you give to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: besides the Sabbaths of the Lord, besides your gifts, besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill offerings which you give to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: These festivals must be observed in addition to the Lord ’s regular Sabbath days, and the offerings are in addition to your personal gifts, the offerings you give to fulfill your vows, and the voluntary offerings you present to the Lord .)
verses.textEnNasb: besides those of the Sabbaths of the Lord, and besides your gifts and besides all your vowed and voluntary offerings, which you give to the Lord.
verses.textEn: These offerings are in addition to those for the Lord ’s Sabbaths and in addition to your gifts and whatever you have vowed and all the freewill offerings you give to the Lord .)

verses.textZh: "又在七月十五日，你们收了那地的出产以后，要守耶和华的节七日，第一天要完全休歇，第八天也要完全休歇。
verses.textZhCnvs: "又在七月十五日，你们收了那地的出产以后，要守耶和华的节七日，第一天要完全休歇，第八天也要完全休歇。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们收藏了地的出产，就从七月十五日起，要守耶和华的节七日。第一日为圣安息；第八日也为圣安息。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘So beginning with the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the crops of the land, celebrate the festival to the Lord for seven days; the first day is a day of sabbath rest, and the eighth day also is a day of sabbath rest.
verses.textEnEsv: "On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the produce of the land, you shall celebrate the feast of the Lord seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Also on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruit of the land, you shall keep the feast of the Lord for seven days; on the first day there shall be a sabbath-rest, and on the eighth day a sabbath-rest.
verses.textEnNlt: "Remember that this seven-day festival to the Lord —the Festival of Shelters—begins on the fifteenth day of the appointed month, after you have harvested all the produce of the land. The first day and the eighth day of the festival will be days of complete rest.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘On exactly the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the crops of the land, you shall celebrate the feast of the Lord for seven days, with a rest on the first day and a rest on the eighth day.
verses.textEn: " ‘So beginning with the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the crops of the land, celebrate the festival to the Lord for seven days; the first day is a day of sabbath rest, and the eighth day also is a day of sabbath rest.

verses.textZh: 第一天你们要拿果树的美果、棕树枝、茂密的大树枝和溪边的杨柳枝，在耶和华你们的神面前欢乐七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一天你们要拿果树的美果、棕树枝、茂密的大树枝和溪边的杨柳枝，在耶和华你们的神面前欢乐七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 第一日要拿美好树上的果子和棕树上的枝子，与茂密树的枝条并河旁的柳枝，在耶和华－你们的神面前欢乐七日。
verses.textEnNiv: On the first day you are to take branches from luxuriant trees—from palms, willows and other leafy trees—and rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall take on the first day the fruit of splendid trees, branches of palm trees and boughs of leafy trees and willows of the brook, and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take for yourselves on the first day the fruit of beautiful trees, branches of palm trees, the boughs of leafy trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: On the first day gather branches from magnificent trees —palm fronds, boughs from leafy trees, and willows that grow by the streams. Then celebrate with joy before the Lord your God for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the first day you shall take for yourselves the foliage of beautiful trees, palm branches and branches of trees with thick branches and willows of the brook, and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days.
verses.textEn: On the first day you are to take branches from luxuriant trees—from palms, willows and other leafy trees—and rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days.

verses.textZh: 你们每年七月，要守耶和华这七天的节期，这是你们世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们每年七月，要守耶和华这七天的节期，这是你们世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 每年七月间，要向耶和华守这节七日。这为你们世世代代永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: Celebrate this as a festival to the Lord for seven days each year. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come; celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall celebrate it as a feast to the Lord for seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations; you shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall keep it as a feast to the Lord for seven days in the year. It shall be a statute forever in your generations. You shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.textEnNlt: You must observe this festival to the Lord for seven days every year. This is a permanent law for you, and it must be observed in the appointed month from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall celebrate it as a feast to the Lord for seven days in the year. It shall be a permanent statute throughout your generations; you shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.textEn: Celebrate this as a festival to the Lord for seven days each year. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come; celebrate it in the seventh month.

verses.textZh: 你们要住在棚里七天；以色列所有的本地人都要住在棚里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要住在棚里七天；以色列所有的本地人都要住在棚里，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要住在棚里七日；凡以色列家的人都要住在棚里，
verses.textEnNiv: Live in temporary shelters for seven days: All native-born Israelites are to live in such shelters
verses.textEnEsv: You shall dwell in booths for seven days. All native Israelites shall dwell in booths,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall dwell in booths for seven days. All who are native Israelites shall dwell in booths,
verses.textEnNlt: For seven days you must live outside in little shelters. All native-born Israelites must live in shelters.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall live in booths for seven days; all the native-born in Israel shall live in booths,
verses.textEn: Live in temporary shelters for seven days: All native-born Israelites are to live in such shelters

verses.textZh: 好叫你们世世代代知道，我领以色列人出埃及地的时候，曾经使他们住在棚里；我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 好叫你们世世代代知道，我领以色列人出埃及地的时候，曾经使他们住在棚里；我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫你们世世代代知道，我领以色列人出埃及地的时候曾使他们住在棚里。我是耶和华－你们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: so your descendants will know that I had the Israelites live in temporary shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: that your generations may know that I made the people of Israel dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: This will remind each new generation of Israelites that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I rescued them from the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNasb: so that your generations may know that I had the sons of Israel live in booths when I brought them out from the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEn: so your descendants will know that I had the Israelites live in temporary shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是摩西把耶和华指定的节日告诉了以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西把耶和华指定的节日告诉了以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，摩西将耶和华的节期传给以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses announced to the Israelites the appointed festivals of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Moses declared to the people of Israel the appointed feasts of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the feasts of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses gave the Israelites these instructions regarding the annual festivals of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses declared to the sons of Israel the appointed times of the Lord.
verses.textEn: So Moses announced to the Israelites the appointed festivals of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列人，把点灯用的榨成的纯净橄榄油，拿来给你，使灯火长燃。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐以色列人，把点灯用的榨成的纯净橄榄油，拿来给你，使灯火长燃。
verses.textZhCuv: 「要吩咐以色列人，把那为点灯捣成的清橄榄油拿来给你，使灯常常点着。
verses.textEnNiv: "Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning continually.
verses.textEnEsv: "Command the people of Israel to bring you pure oil from beaten olives for the lamp, that a light may be kept burning regularly.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Command the children of Israel that they bring to you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to make the lamps burn continually.
verses.textEnNlt: "Command the people of Israel to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
verses.textEnNasb: "Command the sons of Israel that they bring to you clear oil from beaten olives for the light, to make a lamp burn continually.
verses.textEn: "Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning continually.

verses.textZh: 在会幕中法柜的幔子外，亚伦要使这灯在耶和华面前通宵达旦地长燃；这是你们世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在会幕中法柜的幔子外，亚伦要使这灯在耶和华面前通宵达旦地长燃；这是你们世世代代永远的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 在会幕中法柜的幔子外，亚伦从晚上到早晨必在耶和华面前经理这灯。这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: Outside the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law in the tent of meeting, Aaron is to tend the lamps before the Lord from evening till morning, continually. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.
verses.textEnEsv: Outside the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, Aaron shall arrange it from evening to morning before the Lord regularly. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: Outside the veil of the Testimony, in the tabernacle of meeting, Aaron shall be in charge of it from evening until morning before the Lord continually; it shall be a statute forever in your generations.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the lampstand that stands in the Tabernacle, in front of the inner curtain that shields the Ark of the Covenant. Aaron must keep the lamps burning in the Lord ’s presence all night. This is a permanent law for you, and it must be observed from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: Outside the veil of the testimony in the tent of meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the Lord continually; it shall be a permanent statute throughout your generations.
verses.textEn: Outside the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law in the tent of meeting, Aaron is to tend the lamps before the Lord from evening till morning, continually. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

verses.textZh: 亚伦要不断地在耶和华面前，整理纯金灯台 上的灯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦要不断地在耶和华面前，整理纯金灯台 上的灯。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要在耶和华面前常收拾精金灯台上的灯。」
