verses.textEnNiv: The lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the Lord must be tended continually.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall arrange the lamps on the lampstand of pure gold before the Lord regularly.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall be in charge of the lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the Lord continually.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron and the priests must tend the lamps on the pure gold lampstand continually in the Lord ’s presence.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall keep the lamps in order on the pure gold lampstand before the Lord continually.
verses.textEn: The lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the Lord must be tended continually.

verses.textZh: "你要取细面烤成十二个饼，每一个饼用两公斤细面。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要取细面烤成十二个饼，每一个饼用两公斤细面。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要取细面，烤成十二个饼，每饼用面伊法十分之二。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the finest flour and bake twelve loaves of bread, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall take fine flour and bake twelve loaves from it; two tenths of an ephah shall be in each loaf.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall take fine flour and bake twelve cakes with it. Two-tenths of an ephah shall be in each cake.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must bake twelve flat loaves of bread from choice flour, using four quarts of flour for each loaf.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you shall take fine flour and bake twelve cakes with it; two-tenths of an ephah shall be in each cake.
verses.textEn: "Take the finest flour and bake twelve loaves of bread, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf.

verses.textZh: 你要把饼摆列成两排，每排六个，放在耶和华面前精金的桌子 上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把饼摆列成两排，每排六个，放在耶和华面前精金的桌子 上；
verses.textZhCuv: 要把饼摆列两行 ，每行六个，在耶和华面前精金的桌子上；
verses.textEnNiv: Arrange them in two stacks, six in each stack, on the table of pure gold before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall set them in two piles, six in a pile, on the table of pure gold before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall set them in two rows, six in a row, on the pure gold table before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Place the bread before the Lord on the pure gold table, and arrange the loaves in two stacks, with six loaves in each stack.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall set them in two rows, six to a row, on the pure gold table before the Lord.
verses.textEn: Arrange them in two stacks, six in each stack, on the table of pure gold before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 把纯乳香放在每排饼上，象征这些饼作献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把纯乳香放在每排饼上，象征这些饼作献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把净乳香放在每行饼上，作为纪念，就是作为火祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: By each stack put some pure incense as a memorial portion to represent the bread and to be a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall put pure frankincense on each pile, that it may go with the bread as a memorial portion as a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Put some pure frankincense near each stack to serve as a representative offering, a special gift presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall put pure frankincense on each row so that it may be a memorial portion for the bread, an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: By each stack put some pure incense as a memorial portion to represent the bread and to be a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 每一个安息日，亚伦都要把饼摆在耶和华面前，不可间断，这是以色列人永远的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每一个安息日，亚伦都要把饼摆在耶和华面前，不可间断，这是以色列人永远的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 每安息日要常摆在耶和华面前；这为以色列人作永远的约。
verses.textEnNiv: This bread is to be set out before the Lord regularly, Sabbath after Sabbath, on behalf of the Israelites, as a lasting covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: Every Sabbath day Aaron shall arrange it before the Lord regularly; it is from the people of Israel as a covenant forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every Sabbath he shall set it in order before the Lord continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: Every Sabbath day this bread must be laid out before the Lord as a gift from the Israelites; it is an ongoing expression of the eternal covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the Lord continually; it is an everlasting covenant for the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: This bread is to be set out before the Lord regularly, Sabbath after Sabbath, on behalf of the Israelites, as a lasting covenant.

verses.textZh: 这饼要归给亚伦和他的子孙，他们要在圣洁的地方吃，因为这是至圣的，在献给耶和华的火祭中，他永远的分。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这饼要归给亚伦和他的子孙，他们要在圣洁的地方吃，因为这是至圣的，在献给耶和华的火祭中，他永远的分。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这饼是要给亚伦和他子孙的；他们要在圣处吃，为永远的定例，因为在献给耶和华的火祭中是至圣的。」
verses.textEnNiv: It belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in the sanctuary area, because it is a most holy part of their perpetual share of the food offerings presented to the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place, since it is for him a most holy portion out of the Lord ’s food offerings, a perpetual due."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him from the offerings of the Lord made by fire, by a perpetual statute."
verses.textEnNlt: The loaves of bread will belong to Aaron and his descendants, who must eat them in a sacred place, for they are most holy. It is the permanent right of the priests to claim this portion of the special gifts presented to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him from the Lord’s offerings by fire, his portion forever."
verses.textEn: It belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in the sanctuary area, because it is a most holy part of their perpetual share of the food offerings presented to the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 有一个以色列妇人的儿子，父亲是埃及人，在以色列人中间出入；这以色列妇人的儿子在营里和一个以色列人争吵；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个以色列妇人的儿子，父亲是埃及人，在以色列人中间出入；这以色列妇人的儿子在营里和一个以色列人争吵；
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个以色列妇人的儿子，他父亲是埃及人，一日闲游在以色列人中。这以色列妇人的儿子和一个以色列人在营里争斗。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father went out among the Israelites, and a fight broke out in the camp between him and an Israelite.
verses.textEnEsv: Now an Israelite woman’s son, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the people of Israel. And the Israelite woman’s son and a man of Israel fought in the camp,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and this Israelite woman’s son and a man of Israel fought each other in the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: One day a man who had an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father came out of his tent and got into a fight with one of the Israelite men.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the son of an Israelite woman—his father was an Egyptian—went out among the sons of Israel; and the Israelite woman’s son and an Israelite man had a fight within the camp.
verses.textEn: Now the son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father went out among the Israelites, and a fight broke out in the camp between him and an Israelite.

verses.textZh: 这以色列妇人的儿子亵渎耶和华的名，咒诅耶和华的名，人就把他带到摩西那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这以色列妇人的儿子亵渎耶和华的名，咒诅耶和华的名，人就把他带到摩西那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 这以色列妇人的儿子亵渎了圣名，并且咒诅，就有人把他送到摩西那里。（他母亲名叫示罗密，是但支派底伯利的女儿。）
verses.textEnNiv: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse; so they brought him to Moses. (His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri the Danite.)
verses.textEnEsv: and the Israelite woman’s son blasphemed the Name, and cursed. Then they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Israelite woman’s son blasphemed the name of the Lord and cursed; and so they brought him to Moses. (His mother’s name was Shelomith the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.)
verses.textEnNlt: During the fight, this son of an Israelite woman blasphemed the Name of the Lord with a curse. So the man was brought to Moses for judgment. His mother was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri of the tribe of Dan.
verses.textEnNasb: And the son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name and cursed. So they brought him to Moses. (Now his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.)
verses.textEn: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse; so they brought him to Moses. (His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri the Danite.)

verses.textZh: 他们拘留看守那人，等候耶和华给他们的指示。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们拘留看守那人，等候耶和华给他们的指示。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们把那人收在监里，要得耶和华所指示的话。
verses.textEnNiv: They put him in custody until the will of the Lord should be made clear to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they put him in custody, till the will of the Lord should be clear to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they put him in custody, that the mind of the Lord might be shown to them.
verses.textEnNlt: They kept the man in custody until the Lord ’s will in the matter should become clear to them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they put him in custody, waiting for Moses to give them a clear decision in accordance with the command of the Lord.
verses.textEn: They put him in custody until the will of the Lord should be made clear to them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses:

verses.textZh: "把那咒诅圣名的人拉出营外，听见的人都按手在他头上。然后全体会众要扔石头打死他。
verses.textZhCnvs: "把那咒诅圣名的人拉出营外，听见的人都按手在他头上。然后全体会众要扔石头打死他。
verses.textZhCuv: 「把那咒诅圣名的人带到营外。叫听见的人都放手在他头上；全会众就要用石头打死他。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the blasphemer outside the camp. All those who heard him are to lay their hands on his head, and the entire assembly is to stone him.
verses.textEnEsv: "Bring out of the camp the one who cursed, and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take outside the camp him who has cursed; then let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take the blasphemer outside the camp, and tell all those who heard the curse to lay their hands on his head. Then let the entire community stone him to death.
verses.textEnNasb: "Bring the one who has cursed outside the camp, and have all who heard him lay their hands on his head; then have all the congregation stone him.
verses.textEn: "Take the blasphemer outside the camp. All those who heard him are to lay their hands on his head, and the entire assembly is to stone him.

verses.textZh: 你要告诉以色列人：咒诅神的，必担当自己的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要告诉以色列人：咒诅神的，必担当自己的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要晓谕以色列人说：凡咒诅神的，必担当他的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to the Israelites: ‘Anyone who curses their God will be held responsible;
verses.textEnEsv: And speak to the people of Israel, saying, Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Say to the people of Israel: Those who curse their God will be punished for their sin.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone curses his God, then he will bear the responsibility for his sin.
verses.textEn: Say to the Israelites: ‘Anyone who curses their God will be held responsible;

verses.textZh: 亵渎耶和华圣名的人，必被处死，全体会众要扔石头打他；不论是寄居的外人或是本地人，如果亵渎圣名，必被处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亵渎耶和华圣名的人，必被处死，全体会众要扔石头打他；不论是寄居的外人或是本地人，如果亵渎圣名，必被处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 那亵渎耶和华名的，必被治死；全会众总要用石头打死他。不管是寄居的是本地人，他亵渎耶和华名的时候，必被治死。
verses.textEnNiv: anyone who blasphemes the name of the Lord is to be put to death. The entire assembly must stone them. Whether foreigner or native-born, when they blaspheme the Name they are to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever blasphemes the name of the Lord shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him. The sojourner as well as the native, when he blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever blasphemes the name of the Lord shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him, the stranger as well as him who is born in the land. When he blasphemes the name of the Lord, he shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who blasphemes the Name of the Lord must be stoned to death by the whole community of Israel. Any native-born Israelite or foreigner among you who blasphemes the Name of the Lord must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the one who blasphemes the name of the Lord must be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him. The stranger as well as the native, when he blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.
verses.textEn: anyone who blasphemes the name of the Lord is to be put to death. The entire assembly must stone them. Whether foreigner or native-born, when they blaspheme the Name they are to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 打死人的，必被处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 打死人的，必被处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 打死人的，必被治死；
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Anyone who takes the life of a human being is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever takes a human life shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Whoever kills any man shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who takes another person’s life must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if someone takes any human life, he must be put to death.
verses.textEn: " ‘Anyone who takes the life of a human being is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 打死牲畜的，必要赔偿牲畜，以命偿命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 打死牲畜的，必要赔偿牲畜，以命偿命。
verses.textZhCuv: 打死牲畜的，必赔上牲畜，以命偿命。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who takes the life of someone’s animal must make restitution—life for life.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever takes an animal’s life shall make it good, life for life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever kills an animal shall make it good, animal for animal.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who kills another person’s animal must pay for it in full—a live animal for the animal that was killed.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who takes the life of an animal shall make restitution, life for life.
verses.textEn: Anyone who takes the life of someone’s animal must make restitution—life for life.

verses.textZh: 如果有人使他的同伴伤残；他怎样待人，人也必怎样待他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人使他的同伴伤残；他怎样待人，人也必怎样待他；
verses.textZhCuv: 人若使他邻舍的身体有残疾，他怎样行，也要照样向他行：
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who injures their neighbor is to be injured in the same manner:
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone injures his neighbor, as he has done it shall be done to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If a man causes disfigurement of his neighbor, as he has done, so shall it be done to him—
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who injures another person must be dealt with according to the injury inflicted—
verses.textEnNasb: If someone injures his neighbor, just as he has done, so shall it be done to him:
verses.textEn: Anyone who injures their neighbor is to be injured in the same manner:

verses.textZh: 以伤还伤，以眼还眼，以牙还牙；他怎样使人伤残，人也必怎样使他伤残。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以伤还伤，以眼还眼，以牙还牙；他怎样使人伤残，人也必怎样使他伤残。
verses.textZhCuv: 以伤还伤，以眼还眼，以牙还牙。他怎样叫人的身体有残疾，也要照样向他行。
verses.textEnNiv: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. The one who has inflicted the injury must suffer the same injury.
verses.textEnEsv: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; whatever injury he has given a person shall be given to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he has caused disfigurement of a man, so shall it be done to him.
verses.textEnNlt: a fracture for a fracture, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. Whatever anyone does to injure another person must be paid back in kind.
verses.textEnNasb: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; just as he has injured a person, so shall it be inflicted on him.
verses.textEn: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. The one who has inflicted the injury must suffer the same injury.

verses.textZh: 打死牲畜的，必要赔偿牲畜；打死人的，必被处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 打死牲畜的，必要赔偿牲畜；打死人的，必被处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 打死牲畜的，必赔上牲畜；打死人的，必被治死。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a human being is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever kills an animal shall make it good, and whoever kills a person shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever kills an animal shall restore it; but whoever kills a man shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: "Whoever kills an animal must pay for it in full, but whoever kills another person must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: So the one who kills an animal shall make restitution, but the one who kills a person shall be put to death.
verses.textEn: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a human being is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 无论是寄居的或是本地人，你们都应一律对待，因为我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是寄居的或是本地人，你们都应一律对待，因为我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不管是寄居的是本地人，同归一例。我是耶和华－你们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: You are to have the same law for the foreigner and the native-born. I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: You shall have the same rule for the sojourner and for the native, for I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall have the same law for the stranger and for one from your own country; for I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "This same standard applies both to native-born Israelites and to the foreigners living among you. I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNasb: There shall be only one standard for you; it shall be for the stranger as well as the native, for I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEn: You are to have the same law for the foreigner and the native-born. I am the Lord your God.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是摩西告诉了以色列人，他们就把那咒诅圣名的人带出营外，扔石头打死他。以色列人遵行了耶和华给摩西的吩咐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西告诉了以色列人，他们就把那咒诅圣名的人带出营外，扔石头打死他。以色列人遵行了耶和华给摩西的吩咐。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，摩西晓谕以色列人，他们就把那咒诅圣名的人带到营外，用石头打死。以色列人就照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites, and they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him. The Israelites did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses spoke to the people of Israel, and they brought out of the camp the one who had cursed and stoned him with stones. Thus the people of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they took outside the camp him who had cursed, and stoned him with stones. So the children of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: After Moses gave all these instructions to the Israelites, they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him to death. The Israelites did just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and they brought the one who had cursed outside the camp, and stoned him with stones. So the sons of Israel did just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites, and they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him. The Israelites did as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在西奈山对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在西奈山对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在西奈山对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses at Mount Sinai,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: While Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord said to him,
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord then spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses at Mount Sinai,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人，对他们说：你们到了我赐给你们的那地以后，地要守耶和华的安息。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人，对他们说：你们到了我赐给你们的那地以后，地要守耶和华的安息。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所赐你们那地的时候，地就要向耶和华守安息。
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land I am going to give you, the land itself must observe a sabbath to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, When you come into the land that I give you, the land shall keep a Sabbath to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a sabbath to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. When you have entered the land I am giving you, the land itself must observe a Sabbath rest before the Lord every seventh year.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you come into the land which I am going to give you, then the land shall have a Sabbath to the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land I am going to give you, the land itself must observe a sabbath to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 六年之内，你要耕种田地；六年之内，你要修剪葡萄园，收藏地的出产；
verses.textZhCnvs: 六年之内，你要耕种田地；六年之内，你要修剪葡萄园，收藏地的出产；
verses.textZhCuv: 六年要耕种田地，也要修理葡萄园，收藏地的出产。
verses.textEnNiv: For six years sow your fields, and for six years prune your vineyards and gather their crops.
verses.textEnEsv: For six years you shall sow your field, and for six years you shall prune your vineyard and gather in its fruits,
verses.textEnNkjv: Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and gather its fruit;
verses.textEnNlt: For six years you may plant your fields and prune your vineyards and harvest your crops,
verses.textEnNasb: For six years you shall sow your field, and for six years you shall prune your vineyard and gather in its produce,
verses.textEn: For six years sow your fields, and for six years prune your vineyards and gather their crops.

verses.textZh: 但是第七年，地要完全休歇，享受耶和华的安息；你不可耕种田地，也不可修剪葡萄园。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是第七年，地要完全休歇，享受耶和华的安息；你不可耕种田地，也不可修剪葡萄园。
verses.textZhCuv: 第七年，地要守圣安息，就是向耶和华守的安息，不可耕种田地，也不可修理葡萄园。
verses.textEnNiv: But in the seventh year the land is to have a year of sabbath rest, a sabbath to the Lord . Do not sow your fields or prune your vineyards.
verses.textEnEsv: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the Lord . You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
verses.textEnNkjv: but in the seventh year there shall be a sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a sabbath to the Lord. You shall neither sow your field nor prune your vineyard.
verses.textEnNlt: but during the seventh year the land must have a Sabbath year of complete rest. It is the Lord ’s Sabbath. Do not plant your fields or prune your vineyards during that year.
verses.textEnNasb: but during the seventh year the land shall have a Sabbath rest, a Sabbath to the Lord; you shall not sow your field nor prune your vineyard.
verses.textEn: But in the seventh year the land is to have a year of sabbath rest, a sabbath to the Lord . Do not sow your fields or prune your vineyards.

verses.textZh: 你收割以后自然生长的庄稼，你不可收割；没有修剪的葡萄树果子，你也不可采摘；这一年，地要完全休歇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你收割以后自然生长的庄稼，你不可收割；没有修剪的葡萄树果子，你也不可采摘；这一年，地要完全休歇。
verses.textZhCuv: 遗落自长的庄稼不可收割；没有修理的葡萄树也不可摘取葡萄。这年，地要守圣安息。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the grapes of your untended vines. The land is to have a year of rest.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not reap what grows of itself in your harvest, or gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: What grows of its own accord of your harvest you shall not reap, nor gather the grapes of your untended vine, for it is a year of rest for the land.
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t store away the crops that grow on their own or gather the grapes from your unpruned vines. The land must have a year of complete rest.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not reap your harvest’s aftergrowth, and you shall not gather your grapes of untrimmed vines; the land shall have a sabbatical year.
verses.textEn: Do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the grapes of your untended vines. The land is to have a year of rest.

verses.textZh: 地在安息年的自然出产，是给你们作食物的；就是给你，你的仆婢、雇工和寄居的，就是与你们一起居住的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 地在安息年的自然出产，是给你们作食物的；就是给你，你的仆婢、雇工和寄居的，就是与你们一起居住的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 地在安息年所出的，要给你和你的仆人、婢女、雇工人，并寄居的外人当食物。
verses.textEnNiv: Whatever the land yields during the sabbath year will be food for you—for yourself, your male and female servants, and the hired worker and temporary resident who live among you,
verses.textEnEsv: The Sabbath of the land shall provide food for you, for yourself and for your male and female slaves and for your hired worker and the sojourner who lives with you,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sabbath produce of the land shall be food for you: for you, your male and female servants, your hired man, and the stranger who dwells with you,
verses.textEnNlt: But you may eat whatever the land produces on its own during its Sabbath. This applies to you, your male and female servants, your hired workers, and the temporary residents who live with you.
verses.textEnNasb: All of you shall have the Sabbath produce of the land as food; for yourself, your male and female slaves, and your hired worker and your foreign resident, those who live as strangers among you.
verses.textEn: Whatever the land yields during the sabbath year will be food for you—for yourself, your male and female servants, and the hired worker and temporary resident who live among you,

verses.textZh: 甚至你的牲畜，以及你那地的走兽，都以安息年的出产作食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚至你的牲畜，以及你那地的走兽，都以安息年的出产作食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 这年的土产也要给你的牲畜和你地上的走兽当食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: as well as for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. Whatever the land produces may be eaten.
verses.textEnEsv: and for your cattle and for the wild animals that are in your land: all its yield shall be for food.
verses.textEnNkjv: for your livestock and the beasts that are in your land—all its produce shall be for food.
verses.textEnNlt: Your livestock and the wild animals in your land will also be allowed to eat what the land produces.
verses.textEnNasb: Even your cattle and the animals that are in your land shall have all its produce to eat.
verses.textEn: as well as for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. Whatever the land produces may be eaten.

verses.textZh: "你又要为自己计算七个安息年，就是七个七年，你经过了七个安息年，四十九年的日子以后，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你又要为自己计算七个安息年，就是七个七年，你经过了七个安息年，四十九年的日子以后，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要计算七个安息年，就是七七年。这便为你成了七个安息年，共是四十九年。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Count off seven sabbath years—seven times seven years—so that the seven sabbath years amount to a period of forty-nine years.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall count seven weeks of years, seven times seven years, so that the time of the seven weeks of years shall give you forty-nine years.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And you shall count seven sabbaths of years for yourself, seven times seven years; and the time of the seven sabbaths of years shall be to you forty-nine years.
verses.textEnNlt: "In addition, you must count off seven Sabbath years, seven sets of seven years, adding up to forty-nine years in all.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You are also to count off seven Sabbaths of years for yourself, seven times seven years, so that you have the time of the seven Sabbaths of years, that is, forty-nine years.
verses.textEn: " ‘Count off seven sabbath years—seven times seven years—so that the seven sabbath years amount to a period of forty-nine years.

verses.textZh: 在七月初十，你要吹角，在赎罪日，角声要响遍你的全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在七月初十，你要吹角，在赎罪日，角声要响遍你的全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 当年七月初十日，你要大发角声；这日就是赎罪日，要在遍地发出角声。
verses.textEnNiv: Then have the trumpet sounded everywhere on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement sound the trumpet throughout your land.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall cause the trumpet of the Jubilee to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement you shall make the trumpet to sound throughout all your land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then on the Day of Atonement in the fiftieth year, blow the ram’s horn loud and long throughout the land.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall then sound a ram’s horn abroad on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement you shall sound a horn all through your land.
verses.textEn: Then have the trumpet sounded everywhere on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement sound the trumpet throughout your land.

verses.textZh: 你们要把第五十年分别为圣，向全地所有居民宣布自由；这一年是你们的禧年，你们各人要归回自己的地业，归回自己的父家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把第五十年分别为圣，向全地所有居民宣布自由；这一年是你们的禧年，你们各人要归回自己的地业，归回自己的父家。
verses.textZhCuv: 第五十年，你们要当作圣年，在遍地给一切的居民宣告自由。这年必为你们的禧年，各人要归自己的产业，各归本家。
verses.textEnNiv: Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you; each of you is to return to your family property and to your own clan.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall consecrate the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you, when each of you shall return to his property and each of you shall return to his clan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall consecrate the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a Jubilee for you; and each of you shall return to his possession, and each of you shall return to his family.
verses.textEnNlt: Set this year apart as holy, a time to proclaim freedom throughout the land for all who live there. It will be a jubilee year for you, when each of you may return to the land that belonged to your ancestors and return to your own clan.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim a release throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you, and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.
verses.textEn: Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you; each of you is to return to your family property and to your own clan.

verses.textZh: 第五十年是你们的禧年；这一年你们不可耕种，也不可收割自然生长的，也不可采摘没有修剪的葡萄树果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第五十年是你们的禧年；这一年你们不可耕种，也不可收割自然生长的，也不可采摘没有修剪的葡萄树果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 第五十年要作为你们的禧年。这年不可耕种；地中自长的，不可收割；没有修理的葡萄树也不可摘取葡萄。
verses.textEnNiv: The fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for you; do not sow and do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the untended vines.
verses.textEnEsv: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for you; in it you shall neither sow nor reap what grows of itself nor gather the grapes from the undressed vines.
verses.textEnNkjv: That fiftieth year shall be a Jubilee to you; in it you shall neither sow nor reap what grows of its own accord, nor gather the grapes of your untended vine.
verses.textEnNlt: This fiftieth year will be a jubilee for you. During that year you must not plant your fields or store away any of the crops that grow on their own, and don’t gather the grapes from your unpruned vines.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall have the fiftieth year as a jubilee; you shall not sow, nor harvest its aftergrowth, nor gather grapes from its untrimmed vines.
verses.textEn: The fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for you; do not sow and do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the untended vines.

verses.textZh: 因为这是禧年，你们要当作圣年；你们可以吃地里的出产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这是禧年，你们要当作圣年；你们可以吃地里的出产。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这是禧年，你们要当作圣年，吃地中自出的土产。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is a jubilee and is to be holy for you; eat only what is taken directly from the fields.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is a jubilee. It shall be holy to you. You may eat the produce of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it is the Jubilee; it shall be holy to you; you shall eat its produce from the field.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be a jubilee year for you, and you must keep it holy. But you may eat whatever the land produces on its own.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat its produce from the field.
verses.textEn: For it is a jubilee and is to be holy for you; eat only what is taken directly from the fields.

verses.textZh: "在这禧年中，你们各人要归回自己的地业。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在这禧年中，你们各人要归回自己的地业。
verses.textZhCuv: 「这禧年，你们各人要归自己的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘In this Year of Jubilee everyone is to return to their own property.
verses.textEnEsv: "In this year of jubilee each of you shall return to his property.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘In this Year of Jubilee, each of you shall return to his possession.
verses.textEnNlt: In the Year of Jubilee each of you may return to the land that belonged to your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘On this year of jubilee each of you shall return to his own property.
verses.textEn: " ‘In this Year of Jubilee everyone is to return to their own property.

verses.textZh: 如果你卖甚么给邻舍，或是从邻舍的手里买甚么，你们不可欺负对方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你卖甚么给邻舍，或是从邻舍的手里买甚么，你们不可欺负对方。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若卖什么给邻舍，或是从邻舍的手中买什么，彼此不可亏负。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If you sell land to any of your own people or buy land from them, do not take advantage of each other.
verses.textEnEsv: And if you make a sale to your neighbor or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you sell anything to your neighbor or buy from your neighbor’s hand, you shall not oppress one another.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you make an agreement with your neighbor to buy or sell property, you must not take advantage of each other.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, if you make a sale to your friend, or buy from your friend’s hand, you shall not wrong one another.
verses.textEn: " ‘If you sell land to any of your own people or buy land from them, do not take advantage of each other.

verses.textZh: 你要按照下一个禧年以前还剩余的年数向邻舍买；他也要按照这年数可得的出产价值卖给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要按照下一个禧年以前还剩余的年数向邻舍买；他也要按照这年数可得的出产价值卖给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要按禧年以后的年数向邻舍买；他也要按年数的收成卖给你。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to buy from your own people on the basis of the number of years since the Jubilee. And they are to sell to you on the basis of the number of years left for harvesting crops.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall pay your neighbor according to the number of years after the jubilee, and he shall sell to you according to the number of years for crops.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor, and according to the number of years of crops he shall sell to you.
verses.textEnNlt: When you buy land from your neighbor, the price you pay must be based on the number of years since the last jubilee. The seller must set the price by taking into account the number of years remaining until the next Year of Jubilee.
verses.textEnNasb: Corresponding to the number of years after the jubilee, you shall buy from your friend; he is to sell to you according to the number of years of crops.
verses.textEn: You are to buy from your own people on the basis of the number of years since the Jubilee. And they are to sell to you on the basis of the number of years left for harvesting crops.

verses.textZh: 年数多，你付的买价就要增多。年数少，你付的买价就要减少。因为他是按出产的数值卖给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 年数多，你付的买价就要增多。年数少，你付的买价就要减少。因为他是按出产的数值卖给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 年岁若多，要照数加添价值；年岁若少，要照数减去价值，因为他照收成的数目卖给你。
verses.textEnNiv: When the years are many, you are to increase the price, and when the years are few, you are to decrease the price, because what is really being sold to you is the number of crops.
verses.textEnEsv: If the years are many, you shall increase the price, and if the years are few, you shall reduce the price, for it is the number of the crops that he is selling to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to the multitude of years you shall increase its price, and according to the fewer number of years you shall diminish its price; for he sells to you according to the number of the years of the crops.
verses.textEnNlt: The more years until the next jubilee, the higher the price; the fewer years, the lower the price. After all, the person selling the land is actually selling you a certain number of harvests.
verses.textEnNasb: In proportion to a greater number of years you shall increase its price, and in proportion to fewer years you shall decrease its price, because it is the number of crops that he is selling to you.
verses.textEn: When the years are many, you are to increase the price, and when the years are few, you are to decrease the price, because what is really being sold to you is the number of crops.

verses.textZh: 你们不可欺负对方，却要敬畏你的神，因为我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不可欺负对方，却要敬畏你的神，因为我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们彼此不可亏负，只要敬畏你们的神，因为我是耶和华－你们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God, for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall not oppress one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Show your fear of God by not taking advantage of each other. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God. I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "所以你们要遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，遵照奉行，就可以在那地安然居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所以你们要遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，遵照奉行，就可以在那地安然居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我的律例，你们要遵行，我的典章，你们要谨守，就可以在那地上安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Follow my decrees and be careful to obey my laws, and you will live safely in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore you shall do my statutes and keep my rules and perform them, and then you will dwell in the land securely.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘So you shall observe My statutes and keep My judgments, and perform them; and you will dwell in the land in safety.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you want to live securely in the land, follow my decrees and obey my regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall therefore follow My statutes and keep My judgments so as to carry them out, so that you may live securely on the land.
verses.textEn: " ‘Follow my decrees and be careful to obey my laws, and you will live safely in the land.

verses.textZh: 地必生产果实，你们就可以吃饱，在那地安然居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地必生产果实，你们就可以吃饱，在那地安然居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 地必出土产，你们就要吃饱，在那地上安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the land will yield its fruit, and you will eat your fill and live there in safety.
verses.textEnEsv: The land will yield its fruit, and you will eat your fill and dwell in it securely.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the land will yield its fruit, and you will eat your fill, and dwell there in safety.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the land will yield large crops, and you will eat your fill and live securely in it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the land will yield its produce, so that you can eat your fill and live securely on it.
verses.textEn: Then the land will yield its fruit, and you will eat your fill and live there in safety.

verses.textZh: 如果你们问：在第七年我们不耕种，也不收藏我们的出产，我们吃甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们问：在第七年我们不耕种，也不收藏我们的出产，我们吃甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若说：『这第七年我们不耕种，也不收藏土产，吃什么呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: You may ask, "What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not plant or harvest our crops?"
verses.textEnEsv: And if you say, ‘What shall we eat in the seventh year, if we may not sow or gather in our crop?’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if you say, "What shall we eat in the seventh year, since we shall not sow nor gather in our produce?"
verses.textEnNlt: But you might ask, ‘What will we eat during the seventh year, since we are not allowed to plant or harvest crops that year?’
verses.textEnNasb: But if you say, "What are we going to eat in the seventh year if we do not sow nor gather in our produce?"
verses.textEn: You may ask, "What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not plant or harvest our crops?"

verses.textZh: 在第六年，我必命我的福临到你们，地就会生产足够三年食用的出产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在第六年，我必命我的福临到你们，地就会生产足够三年食用的出产。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必在第六年将我所命的福赐给你们，地便生三年的土产。
verses.textEnNiv: I will send you such a blessing in the sixth year that the land will yield enough for three years.
verses.textEnEsv: I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, so that it will produce a crop sufficient for three years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will command My blessing on you in the sixth year, and it will bring forth produce enough for three years.
verses.textEnNlt: Be assured that I will send my blessing for you in the sixth year, so the land will produce a crop large enough for three years.
verses.textEnNasb: then I will so order My blessing for you in the sixth year that it will bring forth the produce for three years.
verses.textEn: I will send you such a blessing in the sixth year that the land will yield enough for three years.

verses.textZh: 第八年你们耕种时，仍有旧粮吃；直到第九年，收成新粮的时候，你还有旧粮可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第八年你们耕种时，仍有旧粮吃；直到第九年，收成新粮的时候，你还有旧粮可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 第八年，你们要耕种，也要吃陈粮，等到第九年出产收来的时候，你们还吃陈粮。」
verses.textEnNiv: While you plant during the eighth year, you will eat from the old crop and will continue to eat from it until the harvest of the ninth year comes in.
verses.textEnEsv: When you sow in the eighth year, you will be eating some of the old crop; you shall eat the old until the ninth year, when its crop arrives.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall sow in the eighth year, and eat old produce until the ninth year; until its produce comes in, you shall eat of the old harvest.
verses.textEnNlt: When you plant your fields in the eighth year, you will still be eating from the large crop of the sixth year. In fact, you will still be eating from that large crop when the new crop is harvested in the ninth year.
verses.textEnNasb: When you are sowing the eighth year, you can still eat old things from the produce, eating the old until the ninth year when its produce comes in.
verses.textEn: While you plant during the eighth year, you will eat from the old crop and will continue to eat from it until the harvest of the ninth year comes in.

verses.textZh: "地不可永远卖掉，因为地是我的；你们在我面前不过是寄居的和客旅。
verses.textZhCnvs: "地不可永远卖掉，因为地是我的；你们在我面前不过是寄居的和客旅。
verses.textZhCuv: 「地不可永卖，因为地是我的；你们在我面前是客旅，是寄居的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The land must not be sold permanently, because the land is mine and you reside in my land as foreigners and strangers.
verses.textEnEsv: "The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine. For you are strangers and sojourners with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘The land shall not be sold permanently, for the land is Mine; for you are strangers and sojourners with Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "The land must never be sold on a permanent basis, for the land belongs to me. You are only foreigners and tenant farmers working for me.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The land, moreover, shall not be sold permanently, because the land is Mine; for you are only strangers and residents with Me.
verses.textEn: " ‘The land must not be sold permanently, because the land is mine and you reside in my land as foreigners and strangers.

verses.textZh: 在你们所得为业的全地，你们应该让人有赎地的权利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你们所得为业的全地，你们应该让人有赎地的权利。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你们所得为业的全地，也要准人将地赎回。
verses.textEnNiv: Throughout the land that you hold as a possession, you must provide for the redemption of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And in all the country you possess, you shall allow a redemption of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in all the land of your possession you shall grant redemption of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: "With every purchase of land you must grant the seller the right to buy it back.
verses.textEnNasb: So for every piece of your property, you are to provide for the redemption of the land.
verses.textEn: Throughout the land that you hold as a possession, you must provide for the redemption of the land.

verses.textZh: 如果你的兄弟贫穷，卖了部分地业，他的至亲可以来，把兄弟所卖的赎回。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你的兄弟贫穷，卖了部分地业，他的至亲可以来，把兄弟所卖的赎回。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的弟兄 若渐渐穷乏，卖了几分地业，他至近的亲属就要来把弟兄所卖的赎回。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If one of your fellow Israelites becomes poor and sells some of their property, their nearest relative is to come and redeem what they have sold.
verses.textEnEsv: "If your brother becomes poor and sells part of his property, then his nearest redeemer shall come and redeem what his brother has sold.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If one of your brethren becomes poor, and has sold some of his possession, and if his redeeming relative comes to redeem it, then he may redeem what his brother sold.
verses.textEnNlt: If one of your fellow Israelites falls into poverty and is forced to sell some family land, then a close relative should buy it back for him.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘If a fellow countryman of yours becomes so poor that he sells part of his property, then his closest redeemer is to come and buy back what his relative has sold.
verses.textEn: " ‘If one of your fellow Israelites becomes poor and sells some of their property, their nearest relative is to come and redeem what they have sold.

verses.textZh: 如果没有代赎人，而他自己的经济能力改善，足够把地赎回，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果没有代赎人，而他自己的经济能力改善，足够把地赎回，
verses.textZhCuv: 若没有能给他赎回的，他自己渐渐富足，能够赎回，
verses.textEnNiv: If, however, there is no one to redeem it for them but later on they prosper and acquire sufficient means to redeem it themselves,
verses.textEnEsv: If a man has no one to redeem it and then himself becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,
verses.textEnNkjv: Or if the man has no one to redeem it, but he himself becomes able to redeem it,
verses.textEnNlt: If there is no close relative to buy the land, but the person who sold it gets enough money to buy it back,
verses.textEnNasb: Or in case someone has no redeemer, but recovers to find sufficient means for its redemption,
verses.textEn: If, however, there is no one to redeem it for them but later on they prosper and acquire sufficient means to redeem it themselves,

verses.textZh: 他就要计算卖地的年数，把余剩年数的出产数值还给那买主，他就可以收回自己的地业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就要计算卖地的年数，把余剩年数的出产数值还给那买主，他就可以收回自己的地业。
verses.textZhCuv: 就要算出卖地的年数，把余剩年数的价值还那买主，自己便归回自己的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: they are to determine the value for the years since they sold it and refund the balance to the one to whom they sold it; they can then go back to their own property.
verses.textEnEsv: let him calculate the years since he sold it and pay back the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and then return to his property.
verses.textEnNkjv: then let him count the years since its sale, and restore the remainder to the man to whom he sold it, that he may return to his possession.
verses.textEnNlt: he then has the right to redeem it from the one who bought it. The price of the land will be discounted according to the number of years until the next Year of Jubilee. In this way the original owner can then return to the land.
verses.textEnNasb: then he shall calculate the years since its sale and refund the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and so return to his property.
verses.textEn: they are to determine the value for the years since they sold it and refund the balance to the one to whom they sold it; they can then go back to their own property.

verses.textZh: 如果他没有足够的能力为自己收回卖了的地，他所卖的就要存在买主的手里，直到禧年；到了禧年，买主必须把地归还，卖地的人可以收回自己的地业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他没有足够的能力为自己收回卖了的地，他所卖的就要存在买主的手里，直到禧年；到了禧年，买主必须把地归还，卖地的人可以收回自己的地业。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若不能为自己得回所卖的，仍要存在买主的手里直到禧年；到了禧年，地业要出买主的手，自己便归回自己的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: But if they do not acquire the means to repay, what was sold will remain in the possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. It will be returned in the Jubilee, and they can then go back to their property.
verses.textEnEsv: But if he does not have sufficient means to recover it, then what he sold shall remain in the hand of the buyer until the year of jubilee. In the jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if he is not able to have it restored to himself, then what was sold shall remain in the hand of him who bought it until the Year of Jubilee; and in the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his possession.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the original owner cannot afford to buy back the land, it will remain with the new owner until the next Year of Jubilee. In the jubilee year, the land must be returned to the original owners so they can return to their family land.
verses.textEnNasb: But if he has not found sufficient means to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hands of its purchaser until the year of jubilee; but at the jubilee it shall revert, so that he may return to his property.
verses.textEn: But if they do not acquire the means to repay, what was sold will remain in the possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. It will be returned in the Jubilee, and they can then go back to their property.

verses.textZh: "如果有人卖了一所城内的住宅，在卖了以后的一整年之内，他有赎回的权利；在这些日子以内，他随时可赎回。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人卖了一所城内的住宅，在卖了以后的一整年之内，他有赎回的权利；在这些日子以内，他随时可赎回。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若卖城内的住宅，卖了以后，一年之内可以赎回；在一整年，必有赎回的权柄。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Anyone who sells a house in a walled city retains the right of redemption a full year after its sale. During that time the seller may redeem it.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, he may redeem it within a year of its sale. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If a man sells a house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year he may redeem it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who sells a house inside a walled town has the right to buy it back for a full year after its sale. During that year, the seller retains the right to buy it back.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Likewise, if a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then his redemption right remains valid until a full year after its sale; his right of redemption lasts a full year.
verses.textEn: " ‘Anyone who sells a house in a walled city retains the right of redemption a full year after its sale. During that time the seller may redeem it.

verses.textZh: 如果满了一年期不赎回，那所城内的房屋，就要确定归买主世世代代为业；就算到了禧年，买主也不必交出退还。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果满了一年期不赎回，那所城内的房屋，就要确定归买主世世代代为业；就算到了禧年，买主也不必交出退还。
verses.textZhCuv: 若在一整年之内不赎回，这城内的房屋就定准永归买主，世世代代为业；在禧年也不得出买主的手。
verses.textEnNiv: If it is not redeemed before a full year has passed, the house in the walled city shall belong permanently to the buyer and the buyer’s descendants. It is not to be returned in the Jubilee.
verses.textEnEsv: If it is not redeemed within a full year, then the house in the walled city shall belong in perpetuity to the buyer, throughout his generations; it shall not be released in the jubilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if it is not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house in the walled city shall belong permanently to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.
verses.textEnNlt: But if it is not bought back within a year, the sale of the house within the walled town cannot be reversed. It will become the permanent property of the buyer. It will not be returned to the original owner in the Year of Jubilee.
verses.textEnNasb: But if it is not bought back for him within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city passes permanently to its purchaser throughout his generations; it does not revert in the jubilee.
verses.textEn: If it is not redeemed before a full year has passed, the house in the walled city shall belong permanently to the buyer and the buyer’s descendants. It is not to be returned in the Jubilee.

verses.textZh: 但房屋在四围没有城墙的村庄里，就要算为乡下的田地一样，是可以赎回的；到了禧年，买主要交出退还。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但房屋在四围没有城墙的村庄里，就要算为乡下的田地一样，是可以赎回的；到了禧年，买主要交出退还。
verses.textZhCuv: 但房屋在无城墙的村庄里，要看如乡下的田地一样，可以赎回；到了禧年，都要出买主的手。
verses.textEnNiv: But houses in villages without walls around them are to be considered as belonging to the open country. They can be redeemed, and they are to be returned in the Jubilee.
verses.textEnEsv: But the houses of the villages that have no wall around them shall be classified with the fields of the land. They may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the jubilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: However the houses of villages which have no wall around them shall be counted as the fields of the country. They may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
verses.textEnNlt: But a house in a village—a settlement without fortified walls—will be treated like property in the countryside. Such a house may be bought back at any time, and it must be returned to the original owner in the Year of Jubilee.
verses.textEnNasb: The houses of the villages, however, which have no surrounding wall, shall be regarded as open fields; they have redemption rights and revert in the jubilee.
verses.textEn: But houses in villages without walls around them are to be considered as belonging to the open country. They can be redeemed, and they are to be returned in the Jubilee.

verses.textZh: 至于利未人的城，就是他们所得为业的城，其中的房屋，利未人有随时可以赎回的权利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于利未人的城，就是他们所得为业的城，其中的房屋，利未人有随时可以赎回的权利。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而利未人所得为业的城邑，其中的房屋，利未人可以随时赎回。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the Levitical towns, which they possess.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem at any time the houses in the cities they possess.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the cities of the Levites, and the houses in the cities of their possession, the Levites may redeem at any time.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Levites always have the right to buy back a house they have sold within the towns allotted to them.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites have a permanent right of redemption for the houses of the cities which are their possession.
verses.textEn: " ‘The Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the Levitical towns, which they possess.

verses.textZh: 如果一个利未人在他所得为业的城里，没有赎回已经卖了的房屋，到了禧年，买主仍要交出退还；因为利未人城里的房屋，是他们在以色列人中的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果一个利未人在他所得为业的城里，没有赎回已经卖了的房屋，到了禧年，买主仍要交出退还；因为利未人城里的房屋，是他们在以色列人中的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是一个利未人不将所卖的房屋赎回，是在所得为业的城内，到了禧年就要出买主的手，因为利未人城邑的房屋是他们在以色列人中的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: So the property of the Levites is redeemable—that is, a house sold in any town they hold—and is to be returned in the Jubilee, because the houses in the towns of the Levites are their property among the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: And if one of the Levites exercises his right of redemption, then the house that was sold in a city they possess shall be released in the jubilee. For the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if a man purchases a house from the Levites, then the house that was sold in the city of his possession shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And any property that is sold by the Levites—all houses within the Levitical towns—must be returned in the Year of Jubilee. After all, the houses in the towns reserved for the Levites are the only property they own in all Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: What, therefore, belongs to the Levites may be redeemed, and a house sale in the city of this possession reverts in the jubilee, because the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: So the property of the Levites is redeemable—that is, a house sold in any town they hold—and is to be returned in the Jubilee, because the houses in the towns of the Levites are their property among the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 只是他们城郊之地不可出卖，因为是他们永远的地业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是他们城郊之地不可出卖，因为是他们永远的地业。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是他们各城郊野之地不可卖，因为是他们永远的产业。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the pastureland belonging to their towns must not be sold; it is their permanent possession.
verses.textEnEsv: But the fields of pastureland belonging to their cities may not be sold, for that is their possession forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the field of the common-land of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.
verses.textEnNlt: The open pastureland around the Levitical towns may never be sold. It is their permanent possession.
verses.textEnNasb: But pasture fields of their cities shall not be sold, for that is their permanent possession.
verses.textEn: But the pastureland belonging to their towns must not be sold; it is their permanent possession.

verses.textZh: "如果你的兄弟贫穷，在你那里手头拮据，你要资助他，使他可以与你一同生活，像旅客寄居的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你的兄弟贫穷，在你那里手头拮据，你要资助他，使他可以与你一同生活，像旅客寄居的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的弟兄在你那里若渐渐贫穷，手中缺乏，你就要帮补他，使他与你同住，像外人和寄居的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If any of your fellow Israelites become poor and are unable to support themselves among you, help them as you would a foreigner and stranger, so they can continue to live among you.
verses.textEnEsv: "If your brother becomes poor and cannot maintain himself with you, you shall support him as though he were a stranger and a sojourner, and he shall live with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If one of your brethren becomes poor, and falls into poverty among you, then you shall help him, like a stranger or a sojourner, that he may live with you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If one of your fellow Israelites falls into poverty and cannot support himself, support him as you would a foreigner or a temporary resident and allow him to live with you.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now in case a countryman of yours becomes poor and his means among you falter, then you are to sustain him, like a stranger or a resident, so that he may live with you.
verses.textEn: " ‘If any of your fellow Israelites become poor and are unable to support themselves among you, help them as you would a foreigner and stranger, so they can continue to live among you.

verses.textZh: 你不可向他收取高利，却要敬畏你的神，使你的兄弟可以与你一同生活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可向他收取高利，却要敬畏你的神，使你的兄弟可以与你一同生活。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可向他取利，也不可向他多要；只要敬畏你的神，使你的弟兄与你同住。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not take interest or any profit from them, but fear your God, so that they may continue to live among you.
verses.textEnEsv: Take no interest from him or profit, but fear your God, that your brother may live beside you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take no usury or interest from him; but fear your God, that your brother may live with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not charge interest or make a profit at his expense. Instead, show your fear of God by letting him live with you as your relative.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not take any kind of interest from him, but fear your God, so that your countryman may live with you.
verses.textEn: Do not take interest or any profit from them, but fear your God, so that they may continue to live among you.

verses.textZh: 你借钱给他，不可向他取利息；借粮给他，也不可要他多还。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你借钱给他，不可向他取利息；借粮给他，也不可要他多还。
verses.textZhCuv: 你借钱给他，不可向他取利；借粮给他，也不可向他多要。
verses.textEnNiv: You must not lend them money at interest or sell them food at a profit.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not lend him your money for usury, nor lend him your food at a profit.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, do not charge interest on money you lend him or make a profit on food you sell him.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not give him your silver at interest, nor your food for profit.
verses.textEn: You must not lend them money at interest or sell them food at a profit.

verses.textZh: 我是耶和华你们的神，曾经把你们从埃及地领出来，要把迦南地赐给你们，而且要作你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是耶和华你们的神，曾经把你们从埃及地领出来，要把迦南地赐给你们，而且要作你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是耶和华－你们的神，曾领你们从埃及地出来，为要把迦南地赐给你们，要作你们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
verses.textEnNlt: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
verses.textEnNasb: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
verses.textEn: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.

verses.textZh: "你的兄弟在你那里若是贫穷了，卖身给你，你不可逼他作奴仆的工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你的兄弟在你那里若是贫穷了，卖身给你，你不可逼他作奴仆的工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的弟兄若在你那里渐渐穷乏，将自己卖给你，不可叫他像奴仆服事你。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If any of your fellow Israelites become poor and sell themselves to you, do not make them work as slaves.
verses.textEnEsv: "If your brother becomes poor beside you and sells himself to you, you shall not make him serve as a slave:
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if one of your brethren who dwells by you becomes poor, and sells himself to you, you shall not compel him to serve as a slave.
verses.textEnNlt: "If one of your fellow Israelites falls into poverty and is forced to sell himself to you, do not treat him as a slave.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if a countryman of yours becomes so poor with regard to you that he sells himself to you, you shall not subject him to a slave’s service.
verses.textEn: " ‘If any of your fellow Israelites become poor and sell themselves to you, do not make them work as slaves.

verses.textZh: 他在你那里要像雇工和寄居的一样；他要服事你直到禧年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在你那里要像雇工和寄居的一样；他要服事你直到禧年。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要在你那里像雇工人和寄居的一样，要服事你直到禧年。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to be treated as hired workers or temporary residents among you; they are to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.
verses.textEnEsv: he shall be with you as a hired worker and as a sojourner. He shall serve with you until the year of the jubilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: As a hired servant and a sojourner he shall be with you, and shall serve you until the Year of Jubilee.
verses.textEnNlt: Treat him instead as a hired worker or as a temporary resident who lives with you, and he will serve you only until the Year of Jubilee.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall be with you as a hired worker, as if he were a foreign resident; he shall serve with you up to the year of jubilee.
verses.textEn: They are to be treated as hired workers or temporary residents among you; they are to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.

verses.textZh: 到了禧年，他和他的儿女要离开你，归回他本家，归回自己祖宗的地业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了禧年，他和他的儿女要离开你，归回他本家，归回自己祖宗的地业。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了禧年，他和他儿女要离开你，一同出去归回本家，到他祖宗的地业那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they and their children are to be released, and they will go back to their own clans and to the property of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and go back to his own clan and return to the possession of his fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And then he shall depart from you—he and his children with him—and shall return to his own family. He shall return to the possession of his fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time he and his children will no longer be obligated to you, and they will return to their clans and go back to the land originally allotted to their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall then leave you, he and his sons with him, and shall go back to his family, so that he may return to the property of his forefathers.
verses.textEn: Then they and their children are to be released, and they will go back to their own clans and to the property of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 因为他们是我的仆人，是我从埃及地领出来的，他们不可以卖作奴仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们是我的仆人，是我从埃及地领出来的，他们不可以卖作奴仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们是我的仆人，是我从埃及地领出来的，不可卖为奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: Because the Israelites are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt, they must not be sold as slaves.
verses.textEnEsv: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; they shall not be sold as slaves.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; they shall not be sold as slaves.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, so they must never be sold as slaves.
verses.textEnNasb: For they are My servants whom I brought out from the land of Egypt; they are not to be sold in a slave sale.
verses.textEn: Because the Israelites are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt, they must not be sold as slaves.

verses.textZh: 你不可严严地辖制他，却要敬畏你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可严严地辖制他，却要敬畏你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可严严地辖管他，只要敬畏你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not rule over them ruthlessly, but fear your God.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not rule over him ruthlessly but shall fear your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not rule over him with rigor, but you shall fear your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Show your fear of God by not treating them harshly.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not rule over him with severity, but are to revere your God.
verses.textEn: Do not rule over them ruthlessly, but fear your God.

verses.textZh: 至于你需要的仆婢，可以来自你们四围的列国，你们可以从他们中间购买奴婢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你需要的仆婢，可以来自你们四围的列国，你们可以从他们中间购买奴婢。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你的奴仆、婢女，可以从你四围的国中买。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Your male and female slaves are to come from the nations around you; from them you may buy slaves.
verses.textEnEsv: As for your male and female slaves whom you may have: you may buy male and female slaves from among the nations that are around you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for your male and female slaves whom you may have—from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.
verses.textEnNlt: "However, you may purchase male and female slaves from among the nations around you.
verses.textEnNasb: As for your male and female slaves whom you may have—you may acquire male and female slaves from the pagan nations that are around you.
verses.textEn: " ‘Your male and female slaves are to come from the nations around you; from them you may buy slaves.

verses.textZh: 你们也可以从那些与你们住在一起的外人的儿女中，或是从他们的家族中，就是那些与你们在一起，在你们境内所生的，购买奴婢；他们要作你们的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也可以从那些与你们住在一起的外人的儿女中，或是从他们的家族中，就是那些与你们在一起，在你们境内所生的，购买奴婢；他们要作你们的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且那寄居在你们中间的外人和他们的家属，在你们地上所生的，你们也可以从其中买人；他们要作你们的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: You may also buy some of the temporary residents living among you and members of their clans born in your country, and they will become your property.
verses.textEnEsv: You may also buy from among the strangers who sojourn with you and their clans that are with you, who have been born in your land, and they may be your property.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover you may buy the children of the strangers who dwell among you, and their families who are with you, which they beget in your land; and they shall become your property.
verses.textEnNlt: You may also purchase the children of temporary residents who live among you, including those who have been born in your land. You may treat them as your property,
verses.textEnNasb: You may also acquire them from the sons of the foreign residents who reside among you, and from their families who are with you, whom they will have produced in your land; they also may become your possession.
verses.textEn: You may also buy some of the temporary residents living among you and members of their clans born in your country, and they will become your property.

verses.textZh: 你们要把他们留给你们的子孙作永远的产业，你们要从他们中间取奴仆；只是你们的兄弟以色列人，你们却不可苛刻管辖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把他们留给你们的子孙作永远的产业，你们要从他们中间取奴仆；只是你们的兄弟以色列人，你们却不可苛刻管辖。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要将他们遗留给你们的子孙为产业，要永远从他们中间拣出奴仆；只是你们的弟兄以色列人，你们不可严严地辖管。
verses.textEnNiv: You can bequeath them to your children as inherited property and can make them slaves for life, but you must not rule over your fellow Israelites ruthlessly.
verses.textEnEsv: You may bequeath them to your sons after you to inherit as a possession forever. You may make slaves of them, but over your brothers the people of Israel you shall not rule, one over another ruthlessly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you may take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them as a possession; they shall be your permanent slaves. But regarding your brethren, the children of Israel, you shall not rule over one another with rigor.
verses.textEnNlt: passing them on to your children as a permanent inheritance. You may treat them as slaves, but you must never treat your fellow Israelites this way.
verses.textEnNasb: You may also pass them on as an inheritance to your sons after you, to receive as a possession; you can use them as permanent slaves. But in respect to your countrymen, the sons of Israel, you shall not rule with severity over one another.
verses.textEn: You can bequeath them to your children as inherited property and can make them slaves for life, but you must not rule over your fellow Israelites ruthlessly.

verses.textZh: "在你中间寄居的外人或是客旅若是富足起来，你的兄弟在他那里却渐渐穷乏，把自己卖给住在你那里寄居的外人或客旅的家族，
verses.textZhCnvs: "在你中间寄居的外人或是客旅若是富足起来，你的兄弟在他那里却渐渐穷乏，把自己卖给住在你那里寄居的外人或客旅的家族，
verses.textZhCuv: 「住在你那里的外人，或是寄居的，若渐渐富足，你的弟兄却渐渐穷乏，将自己卖给那外人，或是寄居的，或是外人的宗族，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If a foreigner residing among you becomes rich and any of your fellow Israelites become poor and sell themselves to the foreigner or to a member of the foreigner’s clan,
verses.textEnEsv: "If a stranger or sojourner with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him becomes poor and sells himself to the stranger or sojourner with you or to a member of the stranger’s clan,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Now if a sojourner or stranger close to you becomes rich, and one of your brethren who dwells by him becomes poor, and sells himself to the stranger or sojourner close to you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose a foreigner or temporary resident becomes rich while living among you. If any of your fellow Israelites fall into poverty and are forced to sell themselves to such a foreigner or to a member of his family,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if the means of a stranger or of a foreign resident with you becomes sufficient, and a countryman of yours becomes poor in relation to him and sells himself to a stranger who is residing with you, or to the descendants of a stranger’s family,
verses.textEn: " ‘If a foreigner residing among you becomes rich and any of your fellow Israelites become poor and sell themselves to the foreigner or to a member of the foreigner’s clan,

verses.textZh: 卖了自己以后，他仍有赎回的权利；他兄弟中的任何一个都可以赎他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 卖了自己以后，他仍有赎回的权利；他兄弟中的任何一个都可以赎他；
verses.textZhCuv: 卖了以后，可以将他赎回。无论是他的弟兄，
verses.textEnNiv: they retain the right of redemption after they have sold themselves. One of their relatives may redeem them:
verses.textEnEsv: then after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him,
verses.textEnNkjv: after he is sold he may be redeemed again. One of his brothers may redeem him;
verses.textEnNlt: they still retain the right to be bought back, even after they have been purchased. They may be bought back by a brother,
verses.textEnNasb: then he shall have redemption right after he has been sold. One of his brothers may redeem him,
verses.textEn: they retain the right of redemption after they have sold themselves. One of their relatives may redeem them:

verses.textZh: 他的叔伯或是他叔伯的儿子可以赎他，他家族中的骨肉至亲也可以赎他；如果他自己的经济能力改善，也可以自赎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的叔伯或是他叔伯的儿子可以赎他，他家族中的骨肉至亲也可以赎他；如果他自己的经济能力改善，也可以自赎。
verses.textZhCuv: 或伯叔、伯叔的儿子，本家的近支，都可以赎他。他自己若渐渐富足，也可以自赎。
verses.textEnNiv: An uncle or a cousin or any blood relative in their clan may redeem them. Or if they prosper, they may redeem themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: or his uncle or his cousin may redeem him, or a close relative from his clan may redeem him. Or if he grows rich he may redeem himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: or his uncle or his uncle’s son may redeem him; or anyone who is near of kin to him in his family may redeem him; or if he is able he may redeem himself.
verses.textEnNlt: an uncle, or a cousin. In fact, anyone from the extended family may buy them back. They may also redeem themselves if they have prospered.
verses.textEnNasb: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son may redeem him, or one of his blood relatives from his family may redeem him; or if he prospers, he may redeem himself.
verses.textEn: An uncle or a cousin or any blood relative in their clan may redeem them. Or if they prosper, they may redeem themselves.

verses.textZh: 他要与买主计算，从卖身那一年起，直到禧年为止；照着年数的多少，按雇工的工价计算赎银。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要与买主计算，从卖身那一年起，直到禧年为止；照着年数的多少，按雇工的工价计算赎银。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要和买主计算，从卖自己的那年起，算到禧年；所卖的价值照着年数多少，好像工人每年的工价。
verses.textEnNiv: They and their buyer are to count the time from the year they sold themselves up to the Year of Jubilee. The price for their release is to be based on the rate paid to a hired worker for that number of years.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall calculate with his buyer from the year when he sold himself to him until the year of jubilee, and the price of his sale shall vary with the number of years. The time he was with his owner shall be rated as the time of a hired worker.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus he shall reckon with him who bought him: The price of his release shall be according to the number of years, from the year that he was sold to him until the Year of Jubilee; it shall be according to the time of a hired servant for him.
verses.textEnNlt: They will negotiate the price of their freedom with the person who bought them. The price will be based on the number of years from the time they were sold until the next Year of Jubilee—whatever it would cost to hire a worker for that period of time.
verses.textEnNasb: He then, with his purchaser, shall calculate from the year when he sold himself to him up to the year of jubilee; and the price of his sale shall correspond to the number of years calculated. It is like the days of a hired worker that he will be with him.
verses.textEn: They and their buyer are to count the time from the year they sold themselves up to the Year of Jubilee. The price for their release is to be based on the rate paid to a hired worker for that number of years.

verses.textZh: 如果卖身时还有很多年才到禧年，他就要按着年数，照他卖身的价银按比例偿还他的赎价。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果卖身时还有很多年才到禧年，他就要按着年数，照他卖身的价银按比例偿还他的赎价。
verses.textZhCuv: 若缺少的年数多，就要按着年数从买价中偿还他的赎价。
verses.textEnNiv: If many years remain, they must pay for their redemption a larger share of the price paid for them.
verses.textEnEsv: If there are still many years left, he shall pay proportionately for his redemption some of his sale price.
verses.textEnNkjv: If there are still many years remaining, according to them he shall repay the price of his redemption from the money with which he was bought.
verses.textEnNlt: If many years still remain until the jubilee, they will repay the proper proportion of what they received when they sold themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: If there are still many years remaining, he shall refund part of his purchase price in proportion to them for his own redemption;
verses.textEn: If many years remain, they must pay for their redemption a larger share of the price paid for them.

verses.textZh: 如果距离禧年只有几年，他就按着年数，与买主计算，按雇工的工价，偿还他的赎价。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果距离禧年只有几年，他就按着年数，与买主计算，按雇工的工价，偿还他的赎价。
verses.textZhCuv: 若到禧年只缺少几年，就要按着年数和买主计算，偿还他的赎价。
verses.textEnNiv: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, they are to compute that and pay for their redemption accordingly.
verses.textEnEsv: If there remain but a few years until the year of jubilee, he shall calculate and pay for his redemption in proportion to his years of service.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if there remain but a few years until the Year of Jubilee, then he shall reckon with him, and according to his years he shall repay him the price of his redemption.
verses.textEnNlt: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, they will repay a small amount for their redemption.
verses.textEnNasb: but if few years remain until the year of jubilee, he shall so calculate with him. In proportion to his years he is to refund the amount for his redemption.
verses.textEn: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, they are to compute that and pay for their redemption accordingly.

verses.textZh: 买主要像每年雇用的工人那样待他。不可在你眼前苛刻地管辖他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 买主要像每年雇用的工人那样待他。不可在你眼前苛刻地管辖他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他和买主同住，要像每年雇的工人，买主不可严严地辖管他。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to be treated as workers hired from year to year; you must see to it that those to whom they owe service do not rule over them ruthlessly.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall treat him as a worker hired year by year. He shall not rule ruthlessly over him in your sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall be with him as a yearly hired servant, and he shall not rule with rigor over him in your sight.
verses.textEnNlt: The foreigner must treat them as workers hired on a yearly basis. You must not allow a foreigner to treat any of your fellow Israelites harshly.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall be with him like a worker hired year by year; he shall not rule over him with severity in your sight.
verses.textEn: They are to be treated as workers hired from year to year; you must see to it that those to whom they owe service do not rule over them ruthlessly.

verses.textZh: 如果他不在这些年间把自己赎回，到了禧年，也可以和他的儿女一同离去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他不在这些年间把自己赎回，到了禧年，也可以和他的儿女一同离去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若不这样被赎，到了禧年，要和他的儿女一同出去。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Even if someone is not redeemed in any of these ways, they and their children are to be released in the Year of Jubilee,
verses.textEnEsv: And if he is not redeemed by these means, then he and his children with him shall be released in the year of jubilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if he is not redeemed in these years, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee—he and his children with him.
verses.textEnNlt: If any Israelites have not been bought back by the time the Year of Jubilee arrives, they and their children must be set free at that time.
verses.textEnNasb: Even if he is not redeemed by these means, he shall still leave in the year of jubilee, he and his sons with him.
verses.textEn: " ‘Even if someone is not redeemed in any of these ways, they and their children are to be released in the Year of Jubilee,

verses.textZh: 因为以色列人都是属我的仆人；他们是我的仆人，是我把他们从埃及地领了出来的；我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以色列人都是属我的仆人；他们是我的仆人，是我把他们从埃及地领了出来的；我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为以色列人都是我的仆人，是我从埃及地领出来的。我是耶和华－你们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: for the Israelites belong to me as servants. They are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is to me that the people of Israel are servants. They are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the children of Israel are servants to Me; they are My servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: For the people of Israel belong to me. They are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sons of Israel are My servants; they are My servants whom I brought out from the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: for the Israelites belong to me as servants. They are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "你们不可为自己做偶像，不可为自己立雕像或神柱，也不可在你们的境内安置石像，向它跪拜；因为我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不可为自己做偶像，不可为自己立雕像或神柱，也不可在你们的境内安置石像，向它跪拜；因为我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们不可做什么虚无的神像，不可立雕刻的偶像或是柱像，也不可在你们的地上安什么錾成的石像，向它跪拜，因为我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not make idols or set up an image or a sacred stone for yourselves, and do not place a carved stone in your land to bow down before it. I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not make idols for yourselves or erect an image or pillar, and you shall not set up a figured stone in your land to bow down to it, for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall not make idols for yourselves; neither a carved image nor a sacred pillar shall you rear up for yourselves; nor shall you set up an engraved stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not make idols or set up carved images, or sacred pillars, or sculptured stones in your land so you may worship them. I am the Lord your God.
