verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall not make for yourselves idols, nor shall you set up for yourselves a carved image or a memorial stone, nor shall you place a figured stone in your land to bow down to it; for I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not make idols or set up an image or a sacred stone for yourselves, and do not place a carved stone in your land to bow down before it. I am the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 你们要遵守我的安息日；敬畏我的圣所；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要遵守我的安息日；敬畏我的圣所；我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要守我的安息日，敬我的圣所。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall keep my Sabbaths and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall keep My Sabbaths and reverence My sanctuary: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: You must keep my Sabbath days of rest and show reverence for my sanctuary. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall keep My Sabbaths and revere My sanctuary; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们遵行我的律例，谨守我的诫命，遵照奉行，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们遵行我的律例，谨守我的诫命，遵照奉行，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们若遵行我的律例，谨守我的诫命，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If you follow my decrees and are careful to obey my commands,
verses.textEnEsv: "If you walk in my statutes and observe my commandments and do them,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If you walk in My statutes and keep My commandments, and perform them,
verses.textEnNlt: "If you follow my decrees and are careful to obey my commands,
verses.textEnNasb: If you walk in My statutes and keep My commandments so as to carry them out,
verses.textEn: " ‘If you follow my decrees and are careful to obey my commands,

verses.textZh: 我就按时给你们降下雨露，使地生出土产，田野的树木也结果实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就按时给你们降下雨露，使地生出土产，田野的树木也结果实。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就给你们降下时雨，叫地生出土产，田野的树木结果子。
verses.textEnNiv: I will send you rain in its season, and the ground will yield its crops and the trees their fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will give you rain in its season, the land shall yield its produce, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: I will send you the seasonal rains. The land will then yield its crops, and the trees of the field will produce their fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: then I shall give you rains in their season, so that the land will yield its produce and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.
verses.textEn: I will send you rain in its season, and the ground will yield its crops and the trees their fruit.

verses.textZh: 你们打禾，必打到摘葡萄的时候，摘葡萄必摘到撒种的时候；你们吃食物，吃得饱足，在你们的境内安然居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们打禾，必打到摘葡萄的时候，摘葡萄必摘到撒种的时候；你们吃食物，吃得饱足，在你们的境内安然居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们打粮食要打到摘葡萄的时候，摘葡萄要摘到撒种的时候；并且要吃得饱足，在你们的地上安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: Your threshing will continue until grape harvest and the grape harvest will continue until planting, and you will eat all the food you want and live in safety in your land.
verses.textEnEsv: Your threshing shall last to the time of the grape harvest, and the grape harvest shall last to the time for sowing. And you shall eat your bread to the full and dwell in your land securely.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your threshing shall last till the time of vintage, and the vintage shall last till the time of sowing; you shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.textEnNlt: Your threshing season will overlap with the grape harvest, and your grape harvest will overlap with the season of planting grain. You will eat your fill and live securely in your own land.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, your threshing season will last for you until grape gathering, and grape gathering will last until sowing time. So you will eat your food to the full and live securely in your land.
verses.textEn: Your threshing will continue until grape harvest and the grape harvest will continue until planting, and you will eat all the food you want and live in safety in your land.

verses.textZh: 我必使你们境内太平；你们睡觉，没有人惊吓你们；我使恶兽在境内绝迹；刀剑也不经过你们的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你们境内太平；你们睡觉，没有人惊吓你们；我使恶兽在境内绝迹；刀剑也不经过你们的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要赐平安在你们的地上；你们躺卧，无人惊吓。我要叫恶兽从你们的地上息灭；刀剑也必不经过你们的地。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I will grant peace in the land, and you will lie down and no one will make you afraid. I will remove wild beasts from the land, and the sword will not pass through your country.
verses.textEnEsv: I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid. And I will remove harmful beasts from the land, and the sword shall not go through your land.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and none will make you afraid; I will rid the land of evil beasts, and the sword will not go through your land.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will give you peace in the land, and you will be able to sleep with no cause for fear. I will rid the land of wild animals and keep your enemies out of your land.
verses.textEnNasb: I shall also grant peace in the land, so that you may lie down, with no one to make you afraid. I shall also eliminate harmful animals from the land, and no sword will pass through your land.
verses.textEn: " ‘I will grant peace in the land, and you will lie down and no one will make you afraid. I will remove wild beasts from the land, and the sword will not pass through your country.

verses.textZh: 你们必追赶仇敌，他们必在你们面前倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们必追赶仇敌，他们必在你们面前倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要追赶仇敌，他们必倒在你们刀下。
verses.textEnNiv: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will chase your enemies, and they shall fall by the sword before you.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, you will chase down your enemies and slaughter them with your swords.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, you will chase your enemies, and they will fall before you by the sword;
verses.textEn: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.

verses.textZh: 你们五个人必追赶一百人，一百人必追赶一万人；你们的仇敌必在你们面前倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们五个人必追赶一百人，一百人必追赶一万人；你们的仇敌必在你们面前倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们五个人要追赶一百人，一百人要追赶一万人；仇敌必倒在你们刀下。
verses.textEnNiv: Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.
verses.textEnEsv: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand, and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight; your enemies shall fall by the sword before you.
verses.textEnNlt: Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand! All your enemies will fall beneath your sword.
verses.textEnNasb: five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand; and your enemies will fall before you by the sword.
verses.textEn: Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.

verses.textZh: 我眷顾你们，使你们繁衍增多，也必坚立我与你们所立的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我眷顾你们，使你们繁衍增多，也必坚立我与你们所立的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要眷顾你们，使你们生养众多，也要与你们坚定所立的约。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I will look on you with favor and make you fruitful and increase your numbers, and I will keep my covenant with you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will turn to you and make you fruitful and multiply you and will confirm my covenant with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For I will look on you favorably and make you fruitful, multiply you and confirm My covenant with you.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will look favorably upon you, making you fertile and multiplying your people. And I will fulfill my covenant with you.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will confirm My covenant with you.
verses.textEn: " ‘I will look on you with favor and make you fruitful and increase your numbers, and I will keep my covenant with you.

verses.textZh: 你们吃久藏的旧粮，要挪出旧粮，腾空给新粮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们吃久藏的旧粮，要挪出旧粮，腾空给新粮。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要吃陈粮，又因新粮挪开陈粮。
verses.textEnNiv: You will still be eating last year’s harvest when you will have to move it out to make room for the new.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall eat old store long kept, and you shall clear out the old to make way for the new.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat the old harvest, and clear out the old because of the new.
verses.textEnNlt: You will have such a surplus of crops that you will need to clear out the old grain to make room for the new harvest!
verses.textEnNasb: And you will eat the old supply, and clear out the old because of the new.
verses.textEn: You will still be eating last year’s harvest when you will have to move it out to make room for the new.

verses.textZh: 我必在你们中间安置我的居所，我的心也不厌弃你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必在你们中间安置我的居所，我的心也不厌弃你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在你们中间立我的帐幕；我的心也不厌恶你们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will put my dwelling place among you, and I will not abhor you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make my dwelling among you, and my soul shall not abhor you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will set My tabernacle among you, and My soul shall not abhor you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will live among you, and I will not despise you.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, I will make My dwelling among you, and My soul will not reject you.
verses.textEn: I will put my dwelling place among you, and I will not abhor you.

verses.textZh: 我要在你们中间行走；我要作你们的神，你们要作我的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在你们中间行走；我要作你们的神，你们要作我的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在你们中间行走；我要作你们的神，你们要作我的子民。
verses.textEnNiv: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will walk among you and will be your God, and you shall be my people.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will walk among you and be your God, and you shall be My people.
verses.textEnNlt: I will walk among you; I will be your God, and you will be my people.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also walk among you and be your God, and you shall be My people.
verses.textEn: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.

verses.textZh: 我是耶和华你们的神，曾经把你们从埃及地领出来，使你们不再作他们的奴仆；我折断了你们所负的轭，使你们挺身昂首地行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是耶和华你们的神，曾经把你们从埃及地领出来，使你们不再作他们的奴仆；我折断了你们所负的轭，使你们挺身昂首地行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是耶和华－你们的神，曾将你们从埃及地领出来，使你们不作埃及人的奴仆；我也折断你们所负的轭，叫你们挺身而走。」
verses.textEnNiv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians; I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk with heads held high.
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. And I have broken the bars of your yoke and made you walk erect.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves; I have broken the bands of your yoke and made you walk upright.
verses.textEnNlt: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so you would no longer be their slaves. I broke the yoke of slavery from your neck so you can walk with your heads held high.
verses.textEnNasb: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would not be their slaves, and I broke your yoke and made you walk erect.
verses.textEn: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians; I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk with heads held high.

verses.textZh: "但如果你们不听从我，不遵行这一切诫命；
verses.textZhCnvs: "但如果你们不听从我，不遵行这一切诫命；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们若不听从我，不遵行我的诫命，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But if you will not listen to me and carry out all these commands,
verses.textEnEsv: "But if you will not listen to me and will not do all these commandments,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But if you do not obey Me, and do not observe all these commandments,
verses.textEnNlt: "However, if you do not listen to me or obey all these commands,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But if you do not obey Me and do not carry out all these commandments,
verses.textEn: " ‘But if you will not listen to me and carry out all these commands,

verses.textZh: 如果你们弃绝我的律例，你们的心厌弃我的典章，不遵行我的一切诫命，违背我的约，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们弃绝我的律例，你们的心厌弃我的典章，不遵行我的一切诫命，违背我的约，
verses.textZhCuv: 厌弃我的律例，厌恶我的典章，不遵行我一切的诫命，背弃我的约，
verses.textEnNiv: and if you reject my decrees and abhor my laws and fail to carry out all my commands and so violate my covenant,
verses.textEnEsv: if you spurn my statutes, and if your soul abhors my rules, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,
verses.textEnNkjv: and if you despise My statutes, or if your soul abhors My judgments, so that you do not perform all My commandments, but break My covenant,
verses.textEnNlt: and if you break my covenant by rejecting my decrees, treating my regulations with contempt, and refusing to obey my commands,
verses.textEnNasb: if, instead, you reject My statutes, and if your soul loathes My ordinances so as not to carry out all My commandments, but rather to break My covenant,
verses.textEn: and if you reject my decrees and abhor my laws and fail to carry out all my commands and so violate my covenant,

verses.textZh: 我就要这样待你们：我必命惊慌临到你们，痨病热病使你们眼目昏花，心灵憔悴；你们必徒然撒种，因为你们的仇敌必吃尽你们的出产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就要这样待你们：我必命惊慌临到你们，痨病热病使你们眼目昏花，心灵憔悴；你们必徒然撒种，因为你们的仇敌必吃尽你们的出产。
verses.textZhCuv: 我待你们就要这样：我必命定惊惶，叫眼目干瘪、精神消耗的痨病热病辖制你们。你们也要白白地撒种，因为仇敌要吃你们所种的。
verses.textEnNiv: then I will do this to you: I will bring on you sudden terror, wasting diseases and fever that will destroy your sight and sap your strength. You will plant seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: then I will do this to you: I will visit you with panic, with wasting disease and fever that consume the eyes and make the heart ache. And you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.textEnNkjv: I also will do this to you: I will even appoint terror over you, wasting disease and fever which shall consume the eyes and cause sorrow of heart. And you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: I will punish you. I will bring sudden terrors upon you—wasting diseases and burning fevers that will cause your eyes to fail and your life to ebb away. You will plant your crops in vain because your enemies will eat them.
verses.textEnNasb: I, in turn, will do this to you: I will summon a sudden terror against you, consumption and fever that will make the eyes fail and the soul languish; also, you will sow your seed uselessly, for your enemies will eat it.
verses.textEn: then I will do this to you: I will bring on you sudden terror, wasting diseases and fever that will destroy your sight and sap your strength. You will plant seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

verses.textZh: 我向你们变脸，你们就败在仇敌面前；恨恶你们的要管辖你们；虽然没有人追赶，你们仍然逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向你们变脸，你们就败在仇敌面前；恨恶你们的要管辖你们；虽然没有人追赶，你们仍然逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要向你们变脸，你们就要败在仇敌面前。恨恶你们的，必辖管你们；无人追赶，你们却要逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: I will set my face against you so that you will be defeated by your enemies; those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee even when no one is pursuing you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will set my face against you, and you shall be struck down before your enemies. Those who hate you shall rule over you, and you shall flee when none pursues you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will set My face against you, and you shall be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you shall reign over you, and you shall flee when no one pursues you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will turn against you, and you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will run even when no one is chasing you!
verses.textEnNasb: And I will set My face against you so that you will be defeated before your enemies; and those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one is pursuing you.
verses.textEn: I will set my face against you so that you will be defeated by your enemies; those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee even when no one is pursuing you.

verses.textZh: 经过这些以后，如果你们还不听从我，我就要因你们的罪加重七倍管教你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 经过这些以后，如果你们还不听从我，我就要因你们的罪加重七倍管教你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们因这些事若还不听从我，我就要为你们的罪加七倍惩罚你们。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If after all this you will not listen to me, I will punish you for your sins seven times over.
verses.textEnEsv: And if in spite of this you will not listen to me, then I will discipline you again sevenfold for your sins,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And after all this, if you do not obey Me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
verses.textEnNlt: "And if, in spite of all this, you still disobey me, I will punish you seven times over for your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: If also after these things you do not obey Me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
verses.textEn: " ‘If after all this you will not listen to me, I will punish you for your sins seven times over.

verses.textZh: 我必粉碎你们夸耀的力量；我要使你们的天像铁，你们的地像铜；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必粉碎你们夸耀的力量；我要使你们的天像铁，你们的地像铜；
verses.textZhCuv: 我必断绝你们因势力而有的骄傲，又要使覆你们的天如铁，载你们的地如铜。
verses.textEnNiv: I will break down your stubborn pride and make the sky above you like iron and the ground beneath you like bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: and I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your heavens like iron and your earth like bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will break the pride of your power; I will make your heavens like iron and your earth like bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: I will break your proud spirit by making the skies as unyielding as iron and the earth as hard as bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also break down your pride of power; and I will make your sky like iron and your earth like bronze.
verses.textEn: I will break down your stubborn pride and make the sky above you like iron and the ground beneath you like bronze.

verses.textZh: 你们的气力徒然用尽；你们的地不出产，境内的树也不结果实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的气力徒然用尽；你们的地不出产，境内的树也不结果实。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要白白地劳力；因为你们的地不出土产，其上的树木也不结果子。
verses.textEnNiv: Your strength will be spent in vain, because your soil will not yield its crops, nor will the trees of your land yield their fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: And your strength shall be spent in vain, for your land shall not yield its increase, and the trees of the land shall not yield their fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: And your strength shall be spent in vain; for your land shall not yield its produce, nor shall the trees of the land yield their fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: All your work will be for nothing, for your land will yield no crops, and your trees will bear no fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: Your strength will be consumed uselessly, for your land will not yield its produce and the trees of the land will not yield their fruit.
verses.textEn: Your strength will be spent in vain, because your soil will not yield its crops, nor will the trees of your land yield their fruit.

verses.textZh: "如果你们行事为人与我的心意相违，不肯听从我，我就要按着你们的罪，使灾祸加重七倍地临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你们行事为人与我的心意相违，不肯听从我，我就要按着你们的罪，使灾祸加重七倍地临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们行事若与我反对，不肯听从我，我就要按你们的罪加七倍降灾与你们。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If you remain hostile toward me and refuse to listen to me, I will multiply your afflictions seven times over, as your sins deserve.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then if you walk contrary to me and will not listen to me, I will continue striking you, sevenfold for your sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Then, if you walk contrary to Me, and are not willing to obey Me, I will bring on you seven times more plagues, according to your sins.
verses.textEnNlt: "If even then you remain hostile toward me and refuse to obey me, I will inflict disaster on you seven times over for your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Yet if you show hostility toward Me and are unwilling to obey Me, I will increase the plague on you seven times according to your sins.
verses.textEn: " ‘If you remain hostile toward me and refuse to listen to me, I will multiply your afflictions seven times over, as your sins deserve.

verses.textZh: 打发野地的走兽到你们中间，夺去你们的儿女，残害你们的牲畜，减少你们的人口，使你们的道路荒凉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 打发野地的走兽到你们中间，夺去你们的儿女，残害你们的牲畜，减少你们的人口，使你们的道路荒凉。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要打发野地的走兽到你们中间，抢吃你们的儿女，吞灭你们的牲畜，使你们的人数减少，道路荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: I will send wild animals against you, and they will rob you of your children, destroy your cattle and make you so few in number that your roads will be deserted.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will let loose the wild beasts against you, which shall bereave you of your children and destroy your livestock and make you few in number, so that your roads shall be deserted.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number; and your highways shall be desolate.
verses.textEnNlt: I will send wild animals that will rob you of your children and destroy your livestock. Your numbers will dwindle, and your roads will be deserted.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also let loose among you the animals of the field, which will deprive you of your children and eliminate your cattle, and reduce your number so that your roads become deserted.
verses.textEn: I will send wild animals against you, and they will rob you of your children, destroy your cattle and make you so few in number that your roads will be deserted.

verses.textZh: "但如果你们经过这些事仍然不归向我，行事仍与我的心意相违，
verses.textZhCnvs: "但如果你们经过这些事仍然不归向我，行事仍与我的心意相违，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们因这些事若仍不改正归我，行事与我反对，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If in spite of these things you do not accept my correction but continue to be hostile toward me,
verses.textEnEsv: "And if by this discipline you are not turned to me but walk contrary to me,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if by these things you are not reformed by Me, but walk contrary to Me,
verses.textEnNlt: "And if you fail to learn the lesson and continue your hostility toward me,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And if by these things you do not learn your lesson regarding Me, but you show hostility toward Me,
verses.textEn: " ‘If in spite of these things you do not accept my correction but continue to be hostile toward me,

verses.textZh: 我也要与你们作对，按着你们的罪，再加重七倍击打你们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也要与你们作对，按着你们的罪，再加重七倍击打你们；
verses.textZhCuv: 我就要行事与你们反对，因你们的罪击打你们七次。
verses.textEnNiv: I myself will be hostile toward you and will afflict you for your sins seven times over.
verses.textEnEsv: then I also will walk contrary to you, and I myself will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I also will walk contrary to you, and I will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
verses.textEnNlt: then I myself will be hostile toward you. I will personally strike you with calamity seven times over for your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: then I in turn will show hostility toward you; and I, even I, will strike you seven times for your sins.
verses.textEn: I myself will be hostile toward you and will afflict you for your sins seven times over.

verses.textZh: 使刀剑临到你们，报复背约的仇；聚集你们到城里，好使我打发瘟疫在你们中间，把你们交在仇敌的手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使刀剑临到你们，报复背约的仇；聚集你们到城里，好使我打发瘟疫在你们中间，把你们交在仇敌的手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又要使刀剑临到你们，报复你们背约的仇；聚集你们在各城内，降瘟疫在你们中间，也必将你们交在仇敌的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: And I will bring the sword on you to avenge the breaking of the covenant. When you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be given into enemy hands.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall execute vengeance for the covenant. And if you gather within your cities, I will send pestilence among you, and you shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will bring a sword against you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant; when you are gathered together within your cities I will send pestilence among you; and you shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.textEnNlt: I will send armies against you to carry out the curse of the covenant you have broken. When you run to your towns for safety, I will send a plague to destroy you there, and you will be handed over to your enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also bring upon you a sword which will execute vengeance for the covenant; and when you gather together into your cities, I will send a plague among you, so that you will be handed over to the enemy.
verses.textEn: And I will bring the sword on you to avenge the breaking of the covenant. When you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be given into enemy hands.

verses.textZh: 我断绝你们的粮食来源 以后，十个女人要共用一个炉子给你们烤饼，她们配给定量的饼给你们；你们要吃，却吃不饱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我断绝你们的粮食来源 以后，十个女人要共用一个炉子给你们烤饼，她们配给定量的饼给你们；你们要吃，却吃不饱。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要折断你们的杖，就是断绝你们的粮。那时，必有十个女人在一个炉子给你们烤饼，按分量秤给你们；你们要吃，也吃不饱。
verses.textEnNiv: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will be able to bake your bread in one oven, and they will dole out the bread by weight. You will eat, but you will not be satisfied.
verses.textEnEsv: When I break your supply of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in a single oven and shall dole out your bread again by weight, and you shall eat and not be satisfied.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I have cut off your supply of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall bring back your bread by weight, and you shall eat and not be satisfied.
verses.textEnNlt: I will destroy your food supply, so that ten women will need only one oven to bake bread for their families. They will ration your food by weight, and though you have food to eat, you will not be satisfied.
verses.textEnNasb: When I break your staff of bread, ten women will bake your bread in one oven, and they will bring back your bread in rationed amounts, so that you will eat and not be satisfied.
verses.textEn: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will be able to bake your bread in one oven, and they will dole out the bread by weight. You will eat, but you will not be satisfied.

verses.textZh: "如果你们经过这事，还是不听从我，行事仍与我的心意相违，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你们经过这事，还是不听从我，行事仍与我的心意相违，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们因这一切的事若不听从我，却行事与我反对，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If in spite of this you still do not listen to me but continue to be hostile toward me,
verses.textEnEsv: "But if in spite of this you will not listen to me, but walk contrary to me,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And after all this, if you do not obey Me, but walk contrary to Me,
verses.textEnNlt: "If in spite of all this you still refuse to listen and still remain hostile toward me,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Yet if in spite of this you do not obey Me, but act with hostility against Me,
verses.textEn: " ‘If in spite of this you still do not listen to me but continue to be hostile toward me,

verses.textZh: 我就必发烈怒，与你们作对；我要按着你们的罪，再加重七倍管教你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就必发烈怒，与你们作对；我要按着你们的罪，再加重七倍管教你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就要发烈怒，行事与你们反对，又因你们的罪惩罚你们七次。
verses.textEnNiv: then in my anger I will be hostile toward you, and I myself will punish you for your sins seven times over.
verses.textEnEsv: then I will walk contrary to you in fury, and I myself will discipline you sevenfold for your sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I also will walk contrary to you in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.textEnNlt: then I will give full vent to my hostility. I myself will punish you seven times over for your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: then I will act with wrathful hostility against you, and I for My part will punish you seven times for your sins.
verses.textEn: then in my anger I will be hostile toward you, and I myself will punish you for your sins seven times over.

verses.textZh: 你们要吃自己儿子的肉，女儿的肉也要吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要吃自己儿子的肉，女儿的肉也要吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你们要吃儿子的肉，也要吃女儿的肉。
verses.textEnNiv: You will eat the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall eat the flesh of your sons, and you shall eat the flesh of your daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat the flesh of your sons, and you shall eat the flesh of your daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Further, you will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.
verses.textEn: You will eat the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters.

verses.textZh: 我必毁坏你们的邱坛，砍倒你们的香坛，把你们的尸体扔在你们仆倒的偶像上面；我的心必厌弃你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必毁坏你们的邱坛，砍倒你们的香坛，把你们的尸体扔在你们仆倒的偶像上面；我的心必厌弃你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又要毁坏你们的邱坛，砍下你们的日像，把你们的尸首扔在你们偶像的身上；我的心也必厌恶你们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars and pile your dead bodies on the lifeless forms of your idols, and I will abhor you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will destroy your high places and cut down your incense altars and cast your dead bodies upon the dead bodies of your idols, and my soul will abhor you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and cast your carcasses on the lifeless forms of your idols; and My soul shall abhor you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will destroy your pagan shrines and knock down your places of worship. I will leave your lifeless corpses piled on top of your lifeless idols, and I will despise you.
verses.textEnNasb: I then will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and pile your remains on the remains of your idols, for My soul will loathe you.
verses.textEn: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars and pile your dead bodies on the lifeless forms of your idols, and I will abhor you.

verses.textZh: 我必使你们的城市变为荒场，使你们的圣所荒凉；我也不闻你们馨香的祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你们的城市变为荒场，使你们的圣所荒凉；我也不闻你们馨香的祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使你们的城邑变为荒凉，使你们的众圣所成为荒场；我也不闻你们馨香的香气。
verses.textEnNiv: I will turn your cities into ruins and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will take no delight in the pleasing aroma of your offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will lay your cities waste and will make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell your pleasing aromas.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will lay your cities waste and bring your sanctuaries to desolation, and I will not smell the fragrance of your sweet aromas.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make your cities desolate and destroy your places of pagan worship. I will take no pleasure in your offerings that should be a pleasing aroma to me.
verses.textEnNasb: I will turn your cities into ruins as well and make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell your soothing aromas.
verses.textEn: I will turn your cities into ruins and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will take no delight in the pleasing aroma of your offerings.

verses.textZh: 我要使地荒凉，连住在那里的仇敌也惊奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使地荒凉，连住在那里的仇敌也惊奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使地成为荒场，住在其上的仇敌就因此诧异。
verses.textEnNiv: I myself will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who live there will be appalled.
verses.textEnEsv: And I myself will devastate the land, so that your enemies who settle in it shall be appalled at it.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bring the land to desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it shall be astonished at it.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I myself will devastate your land, and your enemies who come to occupy it will be appalled at what they see.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will make the land desolate so that your enemies who settle in it will be appalled at it.
verses.textEn: I myself will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who live there will be appalled.

verses.textZh: 我要把你们分散在万国中，我又拔出刀来追赶你们；你们的地成为荒凉，你们的城市变成荒场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把你们分散在万国中，我又拔出刀来追赶你们；你们的地成为荒凉，你们的城市变成荒场。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要把你们散在列邦中；我也要拔刀追赶你们。你们的地要成为荒场；你们的城邑要变为荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out my sword and pursue you. Your land will be laid waste, and your cities will lie in ruins.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will scatter you among the nations, and I will unsheathe the sword after you, and your land shall be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will scatter you among the nations and draw out a sword after you; your land shall be desolate and your cities waste.
verses.textEnNlt: I will scatter you among the nations and bring out my sword against you. Your land will become desolate, and your cities will lie in ruins.
verses.textEnNasb: You, however, I will scatter among the nations, and I will draw out a sword after you, as your land becomes desolate and your cities become ruins.
verses.textEn: I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out my sword and pursue you. Your land will be laid waste, and your cities will lie in ruins.

verses.textZh: "当那地荒凉，你们又住在仇敌之地的时候，地就享受安息；那地要休歇，享受安息。
verses.textZhCnvs: "当那地荒凉，你们又住在仇敌之地的时候，地就享受安息；那地要休歇，享受安息。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们在仇敌之地居住的时候，你们的地荒凉，要享受众安息；正在那时候，地要歇息，享受安息。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the land will enjoy its sabbath years all the time that it lies desolate and you are in the country of your enemies; then the land will rest and enjoy its sabbaths.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate, while you are in your enemies’ land; then the land shall rest, and enjoy its Sabbaths.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the land shall enjoy its sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land; then the land shall rest and enjoy its sabbaths.
verses.textEnNlt: Then at last the land will enjoy its neglected Sabbath years as it lies desolate while you are in exile in the land of your enemies. Then the land will finally rest and enjoy the Sabbaths it missed.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then the land will restore its Sabbaths all the days of the desolation, while you are in your enemies’ land; then the land will rest and restore its Sabbaths.
verses.textEn: Then the land will enjoy its sabbath years all the time that it lies desolate and you are in the country of your enemies; then the land will rest and enjoy its sabbaths.

verses.textZh: 因为你们居住在那里的时候，地不能在你们的安息年中享受安息，唯有在荒凉的日子，才可享安息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们居住在那里的时候，地不能在你们的安息年中享受安息，唯有在荒凉的日子，才可享安息。
verses.textZhCuv: 地多时为荒场，就要多时歇息；地这样歇息，是你们住在其上的安息年所不能得的。
verses.textEnNiv: All the time that it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not have during the sabbaths you lived in it.
verses.textEnEsv: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, the rest that it did not have on your Sabbaths when you were dwelling in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: As long as it lies desolate it shall rest— for the time it did not rest on your sabbaths when you dwelt in it.
verses.textEnNlt: As long as the land lies in ruins, it will enjoy the rest you never allowed it to take every seventh year while you lived in it.
verses.textEnNasb: All the days of its desolation it will have the rest which it did not have on your Sabbaths, while you were living on it.
verses.textEn: All the time that it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not have during the sabbaths you lived in it.

verses.textZh: 至于你们剩下的人，我必使他们在仇敌之地胆战心惊；风吹落叶也会吓跑他们；他们必逃跑，好象逃避刀剑一样；虽然无人追赶，他们却跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你们剩下的人，我必使他们在仇敌之地胆战心惊；风吹落叶也会吓跑他们；他们必逃跑，好象逃避刀剑一样；虽然无人追赶，他们却跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你们剩下的人，我要使他们在仇敌之地心惊胆怯。叶子被风吹的响声，要追赶他们；他们要逃避，像人逃避刀剑，无人追赶，却要跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘As for those of you who are left, I will make their hearts so fearful in the lands of their enemies that the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. They will run as though fleeing from the sword, and they will fall, even though no one is pursuing them.
verses.textEnEsv: And as for those of you who are left, I will send faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf shall put them to flight, and they shall flee as one flees from the sword, and they shall fall when none pursues.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And as for those of you who are left, I will send faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; the sound of a shaken leaf shall cause them to flee; they shall flee as though fleeing from a sword, and they shall fall when no one pursues.
verses.textEnNlt: "And for those of you who survive, I will demoralize you in the land of your enemies. You will live in such fear that the sound of a leaf driven by the wind will send you fleeing. You will run as though fleeing from a sword, and you will fall even when no one pursues you.
verses.textEnNasb: As for those among you who are left, I will also bring despair into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. And the sound of a scattered leaf will chase them, and even when no one is pursuing they will flee as though from the sword, and they will fall.
verses.textEn: " ‘As for those of you who are left, I will make their hearts so fearful in the lands of their enemies that the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. They will run as though fleeing from the sword, and they will fall, even though no one is pursuing them.

verses.textZh: 虽然无人追赶，他们却像面临刀剑，彼此撞跌；你们在仇敌面前，不能站立得住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然无人追赶，他们却像面临刀剑，彼此撞跌；你们在仇敌面前，不能站立得住。
verses.textZhCuv: 无人追赶，他们要彼此撞跌，像在刀剑之前。你们在仇敌面前也必站立不住。
verses.textEnNiv: They will stumble over one another as though fleeing from the sword, even though no one is pursuing them. So you will not be able to stand before your enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall stumble over one another, as if to escape a sword, though none pursues. And you shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall stumble over one another, as it were before a sword, when no one pursues; and you shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: Though no one is chasing you, you will stumble over each other as though fleeing from a sword. You will have no power to stand up against your enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: They will then stumble over each other as if running from the sword, although no one is pursuing; and you will have no strength to stand before your enemies.
verses.textEn: They will stumble over one another as though fleeing from the sword, even though no one is pursuing them. So you will not be able to stand before your enemies.

verses.textZh: 你们要在万国中灭亡；仇敌之地必吞灭你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在万国中灭亡；仇敌之地必吞灭你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要在列邦中灭亡；仇敌之地要吞吃你们。
verses.textEnNiv: You will perish among the nations; the land of your enemies will devour you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.textEnNlt: You will die among the foreign nations and be devoured in the land of your enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, you will perish among the nations, and your enemies’ land will consume you.
verses.textEn: You will perish among the nations; the land of your enemies will devour you.

verses.textZh: 你们剩下的人，必因自己的罪孽在仇敌之地消灭，也因犯了祖先的罪孽日渐衰弱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们剩下的人，必因自己的罪孽在仇敌之地消灭，也因犯了祖先的罪孽日渐衰弱。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们剩下的人必因自己的罪孽和祖宗的罪孽在仇敌之地消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Those of you who are left will waste away in the lands of their enemies because of their sins; also because of their ancestors’ sins they will waste away.
verses.textEnEsv: And those of you who are left shall rot away in your enemies’ lands because of their iniquity, and also because of the iniquities of their fathers they shall rot away like them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those of you who are left shall waste away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; also in their fathers’ iniquities, which are with them, they shall waste away.
verses.textEnNlt: Those of you who survive will waste away in your enemies’ lands because of their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: So those of you who may be left will rot away because of their wrongdoing in the lands of your enemies; and also because of the wrongdoing of their forefathers they will rot away with them.
verses.textEn: Those of you who are left will waste away in the lands of their enemies because of their sins; also because of their ancestors’ sins they will waste away.

verses.textZh: "那时他们就会承认自己的罪孽和他们祖先的罪孽，就是他们对我不忠的过犯，又承认因为行事与我的心意相违，
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时他们就会承认自己的罪孽和他们祖先的罪孽，就是他们对我不忠的过犯，又承认因为行事与我的心意相违，
verses.textZhCuv: 「他们要承认自己的罪和他们祖宗的罪，就是干犯我的那罪，并且承认自己行事与我反对，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But if they will confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors—their unfaithfulness and their hostility toward me,
verses.textEnEsv: "But if they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers in their treachery that they committed against me, and also in walking contrary to me,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But if they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, with their unfaithfulness in which they were unfaithful to Me, and that they also have walked contrary to Me,
verses.textEnNlt: "But at last my people will confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors for betraying me and being hostile toward me.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But if they confess their wrongdoing and the wrongdoing of their forefathers, in their unfaithfulness which they committed against Me, and also in their acting with hostility against Me—
verses.textEn: " ‘But if they will confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors—their unfaithfulness and their hostility toward me,

verses.textZh: 以致我也与他们作对，把他们带到他们的仇敌之地。如果他们未受割礼的心这样谦卑下来，情愿接受他们罪孽的刑罚，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以致我也与他们作对，把他们带到他们的仇敌之地。如果他们未受割礼的心这样谦卑下来，情愿接受他们罪孽的刑罚，
verses.textZhCuv: 我所以行事与他们反对，把他们带到仇敌之地。那时，他们未受割礼的心若谦卑了，他们也服了罪孽的刑罚，
verses.textEnNiv: which made me hostile toward them so that I sent them into the land of their enemies—then when their uncircumcised hearts are humbled and they pay for their sin,
verses.textEnEsv: so that I walked contrary to them and brought them into the land of their enemies—if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled and they make amends for their iniquity,
verses.textEnNkjv: and that I also have walked contrary to them and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if their uncircumcised hearts are humbled, and they accept their guilt—
verses.textEnNlt: When I have turned their hostility back on them and brought them to the land of their enemies, then at last their stubborn hearts will be humbled, and they will pay for their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: I also was acting with hostility against them, to bring them into the land of their enemies—or if their uncircumcised heart is humbled so that they then make amends for their wrongdoing,
verses.textEn: which made me hostile toward them so that I sent them into the land of their enemies—then when their uncircumcised hearts are humbled and they pay for their sin,

verses.textZh: 我就记念我与雅各所立的约，记念我与以撒所立的约，与亚伯拉罕所立的约；我也记念这地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就记念我与雅各所立的约，记念我与以撒所立的约，与亚伯拉罕所立的约；我也记念这地。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就要记念我与雅各所立的约，与以撒所立的约，与亚伯拉罕所立的约，并要记念这地。
verses.textEnNiv: I will remember my covenant with Jacob and my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
verses.textEnEsv: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, and I will remember my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob, and My covenant with Isaac and My covenant with Abraham I will remember; I will remember the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will remember my covenant with Jacob and my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
verses.textEnNasb: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob, and I will remember also My covenant with Isaac, and My covenant with Abraham as well, and I will remember the land.
verses.textEn: I will remember my covenant with Jacob and my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

verses.textZh: 他们会离开这地，地在荒凉无人的时候，就可以享受安息，同时他们要接受他们罪孽的刑罚，因为他们弃绝了我的典章，他们的心厌弃了我的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们会离开这地，地在荒凉无人的时候，就可以享受安息，同时他们要接受他们罪孽的刑罚，因为他们弃绝了我的典章，他们的心厌弃了我的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们离开这地，地在荒废无人的时候就要享受安息。并且他们要服罪孽的刑罚；因为他们厌弃了我的典章，心中厌恶了我的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: For the land will be deserted by them and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them. They will pay for their sins because they rejected my laws and abhorred my decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: But the land shall be abandoned by them and enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them, and they shall make amends for their iniquity, because they spurned my rules and their soul abhorred my statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: The land also shall be left empty by them, and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; they will accept their guilt, because they despised My judgments and because their soul abhorred My statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: For the land must be abandoned to enjoy its years of Sabbath rest as it lies deserted. At last the people will pay for their sins, for they have continually rejected my regulations and despised my decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: For the land will be abandoned by them, and will restore its Sabbaths while it is made desolate without them. They, meanwhile, will be making amends for their wrongdoing, because they rejected My ordinances and their soul loathed My statutes.
verses.textEn: For the land will be deserted by them and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them. They will pay for their sins because they rejected my laws and abhorred my decrees.

verses.textZh: 虽然这样，他们住在仇敌之地的时候，我还是不弃绝他们，也不厌弃他们，不把他们灭绝，我不会违背我与他们所立的约；因为我是耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然这样，他们住在仇敌之地的时候，我还是不弃绝他们，也不厌弃他们，不把他们灭绝，我不会违背我与他们所立的约；因为我是耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽是这样，他们在仇敌之地，我却不厌弃他们，也不厌恶他们，将他们尽行灭绝，也不背弃我与他们所立的约，因为我是耶和华－他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them or abhor them so as to destroy them completely, breaking my covenant with them. I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not spurn them, neither will I abhor them so as to destroy them utterly and break my covenant with them, for I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, nor shall I abhor them, to utterly destroy them and break My covenant with them; for I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNlt: "But despite all this, I will not utterly reject or despise them while they are in exile in the land of their enemies. I will not cancel my covenant with them by wiping them out, for I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, nor will I so loathe them as to destroy them, breaking My covenant with them; for I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEn: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them or abhor them so as to destroy them completely, breaking my covenant with them. I am the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: 因为他们的缘故，我要记念我与他们祖先所立的约；他们的祖先是我在列国眼前，从埃及地领出来的，为要作他们的神；我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们的缘故，我要记念我与他们祖先所立的约；他们的祖先是我在列国眼前，从埃及地领出来的，为要作他们的神；我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我却要为他们的缘故记念我与他们先祖所立的约。他们的先祖是我在列邦人眼前、从埃及地领出来的，为要作他们的神。我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their ancestors whom I brought out of Egypt in the sight of the nations to be their God. I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But I will for their sake remember the covenant with their forefathers, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: But for their sake I will remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For their sakes I will remember my ancient covenant with their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of all the nations, that I might be their God. I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: But I will remember for them the covenant with their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, so that I might be their God. I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their ancestors whom I brought out of Egypt in the sight of the nations to be their God. I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 这些是耶和华在西奈山，借着摩西颁布他和以色列人之间的律例、典章和法则。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些是耶和华在西奈山，借着摩西颁布他和以色列人之间的律例、典章和法则。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些律例、典章，和法度是耶和华与以色列人在西奈山藉着摩西立的。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the decrees, the laws and the regulations that the Lord established at Mount Sinai between himself and the Israelites through Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the statutes and rules and laws that the Lord made between himself and the people of Israel through Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the statutes and judgments and laws which the Lord made between Himself and the children of Israel on Mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the decrees, regulations, and instructions that the Lord gave through Moses on Mount Sinai as evidence of the relationship between himself and the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the statutes and ordinances and laws which the Lord established between Himself and the sons of Israel through Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEn: These are the decrees, the laws and the regulations that the Lord established at Mount Sinai between himself and the Israelites through Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Again, the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人，对他们说：如果人许特别的愿，献身给耶和华，就要依照你的估价献身价。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人，对他们说：如果人许特别的愿，献身给耶和华，就要依照你的估价献身价。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：人还特许的愿，被许的人要按你所估的价值归给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘If anyone makes a special vow to dedicate a person to the Lord by giving the equivalent value,
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, If anyone makes a special vow to the Lord involving the valuation of persons,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When a man consecrates by a vow certain persons to the Lord, according to your valuation,
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. If anyone makes a special vow to dedicate someone to the Lord by paying the value of that person,
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When someone makes an explicit vow, he shall be valued according to your assessment of persons belonging to the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘If anyone makes a special vow to dedicate a person to the Lord by giving the equivalent value,

verses.textZh: 你应该这样估价：从二十岁到六十岁的男人，你要按着圣所衡量银子的标准，估价五百五十克银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你应该这样估价：从二十岁到六十岁的男人，你要按着圣所衡量银子的标准，估价五百五十克银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你估定的，从二十岁到六十岁的男人，要按圣所的平，估定价银五十舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: set the value of a male between the ages of twenty and sixty at fifty shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel ;
verses.textEnEsv: then the valuation of a male from twenty years old up to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: if your valuation is of a male from twenty years old up to sixty years old, then your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: here is the scale of values to be used. A man between the ages of twenty and sixty is valued at fifty shekels of silver, as measured by the sanctuary shekel.
verses.textEnNasb: If your assessment is of a male from twenty years even to sixty years old, then your assessment shall be fifty shekels of silver, by the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: set the value of a male between the ages of twenty and sixty at fifty shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel ;

verses.textZh: 如果是女人，你要估价三百四十二克银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果是女人，你要估价三百四十二克银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是女人，你要估定三十舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: for a female, set her value at thirty shekels ;
verses.textEnEsv: If the person is a female, the valuation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.textEnNkjv: If it is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels;
verses.textEnNlt: A woman of that age is valued at thirty shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNasb: Or if the person is a female, then your assessment shall be thirty shekels.
verses.textEn: for a female, set her value at thirty shekels ;

verses.textZh: 如果是五岁到二十岁，男子的估价是二百二十八克银子，女子是一百一十四克银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果是五岁到二十岁，男子的估价是二百二十八克银子，女子是一百一十四克银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是从五岁到二十岁，男子你要估定二十舍客勒，女子估定十舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: for a person between the ages of five and twenty, set the value of a male at twenty shekels and of a female at ten shekels ;
verses.textEnEsv: If the person is from five years old up to twenty years old, the valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
verses.textEnNkjv: and if from five years old up to twenty years old, then your valuation for a male shall be twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels;
verses.textEnNlt: A boy between the ages of five and twenty is valued at twenty shekels of silver; a girl of that age is valued at ten shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNasb: And if the person is from five years even to twenty years old, then your assessment for a male shall be twenty shekels, and for a female, ten shekels.
verses.textEn: for a person between the ages of five and twenty, set the value of a male at twenty shekels and of a female at ten shekels ;

verses.textZh: 如果是一个月到五岁，男子的估价是五十七克银子，女子是三十四克银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果是一个月到五岁，男子的估价是五十七克银子，女子是三十四克银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是从一月到五岁，男子你要估定五舍客勒，女子估定三舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: for a person between one month and five years, set the value of a male at five shekels of silver and that of a female at three shekels of silver;
verses.textEnEsv: If the person is from a month old up to five years old, the valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female the valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: and if from a month old up to five years old, then your valuation for a male shall be five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver;
verses.textEnNlt: A boy between the ages of one month and five years is valued at five shekels of silver; a girl of that age is valued at three shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNasb: But if the person is from a month even up to five years old, then your assessment shall be five shekels of silver for a male, and for a female your assessment shall be three shekels of silver.
verses.textEn: for a person between one month and five years, set the value of a male at five shekels of silver and that of a female at three shekels of silver;

verses.textZh: 如果是六十岁以上，男子的估价是一百七十一克银子，女子是一百一十四克银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果是六十岁以上，男子的估价是一百七十一克银子，女子是一百一十四克银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是从六十岁以上，男人你要估定十五舍客勒，女人估定十舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: for a person sixty years old or more, set the value of a male at fifteen shekels and of a female at ten shekels.
verses.textEnEsv: And if the person is sixty years old or over, then the valuation for a male shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
verses.textEnNkjv: and if from sixty years old and above, if it is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
verses.textEnNlt: A man older than sixty is valued at fifteen shekels of silver; a woman of that age is valued at ten shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNasb: If the person is from sixty years old and upward, if a male, then your assessment shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female, ten shekels.
verses.textEn: for a person sixty years old or more, set the value of a male at fifteen shekels and of a female at ten shekels.

verses.textZh: 那人若是贫穷，不能支付你估定的价，就要把他带到祭司面前，让祭司估定他的价；祭司就按着许愿的人的经济能力，估定他的价。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人若是贫穷，不能支付你估定的价，就要把他带到祭司面前，让祭司估定他的价；祭司就按着许愿的人的经济能力，估定他的价。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若贫穷，不能照你所估定的价，就要把他带到祭司面前，祭司要按许愿人的力量估定他的价。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone making the vow is too poor to pay the specified amount, the person being dedicated is to be presented to the priest, who will set the value according to what the one making the vow can afford.
verses.textEnEsv: And if someone is too poor to pay the valuation, then he shall be made to stand before the priest, and the priest shall value him; the priest shall value him according to what the vower can afford.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But if he is too poor to pay your valuation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall set a value for him; according to the ability of him who vowed, the priest shall value him.
verses.textEnNlt: If you desire to make such a vow but cannot afford to pay the required amount, take the person to the priest. He will determine the amount for you to pay based on what you can afford.
verses.textEnNasb: But if he is poorer than your assessment, then he shall be presented before the priest, and the priest shall assess him; according to the means of the one who vowed, the priest shall assess him.
verses.textEn: If anyone making the vow is too poor to pay the specified amount, the person being dedicated is to be presented to the priest, who will set the value according to what the one making the vow can afford.

verses.textZh: 如果所许的是可以献给耶和华为供物的牲畜，献给耶和华的任何牲畜，都要分别为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果所许的是可以献给耶和华为供物的牲畜，献给耶和华的任何牲畜，都要分别为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 「所许的若是牲畜，就是人献给耶和华为供物的，凡这一类献给耶和华的，都要成为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If what they vowed is an animal that is acceptable as an offering to the Lord , such an animal given to the Lord becomes holy.
verses.textEnEsv: "If the vow is an animal that may be offered as an offering to the Lord , all of it that he gives to the Lord is holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If it is an animal that men may bring as an offering to the Lord, all that anyone gives to the Lord shall be holy.
verses.textEnNlt: "If your vow involves giving an animal that is acceptable as an offering to the Lord , any gift to the Lord will be considered holy.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if it is an animal of the kind that one can present as an offering to the Lord, any such animal that one gives to the Lord shall be holy.
verses.textEn: " ‘If what they vowed is an animal that is acceptable as an offering to the Lord , such an animal given to the Lord becomes holy.

verses.textZh: 不可更换，也不可代替；无论是好的换坏的，或是坏的换好的，都不可以。如果人一定要以另一只牲畜代替以前所许的牲畜献上，那么以前所许的和用来交换的，都要分别为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可更换，也不可代替；无论是好的换坏的，或是坏的换好的，都不可以。如果人一定要以另一只牲畜代替以前所许的牲畜献上，那么以前所许的和用来交换的，都要分别为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 人不可改换，也不可更换，或是好的换坏的，或是坏的换好的。若以牲畜更换牲畜，所许的与所换的都要成为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: They must not exchange it or substitute a good one for a bad one, or a bad one for a good one; if they should substitute one animal for another, both it and the substitute become holy.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall not exchange it or make a substitute for it, good for bad, or bad for good; and if he does in fact substitute one animal for another, then both it and the substitute shall be holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall not substitute it or exchange it, good for bad or bad for good; and if he at all exchanges animal for animal, then both it and the one exchanged for it shall be holy.
verses.textEnNlt: You may not exchange or substitute it for another animal—neither a good animal for a bad one nor a bad animal for a good one. But if you do exchange one animal for another, then both the original animal and its substitute will be considered holy.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall not replace it nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good; yet if he does exchange animal for animal, then both it and its substitute shall become holy.
verses.textEn: They must not exchange it or substitute a good one for a bad one, or a bad one for a good one; if they should substitute one animal for another, both it and the substitute become holy.

verses.textZh: 所许的若是不洁净的牲畜，人不能把牠献给耶和华为供物，就要把牲畜牵到祭司面前；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所许的若是不洁净的牲畜，人不能把牠献给耶和华为供物，就要把牲畜牵到祭司面前；
verses.textZhCuv: 若牲畜不洁净，是不可献给耶和华为供物的，就要把牲畜安置在祭司面前。
verses.textEnNiv: If what they vowed is a ceremonially unclean animal—one that is not acceptable as an offering to the Lord —the animal must be presented to the priest,
verses.textEnEsv: And if it is any unclean animal that may not be offered as an offering to the Lord , then he shall stand the animal before the priest,
verses.textEnNkjv: If it is an unclean animal which they do not offer as a sacrifice to the Lord, then he shall present the animal before the priest;
verses.textEnNlt: If your vow involves an unclean animal—one that is not acceptable as an offering to the Lord —then you must bring the animal to the priest.
verses.textEnNasb: If, however, it is any unclean animal of the kind which one does not present as an offering to the Lord, then he shall place the animal before the priest.
verses.textEn: If what they vowed is a ceremonially unclean animal—one that is not acceptable as an offering to the Lord —the animal must be presented to the priest,

verses.textZh: 祭司要按牲畜的好坏估价；祭司估价多少，就是多少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要按牲畜的好坏估价；祭司估价多少，就是多少。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司就要估定价值；牲畜是好是坏，祭司怎样估定，就要以怎样为是。
verses.textEnNiv: who will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, that is what it will be.
verses.textEnEsv: and the priest shall value it as either good or bad; as the priest values it, so it shall be.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the priest shall set a value for it, whether it is good or bad; as you, the priest, value it, so it shall be.
verses.textEnNlt: He will assess its value, and his assessment will be final, whether high or low.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest shall assess it as either good or bad; as you, the priest, assess it, so shall it be.
verses.textEn: who will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, that is what it will be.

verses.textZh: 如果他一定要把牲畜赎回，就要按你的估价，多付五分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他一定要把牲畜赎回，就要按你的估价，多付五分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若一定要赎回，就要在你所估定的价值以外加上五分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: If the owner wishes to redeem the animal, a fifth must be added to its value.
verses.textEnEsv: But if he wishes to redeem it, he shall add a fifth to the valuation.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if he wants at all to redeem it, then he must add one-fifth to your valuation.
verses.textEnNlt: If you want to buy back the animal, you must pay the value set by the priest, plus 20 percent.
verses.textEnNasb: But if he should ever want to redeem it, then he shall add a fifth of it to your assessment.
verses.textEn: If the owner wishes to redeem the animal, a fifth must be added to its value.

verses.textZh: "如果有人把房屋分别为圣献给耶和华，祭司要按房屋的好坏估价，祭司估价多少，就定它价值多少。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人把房屋分别为圣献给耶和华，祭司要按房屋的好坏估价，祭司估价多少，就定它价值多少。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人将房屋分别为圣，归给耶和华，祭司就要估定价值。房屋是好是坏，祭司怎样估定，就要以怎样为定。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If anyone dedicates their house as something holy to the Lord , the priest will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, so it will remain.
verses.textEnEsv: "When a man dedicates his house as a holy gift to the Lord , the priest shall value it as either good or bad; as the priest values it, so it shall stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And when a man dedicates his house to be holy to the Lord, then the priest shall set a value for it, whether it is good or bad; as the priest values it, so it shall stand.
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone dedicates a house to the Lord , the priest will come to assess its value. The priest’s assessment will be final, whether high or low.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now if someone consecrates his house as holy to the Lord, then the priest shall assess it as either good or bad; as the priest assesses it, so shall it stand.
verses.textEn: " ‘If anyone dedicates their house as something holy to the Lord , the priest will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, so it will remain.

verses.textZh: 把自己房屋分别为圣的人，如果要赎回房屋，就要按你估定的价银，多加五分之一，房屋才可以归他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把自己房屋分别为圣的人，如果要赎回房屋，就要按你估定的价银，多加五分之一，房屋才可以归他。
verses.textZhCuv: 将房屋分别为圣的人，若要赎回房屋，就必在你所估定的价值以外加上五分之一，房屋仍旧归他。
verses.textEnNiv: If the one who dedicates their house wishes to redeem it, they must add a fifth to its value, and the house will again become theirs.
verses.textEnEsv: And if the donor wishes to redeem his house, he shall add a fifth to the valuation price, and it shall be his.
verses.textEnNkjv: If he who dedicated it wants to redeem his house, then he must add one-fifth of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.
verses.textEnNlt: If the person who dedicated the house wants to buy it back, he must pay the value set by the priest, plus 20 percent. Then the house will again be his.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet if the one who consecrates it should want to redeem his house, then he shall add a fifth of your assessment price to it, so that it may be his.
verses.textEn: If the one who dedicates their house wishes to redeem it, they must add a fifth to its value, and the house will again become theirs.

verses.textZh: "如果有人把自己产业的一部分，分别为圣献给耶和华，你的估价要根据那地的撒种量：每撒大麦二十公斤，估价五百七十克银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人把自己产业的一部分，分别为圣献给耶和华，你的估价要根据那地的撒种量：每撒大麦二十公斤，估价五百七十克银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若将承受为业的几分地分别为圣，归给耶和华，你要按这地撒种多少估定价值，若撒大麦一贺梅珥，要估价五十舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If anyone dedicates to the Lord part of their family land, its value is to be set according to the amount of seed required for it—fifty shekels of silver to a homer of barley seed.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man dedicates to the Lord part of the land that is his possession, then the valuation shall be in proportion to its seed. A homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If a man dedicates to the Lord part of a field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. A homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone dedicates to the Lord a piece of his family property, its value will be assessed according to the amount of seed required to plant it—fifty shekels of silver for a field planted with five bushels of barley seed.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Again, if someone consecrates to the Lord part of the field of his own property, then your assessment shall be proportionate to the seed needed for it: a homer of barley seed at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.textEn: " ‘If anyone dedicates to the Lord part of their family land, its value is to be set according to the amount of seed required for it—fifty shekels of silver to a homer of barley seed.

verses.textZh: 如果他从禧年起，把自己的田地分别为圣，就要按照你的估价定那田地的价值。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他从禧年起，把自己的田地分别为圣，就要按照你的估价定那田地的价值。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若从禧年将地分别为圣，就要以你所估定的价为定。
verses.textEnNiv: If they dedicate a field during the Year of Jubilee, the value that has been set remains.
verses.textEnEsv: If he dedicates his field from the year of jubilee, the valuation shall stand,
verses.textEnNkjv: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.
verses.textEnNlt: If the field is dedicated to the Lord in the Year of Jubilee, then the entire assessment will apply.
verses.textEnNasb: If he consecrates his field as of the year of jubilee, according to your assessment it shall stand.
verses.textEn: If they dedicate a field during the Year of Jubilee, the value that has been set remains.

verses.textZh: 如果他在禧年以后，把自己的田地分别为圣，祭司就要照着到下一个禧年所剩余的年数，给他计算价银，然后从你的估价减去这价银。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他在禧年以后，把自己的田地分别为圣，祭司就要照着到下一个禧年所剩余的年数，给他计算价银，然后从你的估价减去这价银。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若他在禧年以后将地分别为圣，祭司就要按着未到禧年所剩的年数推算价值，也要从你所估的减去价值。
verses.textEnNiv: But if they dedicate a field after the Jubilee, the priest will determine the value according to the number of years that remain until the next Year of Jubilee, and its set value will be reduced.
verses.textEnEsv: but if he dedicates his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall calculate the price according to the years that remain until the year of jubilee, and a deduction shall be made from the valuation.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money due according to the years that remain till the Year of Jubilee, and it shall be deducted from your valuation.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the field is dedicated after the Year of Jubilee, the priest will assess the land’s value in proportion to the number of years left until the next Year of Jubilee. Its assessed value is reduced each year.
verses.textEnNasb: If he consecrates his field after the jubilee, however, then the priest shall calculate the price for him proportionate to the years that are left until the year of jubilee; and it shall be deducted from your assessment.
verses.textEn: But if they dedicate a field after the Jubilee, the priest will determine the value according to the number of years that remain until the next Year of Jubilee, and its set value will be reduced.

verses.textZh: 把自己田地分别为圣的人，如果一定要赎回田地，就要按你的估价，多付五分之一，田地才可以归他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把自己田地分别为圣的人，如果一定要赎回田地，就要按你的估价，多付五分之一，田地才可以归他。
verses.textZhCuv: 将地分别为圣的人若定要把地赎回，他便要在你所估的价值以外加上五分之一，地就准定归他。
verses.textEnNiv: If the one who dedicates the field wishes to redeem it, they must add a fifth to its value, and the field will again become theirs.
verses.textEnEsv: And if he who dedicates the field wishes to redeem it, then he shall add a fifth to its valuation price, and it shall remain his.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if he who dedicates the field ever wishes to redeem it, then he must add one-fifth of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall belong to him.
verses.textEnNlt: If the person who dedicated the field wants to buy it back, he must pay the value set by the priest, plus 20 percent. Then the field will again be legally his.
verses.textEnNasb: If the one who consecrates it should ever want to redeem the field, then he shall add a fifth of your assessment price to it, so that it may belong to him.
verses.textEn: If the one who dedicates the field wishes to redeem it, they must add a fifth to its value, and the field will again become theirs.

verses.textZh: 如果他不赎回田地，而卖给别人，他就再也不能赎回田地了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他不赎回田地，而卖给别人，他就再也不能赎回田地了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若不赎回那地，或是将地卖给别人，就再不能赎了。
verses.textEnNiv: If, however, they do not redeem the field, or if they have sold it to someone else, it can never be redeemed.
verses.textEnEsv: But if he does not wish to redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed anymore.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if he does not want to redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed anymore;
verses.textEnNlt: But if he does not want to buy it back, and it is sold to someone else, the field can no longer be bought back.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet if he does not redeem the field, but has sold the field to another person, it may no longer be redeemed;
verses.textEn: If, however, they do not redeem the field, or if they have sold it to someone else, it can never be redeemed.

verses.textZh: 到了禧年，买主就要交出那地归耶和华为圣，像永属耶和华的圣地一样，归祭司为产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了禧年，买主就要交出那地归耶和华为圣，像永属耶和华的圣地一样，归祭司为产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 但到了禧年，那地从买主手下出来的时候，就要归耶和华为圣，和永献的地一样，要归祭司为业。
verses.textEnNiv: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the Lord ; it will become priestly property.
verses.textEnEsv: But the field, when it is released in the jubilee, shall be a holy gift to the Lord , like a field that has been devoted. The priest shall be in possession of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the field, when it is released in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the Lord, as a devoted field; it shall be the possession of the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: When the field is released in the Year of Jubilee, it will be holy, a field specially set apart for the Lord . It will become the property of the priests.
verses.textEnNasb: and when it reverts in the jubilee, the field shall be holy to the Lord, like a field banned from secular use; it shall be for the priest as his property.
verses.textEn: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the Lord ; it will become priestly property.

verses.textZh: 如果人把买来的田地，不是自己承受为业的田地，分别为圣献给耶和华，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人把买来的田地，不是自己承受为业的田地，分别为圣献给耶和华，
verses.textZhCuv: 他若将所买的一块地，不是承受为业的，分别为圣归给耶和华，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If anyone dedicates to the Lord a field they have bought, which is not part of their family land,
verses.textEnEsv: If he dedicates to the Lord a field that he has bought, which is not a part of his possession,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if a man dedicates to the Lord a field which he has bought, which is not the field of his possession,
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone dedicates to the Lord a field he has purchased but which is not part of his family property,
verses.textEnNasb: Or if he consecrates to the Lord a field which he has bought, which is not a part of the field of his own property,
verses.textEn: " ‘If anyone dedicates to the Lord a field they have bought, which is not part of their family land,

verses.textZh: 祭司就要按照你的估价，给他计算，直到禧年为止；价值多少，他必须当天付给你估定的价银，表示把那地献给耶和华为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司就要按照你的估价，给他计算，直到禧年为止；价值多少，他必须当天付给你估定的价银，表示把那地献给耶和华为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司就要将你所估的价值给他推算到禧年。当日，他要以你所估的价银为圣，归给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: the priest will determine its value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the owner must pay its value on that day as something holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: then the priest shall calculate the amount of the valuation for it up to the year of jubilee, and the man shall give the valuation on that day as a holy gift to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation, up to the Year of Jubilee, and he shall give your valuation on that day as a holy offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: the priest will assess its value based on the number of years left until the next Year of Jubilee. On that day he must give the assessed value of the land as a sacred donation to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: then the priest shall calculate for him the amount of your assessment up to the year of jubilee; and he shall on that day give your assessment as holy to the Lord.
verses.textEn: the priest will determine its value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the owner must pay its value on that day as something holy to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 到了禧年，那地要归还卖主，就是归还那承受那地为业的原主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了禧年，那地要归还卖主，就是归还那承受那地为业的原主。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了禧年，那地要归卖主，就是那承受为业的原主。
verses.textEnNiv: In the Year of Jubilee the field will revert to the person from whom it was bought, the one whose land it was.
verses.textEnEsv: In the year of jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, to whom the land belongs as a possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, to the one who owned the land as a possession.
verses.textEnNlt: In the Year of Jubilee the field must be returned to the person from whom he purchased it, the one who inherited it as family property.
verses.textEnNasb: In the year of jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom he bought it, to whom the possession of the land belongs.
verses.textEn: In the Year of Jubilee the field will revert to the person from whom it was bought, the one whose land it was.

verses.textZh: 你的一切估价，都要照着圣所衡量银子的标准。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的一切估价，都要照着圣所衡量银子的标准。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡你所估定的价银都要按着圣所的平：二十季拉为一舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: Every value is to be set according to the sanctuary shekel, twenty gerahs to the shekel.
verses.textEnEsv: Every valuation shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall make a shekel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.
verses.textEnNlt: (All the payments must be measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel, which equals twenty gerahs.)
verses.textEnNasb: Every assessment of yours, moreover, shall be by the shekel of the sanctuary. The shekel shall be twenty gerahs.
verses.textEn: Every value is to be set according to the sanctuary shekel, twenty gerahs to the shekel.

verses.textZh: "唯独牲畜的头一胎，无论是牛或是羊，既然头一胎是属于耶和华的，人就不能再把牠分别为圣，因为这本是耶和华的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "唯独牲畜的头一胎，无论是牛或是羊，既然头一胎是属于耶和华的，人就不能再把牠分别为圣，因为这本是耶和华的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「惟独牲畜中头生的，无论是牛是羊，既归耶和华，谁也不可再分别为圣，因为这是耶和华的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘No one, however, may dedicate the firstborn of an animal, since the firstborn already belongs to the Lord ; whether an ox or a sheep, it is the Lord ’s.
verses.textEnEsv: "But a firstborn of animals, which as a firstborn belongs to the Lord , no man may dedicate; whether ox or sheep, it is the Lord ’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But the firstborn of the animals, which should be the Lord’s firstborn, no man shall dedicate; whether it is an ox or sheep, it is the Lord’s.
verses.textEnNlt: "You may not dedicate a firstborn animal to the Lord , for the firstborn of your cattle, sheep, and goats already belong to him.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘However, a firstborn among animals, which as a firstborn belongs to the Lord, no one may consecrate; whether ox or sheep, it is the Lord’s.
verses.textEn: " ‘No one, however, may dedicate the firstborn of an animal, since the firstborn already belongs to the Lord ; whether an ox or a sheep, it is the Lord ’s.

verses.textZh: 但如果是不洁净的牲畜，他就要按照你的估价，加上五分之一把牠赎回；如果不赎回，就要按照你的估价卖掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果是不洁净的牲畜，他就要按照你的估价，加上五分之一把牠赎回；如果不赎回，就要按照你的估价卖掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是不洁净的牲畜生的，就要按你所估定的价值加上五分之一赎回；若不赎回，就要按你所估定的价值卖了。
verses.textEnNiv: If it is one of the unclean animals, it may be bought back at its set value, adding a fifth of the value to it. If it is not redeemed, it is to be sold at its set value.
verses.textEnEsv: And if it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back at the valuation, and add a fifth to it; or, if it is not redeemed, it shall be sold at the valuation.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if it is an unclean animal, then he shall redeem it according to your valuation, and shall add one-fifth to it; or if it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.
verses.textEnNlt: However, you may buy back the firstborn of a ceremonially unclean animal by paying the priest’s assessment of its worth, plus 20 percent. If you do not buy it back, the priest will sell it at its assessed value.
verses.textEnNasb: But if it is among the unclean animals, then he shall redeem it according to your assessment and add to it a fifth of it; and if it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your assessment.
verses.textEn: If it is one of the unclean animals, it may be bought back at its set value, adding a fifth of the value to it. If it is not redeemed, it is to be sold at its set value.

verses.textZh: "一切永属耶和华的圣物，就是人永献给耶和华的物，无论是人或是牲畜，或是他承受作产业的田地，都不可以变卖，也不可以赎回；一切永献之物都是归耶和华为至圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "一切永属耶和华的圣物，就是人永献给耶和华的物，无论是人或是牲畜，或是他承受作产业的田地，都不可以变卖，也不可以赎回；一切永献之物都是归耶和华为至圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「但一切永献的，就是人从他所有永献给耶和华的，无论是人，是牲畜，是他承受为业的地，都不可卖，也不可赎。凡永献的是归给耶和华为至圣。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But nothing that a person owns and devotes to the Lord —whether a human being or an animal or family land—may be sold or redeemed; everything so devoted is most holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "But no devoted thing that a man devotes to the Lord , of anything that he has, whether man or beast, or of his inherited field, shall be sold or redeemed; every devoted thing is most holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Nevertheless no devoted offering that a man may devote to the Lord of all that he has, both man and beast, or the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed; every devoted offering is most holy to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "However, anything specially set apart for the Lord —whether a person, an animal, or family property—must never be sold or bought back. Anything devoted in this way has been set apart as holy, and it belongs to the Lord .
