verses.textEnNasb: ‘Nevertheless, anything which someone sets apart to the Lord for destruction out of all that he has, of man or animal or of the field of his own property, shall not be sold nor redeemed. Anything set apart for destruction is most holy to the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘But nothing that a person owns and devotes to the Lord —whether a human being or an animal or family land—may be sold or redeemed; everything so devoted is most holy to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 如果有人永献牲畜作永属耶和华的圣物，就不可赎回；必须把牠杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人永献牲畜作永属耶和华的圣物，就不可赎回；必须把牠杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡从人中当灭的都不可赎，必被治死。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘No person devoted to destruction may be ransomed; they are to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: No one devoted, who is to be devoted for destruction from mankind, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: No person under the ban, who may become doomed to destruction among men, shall be redeemed, but shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: No person specially set apart for destruction may be bought back. Such a person must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: No one who may have been set apart among mankind shall be ransomed; he must be put to death.
verses.textEn: " ‘No person devoted to destruction may be ransomed; they are to be put to death.

verses.textZh: "地上的一切，无论是地上的种子或是树上的果子，十分之一是耶和华的，是归给耶和华为圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "地上的一切，无论是地上的种子或是树上的果子，十分之一是耶和华的，是归给耶和华为圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「地上所有的，无论是地上的种子是树上的果子，十分之一是耶和华的，是归给耶和华为圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘A tithe of everything from the land, whether grain from the soil or fruit from the trees, belongs to the Lord ; it is holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Every tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the Lord ’s; it is holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord’s. It is holy to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "One-tenth of the produce of the land, whether grain from the fields or fruit from the trees, belongs to the Lord and must be set apart to him as holy.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now all the tithe of the land, of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord’s; it is holy to the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘A tithe of everything from the land, whether grain from the soil or fruit from the trees, belongs to the Lord ; it is holy to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 如果人一定要赎回这十分之一，除物价以外，还要加上五分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人一定要赎回这十分之一，除物价以外，还要加上五分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若要赎这十分之一的什么物，就要加上五分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever would redeem any of their tithe must add a fifth of the value to it.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man wishes to redeem some of his tithe, he shall add a fifth to it.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man wants at all to redeem any of his tithes, he shall add one-fifth to it.
verses.textEnNlt: If you want to buy back the Lord ’s tenth of the grain or fruit, you must pay its value, plus 20 percent.
verses.textEnNasb: If, therefore, someone should ever want to redeem part of his tithe, he shall add to it a fifth of it.
verses.textEn: Whoever would redeem any of their tithe must add a fifth of the value to it.

verses.textZh: 牛群和羊群的十分之一，就是一切从牧人杖下经过的，每第十只都是归耶和华为圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牛群和羊群的十分之一，就是一切从牧人杖下经过的，每第十只都是归耶和华为圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡牛群羊群中，一切从杖下经过的，每第十只要归给耶和华为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Every tithe of the herd and flock—every tenth animal that passes under the shepherd’s rod—will be holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And every tithe of herds and flocks, every tenth animal of all that pass under the herdsman’s staff, shall be holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And concerning the tithe of the herd or the flock, of whatever passes under the rod, the tenth one shall be holy to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Count off every tenth animal from your herds and flocks and set them apart for the Lord as holy.
verses.textEnNasb: For every tenth part of herd or flock, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth one shall be holy to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Every tithe of the herd and flock—every tenth animal that passes under the shepherd’s rod—will be holy to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 人不可理会是好或是坏，也不可把牠更换；如果一定要更换，本来的与更换的，都要分别为圣，不能赎回。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人不可理会是好或是坏，也不可把牠更换；如果一定要更换，本来的与更换的，都要分别为圣，不能赎回。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不可问是好是坏，也不可更换；若定要更换，所更换的与本来的牲畜都要成为圣，不可赎回。」
verses.textEnNiv: No one may pick out the good from the bad or make any substitution. If anyone does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute become holy and cannot be redeemed.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: One shall not differentiate between good or bad, neither shall he make a substitute for it; and if he does substitute for it, then both it and the substitute shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed."
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall not inquire whether it is good or bad, nor shall he exchange it; and if he exchanges it at all, then both it and the one exchanged for it shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You may not pick and choose between good and bad animals, and you may not substitute one for another. But if you do exchange one animal for another, then both the original animal and its substitute will be considered holy and cannot be bought back."
verses.textEnNasb: He is not to be concerned whether it is good or bad, nor shall he exchange it; yet if he does exchange it, then both it and its substitute shall become holy. It shall not be redeemed.’ "
verses.textEn: No one may pick out the good from the bad or make any substitution. If anyone does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute become holy and cannot be redeemed.’ "

verses.textZh: 以上这些就是耶和华在西奈山，为以色列人吩咐摩西的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些就是耶和华在西奈山，为以色列人吩咐摩西的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是耶和华在西奈山为以色列人所吩咐摩西的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the commands the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai for the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the commandments that the Lord commanded Moses for the people of Israel on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the commandments which the Lord commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the commands that the Lord gave through Moses on Mount Sinai for the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the commandments which the Lord commanded Moses for the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEn: These are the commands the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai for the Israelites.
